Students pay to have Lauren ramble on about business concepts that she does not embody like leadership and clear communication. Students are pretty much forced to be in unpaid internships against their will.

Terrible professor and even worse class. Do not take this class with Lauren. Lots of busy work and very unclear grading guidelines. Semester long project that requires you to meet every week outside of class time and record your meetings. TA dependent, if your TA is chill, you'll probably get a good grade. Otherwise, good luck.

This is class is the biggest waste of time/money I've spent while at college. Do not take this class with Lauren, take it with literally any other professor. The amount of time and work that is required for this class is insane. She is so unprepared and if you have a question and reach out to her, don't expect much clarification or an answer.

This professor was never prepared for a lecture. The class is just a project and is so much work for a 3 credit-hour class. The TAs will give you failing grades and do not expect a good grade. You better be in a good group project or your grade will suffer.

She doesn't teach you literally anything. She is a journalism major that just happens to teach a Business class for no apparent reason. I had a personal meeting where she dropped my grade 27% because I she got hurt from what I said in a team meeting. I never feel like I engage with this class and or learn anything at all. This class is 100% TA!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor is extremely UNQUALFIED and isn't clear at all through her expectations. Most assignments in this class are busy work for a grade, and have no meaning. I would not choose this professor because she is extremely unhelpful and doesn't care for the students. All she cares about is putting grades in the grade book that don't stand true.
This professor although enthusiastic is not great at communicating with her class and when students face difficulties they are not usually solved.

Don't take this class. Blames any issues in the class on the students, is never prepared for class. Group project was useless and didn't learn anything from the entire course. Your grade will depend on how relaxed your TA is with grading. Dr. Brengarth was very unprofessional and inaccessible outside of class.

BA3500 could be a good class. However the workload was WAY too much for 2 credit hours. It cost me more time than all of my other classes combined. The lectures were useless towards project and class content. Guidelines about assignments were vague. My TA gave my group the wrong information often, graded us unfairly, and did not provide help.

Lectures are completely useless but are required attendance. Graded on a massive, semester-long group project that takes many hours outside of class to complete. She assigned my group a project that didn't meet the class requirements and we had to start over halfway through. Even though it was her mistake, we were graded very harshly. TA dependent.

By far the worst professor ive had. Lectures are beyond boring but if you stay until the last minute they randomly will give an assignment to you or give a point. They release grades so late, only care about her reputation. You have to do a project all semester and they expect them to be perfect but professors suck. Got an A bc my chill ta though.

This class is absolutely ridiculous and unnecessary. So much so that I am wiring my first review on here. You learn nothing and do not have any contact with the professors. Your entire grade is based on a group project that requires S. O. much time out of class. Worst class I've ever taken.

Terrible course. Full of busywork and useless assignments. Busywork prevents students from completing the group project that should be the bulk of the course. Instruction are always unclear. Course should be worth more than two hours with how much work is required. Assigned articles are un-readable. Goal is to boost TCOB funding not students.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: She really cares about her students. She is easy to reach out too and you can tell she really has a passion for teaching. A lot of the projects we did do not matter outside of college but that just what college is. i did not realize it at the time but the work that we did in this class strengthen my resume and improved my linked in

Projects every week, most of them don't matter outside college. Articles and Tedtalks that I couldn't watch because you had to pay for them, which were what our quizzes were based on. Grading criteria not clear, and ta's were of no help.

reviews.comment: If you enjoy listening to right wing ideals be shoved down your throat while also listening to useless information that you will never use again, go ahead and enroll for MANGMT 4140w. Had her for BA 3500 as well and thought she couldnt get any worse. I was wrong

I can say this sadly, but it is true, that I have not learned A SINGLE USEFUL THING in this course. The intentions are good but the execution and learning experience in this class is very poor and needs major improvement. I took this during the Fall of 2020 and I did not think this class was helpful AT ALL. Very disappointing...

The whole class is mostly just a group project with a few busy work assignments sprinkled in. Most of the assignments have unclear instructions. Nothing in this class is useful to the outside world and it should be 3 credit hours, not 2.

BA 1500 thru 3500 are completely worthless. I had Brengarth for all three. Its all busy work and learning material like "learning to work with others". My 2 credit hour class required more attention than the normal 3 credit hour classes. The Edge program is just another service/class for Mizzou to make a requirement and sell to you unfortunately.
She straight up sucks. DO NOT TAKE HER if you can. She makes everything 10x harder then it needs to be.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This was one of the most useless classes I have taken, I did not learn one thing. The grading is harsh when no clear criteria is given what so ever. Attendance is mandatory but the weekly assignments are easy. The group project through service learning is basically your entire grade and everything is all just busy work.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She doesn't offer any grading criteria and grades quite harshly (nitpicking things that were never explained). There was minimal to no instruction or feedback, like being taught by a brick wall. When asked how to operate equipment (broadcast) and what the assignment was, she responded with "There's this thing, it's called Google." Rude and useless.

Assignments are all graded at an extremely tough level and no instructions or feedback are given. Due dates change, and assignments come out of nowhere.

reviews.comment: Although it is only a 2 credit class, it has more work than all my other courses combined. There is no useful content in the course whatsoever, it is all pointless busywork. reviews.comment: Terrible course and professor. The material you learn in this class is absolutely useless, and Professor Brengarth does nothing to enhance the experience. She also treated us like children, assigning us seating and holding your hand along the way. She seems like a nice lady, but the class the lacked purpose and meaning that she tried to instill.
So much work for a two credit hour class.

reviews.comment: The class was overall super unorganized and there didn't seem to be a plan most days. Also, since it's a writing class, the grading was pretty subjective. However, it was always a good time, Dr. Baker is a great guy. Super easy class (considering it's a 3000 level chem class).

Funniest professor I have had at Mizzou. The content can be pretty boring, but his humor and enthusiasm makes it bearable. He really knows how to relate to his students and the class was structured with a quiz after each class that was online. Hardest part about this class was the lab, but they are manageable. Highly recommend for your chem minor.

easy grader, but won't respond to emails for a few days. all assignments were given to us at the beginning of the semester with the due dates. he doesn't put grades in often so you might be waiting till the end of the semester for most of them. it was in covid era so we didn't even have class, just a paper due every week. 2 pages max

Quant lab is hard, but the lectures with Baker are super easy. He gives you major hints every class about what questions will be on the test, and as long as you pay attention to those and do the practice problems in the book, you'll do just fine.

I needed a 4000-level poli sci class for my major and after reading other reviews on here, I decided to take his peacekeeping class. Cannot stress enough how happy I am I did! Professor Reeder is hilarious and engaging, always answers questions and communicates, and his tests are about actually LEARNING the content. 15/10, would take again!!

Dr. Reeder was a wonderful professor. This was my first PoliSci class, so I was a bit nervous and unsure whether or not I would go forward with the subject. His class was not easy and was heavy with readings, but everything was manageable yet challenging! I declared a PoliSci grad minor after this course! :)
Dr. Reeder was great. Easy on the eyes and really kind to students. Have taken three classes from him and wish there were more I could take.
Great professor. Loves what he teaches about, and would definitely take his class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: This class requires a fair amount of work, but the topic was nothing like other Mizzou classes offer so it was really refreshing. Reeder is so nice, wants you to succeed, and care about the world. He is SO helpful and will even point you in the right direction if you are struggling. I appreciated the humor in his lectures, since they could be long
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Amazing lectures--So many papers

reviews.comment: Overall, I really enjoyed Reeders online class. I can tell he would be even better in person! It helps that the topic is super interesting. Only complaint is that the grading was pretty tough, especially considering there really arent any lower level classes students could have taken before this one on the subject.

Professor Reeder is a gem. His classes make you care about the world and makes you question your own place in the world. He is so funny, so caring, and so approachable. I wish I could go to college again just to major in political science to spend more time with him.

Reeder is an amazing professor. He is intelligent, attractive and easy to ask questions to. Make sure the teaching assistant is good or grading might be a problem. But he did a good job handing problems. I would take this class again and again because lectures are so good.

Professor Reeder is one of the best professors I have ever had at Mizzou. He does assign a lot of readings but he'll make it clear which ones you'll be tested on. He is effortlessly funny and will reward you for participating in class. I took another class of his despite not being a poli sci major purely because I loved his teaching style.
Good guy who cares for students. Treats all comments with respect and works with you to get better.

I loved this class with prof. Reeder. He was great at explaining more complex theories and topics. He also made sure to respect and validate everyones opinions. The readings each week were relatively extensive but make more sense if you attend lecture. Very interesting and enjoyable class!

Very fun and engaging professor, he made sure everyone who wanted to got to speak up during class. He also hands out a lot of extra credit for those who attend lectures and is very accommodating to those who have questions.
Grade is solely based on midterm, final, lab attend./part. and a paper. Test are easy but you HAVE to study the slides (which he posts on line). Attendance is not required for lecture but is for lab.
Very good prof that is keeps class fun.  Show up and you do well.
Class is entertaining gives chances to get loads of extra credit easy. If you show up and do the work you pass.

Her instructions are extremely long for assignments, but somehow still unclear. She is picky about a lot of things, so read the fine print. She loves to do group assignments for essays, which is difficult since it is an online class. The exams are atrociously difficult, with only 75 minutes for over 90 questions. I do NOT recommend this class.

reviews.comment: This class is atrocious. I have never in my life had a 3-hour lecture video until this class. The amount of group work is infuriating. Exams are insanely difficult with random details. It is way too much work. Instructions on assignments are 3 pages long, with extremely detailed things done in highly specific ways. timely with email
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Difficult tests and quizzes. felt like she made questions harder on purpose to bring down the average. You can do a lot of work for this class, just to have your grade lowered because she gives hard exams. She is also unclear about many assignments.
She makes tests and quizzes very difficult. She is kind and very knowledgeable, but it will take a lot of work to get a good grade. Not much room for error if you want to get an A.

Dr. Bowman has high expectations for her students. However, if you communicate with her, she is very caring and understanding. Some of her quizzes are excessive and her final is a group project despite being an online course. She does require a ton of reading and lecture, however she grades quite fairly. I enjoyed her class more than I expected
Extremely long lectures, hard assignments, hard grader.

Long lectures and tough quizzes and tests. Very hard to get an A. There are no free points or extra credit; you just need to do well on the tests and assignments every week. Very hard to get an A on the weekly quizzes. Very knowledgeable, but take a different professor if you want to get a good grade.

This class typically had a quiz and about three lectures a week that were long and boring. The exams were difficult and no one ever got a 100. She doesn't curve grades and the month that she covers insurance is homework heavy. There is a group project toward the end of the semester plus a final exam. The content can be difficult to understand.

This class was online and she had 2 one and a half lectures weekly along with other videos and reading. The course was pretty difficult as some of the quizzes did not go along with the lectures. There was a group project, and rarely was there a 100% given in the course. Content was interesting, but way too drawn out.

No one ever received a 100% on any tests or significant projects. Her lecture videos were over 2 hours long every week along with almost 5+ hours of reading and a quiz due every Sunday night. Said quiz was only worth 10 points but had 20 questions that would go over the hours of materials from the week. Overall it was a lot of unnecessary readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Her presentations are horrendous and brutal to read and there is a lot of supplementary material she expects you to read/ watch on top of long lecture videos. The slides she provides are always a little off from the videos.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I absolute love Prof Bowman's classes. She was also a very understanding and kind professor though her class was pretty difficult. There was a lot of reading and a lot of work but overall, she was very open and a great communicator.

Professor Bowman was a very nice and respectable person overall. However, her class was pretty difficult. Some of the exam questions did not match up with the lectures she provided, which made the exams very difficult. Nobody ever got 100%. Lots of reading from the textbook and weekly quizzes (which are easy). Just make sure to WATCH LECTURES!

She is VERY nice and knowledgeable. However, too much time is spent on unnecessary instructions. Her syllabus needs its own syllabus; it is that long. Her efforts to give detailed instructions are often frustrated by contradictions. Parts of her tests/quizzes are wrong and should be peer reviewed and you cannot see the tests to challenge them.
She is very knowledgeable about her subjects, but has too many group projects. She is nice though, and actually does seem to care about her students.

This class was supposed to be easier compared to orgo and cell bio, but it wasn't. It is completely online and had so much to do. The weekly quizzes are easy, but the exams and written assignments are hard. Very picky graders. Not an easy A class, you have to work for it. She is very organized though and keeps good communication for it being online
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: BEST professor. She has worked in multiple different positions in healthcare and has a vast and detailed knowledge of her courses. Truly inspiring, fair, and makes you want to learn. She's the reason I changed my major/emphasis. Compassionate and very caring of students--FANTASTIC TO TALK TO! She makes you work for your grade, but everything's fair

She is a great professor who brings real life stories in to her lecture and actually keep you interested. however, you shouldn't take clinical ethics with her; there is a lot of work involved and the level of difficulty is high. If you don't have several free hours per week to dedicate to this class i recommend taking it with another professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She is by far one of the best professors I have ever had. I had to switch majors and I was not looking forward to the classes I was required to take; she made me love my new major. She brings in her own real life experiences and you never want her to stop telling her stories. She makes you work hard, but it will helps you become a better doctor.

Dr. Bowman was my favorite teacher at Mizzou. I took 2 classes with her (healthcare in the U.S. and ethics, both of which I learned a lot of useful information in. She is such a nice teacher and really cares about her student's success. She is always available outside of class to help you, personally or related to class. Would highly recommend her.
Professor Bowman is not only a great teacher, she is an amazing person. She listens to her students and cares about their lives. I would take any class that Bowman has. LOVED HER.

Possibly the best professor I have ever had. Excellent listener, really good at talking to during office hours, very understanding, very nice. Grading is fair and she uses class input to adjust lectures and schedule. For example, she moved a Monday exam to Wednesday because it was after the weekend of Homecoming.

Professor Bowman was, hands down, the best professor I've had in my 3 years at Mizzou. Her class is challenging - There is a lot of information to learn. But she explains it all perfectly and gives many examples and stories from her own career. I will definitely take another class with her if I get the chance.
Professor Bowman truely cares about her students. Her classes are relevant, current, and she makes it interesting. I would frequently go out of my way to talk to her. She is always willing to help!

She was a great teacher, really made you understand the material as long as you went to class and took notes on the power points.  She's also always very willing to help you.  I would take her class again.
Great teacher; I really enjoyed my time in the class. Although I only received a B in the course, that had more to do with me than her.
Very nice professor. Exams cover what is discussed in class. Some group projects, graded somewhat leniently. Very experienced in the health field, I enjoyed her ethics class the most.

Dr. Belt is definitely a professor that you want to have for all of your calculus classes.  I have had him for Calc 1, 2, and 3, and it was definitely worth it.  You can tell he loves what he does based off how well he teaches calculus. He is the GOAT

Do the practice tests and you're good. Discussions and iClicker questions will be on the test. The tests are like 70% of your overall grade. He is a really good teacher if you pay attention and go to the classes. If you miss a few, then you will have some trouble catching back up. He teaches the content very quickly.
Honestly one of the best teachers I've had. He has a very dry sense of humor but it comes out really funny. Always willing to help, and grades very fairly.
One of the best math professors I have had to teach this course. Highly recommend.

I am writing this review after taking Calc 2 and Calc 3. Professor Belt used so much visualizations in his lectures and it took me 2 semesters to realize how good I had it. Professor Belt is my best professor thus far

Dr. Belt is a wonderful teacher. If you go to class and pay attention in lectures, you will do good in the class. He is very supportive if you ask for help. There is homework over all lectures and a worksheet and quiz each week, these will help cushion your grade for tests, and he sets you up well for tests at review sessions.

Absolutely amazing professor. The course is incredibly well organized and carefully laid out. The lectures are incredibly structured, and he does a great job at articulating the information. Like others have stated previously, he's got the course down to a science.
Go to the TA discussions, that's where you learn everything and where a lot of your grade comes from, don't make the same mistake as me, but Belt is a great professor

Probably the best math teacher I have ever had. Be sure to put in the work; this class will be hard if you don't stay focused. He makes his lectures very engaging, and I find myself laughing from time to time. His introduction to the product and quotient rule was hilarious. I won't spoil it for those getting ready to take the class.

I took this class without taking math for a year, and I was prepared. He is really funny, but moves at a very fast pace, to where my friend and I had a hard time writing down the equations. It would help if your TA would explained things thoroughly; however, I was unlucky on that end too. The tests are a massive chunk of your grade, so do well!!!!!
Amazing professor who really cares about his students.  Lectures are easy to understand, and the course/homework assignments are extremely well organized.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The lectures were really easy to follow but make sure to study for each exam, it was my exam average that pulled my grade down, the homework's and daily work were easy enough

Was very communicative and understanding to any situation that would arise during the semester. Class lectures were encouraged since they were for a small grade however, I guess they weren't necessarily mandatory. 

He's the goat.

Amazing professor. You can tell he enjoys what he teaches. Lectures are clear and easy to follow. Discussions have quizzes you can use notes and worksheets you can work with others. Need to study for the exams they can be difficult if not prepared.

He is very knowledgeable and good at explaining things. He tries to make lectures as entertaining as math can be. Weekly quizzes, but you can use your notes and work with others. Weekly homework that is a lot harder than lectures, but makes the exams easier. Exams are not terrible, but you definitely need to study. Overall a really good professor.
He's the goat

Dr. Belt is very precise with teaching what's important, he makes everything very fun to learn and constantly does engaging hilarious things that keeps the momentum going in class. All the homework is a copy of what we did in class and while attendance is graded through iClickr he does it every day so you won't be affected too much.

Calculus was very confusing to me, but Professor Belt was very good at explaining during lectures. He gave us multiple practice exams we could practice before our actual exam. Very helpful. He sang during multiple lectures; it was awesome.

Literally one of the best teachers I've ever had. Engaging, Witty, and eager to help if you show up to his office hours (assuming you're the only one there, which isn't impossible depending on which one you go to.) Made Calc 1 tolerable and then some. Absolute legend!

His lectures are amazing and he is just genuinely a nice guy. He explains things in a very concise way. His homework's are also very simple in the aspect of it's exactly what we did in class. His exams are also exactly what was gone over in class. Overall a g.

Belt is a great professor for Calc one. His lectures are pretty interesting and he sometimes will do something interesting like sing a song or play an instrument. Taking notes during his lectures are not difficult. There are lots of drop assignments and the tests were almost all curved.

Dr. Belt's teaching style is amazing. He integrates iClicker into the classes to make sure students understand the material. He made me understand things my high school calculus teacher could not. I recommend taking Dr. Belt's classes if given the choice.
I taught Calculus One very well, and it made math fun and enjoyable. I highly recommend Belt; his tests are all multiple-choice, and the practice exams are very similar to the actual exams.

Dr. Belt is one of my favorite professors! I took calc in high school but didn't grasp the concepts very well, but Belt made it super easy to understand. He's engaging and makes the lecture fun sometimes. 3 homeworks a week (one per lecture). That wasn't bad for me but it could be different for others. Attendance is taken via iClicker quizzes.
This dude is the goat

I took this course online and it went pretty smoothly. Grades were made up mostly of exams, with homework assignments, quizzes, and video assignments as a good grade booster. Exams covered many different concepts, but pretty basic questions for each topic. Considering how confusing calculus is, this class was relatively easy given the curriculum.

Belt is a good guy, but goes very very fast during the lectures. It can be hard to keep up when taking notes. Curves the grades a lot though which is nice. When studying make sure you take ALL the practice exams, they are very similar to the actual exam. The exams are difficult because you have limited time to do big calculations. No calculator.

Dr. Belt's lectures are very good. He is great at explaining the material and provides tons of resources for studying for the exams. Attendance is important, there is an iClicker every lecture and an iClicker or Quiz every discussion and they all add up pretty quick if you perform poorly on them.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Belt is perhaps the best professor in the entire math department at MU. He gives engaging lectures for calculus (even singing for the class while playing ukulele one time). Homework is about what you'd expect from a math class, tests have good review material beforehand, the difficulty of the class is based on how fast you catch on to calc.

Made Calc 1 very bearable, amazing lectures that keep you invested and help you actually learn the material. Discussions are hit or miss and very much depend on the TA but I had good experiences there. Overall amazing teacher.
Very funny and charismatic professor. He's very knowledgeable and helpful when you have questions.
Professor Belt is an amazing professor, who is very good explaining concepts and keeping his class interesting. Overall one of my favorite professors so far.

Professor Belt is a very good professor. He explains things in a manner that everyone can understand, is quite humerous at times, and gives out fair exam questions. He's also a great singer! I would 100% take a class with him again! 🙂
Dude is a straight pimp. I am excited to go to my boi Dustin's class every day. Would take his class 100/100 times.
Interesting lectures. explained concepts well. great singer

The lectures were well organized and comprehensive. He covers everything you need to know and in a way that is easy to follow. The exams are fair and practice exams are provided which are similar to the problems you will encounter on the test.

Dr. Belt is probably one of the best math professors I have ever had. I took his MATH1300 course my first year at Mizzou in person and had no complaints. This summer I took MATH1500 online and his format was almost exactly like MATH1300. Tests are multiple choice, lots of homework but doesn't effect grade much if you don't finish.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Belt was one of the best professors! I had zero calc experience walking in, and he made the lectures understandable and very clear. Exams are just like homework problems, and true/false questions on the exams are taken directly from lecture. He offers so much extra help, and truly looks out for every student!

I took Calc 1 online and overall I would do it again. Tests are proctored do what you will with that info. There are roughly three videos, HW assignments, and tiny quizzes per week. You do need to put a lot of effort in to do well but overall Belt is a great professor and is great at explaining his steps when he does problems!

Belt is awesome. He does iclickers during lectures, with 3 homeworks, a quiz and a worksheet each week. The homework assignments can be quite difficult, and long. The quizzes and worksheets were pretty easy. Exams are somewhere in between. They are multiple choice so no chance for partial credit. Overall a very good professor.

as a business major who doesn't enjoy math that often - this guy is genuinely fantastic. coursework is slightly intensive, but he teaches complicated concepts so easily that doing it feels like a cakewalk. one of the best professors i've had the pleasure of being taught by.
Amazing professor, very chill person. As long as you pay attention in class and complete the homework, shouldn't be too hard.

A pretty cool guy. Honestly I could've paid better attention during the lectures but from when I was, he was a very effective professor. There is a decent amount of homework but it's not too bad. And the practice exams are super helpful.

Professor Belt is an awesome professor. As long as you are attending class or watching the lecture videos he post, you will pass this class with ease. The material is not too difficult, you just have to stay ahead and be attendant. He provides ample opportunities to get help if you need it.

Lectures are great, there will be iclicker questions that contribute to your overall grade. Professor is caring, even if he does look like. Takes exams and review sessions seriously. Explains everything in and out during review sessions. All you have to do is sit and focus. Lectures are never boring, always with experiments.

Professor Belt is a sweetheart. He makes math engaging and teaches well. He is very good at explaining the same concept in at least 2 methods to help make sure that you can understand the material. He is the best!
Teaches Calculus Amazingly

He was a very good professor. He lectures with iPad slides, so it goes a bit quickly, but he posts videos so you can go back after. Tests were extremely similar to questions on the homework and his review was very helpful. Overall great guy

Belt was very passionate about the material during lectures and explained the proofs and applications BEFORE showing examples to the class leading to an all around understanding of the material going into the homeworks. There are 3 homework assignments a week that are about 20 questions usually and doing them all the day of will take 3-5 hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Goes a little fast in lectures BUT he does record them so we can rewatch later. Overall a good teacher, seems to want us to succeed.
Great Teacher
got thrown into the class halfway through the semester, still the GOAT of professors.
Lives up to his great reputation on campus. It is obvious that he tries to make lectures engaging and entertaining, and in my opinion he succeeded in doing so.

Lectures are funny at times, and Mr.Belt finds unique ways to get his point across. I had already taken calculus in high school, so the material was easy for me. However, it probably would have required a lot more time from me if I didn't. The homework assignments oftentimes take a while because the answers start to get long. (12-23 questions).
This man is amazing, not only as a teacher, but as a person. He tries his very best to help you succeed.

Love Prof Belt, I had him for Calc 1 and again online in summer (Calc 2). It was tough but he explains very thoroughly and grades clearly. He also cares and responds quickly! I forgot to turn in the last assignment of the course and emailed him 2 days before the semester ended; he reopened it for me and I got a perfect grade. Amazing professor :)
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved Dr. Belt. I'm just bad at calculus, which is why I didn't get a good grade. He's very entertaining and makes the lectures not miserable. I would retake Calc 1 just to have him as a prof. He even brought in his guitar to teach us songs about how to remember certain math rules.

Dustin's teaching style for the online class was mainly online lectures as you would assume, but the online lectures were all 30+ minutes with very little useful content. He also doesn't show his steps well on examples, and has not written notes to follow so you have to follow the lecture or you have nothing to go off of.

He's got a great and very interactive teaching style, I'm just bad at math so I didn't do well. If you want to get iClicker points (13ish%) of your grade, you need to go to class. He's pretty good at pacing with teaching. His exams are great cause it's just whatever you learn from the last final to this one. ie we didn't have a comprehensive final
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Fun lectures, nice professor. The multiple choice tests were brutal for me, I spent a week studying practice problems for 2 to 3 hours a night in preparation for the final (not cumulative) and only got a 52% on it. But I'm exceptionally bad at calculus, if you're reading this you'll probably do fine.

He is a great guy and the lecture part of the class wasn't bad, Tests were not too bad, and he gave nice practice tests for them. DO NOT SKIP HW. It dropped my grade more than I thought because I thought they didn't mean much to my grade but I was wrong. If you pay attention in class and don't fall behind u can def get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took Calc I in high school and I think I just didn't prepare enough for his exams. Otherwise the class is an easy A. Show up to lecture, do the HW, and you'll have so many points that if you do bad on an exam you can recover from it

Even if you hate math you'll love Belt. He clearly wants his students to succeed. Lectures are great, show his understanding of the subject and methods used in the class, as well as include a few jokes that always land. Prepare for hard exams with no curve, tedious but easy homework, iClicker for a grade during lectures, and a great professor.
Has a clear syllabus, class is not difficult but is by no means easy. Belt has some subtle humor in his lectures which can make them a lot better if you can catch it.
Made a horrible class good

He's one of the best math professors at Mizzou. I've had him for both Math 1500 and Math 2300 and both classes were excellent. His lectures are always very clear and he gives great examples. The homework assignments are a little long, but they aren't too terrible.

Uses iClicker, and correctness counts for points. This means you can't miss class, but oftentimes he gives the answer before closing submission so don't worry if you're bad at math. He's pretty funny though, and definitely wants you to succeed. Pretty generous late work policy, drops lowest scores. Exams were all online/mostly multiple choice.

The class is challenging but Dustin's teaching makes up for it. Class is weighted 60% exams, 20% homework, 20% video assignments. Exams are multiple choice and you get a cheat sheet for the exam. He curved the grade of our class which helped me out a ton. The exams are very hard though so make sure not to fall behind.

Great teacher overall! He's a great introduction to college and makes it less intimidating. Objectives are clearly laid out and practice exams mimic the real exam. He's very friendly and cares about his students and is willing to work with them. One of the best teachers!

Dustin is the best mathematics professor I have ever had. I took Calculus 1 at another university and barely passed it. Took it at Mizzou and passed with flying colors. He explained concepts in a way that my previous professor was never willing to do. I was extremely engaged and demonstrated a willingness to relearn the material.

Professor Belt is someone you want to take for Calc I. I had him last semester and he made the subject bearable. Tests were multiple choice (they're not tricky if you studied well) and homework could be submitted right before the end of the semester. You don't want to miss out on a single lecture either. It'll be rough at first but you will be fine
As long as you show up the class is very easy. He makes boring calculus somewhat fun and is easily accessible outside class. Very clear on what is expected.

Professor Belt is incredible. He somehow made calculus lectures entertaining. His incredible understanding of techniques is obvious. There is a lot of points outside of just tests. He puts all lectures on zoom so even if you can't be there in class you won't fall behind and you can still receive full class points even while virtual.
made math fun to go to

belt is a great professor. he explains material in perfect detail that is easy to understand. class is pretty hw heavy but if u keep up with it, no worries. i always struggled with the T&F on exams but they were standard exams. in lecture he uses real life examples as much as possible and that helped me personally. loved belt and you will too.

Belt is awesome, he makes it to where you can get whatever grade you really try for. If you want an A you can get it. With extremely minimal effort I ended up with a B+. There is a lot of homework and it can sometimes be extremely difficult but the tests are much, much easier than the homework and he does a thorough review before each test.

Took AP Calc AB in high school, so this was basically review for me. Belt made class fun and engaging, so I wasn't bored. Exams are way easier than the homework, and are exactly like the practice exams. He doesn't take off points for late work, but there's participation in every lecture through iClicker.

Mr. Belt is a great guy. He's great at his lectures, and is relatively approachable if you need any assistance. There are 3 assignments in Calc 1 per week (I per lecture), which isn't ideal for a busy schedule, but the discussion hour allows you to get extra help and clarification to get you the grade you want. Would definitely recommend.
Such a caring professor. He makes calculus easy to understand and even fun. He sings for his students and always has a fun anecdote. Would fake the class again just for fun.
He is amazing! His class is a little difficult if you havent taken Calc before but its good. Test are a bit difficult. Tons of homework but not strict due date.

I had Belt for Calc 1 (online) in Fall 2020 and the way he uses Canvas is amazing... under every lecture video module there is practice problems for us to try out which were similar to questions on the exams/quizzes he also gave practice exams but they were not entirely similar to the actual exam.
10/10 would take again
Amazing professor, even though this class meets 5 days a week, he makes every lesson worth it.
I took this class over the summer and it was a lot of work. I barely got an A in this class so be prepared to work hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Belt is a great professor, he really seems to care about students and was extremely accommodating for an online class during a pandemic. Calculus is hard, but he taught in a way that made everything easy to understand. The homework is tedious and kind of sucks, but it's really good preparation for the exams.

I had belt for Calc 2 and his tests were fair but the webassigns were hard... the examples given in his lectures were easier than the ones on webassign Adding on when Belt record his lectures sometimes he makes conclusions without mentioning how he made that conclusion Overall, Belt is a good professor but makes his webassigns ironically hard
Belt is amazing! Take any math classes you can with him! I still sing his quotient rule song to take derivatives to this day. He literally performed it on his ukulele

Professor Belt is truly a wonderful teacher. His class is very well organized and he really does a great job teaching the material in ways that suit every type of learner. Class has an organized structure and due dates are the same every week. Exams are nice but if you are gonna do your WebAssign all in one day, be prepared to work for 6-7 hours

Prof Belt is a chill guy and knows what he's teaching but he makes his lectures easier than the WebAssigns which will be 20x harder than the lectures... so I suggest do all the examples from the WebAssign and lecture because questions from those were similar to exams he also throws in some T or F questions so actually watch the lectures

Dr. Belt made a very difficult class so much easier and I loved his class. The WebAssign sheets were very self explanatory and if you need help with something he is more than happy to explain it. If you are taking a calculus 1500 class I would recommend Dr. Belt.

Prof belt is amazing, exams are similar to the lectures but the homework's can be tedious he'll put things not covered in the lecture and he might put 1-2 similar homework questions into the exams but most of the exams are similar to the lectures also watch out for T or F questions he puts on the exams... watch the lectures carefully!!

Prof Belt's lectures were always concise and to the point, and he obviously knew what he was talking about and explained it very well. Prof Belt is the definition of a true homie, and he rounded my final grade up from a 86.9 to a 90 (when i asked him to round it to a 87 lol).

Professor Belt was the calculus teacher of my dreams. His performances (although some call them lectures) were filled with everything from wizard hats to cupcakes. His class may have been entirely online and asynchronous but I felt entirely comfortable thanks to his dreamy teaching abilities.

He's a good guy and he knows what he's talking about. Calculus II is hard, but he teaches in a way that makes it a lot easier to understand. I think I could've gotten a much higher grade if I was able to spend more time working on things for this class. WebAssign and the worksheets can be a bit tedious, though.

Dr. Belt knows what he's talking about but he's great at putting things in the homework that he didn't cover in the lecture. The WebAssign and worksheets every single week get old. The whole class was honestly just a pain and I'm glad it's over.

Visiting student here--I took Belt Summer 2020 and the guy really has mastered Canvas which made learning completely online so much easier. I wasn't optimistic going into this course because I had failed Calc II twice before but I actually did well in this class and I learned a lot. Trust me--if you're afraid of Calc II but you have Belt, don't be.
Despite how difficult the class is, Belt does a great job at at least trying to make it fun and enjoyable. His famous ukulele session is legendary. He's a funny dude and great lecturer.

I took the summer online version of Professor Belt's Calculus 2. His absolute mastery of canvas and comfortable class format made even a beast like calc 2 manageable even while working and still enjoying summer. Take his tests and homework seriously. Every point and question will count in the long run.

Prof Belt is a really great teacher, you will definitely miss him when taking calc II. His tests are very straight forward and as long as you do the practice exams and the homework you should be fine but watch out for some random true/false or multiple-choice questions that are over the stuff you talked about briefly in lecture.

If math is not your forte, then yes, you might find this class difficult. However, Professor Belt is an incredibly amazing professor. He will help you get the grade you want to get. His lectures are very straight-forward, incredible teaching style, very friendly. If you're taking math classes, take as many classes from Belt as you can.

Great professor!! Really wants everyone to be successful in his class by giving them all the resources they need. 10 quizzes, 14 HW, 4 exams, iclicker. Drop 2 quiz, 2 HW, & 2 iclicker. If you have 85% on HW & iclicker then you drop lowest exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This was my first calc class at university, and I am so glad he was my professor. Answers any and all questions, his lectures are always very engaging and funny.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: he gives good examples of problems that would be on an exam and he explains things very well
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: What a great teacher, he makes calculus easy to understand and explains WHY things work instead of just asking you to memorize formulas. Took calculus 1 in high school and learned nothing, but now I feel very comfortable after taking his class.

Dr. Belt was the best calculus teacher I could have hoped for. He was very accommodating for my flights and illnesses, and really cared that the students understood the material. He is very knowledgeable and the class is fast-paced, but if you get lost, the TAs are wonderful and happy to help. An amazing experience for a challenging subject.
Hes a great professor

Professor Belt is a great professor, and I'd recommend him to anyone. He's clear about expectations and runs his classes well. He's also easily accessible outside of class. Show up to lectures, because it's difficult to decipher his notes, even if you're sitting in class and attendance is mandatory.

I should start with his eyes. The way they sparkle when he talks of maximums and minimums. How his voice booms through the lecture hall and fills your soul with an undying passion for second derivatives. The subtle assertiveness you sense when given a tough grade, but you understand because you know you would never be good enough for Dustin Belt..

Dr. Belt is the way to go for Calc 1. Lots of people retake Calculus 1, like me, and if you retake, you're in good hands. If you've never taken calculus, you're still in good hands. Belt is very patient, thorough, and organized. Amazing Canvas page to help yourself stay on task. Show up, study the practice exams, ask questions, and you'll succeed!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Amazing lectures--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He is funny, helpful and intelligent. And all around good instructor.

I took AP calculus in high school and barely passed. I took Dr. Belt this semester and all of sudden every thing was explained clearly and very easy to understand terms. Very unlike my highschool teacher. He is amazing at what he does. He goes slow enough for kids who don't understand but fast enough for kids who do.

Dustin Belt really is a calc god. Go to every class if you haven't taken Calculus before. The practice exams are useful for learning material, but will likely not be very similar to the exam you are given. There will also be a small curve at the end of the semester, but don't count on this to change your grade much. An 88 is an A- this semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dustin is a Clac God and really breaks what could be a hard a scary subject down and makes it easy. You should really study and start doing his practice problems about 4-5 days before the test and if you can memorize what the answers are and how to get them or just understand how the homework problems should be solved you will pass for sure.

Professor Belt actually made it enjoyable to go to a calculus class, which is not what most students would probably say. He could move fast at times, but having 2 discussions per week made it easier to break down slowly. One drawback is that his practice tests aren't very comprehensive, so prepare to do extra work.
Lectures were easy to learn from and practice exams were very helpful

Dr. Belt is a great choice for Calculus 1 (Math 1500) students. He teaches all material very thoroughly and prepares you well for each exam. It is important to come to each lecture because each section is only covered in one class period, so it would be very easy to fall behind if you start skipping classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: This was my first time taking calc. While it is a challenging course, I couldn't have asked for a better professor. He explained clearly and gave fair tests, even though they can be challenging.  You typically get 3 HW a week, but it is for a grade and helps you learn so I found the HW to be beneficial. Overall, I highly recommend this professor.
Good, solid choice. Couldn't have asked for a better first math professor.

Dustin Belt was wonderful and infinitely better than my calc teacher in high school. The guy has a super chill no bs attitude and witty dry humor. He breaks things down step by step and explains concepts super clearly. The tests in this class are very fair but can be challenging. It's really easy to lose a ton of points b/c of silly mistakes.
Very very good at explaining information with examples. I'd highly recommend for calculus 1 students!

Prof. Belt has been a great first impression of Mizzou.  I would highly recommend taking his class.  He is very willing to work with students and wants the bests for everyone.  I recommend you go to office hours and get to know him, he's great!!
Calculus is a tough subject especially calc 2 and 3, if you are going to take it I recommend taking it with this professor
He's great! will open up his office at any time just ask! A great great great great guy!

Benton Kidd's AMS2030 course has been my all-time favorite course so far in college. He is clearly passionate about the subject matter and is very knowledgeable. There is a textbook, but it is not mandatory. There are only 4 assignments throughout the semester, being 4 quizzes, and no homework. If you go to class and pay attention, you'll do great!

Professor Kidd is such a caring professor, and you can tell he's passionate about mythology. His lecture slides are really interesting, and I've never skipped any of his classes because he's so good at reading stories and explaining them. The textbook is required, but it's mainly useful if you want to read all the stories and extra facts in detail.

Only thing to consider about this class is it's test based , but there are no assignment, paper or anything , only four exams, but the exam questions are very easy and a good exam review material will be provided. I liked this class a lot.This was the only class that I wanted to go to lectures even tho attendance was not mandatory.

His lecturing skill is so good, lectures were so interesting that i didn't want to skip any. She has a very good sense of humor and makes lectures interesting with amazing slides, one thing to consider is this course is only test based, there were no assignment or quiz,but TA was helpful ang very good test prep review material was provided.
Nice to have a class without some stupid political agenda, just really interesting stuff. I actually learned soemthing in this class and the topics kept my attention.
Yeah good course never boring great images of so many things u havent seen. u will enjoy :-)
The Egypt course was great and very thorough. He includes all the tombs and pyramid stuff but lots you don't know about like wigs, makeup, and even tatoos. I loved this course. it was so interesting.

Dr. Kidd's teaching style is extremely lecture heavy. The grade is based only on 4 exams so you have to perform well on the exams for a good grade. There is a lot of information presented ever lecture so make sure to not miss class because he doesn't record them either. You won't need the textbook, and there is no note outline that is accurate.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I would take any class with this professor. Relaxed lecture style and interesting too. YES YES YES
Loved this class! It was a lot of fun but you do have to go and take notes in lecture. The class is not posted online so be prepared to attend.
I learned so much about ancient Egypt and now looking forward to your mythology course. Thank you!
Take it, you won't regret it. Not hard either. I coulda had an A but I was lazy, but reallly liked the class. Kidd coolio :-)
If you like dismemberments, decapitations, being burned alive, bestiality, murders in the bathtub, flesh-eating sorcery, and vengeful gods and heroes, this is the class for you. I loved it :-)

Pretty sure I'll have an A as final grade. If you don't know Greek myths, you do need to come to lecture, which is way better than reading the book. The class was eye-opening to me, to learn the myths as they were told by ancient Greeks, not all the reinventions. If you like gory, dark, and irreverent, this is the class for you.
Loved this class! Passionate professor, great powerpoints. I've always loved Greek mythology and ths class did it justice
Exams are the only assignments in the class. Prof. Kidd is passionate about the mythology and does what he can to makes the lectures entertaining.
Really learned a lot in the minor arts seminar. Dr. Kidd is very knowledgeable and has a pleasant teaching style. Some students were snippy and nasty to him, and he handled that well too.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: 1060 is FUN. Not the mythology of Hollywood. Prepare for some interesting lectures from Dr. Kidd. Amazing graphics too. Wish there were more professors like this! Does require showing up and studying.
I have two bachelors degrees and a masters. And Benton Kidd is still my favorite professor of all time out of all of them
Learned so much about the ancient world that I never knew. Dr. Kidd is so knowledgeable about material culture. Very much recommend this seminar, if you want to learn about some very neat stuff.

Very impressed with this class and professor. Lectures were never dull and his visuals were entertaining. Highly recommended, but you do have to go to class. Tests are all lecture based and if you don't go, you'll be lost for the test.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class is pretty cool and Kidd is really chill
Excellent class and professor. Saw Dr. Kidd once at a cafe, and he was so nice. Bought me a coffee and we had a nice chat. Seems like he's really interested in the students. Highly recommended.
A nice and funny guy who made the class more interesting
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I looked forward to him and this interesting class. Great personality, funny, and clearly likes what he teaches. Great PPTs, obviously puts a lot of time into them for the students enjoyment.

He goes a little fast in lectures but everything he talks about is on the test. There are 4 tests and that is your whole grade. Attendance is not mandatory, but highly recommended since what he goes over is on the test. Cool class and nice teacher.

Dr. Kidd is an excellent teacher who loves what he teaches. He has a funny sense of humor and makes the lectures interesting. As long as you go to class and take notes and review for the tests you'll pass the class. There is no actual final, it's just a regular test.
Nice young professor who makes class both informative and entertaining. Thanks.
Come to class and take good notes, and the class will be a breeze. Dr. Kidd made lecture enjoyable with witty commentary. Once the lights dim prepare to hear interesting stories!
Listening to Dr. Kidd's voice with the lights down was just a nice cap-off to my day. This class really took me by surprise, fell in love with ancient Greek culture.

Dr. Kidd is the best professor I've ever had at Mizzou. His lectures are hilarious and really interesting, even if mythology isn't really your thing. I would recommend this class to anyone looking for an easy A and always interesting classes.
If it's 1060, it's a rollercoaster ride of murder and mayhem. Kidd doesn't hold back. Loved it!
I miss this class! Dr. Kidd, you were great!
Oh Dr. Kidd you and your silky voice. I so wanted you to read me to sleep.
Geek with chic. Loved him.
AWESOME. LOVE HIM!!!
Kidd's da bomb. Great class!!!
Kewl dude. Go talk to him.
My favorite class. Look forward to it and Dr. Kidd three times a week. Would like to know a little more about him in person. Interesting dude.

This class was great. Dr. Kidd is an awesome professor and seems to be passionate about what he is teaching. I feel like a little kid listening to bedtime stories when I go to this class. This class can be a really easy A, but you have to actually GO to class, listen, and take notes; otherwise, it probably won't work out for you.
Kidd rocks this class. The person that says he jumps around is stoned. Lectures are linear, clear, and easy to follow. Best elective I've had.

Easy class, easy tests. I just looked over my notes the night before exams and got As on all of them. And if you go to class and take good notes, you don't really need the book. I only opened the book a couple times. Although, if you miss class, you could just read the book and get the same info.

Kidd skips around when lecturing and sometimes gives a lot of info that you dont need to know. He doesnt give out study guides, but he holds a review session before the test. He seems interested in what hes teaching, I just wasnt interested in the material. I took stellar notes and tried my best, this class just seemed a little on the hard side
Oh I so love this class. It's my favorite and I'm a math major! Funny, unique professor.
Tests are easy if you know the material. The class is pretty interesting and easy to follow, and it's almost like listening to bedtime stories.  Professor seems pretty nice.
DO NO TAKE HIS CLASS!

I'm an Economics major. Thought this would be some bogus elective. Gave it a shot and ended up loving it. One of my favorite professors and the class was really interesting. Also, it'll be one of the easiest A's you have. If you need an elective, take it with Kidd. He still writes me Recommendation Letters and I only know him from this class.

I was pretty neutral about taking this class, just needed a humanities elective. Wound up LOVING this class and looked forward to it every week. Kidd is witty, entertaining, but informative too. I'd recommend the class to anyone. Kidd's among the gods :-p

AWESOME teacher. Love every minute of him. I actually look forward to going to this class 3 times a week. Content is fun and Dr. Kidd makes it a great experience. Warning: it's not a blow-off class. You do have to study and missing lecture put me at a disadvantage.

Dr. Kidd is an amazing professor (not to mention a total knockout with a mighty fine wardrobe). His lectures are fun, informative and seamless. His slides are great too. I wish my other profs were that creative with visual content. One of my favorite teachers at MU, hands down. I want him in my life forever!
Dr. Kidd made mythology really fun and interesting to learn about. You cannot skip class because everything taught is directly from lecture. Do not buy the book. I did not open it the whole semester.

Class is pretty interesting and he definitely knows his stuff. Not mandatory to go to class, but if you don't you definitely need to get someone's lecture notes. The exams you definitely have to study for. Right now I have and 89% so hopefully i can get and A.
Dr. Kidd is a cool dude. Keeps things interesting, and as long as you go to class you will get an A. Very knowledgeable and has some very funny moments
I taking it now. I LOVE him. I expect to have an A.
I taking it now. I LOVE him. I expect to have an A.
This was my favorite class at MU. I LOVE Dr. Kidd. He is funny but knowlegeable, and really brought the gods to life.

The professor is super smart, honestly kind of a genius, but he has no ego about it. He is really positive and has a lot of charisma, and he seems like he would be a genuinely good friend outside of class too. The class was easy to enjoy and remember.
Dr. Christ is AMAZING! Hands down my favorite professor ever! Charming, friendly, funny, and brilliant.

i've never had a professor like this. he's genuinely kind and makes you feel like you matter and honestly smart because he is so smart. the vibe is so positive and real. I leave class feeling happier than when I walk in. he ends every class with “have the best day ever" and I believe he truly means it.

Super interesting class. Decent amount of reading, but the reading quizzes are really easy. He works really hard to make sure everyone does well. Dr. Christ is also really lovely and super smart, highly recommend any of his classes.

Not even exaggerating, this is the GOAT professor. One of those teachers you don't forget because they actually care and set a good example for how people should treat each other. Definitely take this class if you can. He's just a solid professor and a good person. Sets the tone for the class without making a big deal about it. 100% recommend.

Genuinely the kindest teacher I have ever had in my whole learning career. He genuinely believes in every single one of his students. I have been to his office hours before, and it felt like I was talking to a well-respected, knowledgeable peer. He never talks down on his students and is clearly incredibly passionate about what he teaches.

Had him for Intro to Sociology and honestly he's the kind of professor you wish you had for every class. He's organized, clear, actually grades fairly, and never makes you feel inferior. He's also really patient and just has good energy in the room.

He's really smart and explains things with stories and examples instead of just reading slides. He's also funny without trying too hard and keeps class from being boring. You can tell he really cares about students and he always makes time if you have questions or need help. He's super humble too which makes it easy to talk to him.
Kindest human being ever. I wish I could literally take every class with him
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great professor and lecturer. He has very clear grading criteria and truly wants to see every student succeed. Make sure to attend lecture and take notes and you will do great.

I'm a junior in engineering and never cared about humanities. This class made me interested in topics i thought I never would care about. The class became my favorite lecture to go to. Professor is awesome and cares more about the students and teaching abstract perspectives rather than making you memorize from a textbook. Would love to take again.

GOD I love this man. Nobody really shows up to his lectures and I feel bad honestly because you can tell he truly cares. I never read the textbook and ended up with a 93%. He rounds up your grade by the tenth, so if you have a 92.5 (A-) you will have a 93 (A) so that's great. Very wholesome fella

This class was super easy: read the textbook, show up to lectures, take a ten question quiz at the end of every week and three exams the entire semester. There is extra credit opportunities as well. Stephen is super passionate about what he teaches and just wants his students to do well in the class. Would highly recommend for gened credits!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: AMAZING AMAZING AMAZING! My favorite professor I've had, engaging lectures and truly cares about teaching!
all tests were open book and online. he is so freaking nice and just wants everyone to do well. TAKE HIS COURSES!!!!

Loved taking sociology with Christ! He's obviously very knowledgable and has a passion for teaching. Tests are pretty easy, and the workload is reasonable and not too difficult. Even though it was a low-level course I still learned a lot and enjoyed his lectures. I would love to take another class with him!

Really good class and super easy to understand. Tests were not to bad and he was really accommodating. Grade compromised of online quizzes due at the same time each week and three exams. Mostly just vocabulary.
This man is the real deal. Believe the hype and take this class. Best professor I've ever had.

Professor Christ is kinda like if Mr. Rogers decided to teach college. His lectures were awesome, but what really stuck with me was how he treated me when I had an emergency. He cared enough to actually help me. Like, really cared. He showed me kindness and understanding I don't expect from a professor. One of the kindest people I've ever met.

Dr. Christ really knows his stuff and actually makes class interesting, which is rare. You can tell he's super into the material and isn't just teaching for a paycheck. Also, not gonna lie, he smells really good.

Professor Christ is easily one of the most brilliant and genuine professors I've had. He's incredibly good at breaking down complex stuff from the textbook, always patient, and genuinely cares about his students. He helped me in a big way when I got behind on work. Can't recommend him enough. He's one of the good ones.

Literally the most naturally charismatic professor I've ever had. He has a way of explaining things and telling stories that draw you in and keep the class interesting. I never got the vibe that he thought he was better than students like I do with a lot of my other professors. He is a shockingly kind professor and person.

He was the only professor I wanted to go to office hours for. He was amazing, and he genuinely cared about what he was teaching. he was amazing he also bumps up grades if your engaging in class and are close to the next letter grade

Dr. Christ is the best professor I have had at Mizzou. You can tell he loves what he teaches and makes his lectures engaging and interesting. He is extremely approachable outside of class and will answer any questions you may have. Overall, I would recommend taking his class!

Honestly, best class I've taken here. He is so passionate and kind. The class was interesting and not stressful at all. The exams were online, open note. It would be so hard not to pass his class, he truly wants everyone to do well. Attendance was not mandatory, but plz go, he was so energetic and fun to listen to, and he deserves the audience.

Dr. Christ is a very passionate and inspiring professor. He will tell you everything you need to know for tests and quizzes, you just need to show up to class. Attendance wasn't required, but class was enjoyable. If you pay attention for most of the class, you will easily get an A. Dr. Christ is awesome!

He outlines everything we will be doing and also offers extra credit. He does not like surprises and he is passionate and interesting to listen to his lectures. Attendance isn't mandatory but encouraged to get the notes.

This professor is honestly amazing. He's super smart but never makes you feel dumb and he actually cares about students. He just has this really cool, effortless vibe that makes his class fun to be in. If every teacher were like this, school would be way more exciting.
It's only been one day and he's already my favorite professor at Mizzou. This guy loves what he does and it shows. I wish I was looking forward to my other classes like this one.

One of the best — if not the best professor I've had at Mizzou. I could be having the worst day and walking to his class would change that. Dr. Christ is passionate about teaching and it manifests in the classroom atmosphere he creates and the attentiveness he gives to each students. Participate actively in class and you're all set.
1000% take this class with prof christ he is the best EVER.

Dr. Christ is hands-down the best professor I've ever had! His charisma and energy made Intro to Sociology a highlight of my semester. Class felt like a TED Talk every day. He's kind and approachable. If you want to actually enjoy a class and leave feeling smarter, take him. 10/10 would recommend, even if sociology isn't your thing.

Professor Christ was a great teacher and this is by far one of the easiest classes I've taken. You don't HAVE to go to class but he does go over a recap of the unit the day before the exam date so I would go to that fs. Lectures are pretty boring and he does mumble but he's a sweet and personable professor. There is extra credit. Tests are online.

Love this professor! He brings such positive and inspirational energy to his lectures each time. Attendance is not mandatory but he also does not post the slides online to push you to attend class. Easily understandable content. Online quizzes each week. Easy workload and easy exams. Don't have to do the readings. Overall, this professor is amazing

Stephen is an incredible lecturer, very organized, prepared, and high-energy. He was excited to be in class each day and it showed. Tests are hard but the review sessions are incredibly relevant and worthwhile. Going to office hours regularly throughout the semester was the best decision I made in terms of understanding the content.

Stephen Christ is the best professor. He truly cares about his students' success, and is on your team. If you're confused on questions during an exam, he will pretty much tell you the right answer. He uses exams as a learning opportunity and I feel like I have learned the most from this class in comparison to all of the others I'm in.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He was an awesome teacher!!! I love him! He makes sitting in a lecture hall for 90 minutes interesting! Class wasn't mandatory but he gave us slides and many examples of the material you couldn't get if you didn't go. The test concepts are easy but it's a lot to study and memorize DO NOT WAIT UNTIL THE LAST MIN! Also he gives extra credit afterexam

i love this man so much. really nerdy professor. his passion is infectious. slides are simple and to the point, lectures are engaging. he brings in lots of examples to make the class interesting. workload is 3 easy tests and a quiz every week. he is such a passionate and funny professor. he's a genuinely pure soul and really nice to students.

I. Love. Professor Stephen. His lectures are so fun and engaging, he's genuinely hilarious, and makes all the course information really easy to engage with and understand. Three exams are super easy if you study the review guide and go to class. There's reading but you don't have to do it. 10/10 wish I could take his class forever.

Professor Christ is one of the best professors I've had. The class is great and everything he teaches is interesting, partly because of his lectures. It's been the most stress free class I've taken at Mizzou. Read the textbook and do the weekly quizzes. He gives a study guide for the exam and reviews with the class. He's a genuinely kind person.
Dr. Christ is a cool professor and really cares about his students.

Professor Christ is not your average professor. He's got a razor-sharp wit that keeps you engaged, the ability to explain even the most complex topics in simple ways anyone can understand, and an undeniable charm. Highly recommend!

Best professor I've ever had. Knows what he's talking about and breaks everything down in a way that makes the class interesting. He walks in and holds court for the entire class period. Really easy to talk to when you need to.

He teaches a well organized course. Everything is laid out for you and you can work as far ahead as you want. It's an interesting class. He posts lectures for everything and you have discussion boards, a quiz every week, three papers, and two tests. Recommend this professor.
Made my first semester of college just that much better. I will never forget this professor!!!

The best part of this class is how much Stephen Christ clearly cares and is very passionate about this subject and it makes it much more enjoyable to listen to his lectures. If you attend the lectures and pay attention this class is not too difficult. There are quizzes every week but they are pretty easy and help boost your grade.

I absolutely love going to his class. They are very interesting lectures. He has a very dynamic personality that makes the class interesting. He makes an effort to know each of his students' names and personalities. I would definitely take him again. He made me interested in sociology.

Best professor I have ever had. He is incredibly smart and has the ability to translate the material into something you can understand. Makes a point to show how sociology applies to the real world. Very student friendly and wants everyone to succeed. Seriously would change my major so I could have him as a professor again.

Stephen is a very sweet professor. He is genuinely the nicest person I've ever met. His class is a lecture style, so he talks the whole time & has power points. I loved the class. Only 2 tests. 1 midterm, 1 final. He does a review class each time. Knows his stuff and is actually kind of funny. Overall easy class if you pay attention and study.

Dr. Christ is a very nice professor however, his lectures were horrible and he goes off topic a lot. He randomly takes attendance so you have to show up but people constantly leave mid-lecture (gives you an idea of how boring his lectures are). I took this class for a diversity requirement and would've rather taken any other class. Waste of time.

Professor Christ is probably one of the best professors. He is always available to talk too and he is super understanding. He takes attendance randomly. His lectures at the beginning are boring but towards the end the topics get better and more interesting. There is a extra credit essay at the end and his class is pretty easy.

Honestly one of the best professors ever. Super easy to talk too and very understanding. He has two essays but they are short and not hard. There is also a extra credit essay at the end. He takes attendance sometimes but not at every lecture. I do think lectures can be a little boring in the beginning but later the topics get more interesting.

Stephen is very excited about sociology. I have never had a nicer professor that I have respected more. His course is both engaging and simple. He gives us time to share "sociological stories" every day, which he calls student announcements. I actually enjoy this course.

Literally the sweetest and most compassionate professor I've had in my college career. If you have any questions, he is fully attentive to you. He strongly encourages people to come by his office hours because he wants to get to know his students. He makes the content interesting and applicable. Super great professor overall!
I love this professor. He always gives time in class for us to talk and encourages us to get involved in sociology and culture, as it is all around us.

Absolutely incredible. I wish I had more opportunities to take classes with him. He's wacky, a ton of fun, but also incredibly smart in a non-pretentious way. One of the most engaging teachers I've had so far. He's a fair grader and actually makes you want to come to class! Very grateful for him!

If you don't already have an interest in sociology you can count on Professor Christ to change that. Hands down my favorite prof. His lectures are amazing and the class itself isn't too difficult. There is one assigned textbook for the class (which can be helpful for exams and quizzes) but if you go to class + take notes, you'll be fine!

Stephen is a wonderful prof. He truly cares about his students and is passionate about his lectures. He encourages class participation and creates a community even in a large lecture hall. The textbook he uses is also engaging and modern. There are weekly online quizzes, 2 online exams and 2 personal essays. Very easy class.
Dr. Christ is super super nice and gives you lots of grace. This is not a hard class, especially if you take it online. He's super understanding and offers extra credit.

He really cares about his students and you can tell he is passionate about the subject. I thought his jokes were funny and he tries very hard. Office hours were helpful and he explains things very well and never makes you feel like you asked a stupid question. Good class, fantastic professor, decent amount of reading, average tests.
BEST PROFESSOR EVER!!!!!!!!!!! Amazing I wish I had him for my other classes!

Christ is extremely helpful when questions are asked and doesn't belittle students at all. He's an overall great guy and is willing to help students do well in his class. Helped me out a lot with a missed deadline.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Great lecturer and overall smart guy. He makes more abstract class material relatable by showing videos. He is flexible with office hours and the exams are fine if you study material from the slides and use the study guide.
An amazing, passionate, unique professor who really knows his stuff. He is entertaining and a lot of fun to work with. He is super nice, wants you to succeed, and wants you to think for yourself.
super super nice and understanding. really reasonable amount of homework and work, especially for a completely online class
Coolest professor I have had at mizzou. Posts notes on blackboard. Fun in class and tells entertaining stories.  He's young and doesn't take himself too seriously like my other professors here.

SO easy. He posts the PP's he uses in lecture on BB and doesn't take attendance. One online quiz each week and he takes the questions DIRECTLY from the PP's.
