Tests are online, and there are two semester projects, which are 50 points each. Labs are the worst part of the class and they aren't even that bad.
She is an amazing professor you just have to pay attention and apply yourself!

Dr. Kalton has been my favorite professor at Mizzou, she cares so deeply about her students. In a lecture hall with class of ~250 students she still gets to know as many as she can and cares so deeply about all of her students and is super easy to talk to! After talking to her once during office hours she remembered me for the rest of the semester.

Professor Kalton is super nice and very easy to talk to or ask questions. The lectures were fine. The only rough part was the Exams. They are heavily based in the textbook rather than lectures, they are open note which helps tons, but they are still long and difficult. But overall the class was fine.

Her lectures were entertaining and easy to keep up with. The quizzes and tests were designed to support students' grades and were passable as long as you paid some attention to the textbook. Her grading criteria made the class very reasonable, and she was a kind professor.
Dr. Kalton is so amazing! She cares so deeply about everyone of her students! This course was open book/note and she took feedback from everyone to better herself and the class!

This class so fun and she would connect with her students. She knew all of her students by face if not by name. She gives a quiz every week which helps for tests which were open book and open note. She did iclickers in class for participation and for extra credit from them. She deeply cares about what she teaches and it shows in her teaching.

Literally can not recommend this professor enough. It is very clear that she genuinely cares for her students. She is exciting, spirited, and very refreshing. Her expectations for her students are very clear and attainable. She handled difficult subjects very gracefully and was generally just a joy in class. Please take her class shes amazing

Quizzes matter so much!! Please lock in on those early because I didn't. Focus on quizzes and short answer possibilities on the tests and you'll do pretty good on finals! Just TAKE NOTES every week for sure.

He's pretty good -- just make sure to go to lecture or at least go over the slides that are in lecture, because those are important for exams. If you fumble an exam it's fairly difficult to get your grade back up due to the class having no weights based on assignment type. Not a very hard class tho & you get a double sided cht-sheet for each exam.

I loved this course. Dr. P was very passionate about what he was teaching and the lecture notes were easy to follow. You will have around 6 hours of coursework to do outside of class (homework, concepts for the chapter, etc). Make sure to keep up with it and go to lecture (though its not mandatory) as stuff said in lecture may show up on the test!

Professor P is by far my favorite professor I have ever had. He makes his lectures engaging despite the dry subject material. If you are paying attention in lectures and labs there is no reason you should not get an A. That being said, although attendance is not required for lecture, DO NOT SKIP as you will be far better off in this class.

Don't get me wrong, he's a great genuine professor who actually does a good job helping us learn accounting. My problem is his 200 point exams are super hard with open ended problems being completely different from what he mentions in class. Also quizzes are more trivial based than what is actually covered on the test. Journal entries are so rough.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. P was such a good professor. You actually learn and understand the content during lecture. Lecture attendance isn't required, but he gives really good examples of exam problems you could possibly see, so I definitely recommend going. Utilize cheat sheets and lab time!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Missed exam due to illness, awaiting response from professor as to whether or not I may retake the exam. If able to retake the exam I will end the course with a B+\A-, is the professor does not allow me to take the exam I will end with a D. This should not be legal.

Most important thing is to know how to do the lab problems, as they are most of the exams. The multiple choice questions are from the textbook so you actually have to read the book. Quizzes in lab also come from the textbook and are multiple choice.

Know how to do the lab problems and you will be fine.
has quizzes in lab every week worth 10 points. The questions on it are more trivial and nothing like what you would actually study for the exam.
Class is more about memorizing accounting terms
Amazing teacher that truly cares for his student. Very good teacher.

He gives you nothing to prepare for exams, you are on your own. During this class I just had no idea where to even start studying for a test. I guess he wants you to basically memorize the entire textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I thought Dr. P was very enthusiastic about teaching. His downfall was that his exams were fairly difficult, with most averages being around the 70% mark. I would say if you have this class, make sure to find someone you know sit by in the lectures or study with, so they can help you with workout problems that you have during lectures!

Attendance is not mandatory for lectures, but only for the lab that happens every Friday. The class was pretty average in terms of difficulty. Home work assignments were easy and took me about two hours each week to finish them. I performed well on all the exams just by studying the textbook and reviewing the examples that he shows us in class.

Do not be mistaken this class is not easy. As an 3.7 student I struggled. Content wasn't hard but exams proved to be difficult with averages going below 70.  Dr.P is super nice and would let out super early every class. Quizzes every lab and the best way to get 10/10 is bomb notes. Study hard and don't skip any class
Dr P is super cool and very engaging. I loved taking his class and would take him again.
The class was difficult but Dr. P was by far the best professor at Mizzou.

Professor P. is by far the best teacher I have taken at Mizzou. Definitely cares about his students. If you need help he is very reachable. His lectures are straight to the point and he gives plenty examples in class to master the content.

Dr. P is great. I hated the content of his class, but thanks to Dr. P it wasn't so bad. He is genuinely a super good guy and he doesn't try to make the content harder than it is. Very straightforward class, I can't complain.

Seems like a nice guy, but completely let us down during this online semester due to covid. He uses mcgraw hill connect for all his homework and quizzes which I did fine on. His only interaction with us consists of 1 poll question for attendance per week. His exams (scantron) however are overly difficult and you do not get nearly enough time.

Dr. P is alright. Overly interactive during lectures, the 75 min class could easily be 50 min without it. He truly cares about the understanding of each student, however. Also gives a notecard for every exam, so, not hard to pass.

Dr. P is possibly the best professor I have ever had. I naturally like accounting and numbers, so one may not enjoy this class as much if they don't like accounting. He teaches so well through examples and I always feel prepared for the tests because of his lectures. Take this class. Dr. P will not disappoint.

Dr. P is an awesome professor! He explains the concepts of accounting very well to build a foundation of knowledge for business students. If you read the book and pay attention in lecture, studying for the tests won't be hard. If you try to understand most of the concepts in this class you will perform just fine.
literally the best teacher I have ever had. Only 500 person class that I have actually learned in
Dr. Orbann is absolutely amazing. She is so supportive of her students and wants everyone to succeed. Participation really matters but there are so many opportunities for it. I loved her class!
Dr. Orbann is a very caring teacher who makes an effort to connect with her students. She gives very clear feedback and her class is well organized.

Dr. Orbann is very caring and is willing to help if you are having a hard time in her class. There aren't many assignments, but they are worth a lot of points. She's very into using AI to help generate ideas and likes group assignments. She is very nice, although her lectures are somewhat boring. The material isn't half bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Super easy class. Attendance does not matter, exams are online and open note, and projects are not worth a lot of points. The lectures can be pretty boring but Dr. Orbann makes them interesting and tries to be engaging with the class. She is so nice and understanding. I would definitely take a class from her again!

Absolutely loved Dr. Orbann's lectures! Even though the content is not super exciting, she stays engaged with her students and makes it easy to understand! Also, she is the most knowledgeable and up to date on the topics she teaches of any professor I know. Definitely my best professor yet at Miz!

Lectures are boring unless health care systems & insurance interest you. Need to understand material to do well on tests. A few group projects, short papers, presentations. TA grades everything. Orbann cares about updating her presentations, uses lots of graphs & a few videos. She's trying, and it's not the worst class. I kind of liked it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Orbann presented information about insurance and health care in the most interesting way you can. The course content is dry but she does a good job of keeping students engaged. There are 10 reading responses, a film review, a group project, 1 midterm (which is the only test), and the final is a debate on health reform.

She's very enthusiastic about her lectures and makes them interesting. Also was an easy A if you paid attention to the lectures and did well on the quizzes. Never had exams, just homeworks and online quizzes. Class covered a lot of common sense so just sit back and enjoy the A. MUST go to class though-attendance and participation points are given.
She is the most boring professor I have ever had and I am a senior.

She takes forever to grade. Our grades are due tomorrow and she hasn't graded multiple assignments from months ago. She is not easy to get a hold of, doesn't even have office hours. She explains things in round-about ways and never gets to the point. She talks your ear off with no intelligence behind her words. This lady doesn't deserve a phD.

Dr. Orbann is a pretty good professor. Her lectures were not that interesting and it was hard for me to pay attention. I enjoyed the topics we discussed, but how she delivered her lectures was very slow and monotone. She was nice, and was a fair grader. She was a good professor to have, but I wish I had one who was more excited.

This class was really easy, if you studied for the tests at all you would do fine. There are a lot of participation points so going to class is important but the lectures aren't too boring. You don't need the textbook!

She clearly cares a lot about the subject, which was a bit of a problem. She routinely assigns insanely long readings because they're "interesting," and will lecture on a lot of complicated graphs. It's a bit of an information overload if you ask me. Nice and cares about her students learning, but just expects too much. Tests were specific.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Heath Care in the US had the potential to be a very difficult topic to understand, but Carolyn made it very interesting and easy to understand! You learn so much from lectures and her assignments were incredibly interesting. She really cares about her students doing well and understanding the material. I cannot recommend her class more highly!
Class itself is easy. Guest speakers everyday.  She walks up and down the isles and watches to see if you have your phone out, if you do, she'll kick you out. Tests are easy
She was very easy! I received A's on all my papers and exams.
The class is good. Carolyn is awesome. Enough said.

I don't think she has any experience in journalism. She finished the hour and a quarter class in 30 minutes consistantly, she barely knows about any of the adobe software she teaches, she reads off the slides and she takes off substantial points for very minor mistakes. If you can get literally any other J1200 professor please do
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you can, find a different professor. She doesn't know how to do the projects that she is teaching. Instructions are incredibly unclear and I self taught myself 90% of the class.

I thought the reviews here were just dramatic but no, she really is the worst professor. Can't teach for her life and always seems unprepared or confused. Not sure what her qualifications are for teaching but for how much I pay for the class I am incredibly disappointed. Very discouraging and frustrating. Prepare to teach yourself.

If you have this teacher for your entry level journalism class, just be ready to teach yourself. The adobe software is confusing, but she is no help on how to use it. She gives very harsh critiques with unrealistic expectations for an entry level class. She is easy to talk to you if you mess up a project though.

You will not learn one thing in this class. Taking this class will guarantee you long nights trying to piece together an assignment, knowing nothing about the software or even the assignment, because she refuses to teach literally anything. I crossed the street without looking because I was trapped in this hell of a class.

The worst professor I have ever had in my life. She cannot teach to save her life. She resorted to having us watch YouTube videos because she couldn't explain how to use the software correctly. It doesn't matter how polite you are, if you email her any questions about your grade or an assignment, be prepared to receive a very demeaning email back.

Worst professor I've had. Terrible lecturer, does not explain softwares, incredibly vague in instructions, leaves demeaning feedback on work despite spending hours on projects. Made me question my decision to enroll in the J-school. Avoid this professor unless you enjoy feeling irritated on a week-to-week basis.

This professor is awful. This course is required for J-school, I highly recommend taking this class with a different professor. Class only lasts 10-15 minutes and she does not at all teach how to use  any software. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS.
If she doesn't like you, prepare to never get a decent grade. Class would end after 15 minutes and she would not teach how to use any of the software.

The comments this instructor makes on student work is harsh, and diminishes the hours of work students put in. Class length was always 15 to 30 minutes, getting out sometimes an hour early. With this in mind, she still didn't teach how to use the software. If you have to take this course, please consider taking it with another professor.

Harsh grader with vague instructions. Lectures are rushed and unstructured. She never reminds you of deadlines, you must keep track of everything yourself. She can't teach the Adobe software and barely knows how to use it herself. She often misgrades so if you don't carefully check her feedback, you'll lose points for her errors. Avoid if possible.

She was the hardest grader I have ever seen, and her comments are so diminishing as a freshman taking this course. She can really turn away faces from Journalism as a whole. As an intro course it was so rushed, and she barely taught how to use the software's, so I would be up all night working on projects. Do not take this with her

The class was so rushed, and I had to learn everything on my own. The class is required for journalism majors, so there was no way around it, but if you can, please avoid this professor. Her comments on my work were always aggressive, and she was quick to give me a zero if I turned in something late, but took forever to give me good grades.

She is an okay professor, I just had lots of projects from video editing that I stayed up till 4 am doing. I also didn't appreciate how I would show up for class and she didn't even show up so I wasted 30 minutes walking to a class without any communicatioin class is cancelled. She doesn't teach how to use premiere pro, she just says good luck. :(

She is by far the toughest grader I have ever encountered. I would avoid taking her class AT ALL COSTS!!! This class moves insanely fast and she doesn't take the time to explain any of the software that is used within this course. DO NOT turn in stuff late, I so believe she takes off late points just for fun.

This professor diminishes creative work, which is frustrating for someone who teaches a class on visual journalism. This course could be fully online, and often she wastes time in class by stretching out lectures, cutting class an hour short, or giving busy work. If you are required to take J1200 try and take a class with a different teacher.
Loved Chindris but hated Calc 2. He was an amazing professor and although the class was very difficult, I enjoyed going to class because he is quite funny and loves his job and students.

Very kind and genuinely cared for all the students. The tests and homework could be hard, but he gives lots of hints and help if you actually go to class. 
I don't understand how people could've passed this is they didn't go to class, but it's pretty easy if you do.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Chindris is a brilliant professor. He is super nice and caring and will help out the best he can. Calc II is super hard but he makes it passable. His study guides are exactly like the exams. He also grades the exams really nicely. My TA was pretty difficult and graded hard and I thought that the quizzes were harder than the exams. HW weekly.

Dr. Chindris is one of my favorite professors. I found that I often came into class stressed about classes and tests, but I was calmer when I left. He often made an effort in the first minute or so of class to talk to us about random things. While lecturing he checked in with us often to make sure we understood and answered any questions.

He is a great lecturer, always ready to help a student with any question they have, and gives very fair exams based on study guides. Easy to understand. Calc II is a lot of work, but he makes it manageable.

I loved this guy. I was so nervous for Calc 3 because it was my first college math class. He explained things so well and never had any surprises on the test. The homework is an easy grade booster and also has relevant practice problems, unlike some other math teacher's homework.

I enjoyed having this professor. Calc 3 was the hardest of the calculus courses (in my experience) and I do not think I would have done as well with another professor. The exams are fairly similar to the test reviews so make sure you study those well! He also allows a notecard for the cumulative final.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Great teacher. I had him for Calc 3. The notes are on canvas but it helps a lot more to go to class so he can explain it more. Also drops lowest 2 homework and quiz grades. Quizzes and exams arent difficult. Exams + final often follow the structure of the study guides he gives out with answers. Homework can take awhile sometimes. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He's a great guy and he made calc 3 pretty reasonable. Make sure to go to lectures as his notes on canvas are difficult to follow. Tests are often fairly close to exams. Very caring and helpful in office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Calin is the best teacher ever. He teaches slowly which is sometimes really aggravating when I'm confident in a concept but when I'm not I really appreciate his willingness to answer questions and explain things. His quizzes and homework are really difficult but this makes the tests super easy. 10/10 would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Would take again

reviews.comment: If you're taking calc 2, this guy is the best. All of my other friends were struggling in calc two while Dr. Chindris actually made me enjoy doing calculus while being a funny, and extremely fair professor. He makes reviews for each test that are always a good representation of the test. Also, he will point out typical exam problems in lecture.

This professor was fantastic. I had him for calc 2, but he was able to make the material very manageable and was a great overall great professor. I would strongly recommend that anyone who has to take any math class to take it with Dr. Chindris if possible.

Chindris was probably my favorite professor as a freshman. I took Calc II and really lucked out with him. He's easy to understand, very funny (often accidentally), and hands down the nicest teacher I've had at Mizzou. I highly recommend that you actually do homework and get everything you can out of it. Again, I loved this guy and highly recommend.

Dr. Chindris was a great professor that was able to turn very hard concepts into something more tangible.  Lectures are to the point and easy to take notes to.  He also has funny mannerisms that made me crack up in class. Calculus 2 would have been much harder with a different professor
As far as calc 2 is concerned he does an awesome job making it manageable and easy to take in

Calc 2 isn't going to be easy, regardless of the professor. Chindris is one of the easiest international professors to understand, and he does a great job explaining the material. His tests aren't bad, when I was really prepared I would finish his test in 20 minutes or less.

Matrix Theory can be a difficult class sometimes and so I expect it's impossible to have a professor make points so clearly that everybody can follow. For myself, I never had a problem following what Chindris was saying (though some did). But regardless of how you fare in the class, everybody loves the guy. He's one of the nicest there is.

Nicest guy ever. Very clear expectations, no quizzes, only 7 graded HWs. Goes fast in class, but will take the time to answer questions. Holds review sessions for exams, gives ample preparations. Some of the material is fairly abstract but he does his best to translate it. But like I said, nicest prof I've ever had. Makes me wish I was just as nice
The organization on canvas might be the worst Ive ever seen. Nothing is easy to find. There's no syllabus. The class isn't that bad honestly, but the canvas page is just so bad.

Do not take this professor he makes everything harder than it has to be he lectures 3 deep into the next exam before you even take the last exam. The exams are like puzzles and intentionally attempting to trick you and he's not generous with grading at all.

Dr. David provides you with a lot of resources to help you learn. His lectures are packed with information and sometimes it's hard to hear him, so try to pay attention in class. He has a good sense of humor and is caring, though. The exams are all short answer, so engage in class and truly understand the concepts, don't just memorize definitions.
He is a sweet old man. He mumbles. He is trying his best.
Class is pretty easy if you go to the lectures and take the practice exams.
Professor David is a very great guy. Lectures are long and there is a lot of information. Homework and discussion are nice. Very clear in grading and what he expects on exams. Great class!

I think that Dr. David was a fantastic teacher, he is old so his voice can so make the lectures a little sleepy but he tries to keep it interesting, he makes the class so much easier to understand. He is open to many learning methods and really wants to help you learn. He is overall a fantastic teacher and I would highly recommend taking his class

There's 5 exams with your best score replicated to form a 6th exam-- then the final. Each exam is around 4 to 7 problems, but they take up about 10 pages of short response. There's no multiple choice, so you gotta write stuff down on the paper if you want a shot at getting credit. Def the hardest exams I've ever taken.

Class is clearly outlined and organized. He can talk a bit slowly in lectures but they aren't mandatory to attend. Plenty of extra credit and study resources are offered, and he's very understanding of missing exam dates and provides retakes.

Good Professor, if you go to class the lectures are more enjoyable, tests need to be studied for using old tests and reviews, if you actually try to learn the class the way he teaches it, it will make more sense.

lectures are pointless, the PowerPoint is set up weirdly, watch panopto videos instead of going. go to class when there is a quiz. go to the discussion. it is helpful, will give you an extra cushion, and are fun. online assignments are easy. exams are short answers, but depending on who grades them you can get partial credit. do not fall behind.

Practice exams and study guides are what's important for the exams. Reading the textbook also helped me a lot. Skip (unless there's a quiz) and watch lectures at 1.5x on Panopto--he talks incredibly slow. Attending discussion and review sessions can help you get extra credit at the end of the class, so don't miss them.

John tried to make lectures fun with jokes, but there is just so much material to know and understand. You typically finish exam material a week before and he continues with the next exam material the week of your exam, so it was hard (for me) to stay focused on the right information.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Drawn out lectures with little information in each (could probably take half the time it actually does).Stopped going to class and watched his videos at 2x speed and it still felt slow. He posts homework with no regular schedule so it can be hard to keep track of when things are due. Tests are easy if you look at past tests and discussion problems.

I have Prof. David for Spring '20, and I couldn't tell you how anyone could dislike him. His tests may challenging, but he gives us plenty of extra material to cushion our grades without it becoming busy work and even some opportunities to fix our mistakes. He's definitely one of the nicest and most understanding professors I've ever had.
Extremely hard to understand and exams are all free response. He flies through the notes with little explanation.

Dr. David can be arrogant and rude at times. He can be really hard to understand in lectures because of his age and rushes through powerpoint without explaining things clearly. His tests really make you apply concepts and he makes them very specific and extremely difficult to work out because of the wording. NO MULTIPLE CHOICE, ONLY ESSAYS.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I took this class Spring 17 and it was great! The class is hard and the exams are very specific, but if you go to class and discussion and actually pay attention and study hard, an A is achievable. I did buy the book but did not open it a singular time. Going to office hours helped immensely, Dr. David really cares about your success.
Tough tests

Material is intensive but if you read the book, do homework and watch tegrity lectures at your own speed you will do fine. T.A.s make this class. Instructor is often rude and unhelpful when approached. Lectures are quick and littered with dad jokes that have nothing to do with genetics & can be grossly insensitive. Insanely specific test grading.

I loved this class and Dr. David. He focuses on big-picture ideas rather little details and really makes you think. All the info you need is at lecture so I would not buy the book. The class was hard but manageable with effort and time. Dr. David really fostered class participation and had great humor as well.

I very much liked this class. The lectures were always informative and worked clearly in conjunction with the tests. Very dry humor, and a man who makes you think about big picture, I think John David was a wonderful professor.
He's a genuinely great guy that wants his students to succeed. Sometimes, the lectures can be a bit confusing, but if you read over the text at least a little bit then you should be all right.

I strongly disliked this class. David's lectures are extremely confusing and he goes off topic a lot. His PowerPoint slides contain barely any words, mostly pictures, and he changes the slides way too quickly whenever they have any helpful words. I did very well in this class only because of natural smarts and teaching myself the material.
His lectures have literally nothing to do with the tests. I went through every tegrity of his class and nothing was on the actual exam. The exams are hard. I honestly did not like him.
He lectures are really long. he goes of topic a lot. you do not have to attend class to do well. but you do have to do his work to get a good grade

Dr. David is a super nice guy that want his students to succeed. He teaches the class from a more professional prospective rather than utilitarian, which has its ups and downs. It is sometimes hard to know what he means/expects you to know. Discussion is a must. Work hard and an A is definitely achievable.
I had a hard time receiving direct help from the professor.

I loved Dr. Davids genetics class. He really cares about his students. His test do require an ample amount of studying but a good grade is easy to achieve. You get a lot of old exams and study material. So, you always know what to expect on exam day and they're are never any surprises. Overall, he makes the class fair.The Class average was a C+/B-.
He's a bit arrogant, but he definately cares about students learning the information. Do your best to use any other resources.

He was a really cool guy. He wasn't very approachable (he's the head of his department), but he really cared about his students' learning the material, not just regurgitating it for the exam. I loved this class!

A little boring at times, but covers the material pretty well.  Can jump around at times and be a little confusing; talks a bit fast at times as well.  Tests require quite a bit of studying, but if you understand the material, you should do well.  Use your TAs as much as you can.

He's very knowledgeable and really interested in students learning. However, lectures are hard to follow and his voice puts your to sleep. Tests are short answer and essay but a lot easier than expected.
easy for a science class but the lectures are horrible and really boring...definitely go to discussion sections because thats where you learn all the material

Very interesting material, but I don't know how the last person LOVED the lectures... There were definitely more than a few times everyone looked lost because he just rambled.  Discussion section helped tremendously.  The tests are very fair... I got an A+ in there so its definitely not impossible... if you enjoy Genetics, its a good class

I LOVED his lectures! He was recomended to me by another student going to med school. He said that if I wanted to hear medical examples and learn a lot, to take his course. He is a firm believer on his students learning genetics and not just getting the grade. His teaching style demonstrates that.
The lectures were a bit boring at times, but Dr. David was a very nice man and very willing to help whenever students are confused.  I really enjoyed this class.

I don't how terribly interesting DNA replication can be, so I don't fault him when his lectures are a bit stuffy. His tests are very fair and he does his best to answer questions that you present to him, even though genetics isn't his specialty.

In person, he is very likable and an excellent tutor, but during lectures I don’t think he realizes when he is being too complex or talking too fast. Despite that, his lectures are thorough, tests fair, and TA’a can fill u in on what he misses.
boring lectures, long, somewhat hard tests, but seems to care.
Good natured and easy to talk to.  The class wasn't too difficult either.
Wasn't horribly difficult for a bio class, he's a nice guy if you have questions, but he's a really dull lecturer...

He is very kind and truly cares about his students and what he teaches. He is an amazing lecturer that kept me interested in topics I normally might have zoned out for. Very knowledgeable and passionate.
The lectures were very interesting. Grading felt fair. Visual Culture was an amazing class!

Th best teacher I've had up til now. He is so kind and understanding, especially when papers are submitted late. The course was hard but I was in the honors and writing intensive section. All grading was clear. Great teacher, hope to take another class of his someday.
fantastic lectures. there is mandatory attendance but you won't want to miss them.

Professor van Dyke was fun to have as a professor, he was always very excited and animated during his lectures. He really helped make you interested in the subject material. His essays were graded tough-ish, and the quizzes were tricky. However, I did enjoy his class.
Confusing lectures. Not clear at all. Wouldn't recommend. Basic intro course but super misleading lectures and teacher goes off on tangents a lot.

I came into this class with no interest art. But the material is interesting and is taught by great and approachable teacher who is a leader in his field. Lectures are electric. Fair warning, this is not an easy class but you will leave with a strong grasp of the concepts and a heightened appreciation for art. I highly recommend this class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very nice professor, but not clear on expectations or grades.  Does not really give feedback, so you are left the last week of class having no idea what your grade is.

Prof Van Dyke is really enthusiastic about Modern Art (especially European) and knows a lot. He narrowed the midterm and final down to 32 pieces, which was good since he covers a lot of ground. Attendance was taken randomly 5 times for a grade. Seems like a nice guy. Takes cellphone use personally. I highly recommend this course.
Class is easy if you go to class and pay attention. George is funny! There is a textbook, but I didn't read it.
His class is structured well and he gives you a lot of extra credit. Just come to class, take good notes, and participate and you will succeed. George is hilarious and a fabulous professor!
Knows how to teach material and provides real world examples to connect concepts.
One of the best economics professors. Has a great humor to make the class go by quick. Very well spoken and provides lots of help.
This is my second class with George, I think he is great.
He has everything laid out well... 1 hw assignment per week and 1 discussion per week. His exams are a lot like the study guide just make a good cheat sheet.
My glorious king
Very informative lectures.

I have taken both 1015 and 3229 with George and loved both classes. Econ can be hard to understand, but he really likes to make the material digestible. I truly recommend either of these classes. I even took one online (3229) and still found success!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Great professor who is great at lecturing. I'm a big fan of George.

Great Professor, makes me want to major in economics, so many extra credit opportunities and really caring and you can tell he loves his job and is willing to help. I hope to take him again as he truly is great! Couldn't recommend enough!
Clearly explains expectations and makes material easy to understand.
He is very structured and helpful whenever you need help, great teacher

George is one of my favorite professors at Mizzou. He does a very good job explaining things. I've taken two classes with him now, and he has been generous with bonus points in both. He's a super funny guy, and I enjoy going to his lectures.

George was my favorite professor for the semester. I am in no way good at economics but he made it so easy to understand and was good at explaining things. The class was def not easy but he was always ready to help and explain. he's also hilarious and such a diva, he was amazing. If you suck at economics, take his class, he is an amazing teacher.
I fw george geavy
Good lectures, lots of extra credit opportunities, practice exams and review sessions to help you be prepared

Professor Chikhladze was a great professor and is clearly passionate about the subject he's teaching. As someone who had a really hard time in microeconomics he made macroeconomics one of my favorite classes despite my dislike for math. I also really appreciated having readings and videos that helped my learning. Relatively difficult but engaging!

Professor Chikhladze was a very nonchalant professor, but in the best way possible. He has a flipped classroom, meaning you write notes on the lecture at home, and work through problems during class time. If you forget to do the lecture at home, don't stress, he gives a pretty good summary during class. Also, you get to drop your lowest exam!

Go to class and do the iClicker. He's super understanding and willing to accommodate you if needed. His lectures are good and he truly only wants his students to succeed. You do have to put in some effort, but he does a good job of making it interesting and applying it to real-life examples.
W proffesor.

Although ECON is a tough subject for many, George is liked by so many students. If you have options on professors to take for ECON, take it with George. He is very thorough with lectures and funny/light hearted. He cares about students success as he makes sure to emphasize different resources and gives extra credit to classes as a whole.
George is great! His accent keeps you engaged and his clicker mistakes keep you on your toes. He is fun to look at.
George is dope.  Class participation and discussion participation is very important, and his tests are easy to prepare for!  He is fun and engaging despite the class being over an hour long too.

as long as you attend the lectures, you will be good to go- it's hard not to understand the material as long as you show up. he does a lot of iclicker, but it applies really well. i recommend him to everyone who has an economics course to take.
The rating speaks for itself. George is an amazing professor.

(For context I was in 1015)
- Uses iclicker: He drops 4 of your lowest iclicker grades 
- Drops your lowest test ( had 3 tests and a final )
- If you attend lectures and pay attention you will be fine. The way he teacher is clear and not hard to follow
George is a class act at the University. His lectures are clear and understandable and he is clearly passionate about the subject matter. Ample extra credit as well.
Great professor. One time I saw him at the Chipotle and sat and talked with him for a few minutes on economics.

Second time taking one of George's classes and I wish I could take another. I ended with 17 extra credit points because of attendance/course evaluations. As long as you go to class and take some notes you should do good in this course.
Lecture heavy and is a decent amount of your grade. Exams were pretty easy and you don't need a cheat sheet. Pretty nice guy and understanding.

Very knowledgable prof. The class was fairly hard, but if you go to every class you will be fine. Exams aren't bad. He is very self aware and always knows the appropriate level of difficulty to test us on. A lot of assignments but not necessarily a bad thing because they keep your grade up. Taken his classes twice and would again.
Really good teacher, he prepares you well for exams, content can be tricky sometimes tho

The tests were very easy to understand, he gives us past exams with practice problems for our "study guide", and these questions are similar to the exams. Quizzes don't take more than 20 mins to complete, also the weekly discussions are very strait forward and easy to complete but crucial to your grade. Also iClicker points are very weighted.
Dr. George is the man. I am sad that I can't take any more of his classes. He's funny, engaging, understanding, and he is a chad.

George is kind of hilarious. People will ask questions and he replies "I dont know". One kid proved him wrong by pointing something out in the syllabus and then he changed the syllabus. Got mad at a student for "doordashing" a quesadilla... Anyway pretty easy class, go to lecture because iclicker points add up.

George is an amazing professor and lecturer. I took him for 1015 and decided to take him again for 3229. Lectures are very important in his class, and teach you everything you need for the exam. I wish he still put his lectures on panopto because when I slacked for a unit in 1015 I was able to watch every lecture and get an A on the exam.

George was a great teacher. Show up to class everyday and pay attention to his notes. I liked to take notes of his lecture slides beforehand and take supplemental notes as he went. Write down the problems he does in class. Do the optional chapter problems provided as a way to study for the exam. Don't forget to study the articles for the exam too.

Show up to lecture especially during the Friday clicker questions they will impact your grade. Overall, a great professor don't forget to ask questions if you need clarification, visit his office hours. He is there to help you, also loved the articles that related to the class that required critical thinking.

Dr. Chikhladze is an incredibly knowledgable and charming professor. His lectures are detailed and he is liable to crack jokes often. Homeworks are never too hard, and a good bit of your grade is based on iClicker participation. Pay attention to the video lectures and you will be prepared for the workshops, though I seldom watched them beforehand.
Great teacher overall. The class was very interesting, but the tests are super hard. He gives a good curve at the end of the year though.

Dr. George is great! The weekly quizzes and discussions can get tedious, but they did help me learn the material better. There are clicker questions every Friday, and they are a part of your grade, so if you're going to attend any of the classes, make sure it's the Friday classes. Textbook is helpful, but definitely not necessary (I didn't use it).

George is a teacher, his tests are not too difficult, and the weekly homework assignments do not take long to do either. There are lectures to watch before the discussions that will help you know the material before class. I never watched any of them and still found the discussions to prepare me for the tests. Would definitely take his class again.

George gets a lot of hate about his accent, but it's not bad at all. As long as you don't sit in the back row in a large auditorium, you will be fine. Quiz and discussion every week, usually take no more than 30 minutes. Tests are a little difficult, but just look over the slideshows and you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Out of all the teachers I have had I would rate him at the bottom. His teaching is just downright awful. He doesn't properly prepare you for tests. His accent makes him hard to understand. The practice tests have incorrect answers and he barely gets back to his students when emailing him.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: - Didnt respond to emails - Did not give a curve - So much work (quiz, homework, lectures, practice problems, discussion post) didnt help for exams.

Loved Dr. George! Kept lectures entertaining and exams aren't hard if you go over lectures beforehand. Book helps, but definitely isn't needed. Homework, quizzes, and exams are on a clear schedule so it's not hard to keep up with the class.
Super chill professor. But this class in particular is very challenging. Way more difficult than micro and macro econ

The class was a mix of journalism and econ, but not conducted very relevantly. He was an okay lecturer, nothing special. The class was everyday, though, so that was excruciating. Attendance was taken by clicker.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Attendance isn't mandatory but there are clicker questions and he explains the material super well. I barely paid attention and did amazing in the class - our final score average was so high he didn't even curve the class, so I was not the only one. If you put in work, you'll get results. Also there are a bunch of quizlets to help you study for exa

If you come to class, focus and do weekly quizzes, you'll succeed. The class moves fast, so coming to class and listening is v important but kids who complain and say he's hard just come to class and mess around. If you don't get it, just go into his office hours if you're trying. Literally no reason you can't get an A especially with all the EC

I decided to double major in economics after taking this class. He truly sparked my interest in economics because of his thorough understanding of the subject. It's a difficult class, but there's a chance to earn up to 20 points of extra credit by clicker questions, small projects, papers, etc. which helped a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Very hard to understand and follow because of his thick accent. I wouldn't take this again because even when I went to class and listened, I couldn't hear what he was saying. Definitely a set back to my learning.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Be sure to attend class because you can earn up to 12 bonus points at the end of the semester just by answering the clicker questions. Don't need to read the book.

Not great, doesn't return emails. His tegrity videos were useless because of background noise. No real study guide for tests only practice tests. Made us subscribe to the Wall Street Journal for discussions, I didn't do it but still got 100's on discussions and all quiz answers are online in various quizlets.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: George's lectures sparked an interest for Econ in my life. He covered the relevant material using real life examples, and he didn't waste time. The lectures were pretty lively given the subject matter. Make sure to look over the material in your free time and reach out when you need questions answered.

great teacher, after talking to other classmates im pretty sure he is the easiest teacher for this specific course.  only "need" textbook for homework, teaches most everything in class...  homework isnt to relevant a doesnt waste alot of time gong over irrelevant material that wont be on exam.  putting off 4353 so i can take that with him too

The class sucks, but George knows what he's talking about and teaches the content well . Lots of extra credit opportunities to save your grade.  Pay attention, take good notes, go to the review sessions and you'll end up with a fine grade.
George is an okay professor I would say. The way he describes things isn't always the best but he tries. He's hot so that helps but he's overall meh..

He really wants to make sure that we understand what's going on in class. Tons of extra credit opportunities. Always on time to class and always lets us out on time. I don't have to take anymore Econ classes, but I would definitely take his class again.

George is alright. Extra credit opportunities are nice, but there is no homework, which limits the learning in this class. Once, I walked all the way to class at 8am (20 minute walk for me) and he missed the class... When emailing him, be ready to forward it back to him several times before he decides to respond in the fewest words possible.

Doesn't respond to emails and isn't really accessible outside of class but is super knowledgeable.  Hard to understand though, has a very heavy accent.  Good sense of humor and is very attractive so easy to pay attention too. Have to work your ass off to get an A, though.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Highly recommend going to every class. He gives out extra credit for those who are in the top 25% of the class with clicker points. Class is super boring but he tries to make it more relatable to us with good examples in lecture. Don't wait till last minute to study for tests. Don't ever bother emailing him because he rarely ever answers back.

George is a great guy, and when you go to his office hours he really helps you understand the material if you're confused. However, he does have a accent. (He's from Georgia) If you're going to struggle with it, choose a different class. While you don't really have to go to class, the topics are harder so attendance is highly suggested.

This class -YAWN. His lecture style is more like rambling and hard to follow. Clicker heavy. Be sure to keep up with the curriculum in the textbook. Tests will kick your butt. Take advantage of ALL extra credit opportunities. TAs mostly grade for completion.

His class is difficult, but only if you do not pay attention or study. He gives former tests for you to study from and offers a review session before each class. Also he gives EC for attending class up to 20 points. The class is hard but with work an A is easy.

George is knowledgeable, friendly, approachable and absolutely dedicated to making Econ understandable for even the least-fluent journalism major. A phenomenal instructor for an otherwise off-putting class. Clicker questions are no longer mandatory, so you don't HAVE to attend every lecture, but you won't regret it one bit come exam time.

George is a great teacher and makes Econ easy. The lectures can be long and it's easy to not pay attention, but if you put in  the effort your grade will reflect that. He's very approachable for extra help, and offers lots of extra credit.

George is a great professor but the class can be tricky if you don't pay attention. It is not that difficult to get a good grade it just can be hard to go to 5 classes a week with long lectures on complex topics. Do ALL the extra credit he gives you.

George is a great Professor.  If you come to class and listen you will mostly likely enjoy the class and get an easy A.  The topic is dry at times, but George is an interesting guy.  If he asks questions or needs help with something always go for it, as he hands out bits of extra credit to people that help him fix the projector etc

George is a nice guy and cares about the topic but I really couldn't listen in class just because he doesn't really make them interesting and especially because it's everyday.  Tests can get hard sometimes so make sure you study more than just his practice tests.

Everyone says he's the best Econ professor. He wants you to do well and doesn't try to trick you or anything but if you don't study you won't. Weekend quizzes are easy to forget but they're also pretty easy.  Lecture attendance is random and for extra credit but LAB ATTENDANCE IS MANDATORY.  I've heard he's easier on his 8am class but idk

Awesome teacher! Very intelligent but keeps everything on a college lecture hall level. Doesn't confuse you by trying to go over your head. The tests are worded clear and aren't that hard. Clicker points is an easy way to boost grade. Respect him fully!
Awesome guy. Loved the class

Dry lectures, and often notes are not so useful for the quiz, exercise or tests. Have to self-teaching by reading textbook. Tests are easier than the quiz or exercises. Generous curve after the final.
I loved George! He is funny and has a great accent so you'll stay engaged. He is really good at what he teaches. He understands it well and can translate that to students well.
George is funny and is nice to students. He is also beautiful to look at. This may be bad, but I went to class to see him because he is just that beautiful.

He's nice too look at and his accent makes lectures bearable. Class is pretty boring unless you're interested in economics.. but if you want a good grade go to class and pay attention as hard as it may be.
He is a harsh grader, and when you go see him he is not helpful, and makes you feel dumb. Doesn't bump you up when you have a 79.6...

Such a helpful professor! He is awesome and funny and friendly and overall great! ECON 1051 is a easy class if you go to every class. DON'T SKIP. Because George's class explains everything you need to know in details. I feel bad for people who failed this class because it is so easy and useful. PS there are bunch of extra credits.
Impossible to pass this class without attending almost each day. If good notes are taken, its not too hard to get by with a good grade without reading the textbook.
George is a very smart man and a good professor. Personally I'm not the economics type, but he made it tolerable. He has a cool accent and I see him playing basketball at the Rec on a daily basis.

The class is very easy, and you could do well just reading the textbook as it covers all the information. George is a great lecturer, though, and he does a great job of explaining what the book doesn't do a great job of explaining, and of providing practical examples of the theories. By far the best Econ prof I've had

This professor is worthless. I emailed him multiple times and never got a response. And when I did finally get a response he called me by the WRONG name. Does not care about students at all and you can't even understand him. If he says the word GARMIN he is trying to say GOVERNMENT.
He's a great teacher and you get used to his accent really quickly. Received A's on almost every test

George is excellent person with sense of humor which makes this boring subject very interesting, he is always well prepared and knows what he is talking. Explains very clear and in details, I would take Econometric class of George but he did not teach it. Good bless you George:)

He's a funny guy and a clear explainer. Class isn't necessary to attend but I'd recommend it to help on quizzes and extra credit. Medium hard exams...the final was a killer but I still walked away with an A-.

George is a great guy. Make sure you attend all of the classes and come to the Wednesday classes especially because that's where the journalism portion comes in. Google the quiz questions also, the answers are online. Do the practice tests and exams before exams. George has funny jokes. Don't sit on facebook or your phone during class.

He is amazing! He really knows what he is talking about. Failed Sandy's class and retook with George. He is SO MUCH BETTER! I suggest taking his class! He has a dry sense of humor which makes class fun.

Dr. George is an amazing professorial. He makes everything extremely easy to understand. You don't need to read the text, his lectures are simple. Take the time to talk to him. he will help you out a lot. I've never understood how kids thought this class was difficult.

Prof. Chickladze is great for an 8am, especially an econ 8am. He makes these random little jokes and has horrible handwriting, but still likes to write things out. His graphs help a lot when explaining concepts. Sitting in the front row is an excellent idea -- otherwise it is much too tempting to FB. He obviously knows what he is talking about. :)

George is a good professor especially during an 8 am class. He knows what he's talking about and is easy to understand. He has good examples and wants his students to understand the material. Read the book as it's helpful for the quizzes every week, usually it's word for word in the textbook, and it's not a bad read. Old tests available too.

George is great! He is a fair grader and really cares about his students. He has a thick Middle-Eastern accent so at first he is hard to understand but you get used to the way he says things quickly. His jokes are actually funny and he does a lot of examples which help a ton! Make sure you go to class every day, and actually pay attention!!

Professor George is awesome. I didn't buy the textbook, I just made sure I went to lecture everyday. He really spells everything out in the powerpoints. Weekly quizzes help you stay on top of your game. He curves at the end, too. I did have to sit in the front so I could hear/understand him. I dreaded this class but Prof. George made it bearable.

Not worth your gpa. The first few weeks I had no idea what was going on and completely failed the quizes (he gives them out each weekend.) I stopped going to class and started to read out of the book, take my own notes, and used Aplia (an online program) I've aced every exam since. Moral of the Story: you can teach yourself.

George is a good professor, knows what he's talking about. Gives old exams for practice. Quizzes every week keep you updated in the class so you dont fall behind. With effort this class is an easy B, possible A.
Keeps up the pace and uses good examples

A very good professor. Gave a lot of extra credit on make up quizzes, a make up exam, and random attendance points. I got a 50/50 on every in class exam because he goes over the written problems a lot in class. Read the book to study more of the small stuff that will be on the final exam multiple choice.
george is a great teacher and tried very hard to help everyone succeed. great class! and TA's were awesome too!

amazing teacher, funny clear, to the point. easy class would have had an easy A if i would have completed all my assignments on time. TA's are little to no help tho. but i definitely would recomend this class to anyone taking an economics. AMAZING CLASS.

took his microeconomics class, great teacher made things really simple. I would definitely recommened him, easy as long as you go to class. didnt order a book, notes were online,very informitive class
I would hang out with Captain George after class. He's that cool. And more importantly, he's a fantastic teacher.

Attendance is not mandatory but lectures can be intricate so it's still advisable to attend. She publishes all materials on Canvas so everything is accessible and organized. A lot of reminders about assignments are given in class so not attending could mean missing an assignment unless you check Pearson frequently.

Dr. Downer is one of those people that really REALLY wants everyone to succeed and wants everyone to have the same passion about science that she does. That makes the disorganization and 30 minute off topic rants easier to take. The textbook isn't necessary but definitely attend class, she will give the peeps in class a leg up on tests and quizzes.

As long as you participate in class, schedule office hours (keep trying to email even if she doesn't respond), do the homework, and study for the tests you will be fine! She can be disorganized at times but she also cares very much about biology and students success.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you want a professor who won't even follow their own syllabus, this is perfect for you. It is also great when she makes a big deal about cheating and punishes everyone and says no one gets a curve, but then admits on the last lecture that it was only a handful of students involved but yet we all got disciplined. She is just all over the place.

So unorganized and forgets to tell you about assignments she posted. Tests are fairly easy if you actually study, but she formats some of the tests terribly. She attempted to punish the class for a few individuals cheating and then came up with the worst possible solution for future tests. Finally, she will not respond to your emails. ever.

Dr Downer's organization of the class is not perfect BUT CLEAR.  I guess you cant please everyone. She cares about student sucess and takes cheating seriously. There were some bad actors in this class and yes there were consequences to prevent a repeat. But security measures though a PAIN were never harmful. I would HIGLY recommend.

Professor Dwoner is very unorganized, even for a general biology class for non-majors. She really does whatever she wants. She changed the exam format the day of the exam and was upset we didn't finish after she took up thirty minutes of class to talk about how the final would be "the hardest she has ever made for students."  Avoid this class!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great class. Loved the topics. Lectures are a bit long but just go to class and be engaged. Ask questions and take good notes. You will be FINE.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The course is pretty organized.  There are 4 exams. Each exam covers a number of concepts. Grading criteria is clear but some scores may be delayed. Overall very decent class. I have  learnt a lot. I see comments about the professor horrible. SO NOT true, she is fair and wants you to succeed.

Dr Downer is very passionate about biology. She spends a lot of time explaining concepts in lecture. You can tell she cares about students learning the material. She will throw curveballs on test and switch things up at times. It may catch you be surprise but it will be helpful for your grade. Beware of Post Lecture Quizzes.

This is my first science course in college and it was great. The lectures were long but organized and clear. The course canvas page is also VERY organized. I am confused about people saying she is not organized. Maybe they should come to class. She is ALWAYS  available for office hours if you make an appointment. Lots of chances for Extra Credit,

She is extremely unorganized and cause me more stress than needs to be for a intro level class. Don't get test scores back until like 3 weeks later, after coming to class and saying the grade will be released soon.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is very disorganized and does not respond in a timely manner. She can be late sometimes to class and office hours. Her lectures can be disorganized and she doesn't line up with the textbook. Lecture heavy, and I would not take her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Absolutely horrible and SO unorganized. Told students the DAY OF the exam that it was all open note- though me and other students studied very hard for this exam as she said it was one of the harder exams. Then to tell us our final exam will be the hardest and that we dont really have a study guide for. Never actually teaches material at all.

TRY YOUR BEST TO AVIOD HER CLASS! She is very unorganized and is all over the place. The material is easy learned this stuff in high school but her teaching makes it so confusing. She never stays on the right timeline so it makes it hard to use the online textbook to study. She spends 30 min each slide. Bad at communication. Never looks at email!
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Downer does care about her students, but she is the most unorganized professor I have interacted with. She DOES NOT respond to emails or post grades in a timely manner, she is always late to office hours or meetings. The material is not hard, but her disorganization makes the class harder than it should be. She is a okay in lecture.
SO nice and helpful if you really need it. Go to office hours and you'll be totally fine.

Not a particulary inspirng class, but also not difficult. The negative reviews come from people who won't make it far in college: of course Dr. Downer won't teach everything in lecture; studying is required out of class hours. Regardless, it is still elementary bio, nothing too difficult.

She wasn't a bad professor, just very disorganized. Lecture materials posted online, very few assignments/case studies all semester. Exams were not difficult, mirrored in person lectures and content she posted. She really cares for her students, but she had a lot of life things going on. Definitely one of the easier biology classes I have taken.

Be sure to take this class with Dr. Downer if you like disorganization within a class. By far the most disorganized professor I have had. Lectures have little to no structure, and there was no direction on the exams. Every exam had at least one error and would lead to questions being taken out. Get ready to teach yourself the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Downer is truly one of the most attentive and willing to help professors i've had. The exams are not set up to trick you, and she is very repetitive which helps a lot. Also her homework is very relative to the content/exams. Very sweet and funny, would definitely recommend! P.S. go to class! She offers lots of hints to those who are present.

Tests don't make sense, like I couldn't understand the answer choices. Test review is super vauge and somehow all the tests are formated wrong or ask stuff we never learned. So much out of class work too. Treats you like a child

Not sure why she has so many poor reviews. Never went to the lecture and ended class with an A. Exams are open note. Just make sure you do the homework on time and you'll most likely end up with a good grade. She gave study guides for most of the exams (but not all?)

I HIGHLY recommend talking to her and getting to know her. She was such a wonderful teacher and so understanding. The exams were a bit difficult but the other class work was self-explanatory and well needed. DO THE TEST REVIEWS!! YOU WILL GET EC. Anywho, would have her as a professor any day.

If you do the work, you'll be fine. The tests were all open note and she let you use any resources that you needed. Honestly, I don't really know why she has a lot of bad reviews, but if you're taking her for Bio-1010 you shouldn't have anything to worry about.

Very knowledgeable and can be funny at times but takes time out of every class period to tell students to keep coming to class. Also no late work is accepted which can be a problem for some. I haven't emailed her but know she gets a lot of emails and responds to most.

While she doesn't require attendance, she highly encourages it, but it is nice to not be forced to be in class. Is not very flexible with deadlines, but we are in college, so I didn't expect it to be easy. She understands it is an intro course and explains topics very well.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Downer was supposed to be my instructor for Bio 1500, but most of the class was conducted by the other Bio 1500 professor, Dr. Bush. All of the homework videos are done by other people in the Bio department, and the class is set up well but oftentimes the once-weekly active learning sessions seem like busywork.

I took bio 1500 with Dr. Downer and thought it was a great class. Just be aware that it's flipped so there's lots of homework. The material is a little strange at times but it's interesting.  Even though my schedule said the class was MWF, you don't need to go every day. Dr. Downer was really nice and helpful.
Good professor, really caring of her students. I went to maybe 50% of the zoom calls and got an A. Just do the assignments and study for tests and you'll be good

this class was synchronous and I struggled keeping focus during a lecture zoom, That has nothing to do with her teaching tho I got a b because of the effort I put in. It was a learning experience for me if you struggle with paying attention during lectures normally this is not the class for you. The best thing is she gives lots of extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had her on zoom and I thought It was great. Sometimes she can overcomplicate something but she posts her slides and records her lectures incase you miss it. She also gives you extra credit which is super helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Downer cares about her students, and is always willing to help. However, she moves quickly and jumps around through lectures, and does not follow a specific schedule for posting assignments. Dr. Downer is one of the sweetest professors I've had, but if you struggle with a lack of structure, you may want to take this course with someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Downer is one of the best professors I have had. She genuinely cares about her students and their grades. There is an extra credit opportunity before each exam (4 total). She covers everything you need to know for the exam during the lectures, so reading the book is not completely necessary. Late on posting exams.

The sweetest lady ever so genuine & cares about everyone. Very approachable. Homework was actually helpful, & there were lots of extra credit opportunities. The only thing for me is I studied a good amount with flashcards + her study sheets and never got an A on a test. One bad test wont kill your grade though. She loves her job & students!
Professor Downer worked hard consistently to manage such a large class. I respect Professor Downer's dedication to tending to each of her students and making them feel heard.

Dr. Downer is a great professor who really cares about her students. Her lectures are very thorough and is willing to answer questions. If needing extra help she is willing to talk to you one on one or with a group. A very sweet professor who wants to get to know her students and wants them to succeed.

Dr. Downer is a caring professor, and she puts thought into making sure her students achieve good scores. If you pay attention during lectures and study the material (making a quizlet is helpful) you should have no problem getting an A. Only thing is she never puts up exams or assignments when she says she will so I had to change my schedule around

Dr. Downer brought life to some complicated chapters within the course but she never made it impossible to pass. She had constant review sessions, one on one times, and always ready to laugh. Without a doubt my favorite professor and hopefully friend after the course

Dr. Downer did an excellent job presenting the material to us and covering all topics that would be on exams. Textbook reading was not required but I found the lectures more digestible by reading ahead of the material so I was somewhat familiar by the time she lectured. She is extremely compassionate and loves her students. Highly Recommend.
She was an amazing teacher and she truly cared about each of her students!

Professor Downer seemed like the only professor that cared about you. She wanted to see all of her students succeed, and talked about the importance of mental health, which was honestly a relief because she was just real. She is so kind to everyone and is simply a good person. Im lucky to have had her as my bio professor. Definitely recommend.
I LOVE DOWNER AND SHE IS SUCH A GREAT PROFESSOR!! SHE IS THE BEST AND HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

Dr. Downer is EXTREMELY APPROACHABLE. She had regular zoom meetings just to connect with students outside of class. She is down to earth and supportive. She really cares about her students' well being. Exams and quizzes were made available for several days online. On the last day of class, many of us let her know how much we appreciate her!

She is honestly a great teacher. She is super passionate about her job and subject. She dummy proofs the lectures, so if you pay attention you barely need to study or learn the topics on your own. The tests are extremely reasonable and she gives out a ton of extra credit. Honestly a great class, and she deserves a higher rating.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: A straight-up baller who is both very educated and passionate about Biology. Perhaps intimidating but actually really caring and funny, will meet 1 on 1. Going to lectures and review sessions is vital.

Dr Downer has been one of my favorite professors! She is very passionate about the topic and that shows in her lectures. She knew that we were all there for a requirement and gave tons of help and extra credit. I am not a science person and had one of my best grades in her class. She gives HW but its all helpful and shows back up on exams!

She is very clear in her lectures. Exams and assignments are graded in a timely manner and she provides feedback on all assignments through canvas. Study guides and reviews are provided for exams. You have to attend class and actually study. I enjoy this class and her organization of the course material is a bonus!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Downer is the best professor I've had. She gives around 16 pts EC every test, and every test is made up of all the questions from the study guides and homework. If you do the study guides and hw, it should be a very easy A. She's passionate about the topic and it shows through her teaching. Lectures were never boring. Would HIGHLY recommend.

Dr. Downer is clear in her teaching style and very accessible outside of class. She moves quickly in her lectures, and takes a hard line on side conversations in her class. The exams are not too difficult if one studies, and attending class makes studying tons easier, although she does still post her slides online.

reviews.comment: Downer is a very interesting teacher to say the least. Sometimes she does get lost and off track, but most of the time she is clear on what she is trying to get across. Teaches to all her exams and if you go to class she gives hints to some questions on the exams. Would for sure recommend taking her Bio 1010 class because its very easy.

reviews.comment: She is very nice, but I feel like her teaching skills just didn't work for me.

reviews.comment: I'm not sure why she has such low ratings, she is very clear on what she expects and what is going to be on the exams. Very friendly and is ALWAYS asking in class if there are any questions.
