He was an absolutely amazing teacher. The tests are created by the students, so in turn they are pretty easy and he gives an enormous amount of EC. He is very helpful and everything is very straight forward. I highly recommend him!

He's very passionate about what he teaches and he's very good at what he does. However, the class was rather difficult. His lecture slides only have pictures on them so you have to make sure you take good notes and pay attention. I did enjoy how he recorded every lecture so I didn't miss anything even if I was sick.
Assigned multiple "group essays"
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Blomquist is clearly very knowledgeable and passionate about anthropology. The lectures can be a bit boring but he gave us a brain break halfway through class. The powerpoint slides he posts are useless without attending lecture because he says most of the important information.

Super nice guy but lectures can be pretty dry. Make sure you show up to class and listen attentively. Even though he posts his slides on canvas it's not enough to get by on the tests, so make sure you take good notes during class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Blomquist is clearly a very nice guy but his lectures can be pretty dry. However, if you show up to the lectures and listen attentively then you don't need to read the book and you'll do fine on the tests. I recommend taking the lab along with the lecture because it's super helpful to get extra practice with the material.
If you go to lecture you don't have to do the readings.  He makes lecture slides available online, but if you don't take good notes they are completely useless. Study the vocab for each test.
Horrible. Uninteresting, unclear lecturer with incomprehensible powerpoints and a poorly-written textbook. I've learned absolutely nothing, and the homework has very little to do with the subject.

I honestly never read the book and still got an A. He curves exam scores and takes attendance three times a semester. He's a really nice guy and you can tell he's passionate about what he does. I highly recommend taking the lab WITH the lecture because it is unbelievably helpful.

I thought he was a good teacher. I did most of the readings, not 100% of them, but he opens up discussions in class so it's easy to participate. I thought the tests were straightforward and it's clear he has an interest in student learning.

Blomquist is really quiet; he is knowledgable, but does not make the class interesting. Even coming in with prior enthusiasm was not enough to make the class enjoyable. Speaking with him after class is awesome, but during lecture there is just no . . . its boring. He can also sometimes he a little arrogant, but he doesn't mean anything by it.

HORRIBLE! He taught his lectures discussion style and then his tests are completely different, extremely hard! He expects everyone in his class to be an ANTHRO major, I am a minor and have had A BUNCH of prior knowledge and experience coming into his class and I bombed it. His arrogance is astounding. Truly doesn't care about you learning.
He teaches one way and yet tests a completely different way, I can see where a lot of kids would not only do poorly in his class but get easily frustrated at his reading load!

I actually really liked him, he's very calm and soft spoken, but he's definitely not incomprehensible. Class was very laid back and usually just open discussions of the readings, which were interesting most of the time.

Actually a great teacher if you pay attention... Sit in the front of the class and you'll hear him fine. Tests aren't difficult if you come to class and take good notes. He gives you all the slides so there's no reason not to do well if you just prepare. TAKE THE LAB! It's a BIG advantage.  Great class and interesting material!!

Horrible teacher.  Boring speaker.  Points at words at a power point and doesn't explain his examples using proper analogies etc...  Doesn't comprehend his own guidelines or go by his own rules either.  Seems like he is on a constant power trip when speaking to him outside of class.  I don't recommend.

This teacher is very arrogant and doesn't care if you understand the lecture. He speaks really softly and mumbles the entire lecture. His exams are extremely difficult. They cover lots of information and there is not a study guide or a study list. He takes attendance around ten times randomly and if you miss times your final grade is deducted.
Super easy going and caring professor.

Great class, great professor. Dr. Blackburn really cares about informing her students and cares very little about memorization. She presents information that is interesting and she is very knowledgable. Would recommend the class to anyone.

Dr. Blackburn is by far one of my favorite professors! I enjoyed taking my capstone with her. She is so invested in seeing seniors pass and gradutate. Do not be surprised about the group work as that is what the capstone is for. Only had to come to class once a week. Quizzes and midterm were easy. Heavy emphasis on doing your part within your group
Amazing professor!!! She really cares about each student and wants us to succeed. I would recommend this course and professor to anyone and everyone. Easy A.

Loved this professor. You could tell she actually was interested in the topic. Just go to class and take notes and you will be fine. There are two tests and other small assignments, but everything is open note. She also gave points for attendance. I didn't like was how fast she went through her powerpoint but she posts it on Canvas after class.

Do yourself a favor and take Dr. Blackburn! She is absolutely amazing! She truly cares about her students and is extremely helpful! She tries to get students engaged during lectures and listens to what everyone has to say. I have the utmost respect and appreciation for Botswana Blackburn!

dr. blackburn is a very nice lady, she really gets to know her students and is there if you absolutely need her. Very lecture heavy but slides were also on canvas. 50 points worth of participation so go to class. she is very nice and would recommend any of her courses

Dr. Blackburn is great in the capstone. Many group papers and assignments. Midterm is hardest assignment. Papers are an easy A if you follow rubric. Need to be at class once a week. Would highly recommend taking HS4985 with Blackburn.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: If you're willing to work a little, this class is an easy A. There is at least one assignment each week, sometimes two. The exams aren't too terribly difficult if you do the assigned readings, watch the videos and listen to the lectures. She doesn't respond to emails quickly at all which is a downside since the class is online. Overall, solid class
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--SO MANY PAPERS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Definitely recommend taking Public Health with Professor Blackburn, loved her! Class content isn't hard and if you come to class it's a guaranteed A pretty much.

I love love love Dr. Blackburn. She's hands down the best professor I had at Mizzou. She was always willing to help, coursework is not too difficult, tells you what's on exams. If you can take her, TAKE HER. There's absolutely no reason you can fail her classes.

Probably the best teacher I have had at Mizzou. The class is interesting and easy. She is willing to help and is always concerned about her students understanding. The topics in her class are relevant and definitely not boring.

Blackburn cares a lot about the subject matter and her students. I only opened the book during the open book test, and probably could go without it.  Tests are easy if you print the summary slides from each lecture. Go to class and do the projects, and you'll be fine.

Very easy class, useful info about our healthcare system, she puts her Powerpoints on BB, you can have a one page study guide on the tests, sometimes the class is interesting, sometimes its dull but it is very easy, I highly recommend it.

Easiest class I have ever taken and its a 4000 level! She gives you everything you need for the test and allows you a study guide. Her assignments are super easy too. Either pay attention in class or read the assigned books (but you don't have to do both) and you will get an A, B at the VERY least.

I had an A going into the final and answered a question on the exam exactly as taught by HIS TA. When I brought the item and supporting documentation to Prof Bluedorn, he said information provided by the TA was not to be relied upon for his exams. Why in the world would I go to the TA sessions? This was very close minded and frustrating.
Lots of karisma and intelligents.  Outstanding.
Wonderful teacher...exemplifies everything a real teacher should be...definitely take his class.
Helpful, friendly, and consistent in his teaching. If you need his help, he will go out of his way, 150% to help you. GREAT professor!
Very clear and helpful.  He tells you exactly what you need to know for the exam and is friendly
Great teacher, trys to make things interesting and makes sure people learn what they need to, very clear, on what to learn to do good in the class.

Professor Blandon is a funny and upbeat teacher if you are willing to participate and speak up in class. There are a lot of readings to do, and he does not enter in grades immediately so I was never sure of my overall grade, but he is a genuinly nice guy. You just really need to put in the effort.

This is my 2nd time having him! I have loved him each time! While he doesn't use Canvas a lot (you dont know your grade till the last week), if you show up to class & speak (I missed 2), youll get an A. You don't even have to speak well! There were 20 people in my class and 10 of them received A's. There's hw b4 class but Google summaries can help!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I normally get As in Spanish but not here. Every class is a discussion but you HAVE to participate and turn in a summary of the (very dense) reading. It was impossible to know how you were doing since he doesnt record any grades on Canvas and has unclear expectations. I found him to be condescending and rude and do not recommend taking his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I was a little overwhelmed at first, but once you understand the format of the class it is very enjoyable. You will have to read a lot and turn in a page of notes for every class, which I found helpful as something I would do anyway. Participate & contribute and you will do very well in this class. Lectures were interesting and great for practice.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I enjoyed Spanish before taking his class. He can sometimes be condescending in how he responds to his students. He also gives a lot of busy work. You have to write a summary (about 1 page) for EVERY SINGLE LECTURE, but the class isn't writing intensive. Participation matters!! Try to get on his good side and do the homework and you'll get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: No Tests. Do your homework and participate and you'll get an A. Great guy and fun teacher.

Good professor overall. He teaches well, and I always enjoyed his lectures. He expects some participation. A little unclear with assignments though - half the time the class was confused about what he'd want us to do exactly, or what his expectations were. I thought I was going to get a C or something but ended up with an A. Wooh!

This class was easy, but enjoyable. The occasional movie was a slog to watch, but that's literally every film class. Andy sometimes made jokes that made me roll my eyes, but he's chill. I like him, and he gives good feedback even when he gives you 100% all semester. Seriously, do the work and you'll pass, even if it's late sometimes.
Best class I have ever taken at Mizzou! Love Andy Black and everyone should take a class with him.

Cross-listed as Theater 3930 the class was really easy, for 1/2 of the weekly assignments he would lead a discussion that would basically give the answers & the assignment was due that night so if you didn't do it you're fine, really understanding with corona, not strict on deadlines at all, extra credit for attendance, I got 100% in the class

GIVE THIS MAN A STANDING OVATION! He is an incredible teacher. Because of COVID we only got to do 2 of 3 of the assigned plays but, he as a person is caring and amazing. The class got very personal at times and there was laughing, there was crying.
Goat, one of the friendliest professors, never puts unnecessary expectations upon you

Professor Bombard was actually one of the sweetest professors I've had. She's very clear in her directions, and if you simply do her assignments and show up, you will get a good grade. She wants you to succeed and does her best to help you succeed.

Dr. Bombard was a very great person! Some of her assignment styles weren't my favorite, and for an English 1000 class you do need to attend. That's where you can get most of your points and keep up with assignments. Everything was relatively easy, except for the group project since people didn't show. It's an easy A if you put literally any effort.

Dr. Bombard was an incredible creative writing professor. She treated everyone's work with the care it deserved and gave fantastic feedback, all while keeping a central goal of encouraging the artistic growth of each student. Her class was a delight!
super easy prof but sweet! if looking to better your poetry go to her!

I had her for English 1000 and she is the sweetest, as well as a great teacher and an all around kind human being. You can tell shes passionate about what she does, is super helpful, and a pretty easy grader. She does her best to make a fairly dull gen ed class as painless and stress-free as possible. I really enjoyed English with her!

I recently injured my knee and cannot make a 20-minute walk to class on crutches. When I asked for any form of accommodation, the professor told me I could not access the video notes and that my only option was to have a friend take notes for me. So, be wary, you have to be in class every day, no matter what, or you will not know what's going on.

Had her for Math 4370, 4371, and 4372. Fantastic teacher and resource for actuarial students at Mizzou. As long as you put in the effort for the quizzes and tests, she will see the work you put in and you end up with a good grade. Attendance not required but recommended.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very formula heavy class that requires a lot of practice and studying. Exam questions are usually taken from homeworks. Weekly quizzes and homework assignments help to keep up with the material.

Although homework was not mandatory in this class, Professor Bobitan gives plenty of suggested problems.  The material and class are quite difficult, but the quiz and test problems are similar to (or the same as) the suggested problems and class examples.  She is willing to meet with you to help you understand the material well.

He maintains a very structured and strict classroom. He expects no talking and attention for the whole lecture. Lectures are long and require sustained focus. Classroom policies on phone use, talking, and headphones are consistently enforced, and reminders will be given. I would not recommend taking this if you don't have to

Dr. Booker's tests are extremely long (80-100 questions, ~2 hours long) and his lectures are boring and monotonous. However, he is super generous with grading and knows what he's talking about. You can miss around 3 weeks of class and still get a 100% attendance grade, and he drops our lowest exam and 3 of our lowest homeworks. Easy class to pass.

I would for sure take his class again, I had him this recent semester and I had a 95% in his class. The tests are difficult but studying makes it easy. He has many opportunities for extra credit and allows you to miss a good amount of class + a dropped test grade. I felt very comfortable with being able to score high in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Booker is the worst professor I've had. He lectures in a monotone, reads slides we already have, and tries (and fails) to be funny. In-class questions are mandatory and tests are hard, often unrelated to lecture or book. He does drop the lowest test though. He calls out students for talking. Total waste of time.

Dr. Booker is very nice and this class is very easy but his lectures are incredibly boring. I would take it again though because you can miss a certain amount of days that get dropped, theres no final, and the exams are open note. He will yell at you though if you talk during his lecture.
Dr. Booker is a very good professor. All exams are online, open book, open note, and there is no final. The class is very easy and interesting.

This professor is awesome! The class is an easy A. Mandatory attendance, but open-note exams (all online). He leaves the exams open for 3-4 days, leaving you plenty of time to take it. Probably the easiest psych class you'll ever take. Also posts the notes online to go back and review. Allows three skipped classes per semester. Overall worth it!

Dr. Booker's Developmental Psych class is an easy A. Although attendance is mandatory, lectures are not too bad. The tests are online and open note, he also provides recordings of lectures as well as transcript summaries for each of them so you don't have to re watch them. Extra credit with textbook material as well.

Dr. Booker is a really good guy and you can tell he is passionate about what he teaches. The classes can sometimes lack engagement (if you have a short attention span like me lol), but he posts all the notes online so it's easy to go back and study! The exams are online and open note. Overall a great class and an easy A!

Our entire grade was based off of 5 exams. 4 making up 60% of your grade (lowest dropped) and the final itself 40%. The first 2 exams of the semester there were multiple internet issues and after multiple complaints by students he put them online, remote and open note. Lectures were boring and he posted the notes. 10% extra credit online.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Good professor, easier class. Online tests and homework. The professor will call you out if you are talking during a lecture.

I kind of lost interest in developmental psychology in the middle of the semester. The tests were hard and I blew the last three. But, most of the grade was based off attendance and homework, which motivated me to go. He wrote his own textbook, demonstrating mastery of his field, but I still got bored in his lectures.

I loved taking this class! The pros were all the exams were online, the lectures were easy to follow and take notes on, and the unit homeworks only being due before the exam, instead of on certain days. The only real con of this class was attendance being mandatory through iclicker. I would recommend taking this class!!
Very easy class. All the homework and tests are online. Attendance is mandatory and counts for points, so go to class. Fairly interesting class.

Professor Booker is honestly a very caring man. The worst part about this class is that attendance is mandatory even though you feel like you shouldn't have to go. Exams are online and the homework is just learning curves. Very easy A.

His class wasn't hard, but it was really confusing. The information given in lecture wasn't the same as what was on the test, so you had to read the book very thoroughly. There was so much extra credit offered I probably could've skipped two exams instead of just one, but you get one drop exam anyway.

Lecture is very boring and long and all of the info is in the notes. I would still recommend going because he reinforces the information. Online homework is nice for practice and he offered a ton of extra credit at the end of the year. Tests are kinda difficult but he curved all of them for my class and that helped my grade a lot.

If you took AP Psych, you'll know most of the material in this course. All tests were open note and fully multiple choice with no cumulative final. Not a particularly engaging class for me, but Dr. Booker was a solid lecturer and clearly communicated what he expected from students on day 1. If you need a chill psych class, this is a solid choice.

I enjoyed Developmental Psych, and Professor Booker was great, too. The class was interesting and not too much work. Sometimes I feel like the test materials were not given in the notes or slides, but the semester I took it we were allowed one retake on every test, so the grading wasn't too hard. A fair and enjoyable class and instructor.

The class is straight forward. If you do the homework and take the quizzes on time, then you will pass the class. The teacher is very nice and helpful. He answers all questions to the best of his ability.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: No textbook or zoom lectures, but you do have to buy a code to access homework. There is a small assignment and quiz due weekly. Booker makes concepts very easy to understand and the class is very interesting. There are usually multiple attempts given at each quiz and extra credit offered at end of semester. Would take again!

Attendance is a big part of grade so that is a grade saver. Lectures have little to do with the test. Average C tests (Which was normal most people got C or lower) but still got an A because of homework and extra credit quizzes. He says info is in book but that still didnt help.

Super easy class to pass. He does take attendance through Top Hat but you're allowed to miss a few days. No cumulative final and he drops an exam grade. Mainly reads off of his slides, exams are passable if you read the textbook, do the practice quizzes, and the textbook flashcards. Tons of extra credit points.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is the hardest person to listen to for an hour. He just reads off of the slides and doesn't expand off of them. He does not give examples that will help you prepare for the exams. The exams are also hard and the class average is usually in the 60s. If you are looking for a class to not be too challenging you are not looking for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Lectures are boring and theres no use even going to them because NONE of what he talks about will be on the exams. Developmental Psych is a super interesting subject but Jordan Booker fails to effectively teach it.
puts things on the exam that we never went over, even if you study it doesn't matter because you still will not know something on the test.

Very awesome guy! He really wants his students to do well and you can tell he is really interested in the topic. Lectures and slides are very straight forward, same with the exams. He's is really nice by putting all of his notes online so missing class isn't that big of a deal.

Super nice guy. Class days usually consist of taking notes so if you can't go to class for some reason the notes are always online. Test are pretty straight forward if you look over your notes and read chapters in your book. One essay at the end of the semester but not difficult. Lots of online activities that are participation grades.
Dr. Boyce is an inspiration! He is so knowledgeable, and funny. I was dreading taking Logic but he makes the extremely hard material very manageable.
He prepares you perfectly for exams/homework's, never gives unexpected questions, and does a good job at keeping lectures engaging with thought provoking questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I know him!
Please take this class!
You wont regret learning about the universes secrets with Dr. Boyce—the goat.
This class changed my life for the better
His classes are hard but its so worth it.
Just go to class and do the readings, and you will have a great grade and a great time.
Discussions are so fun!
Very sad to see all the bad ratings. Dont listen to them.
Learn whats right and wrong the right way
Best Proff at mizzou
So interesting! Take this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The only problem with Dr. Boyce is that he is too smart pick his brain and you wont regret it
I dont understand all the bad ratings. Yes its a hard class but you will learn so much. Best Prof at MU.
Truly a subject matter expert. His passion for philosophy is contagious.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Hard readings but so fruitful. Ive never learned more in any class ive ever taken at mizzou
Amazing! Smartest guy Ive ever met. A true philosopher, and very funny! Go Dr. Boyce!!

Dr. Boyce is very nice but this class was terrible.  He goes too fast through the slides and makes us cram so many topics into one class. There would be stuff on the syllabus for October and we were learning it the first week of September. He gave us an exam after he had cancelled class and office hours for two weeks straight.

I think this is the most boring class I could've ever taken. I was so excited to take philopshy this semester and I have been so disappointed. The readings are long and terribly hard, he doesn't define terms and just flies through slides. The TA is the best part of class. I dread going to class, everyone I've talked to in my section feels the same.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This professor made me lose interest in philosophy. I had wanted it as a minor, but after taking his course I could no longer pursue the subject. I worked very hard on papers and got horrible grades returned to me. Maybe philosophy isn't for me, but he could've pointed it out without such harsh feedback and grading.

An amazing professor! I took the class just because I needed an honors credit and though I would hate it, but he made the class extremely interesting and constantly asked students to give their opinions and thoughts about the material. Class was a casual discussion between students and professor instead of a lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: It's not a hard class, its a boring class. Professor Boyce is extremely passionate about ethics and likes to challenge his students to think, but doesn't do a very clear job of making sure the arguments we go over are understood.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: The only textbook use are the two small book requirements that have assigned readings and quizzes each week. Quizzes are random so reading is important, but he gives three quiz drops. Only two exams that are very straight forward as long as you attend class. Attendance isnt mandatory, but definitely recommended because its for points.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Hard class with 2 Papers that are basically your entire grade outside of the midterm and final. Pop quizzes make students read but not even entered in grade book. TAs are very nice though and helpful in understanding the subject and the professor is generally a nice guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Cannot understand what he talks about.  Takes participation way to seriously.  Lectures are long, boring, and a waste of my time.  Did not know my grade until the last 2 weeks of class so I did not know I was doing.  I would not recommend this class. There are also only a few assignments throughout the semester.
This class is long and boring and very hard.

Prof. Kim has a good personality and he is very understanding. He also gave good feedback when I talked to him about assignments before submitting. He is always willing to help with assignments. I think he needs to improve his lecturing skills and make his lectures more clear and interesting. I think he just needs more experience with that.

This class was quite confusing and we didn't understand the concepts. The class was lecture heavy and was very boring. The class even had a low average of 55% on the first exam. The class only contains of two exams. I think Kim was a nice person but since it's his first time at Mizzou, he can improve over time or be put in a better place!

I had Dr. Kim in the Fall last semester. The class was mainly lectures which was fine by me. Some days were more difficult than others but everyday there was a lot of notes and a lot to learn. He was very understanding. Great Class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Dr. Kim was not a great teacher in terms of lectures. It was extremely boring, assumptive that the students had prior knowledge (to a beginners course), and just overall difficult to enjoy. The first test had an average of around 55%. There were only two tests throughout the semester. 


Dr. Kim is very kind and I can imagine him improving in time.

She was great. Very personable and grades based on how much effort you put into everything. The class can be difficult for those who don't play an instrument, but she does a really great job of teaching it.
Theory 1 is a hard course but if you go to office hours and turn your stuff in on time you should be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Such an amazing professor. She's high energy, hilarious, while providing a very in depth lecture about what can be a complex topic at times. Very easy to talk to, a fair grader, and provides very good feedback on how to improve. Highly recommend.

My favorite professor. She's so sweet and honestly really funny because she's not afraid to embarrass herself to explain something. She really makes everyone participate and encourages creativity. Her attendance is recorded on iClicker, but all of her lectures are video recorded and posted on Canvas along with the notes at the end of the week.

The aural training class got very boring because it was easy, but she gave aural skills to other students who were struggling. She did appreciate humor on the homework assignments, and I gave some. The class was not interesting, but I would have her again for a different class.

McLarty was a wonderful professor. She was very intelligent with the topics covered in class. I love how she grades on improvement and progress rather than how objectively "good" your projects are. As long as you put in the work and go to your feedback sessions, you are going to get the grade you worked for :)
Amazing teacher, she really connects with the students and is very knowledgeable about her subject. Very caring and easy to talk to, and explains things in an easy to understand way.
One of my favorite professors. She's is always cracking jokes!

Dr. V was a really nice professor! Her accent is initially pretty hard to understand but you get used to it very fast. She is really funny if you pay attention and always has really interesting real-life examples in her lectures. You get two tries at each test and the questions are really easy if you take decent notes or save the lectures.

The content for the class is boring, but a lot of the research you have to do for discussion posts is interesting. It definitely made the class more bearable. She uses iClicker to keep you engaged in the class and uploads lectures online in case you miss one.

She was ok. She has a heavy accent so its hard to understand the material and her PowerPoints arent great. Very hard to take notes with. Her tests also have different answers then her PowerPoints which is  frustrating. There are iClickers but theres a zoom link. Im ending with an A but I wouldnt want to sign up with her again. Shes sweet tho!
Answers on tests could be found in notes from lectures but were wrong on the test. Boring class very easy material. Attention to lectures is somewhat important.

I love this professor. The content in this class was very boring, but she made it a little more bearable. It's very easy to pass if you just watch the lectures, which if you miss she also posts on canvas. Her tests are different than other food science teachers so you wont find the tests on quizlet. Easy A class

Silvia is a wonderful professor, given that the class itself is not super easy. The pacing of each chapter is a lot to fit into one semester, yet it's manageable. She is hard to understand at times, but is always there to answer questions and show students how physics works in real-world examples. The lectures are recorded
Very dry sense of humor. Lots of practice in class. Virtually the same as AP Physics I.
A lot of work and test heavy. The lectures were rushed and confusing.

Dr.Bomparde is a great teacher. You can tell she really cares about her students and their learning. Grading is pretty tough; make sure you really understand FBDs and make sure you include units on exams and labs on everything don't forget your calculator
So sweet and understanding even when i struggled in the class

Dr. Bompadre is a pro. Her lectures aren't perfect (feel too fast, not enough "concept" explanation without math), but I always felt ready for tests, labs. PHYSCS 2750 Expert TA homework is tricky, but you get many attempts, hints, feedback. Her tests are reasonable in length and difficulty. Solid resources for test prep. Funny, with a great accent

She is be blunt with all responses in class, but she balances it out with a light humor. I truly loved her as a professor and wish she was teaching more classes that are required for anyone outside of physics majors.
I would pray every day for the buses to run me over as I was walking to her class.

Dr. Bompadre is an angel. Physics is naturally a difficult subject, but Dr. Bompadre does a great job of simplifying the concepts in lecture with a good mix of theory and solving problems. She uses an open source textbook which is FREE!! and helpful. The discussions aren't really necessary and the labs are tedious but thats kind of to be expected.

I rarely write reviews, but I'd be doing a disservice not mentioning Silvia. Dr. Bompadre's level I physics course is overly complex, fast-paced, and inconsistent. Practice work doesn't match exams, lectures feel rushed with poor clarity, and concepts aren't well explained. There is almost no time spent going over "concepts" without the numbers.

She was a good proffessor. She was strict about talking in class but if you aren't at the maturity level of a 15 year old you shouldn't have issues. Homework was tedious but not too difficult and labs were usually fun.

She was bad at teaching, would only read off the slides and not actually explain anything so you had to teach yourself. The “practice exams” were nothing like the actual exam so they were basically useless. Our 1st exam average was a 60 and year before was a 50, I think if your students are collectively doing bad you might be the problem.

Not a great teacher, very rude and disrespectful towards students. Difficult homework and very difficult exams. Provided study materials are not that helpful, go over homework and discussion problems to study. I thought this class wouldn't be bad but I have been struggling significantly more with it than calc 2.

I don't know what happened as I had heard good things about Bompadre, but this class has been a nightmare. Her exams are significantly harder than any study material provided, there are 5 of them worth 60% of your grade. Labs are long, mandatory and complex. Homework is difficult but not useful for studying. This was a very frustrating class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you want to absolutely hate physics take Dr Bompadre. She provides practice exams that have 0 relation to the actual exams & the homework questions aren't on the exam. The most info you get before the exam about the questions is the topic. 5 exams worth 60% of total grade. Don't go below 70% in lab section or you fail the course. Save your GPA.

Bompadre is super sweet and 2750 was easy for me. The lectures were somewhat helpful however you'd be fine if you skipped every once in awhile. The labs and discussions felt like a huge waste of time and attendance was required. If you study the study guide for a couple days before the test, you'll be fine; I think there's a hidden curve.

Dr Bompadre was an average professor. I took an intro class, I found the hw difficult most of the time, but other times it was easy. The tests were never too terrible, just be sure to study. 5 tests and no final.

I had prof Bompadre for multiple classes, and she quickly became a favorite of mine! For phys majors, she is a great resource for asking any questions that are major-related, whether that be about opportunities, class recommendations, or whatever else. She is caring and would absolutely love to help.

Great professor who explains concepts well and step by step instructions perfectly. Real world examples, in person demonstrations, and engaging questions all present in lecture. In person attendance not mandatory, all lectures are recorded. Uses iClicker but no grade for it, purely for engagement. Great sense of humor, straightforward grading.

Lectures are somewhat helpful, but doing the homework, discussion problems, and practice exams were what really helped the most. Discussion was basically useless, and you can do the problems on your own. Labs were required and long at times.

Dr. Bompadre is an excellent professor and very accessible. She gives great advice as well, however, the course uses powerpoint lectures because of the sheer volume of students. Due to the difficulty of the class, it is easy to fall behind. The course uses an open-source "University Physics Volume II and III" textbook, which is very good.

Silvia's class is great because her grading is very straightforward. I've had her for both Physics 2750 & 2760. In 2750 freshman year, I think I failed the first 3 exams, and still passed the class. There are 5 exams, but none are cumulative or dropped. The labs are annoying, but they're graded generously - same goes for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: As a physics major, I have had her for many classes, and she was even my advisor at one point. Very helpful and intelligent professor. Her tests are very easy if you are fluent with the content, and gives helpful handouts in class.

Very kind and genuinely cares about students. The class (intro to physics something or other for first year physics undergrads) was definitely a throwaway class but she did her best to make it interesting and bring in speakers to pique our interest in the field. Would recommend and seems like a good person to go to for questions about the degree

I quite liked her. Her lectures were mostly useless, but I would recommend paying attention to the worked out examples for exam prep. She gives sample exams before each exam which are extremely useful. Labs are long

I was lucky enough to have Dr. Bompadre again for 2760 after having her for 2750. Lectures are great and provide plenty of example problems/solutions as well as demonstrations. Participate in class and you will be best friends, talk while she's talking and she will not like you. Can't recommend the honors section enough for honors.

She's a very lovely person! With that being said, I can't say I enjoyed being in her class. Her lectures are very fast paced which makes it difficult to take notes by hand, so at that point you're better off just watching the recorded lectures. She also tends to lose her patience when students cant answer questions, which can be demotivating.

Dr. Bompadre is a good professor -her flipped classroom approach works well for honors physics. However, she gets very frustrated in class if people don't participate -and gets upset with the students for not knowing the answer rather than explaining it or trying to reteach. Apart from that, her teaching style is excellent
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She definitely teaches from experience and really seems to understand the content. She communicates really well to students. Not the most approachable person, but I rarely needed any extra help. Do not ask for extra credit... Never saw that as academic dishonesty before her class but if you come to class you won't need it.

Bompadre is very fair and teaches you a lot. Labs and discussions at times get tough, but hang in there and you will be in good shape. Definitely recommend getting in the honors section too, you will have some extra opportunities and get 5 quick credits.

Overall pretty good. Her lectures move pretty quickly, cover lots of topics, and can be unclear at times, so be prepared to study and do practice problems. She is very helpful, though, and is always willing to answer questions and review problems. The discussions are your friend, that's where I learned almost everything throughout the semester.

Easy to get near-perfect lab average, HW is way more involved. Exam 1 (Kinematics and Newton's Laws): 48.3%. Exam 2 (Work, Energy, Momentum, Collisions): 75%. Exam 3 (Rotational motion and Equilibrium): 85%. Exam 4 (Fluids, Waves, and Periodic Motion): 53.3%. Exam 5 (Thermodynamics): 98.3%. Go to the tutors and TAs in your free time.

Hard but rewarding class. TAs and Tiger Tutors absolutely essential. Easy to get near-perfect lab average, HW is more involved. Exam 1 (Kinematics/Newton's Laws): 48.3%. Exam 2 (Work & Energy/Momentum & Collisions): 75%. Exam 3 (Rotational Motion/Equilibrium): 85%. Exam 4 (Fluids/Periodic Motion/Waves): 53%. Exam 5 (Thermodynamics): 98.3%.

The class material in my opinion was very difficult - very math based. If you struggle with calc 2 this class will be difficult for you. She did a good job teaching the hard material though and used demonstrations where she could. Tests are each only 3 questions each so if you don't know one you basically automatically fail lol.

First off, this class can also be recognized as PHYSCS1050 as well. I took this as a 8 week summer class online, and it wasn't bad. Assigned one homework and discussion module per week, which required outside research over general space questions. Probably took two hours a week at max. Exams are open book, but have the heaviest weight.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great teacher overall. Her material is easy to understand and there are so many physics resources out there to dissect harder topics. I really love her grading scale and how she grades. Really great teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Bompadre was very organized and clear. Lectures were decent but covered a lot of information that was never touched again. The labs were usually very straightforward, and the homework didn't take too long but didn't really help prepare for the exams. I found the practice exam most helpful in studying for exams.

I really enjoyed her class. At first getting used to her teaching style was difficult but after the first exam I was able to catch on. 100% watch/attend the lectures!! use practice exams to prepare for other exams and ensure you to know how to do the homework before the exam! overall, thought she was an okay teacher, and she make it make sense!

She is super organized on canvas from day 1 which is super nice. Lectures aren't super engaging and go a little fast sometimes, but they are always posted online as well. Labs are a breeze and the exams aren't too bad either. Some extra credit was given on the last couple exams.

Professor Bompadre herself isn't so bad of a professor if you have the work ethic and strong in mathematic sciences. The tests are roughly 3 questions with multiple parts building off of each other. I really struggled with the first three (the third being the hardest), and a few of the TAs who grade the test take points off without explaining why

Dr. Bompadre is very enthusiastic about her class. While I cannot totally get behind the structure of the class, I understand it. Spend time understanding what is expected to be completed in this class on a daily basis, there is a lot of different aspects to the course, but it becomes manageable once you have a good schedule.

Dr. Bompadre can go extremely fast in lecture, so if you're planning on writing notes by hand, you'd be better off just watching the recorded lecture later. The homework isn't too bad, and if you get less than 75% in lab, you automatically fail the class. Just show up, do the homework and labs, and you'll be ok.

She was ok. She went WAY too fast in her lectures to take notes so I didn't even go to them. However, she posted pre-recorded lectures on canvas so I could pause whenever. Also, she uploaded skeletal notes so notes were easy to take when you watched the lectures. Homework was sometimes insanely hard and sometimes insanely easy. Lowest lab dropped.

She doesn't teach anything. We have class 5 hours in-person but makes us watch all the lectures online beforehand and then during class gives us worksheets to work out with a partner with problems that do not reflect the online lecture at all. These problems are incredibly hard and she doesn't teach you how to do any of it. Avoid at all costs!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: The class material really isn't that difficult but if you don't go to disccusion and do all the homework and practice problems the exams will be difficult for you. Bompadre provides everything you need to succed and answers all questions in a timely manner. Grading on the exams are very fair, alot of partial credit. NO FINAL!!!

She didn't do much, the TAs carried. The discussions were pointless but required attendance. The lectures didn't really help you for the test. You kind of just have to look at the review from the discussion on the day of the test and the old test she gives, to put two and two together and hope for the best on the test.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Would not take this professor again IMO worst experience I have had in college. Not willing to bargain for any points, even though work points may be justified, and is also not willing to admit mistakes, INCLUDING on the tests themselves- ask me how I know. The reviews and practice exams are extremely misleading. Take my advice- find another teach.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This course is terrible. Everything was in person besides the lectures. Exams resembled nothing covered in class. The TAs and Professor are HARD graders, don't expect partial credit. Avoid this class at all costs!!

I wouldnt say the class was hard rather it was very time consuming. As long as you keep up with lectures youll do great. Always do the homework as it strongly reflects how the test will look. Use office hours for help with the labs. Remember you must have 75% or higher in the lab section in order to pass the class. HW,lab,quiz, recitation weekly.

**I took this class online and during covid** The course is more time consuming than it is difficult. A weekly lab, homework, quiz, and recitation. Be warry that this professor requires that your average lab grade be a 75% or above to pass the CLASS regardless of your other assignments. That being said the labs are pretty easy and one is dropped.
Dr. Bompadre is great! 10/10 would recommend (though Dr. Kosztin is awesome too)

Class/material isnt bad but the professor rubbed me the wrong way. Not only did I have this experience but some friends in my lab section had similar. Uptight & rude. Had the class during the pandemic & she was not understanding at all when I had technical problems. caused my grade to drop by 15%. (I had a 98 & was a good student) She doesnt care

I didn't interact with Bompadre much since her lectures were prerecorded, but I thought the class was fair, though difficult. I struggled a lot at the beginning, but once I started taking notes on the textbook and constantly pausing her lectures to take notes (20 min videos took an hour), I did MUCH better. Take advantage of TA office hours!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The recorded lectures were so bad. They didn't cover content well, and were very difficult to understand (like, literally understand what she was saying). Content is pretty easy though, and test questions are pretty darn close to the hw. Open note tests are hard to fail imo so the class was easy. Two attempts on most exam questions

Dr. Bompadre is a good professor. She helped me understand some things I was never able to understand before. Since it was on zoom some things were just confusing. Participation quizzes were actually very difficult, . Tests are super hard, you need to study! Expert TA is really tedious at some points. I really did learn physics from this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She tried her best to make the class fair, and I'm very appreciative of that. However, her teaching style made it hard for me to follow lectures. Feedback on discussion boards seemed to be largely unhelpful, but not always. Be sure to ask your TAs questions on labs. ExpertTA can be confusing at times.

Modern Physics is a hard class to begin with, but Bompadre made it manageable. Tests are rough and they make up a majority of your grade, so be prepared. Lectures are relatively short, but she rushes through them, so you might have to watch them more than once to completely understand. Grading is nicely curved.

Good professor overall. Teaches the material and teaches it well. She is a little stuck up when it comes to other majors outside physics, especially engineering. If she is says she is just "passionate", she is really just angry and will insult you personally. Fine and fun class overall, just would not take again to deal with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Bompadre provides an amazing intro. She's willing to work with the class on due dates and material as needed to get everyone up to speed and ready for the tests. Her charming personality belies a gruff exterior and really makes this class worthwhile. Online lectures can a tough adjustment, but she does her best to check understanding in class.

Bompadre is a good professor for physics 2750. The class is easy to understand if you try, the tests are pretty forgiving. Though she is good, she has flaws. She has a short temper to distractions or criticism, and some questions on her tests hold too much weight when not being covered in the study guide or review.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Bompadre is a great teacher and she does her best to make sure we understand the material. Just go to lectures, labs, and discussions, stay on top of your homework and you'll be okay.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Easy going teacher. Tests are basically open book just be ready to read and research.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Bompadre was good. She would stall lectures trying to get participation from, 300+ kids which was annoying as it was a lecture. Practice exams are good guides. Online homework is MUCH harder than the exams. Go to recitation! You learn a lot. Very fast paced course with lots to learn. 5 midterms, no final, so make sure to study hard and perform.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I was afraid of taking this class online but the classes were nice and clear, broken into small sections and then there were also online problems she did.  The grading was clear and I liked the class a lot.

Good professor, only issue is that she has to speed through some sections (due to time limitations so not really her fault). Discussions are good for catching up. She offers tons of extra credit and her practice tests are generally very similar to her real tests.

Very knowledgeable, but at points does not explain her work and often times can lead to mistakes down the road.  She will go by quickly in her lectures and won't explain concepts very well, so be prepared to learn it outside of class.

Overall a very fair professor. I found that the lectures could feel long but at the end of the day she tried her best not to overload us even though we had 15 weeks to get through 20 chapters.  For me the most "frustrating" part of the class was that tests could take FOREVER to get back.  Take the class, talk to her often, put in some outside work.
She's cool

This class wasn't terrible for me difficulty wise, but I realize with a different teacher it could have been a lot tougher. Her tests usually look very similar to her examples in class and the discussion questions. Some tests even had bonus points. She makes it easy to get a good grade if you pay attention and put in effort.
The class was OK, it's a bit fast paced for my taste, but I don't know if you can have it any other way! Exams were very fair, and she was helpful. Nicest to deal on a 1 on 1 way.

Very good professor. The class is difficult but she has lots of opportunities for extra credit. The recitations are VERY important. While the material may be hard for some, her exams can be considered "fair" if you put the time and effort in.

The class is VERY HARD, but that is what physics is, no way around it!  But Dr. Bompade makes all possible to make the class go smoothly and is always willing to help and have extra office hours.  Labs are kind of boring.  Discussion sessions are helpful, don't skip them.
Nice prof!  Very helpful and caring for the students.  Class was **very** interesting.  If you can choose your prof. take Intro to Mod Physics with her!!!!
She was nice, and flexible.
Prof. Bompadre is a very clear teacher and makes herself very available to address any concerns students may have. Highly recommended.
Highly recommended!
This is a nice class where you get an overview of all of the modern physics of early 1900's (why modern? LOL!). The prof. does a good job explaining the concepts.
Good class, very nice teacher.
This is a nice course.  You learn lots of things about the origins of the modern physics (relativity, quantum).  It's a lot of stuff, certainly, but things went smoothly.
This was a nice class.
Very nice, very helpful.  Works very hard for the course.

Definitely cares about his students. Lectures are easy to understand, providing numerous real-world examples to help you better understand. only downside is how long he takes on one slide, having to speed through the rest. Exams were fairly easy, if you go to class and watch/go to his TA review sessions. most fun business class i have had.
Awesome professor, you can tell he really cares about his students

Easily one of my favorite professors at Mizzou. Had very little interest in law before taking the class, left with a firm understanding and no negative opinions of him. 

His lectures were always well attended and thoroughly interesting.

Class content was not necessarily easy but he explained it well and offered many opportunities to learn.

George is the best professor I've had. Though the content of the class is hard, he teaches it in a way that is so understandable. He also makes an effort to get to know his students on a more personal level. Very quick in responding to emails, and always lets you know that hes there to help. I highly recommend taking his class

Georgre Brand is a highly respected professor. He takes a very hard class with difficult and complex topics, and makes them very easy to understand. He is clear about what will be on the exams. His course is content heavy, and his tests are very difficult, but he used to be a lawyer so he can use real world examples, and help students connect.
You really need to read the book and do absolutely everything that this professor says to do. If you want to be successful on difficult tests, studying is essential.

I took both of his classes, the advanced B Law might be my favorite class of all time. Brand is in talks for the greatest of all time. Very knowledgeable and caring, makes a difficult class better. I highly recommend him to anyone. Do not screw around and blow off the tests, they are difficult but possible if you study.
He's really nice. Helped me out a lot when I had online issues and extended due dates when canvas wasn't working. Cares a lot about his students.

Lots of good information is covered, but it goes by so fast that it's hard to keep track of. Most of the things I learned will benefit me some way in the future, even not going into law. The only grades are Tests, Attendance and Quizzes, so don't screw around and think you can cheat off people during the exams, because they're proctored like crazy.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I enjoyed Brands class. I am a 3.6 student and found some exams to be more challenging than others. He curved one exam 13 percent which gave me more than a 100 on the exam
Fantastic professor, difficult subject. It is by no means an easy class, but Professor Brand teaches it well and generally curves generously.

Professor Brand was a fantastic professor for business law. It is apparent that he is very knowledgeable about the topic and wants his students to succeed. Lectures are engaging and exams have a generous curve. Weekly open note online quizzes provide a good grade buffer for the exams.

I have never disliked a teacher more than this man in my life. You will spend every week doing the longest most meaningless assignments and painfully sitting through mindless lectures. He runs a backwards classroom & never says that, so be prepared to teach yourself all of the material. Do yourself a favor and NEVER take a class with Bruce Runyan.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Genuinely one of the worst professors I've had at Mizzou. iClicker is worth a huge chunk of your final grade but half the class gets every question wrong. Lectures are all over the place and he never teaches material, just does problems in excel with little no explanation. Lot's of homework and McGraw Hill questions that are never on the exams.

Great guy, tries to make the lecture enjoyable. However, he is all over the place. Excel, note-taking, Icilcker (that he gives you 15 seconds to answer), and just him talking about 8 different things, the lecture isn't beneficial. I had to teach myself everything using the practice exam. Study halls with the TA are more beneficial than he is

Entire class is McGraw Hill, and he doesn't actually teach anything, just does excel problems on the board. Expects you to learn everything from the ebook. Homework is ridiculously long and tedious, hours a week. Tracks iClicker in class, grades iClicker on correctness, and routinely at least half the class gets it wrong.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Nice guy but bad class structure. 3 exams in this class worth most of your grade. He doesn't teach any content, just uses excel to go through problems which does not teach you anything. Homework can be long and tedious. Need a restructure to this class ASAP
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
You will end up teaching yourself all the material because he doesn't lecture on the material, just does examples on excel and jokes around. We learn all problems on excel and then cant use it to take any exams. You have chat the homework or it takes 5 hours. 

He's a great guy who cares about his students future, and he's actually pretty funny

He is a nice and enthusiastic dude, but his teaching style can be very unorganized. Do all of the homework and get an 100% on them (it is impossible not to unless you don't finish), go to class, and average a 57% on the exams, and you will get a C-. If you just want to pass classes and don't particularly care about your GPA, you can pass easily.

Hear me out, he is a very interesting dude but he actually truly cares about every student. He is such a good dude and he wants the best for every student. He is always offering help for students. While his class is difficult, he really wants the best for everyone. Just show up to class and you'll be chillin!

Avoid him if you can.  Attendance is mandatory, iClicker is graded on right and wrong; have a typo, he is counting it wrong. Doesn't teach any of the content, so be prepared to spend DAYS teaching yourself.  Won't answer your questions, says to ask your "team".  Gets exams and everything else from McGraw-Hill, doesn't write anything on his own.

Do not, under any circumstances, take a course taught by Prof. Runyan. This is by far the worst professor I've had in four years at Mizzou. There are an ungodly number of assignments that do more harm than good. 3-hour GRADED practice exams, so you're essentially taking double the exams. Relies too much on the book; homework is impossible.
He is a great and funny guy which makes his lectures fun to attended. If you pay attention in class and learn a little bit outside of class it is not that hard.

Teaching style reminds me of keller if that says anything. class is do able and not impossible to pass but teaching style is extremely hard to understand. the only way to pass is to memorize the practice exam and you only have access to it two days before the exam day.

Worst teaching style I've seen at mizzou. Have been to every class, done every homework, felt like I haven't learned a thing. Completely different lectures when looking at how other accounting classes are. Uses way too much excel rather than showing how to actually do the work.

I have genuinely never had a worse professor. I didn't learn a thing in this class, and I genuinely think he doesn't know anything he is talking about. He relies on McGraw Hill to teach everything. I genuinely don't know how he is still employed at this university, and the fact that I am paying for him to teach me is a joke.

Confusing circuitous lectures that get you nothing. You will struggle. You will spend HOURS on assignments worth very little. Exams take a ton of studying because you are teaching the class to yourself. I cant believe it but he grades practice exams and they are required. Never seen anything like it. Chatgpt, Chegg
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This man is one of the most kind and understanding professors i will ever have. I have been sick sick  for about a month and he has been so patient and is making sure my grade doesn't get destroyed. Take all of his classes and sit in the front. Best professor ever

If you are looking for an easy A, look elsewhere! 3347 with Runyan is not an easy class, but you get out of it, and out of him, the effort you put in. He's not a great lecturer, but if you come to class prepared, his walkthroughs of problems help break things down well. If you make it through the course, you'll be better for it.

I have never been disappointed to the point where I have taken time to write something on rate my professor. Take that as a sign to NOT take this professor for ANY accounting class you will regret it.
Runyon sucks booty cheeks, wouldn't take again.
Interesting
Bruce was a very engaging teacher that did more than just read out of the textbook.

Honestly this class will keep you engaged. Not in the class material, but in everything else that he talks about and does. The structure of the class is pretty easy and the exams are just like the practice tests. If you participate, life will be better for you.
The lectures are hard to follow and confuse us students most of the time, rather than teach us.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: In my time at the university of missouri, i have been lucky to have mostly good professors. With that being said, I made the biggest mistake by taking Bruce Runyans class. Ive never taken a class more unorganized, and have never seen a worse structure and teaching style than his. Tests were ridiculously hard, and he doesnt prepare you for them.

This class was very frustrating. There were about 6 hours of homework every week that you had to complete. I highly suggest meeting with the TA for that class when it is offered to get help on the application. If you take the practice exams enough, you can memorize how to do the problems on the test because they are the same besides numbers.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This guy might not have any idea what hes talking about. I'm not sure because I haven't learned anything from a single thing he's said. This class is truly a mystery and I feel like sherlock holmes. Bring your magnifying glass and tobacco pipe, because you're in for a ride. I am lost

Poorly managed class. Lectures are very very unclear and won't help you when the test comes. Test questions are similar to practice tests, but many curveballs and trick questions. Its hard to learn because you're essentially teaching yourself everything and you have to show up to a lecture that doesn't help at all. Ignore positive reviews.

Dr. Runyan is hilarious. He uses a reverse classroom and all content comes from the book. Kept lecture engaging. Class is required, lots of iClicker. Weekly homework isn't too bad at all. Exams are multiple choice and the questions are the exact same as the practice exam questions (including numbers).

There is another professor who teaches this class. You should try to get him instead of Runyan. Runyan assigns more homework and his tests are harder. The tests are on content that he barely reviews, he grades the practice tests for some reason. Everyone is struggling. Very confusing lectures and tests have poorly written problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very poor teaching. Entirely useless lectures that make you feel completely lost. Use chegg or you'll be guessing mystery numbers in smartbook for hours and hours. Covers the easiest material in class and leaves the hard homework problems for you to struggle with. Teach yourself everything and hope you do a good job.

He is a great person but should not be a professor. His teaching consists of asking students if they are "feeling it" and then moving on to something completely random. I have not learned a single thing from lectures but attendance is mandatory so you have to go. If you are taking this for a minor use chegg. I have never been more lost in a class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Runyan makes this class so difficult no reason. Tests are 60% of the grade, and the work we do during class doesn't look anything like what we are tested over. This is partially due to the professor making jokes and trying to liven the class up, but essentially teaching terribly because of it. if you need this for a minor just use Chegg.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I cant tell if this class is supposed to be hard or easy, because the concepts are not explained well in class and I have to teach myself everything outside of class with the boring Smartbook assignments that take hours. Many smartbook problem assignments which you're on your own for and arent similar to in class content at all. Use chegg

Professor Runyan was so great. The course overall is a lot of work, but the course structure sets you up for success. You just have to do the work and study for the tests. He offers extra credit, and you get points for going   to class and answering iclicker questions. He was very funny and I really enjoyed his class!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: If you have a busy schedule do not take this class. Assignments due every day you're not in class besides weekends, test are weighted way to heavily (60 percent), study halls not at feasible times if you have work, when asked about the test he just talks about how you have to score hundreds on every assignment to offset a bad test grade.

Honestly, great guy & good lectures but he has no clue how difficult this class is (Many in my section have stated this & my advisor mentioned several people are struggling). I asked him for help as I struggle with test & he told me if I get perfect scores,100% on all assignments it will offset the 3 tests. Which test are weighted 60% of the grade.

This class is definitely time-consuming but if you do the assignments you are guaranteed to pass. These assignments are due on the days you don't have class. Study halls, practice exams, and unlimited study attempts make things easier. The practice exams also look just like the test which is super helpful. He is funny and makes class enjoyable!

Professor Runyan is easily the funniest and most entertaining professor's I'll ever have, seriously... this guy could be an actor. This class takes a lot of time and attention, but at the end of the day is enjoyable. Be ready not only for a good understanding of accounting, but also good life lessons and cooperation with your "neighbors" in class

Ngl these reviews terrified me before I began his class, but Prof Runyan is a pretty great guy who really tries to make accounting easy to understand. The homework is the worst part imo but it's always the same each week so you know waht to expect. iClicker is also important, so as long as you show up you'll be alright.

professor runyan is easily one of the best professors i've had at mizzou. Just show up to class, do the iclicker questions, and do the practice exams before the tests. The class is very routine with assignments due monday, wednesday, and friday that take an hour or two at most to complete. Highly recommend him if you need 2010 for your minor.

This is for ACCT 8437 Strategic Cost Analysis, not sure why I can't select that course. Easy course with an emphasis on learning new technology like Blockchain and Power BI. Professor Runyan is encouraging and helpful, as well as assessable outside of class. Most helpful course I have taken in not only grad school but also undergrad. I recommend!
Looking at 6-7 hours of homework (not counting any studying) per week.

He's the worst teacher I've ever had. Coming to class matters but honestly, it's pointless because he doesn't say much. It takes him forever to explain concepts and most of the time he doesn't even know the answer. When I asked him if he could write out how he got the answer he said he wouldn't. He makes me more confused when he explains topics.

Friendly guy who is easy to communicate with, but gives out a lot of homework and can be pretty hit-and-miss with explaining concepts. You will devote a LOT of time to his class if you want to do well.
He was a good professor and definitely cared about his students, just a lot of homework!
Hardest class I've taken. Soooooo much homework that takes hours and hours to do.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. B is an amazing woman. She cares about her students and is very adaptable in terms of course schedule. She is very sweet and makes boring lectures more fun!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: I would highly recommend taking Public Speaking with Maria. She's very understanding and helpful if you ask for help writing your speeches or picking a good topic. She gets to know all the students in her class and is always easy to approach. Just be sure to study more than the chapter notes she assigns for the midterm and final and you'll be fine.
Attendence is very strict and makeup work is pretty much non existant. Very easy going professor overall though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Good professor, very passionate about his job and does a great job teaching. Attendance policy is pretty strict, and assignment due dates are rather odd (assignments being due at like 10am and such) but otherwise a good professor, just be sure to do your work before it's late.
His attendance policy is one sided.  He will lower your grade each time for a missed class but he himself has cancelled 4 classes this semester at the last moment!

Mr. Burdock teaches material well and the workload is not too difficult. The problem is that the attendance policy was HARSH. Every missed class will bring your entire grade down slightly and classwork cannot be made up if a class is missed, so missing one class can potentially be a grade tanker.
An easy class as long as you show up and do the work
Burdock was one of my favorite professors in my 7 years of college courses. He was always willing to work with us so long as we were willing to work with him.
Erick is honestly the best teacher I have had in years.  So funny, engaging and knowledgeable.  Would recommend 100 %. Juiced!
This class was a huge source of stress for me.

Be prepared to be behind in this class. In just the 16 weeks I had of this class, it was cancelled 9 times, which may sound nice, but it makes it difficult to stay on track. It was frustrating knowing how much I'm paying for this class just for it to never happen. Class time is not utilized fully, meaning most of the work is done outside of class.
Does not get grades in in a timely manner, assigns unnecessary amount of homework, and takes points off for attendance

Eric is so fun in class. There are no tests, just group and solo projects that are all pretty much up to you on creativity. Don't miss class or you'll be behind and miss participation points. 100% would take any of his classes again and I'm not even a film/English major
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: You truly won't regret taking any of his classes. I've had two classes with him (WGST/FILM) and I always was eager to show up and learn. What he says is valuable, and helped me not only grow as a student, but as an individual. Definitely recommend!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Burdock has been my favorite professor! I had him for Intro to Film and Female Monsters in Film, both classes were so interesting. He is passionate and enthusiastic about the topics and provides plenty of positive encouragement for sharing ideas in class. Keep up with assignments and you'll get an A

Burdock is such a great film professor. His enthusiasm and knowledge of film made this my favorite class. In class discussions are low key and easy to participate in. Its the same homework every week so there's no surprises when it comes to assignments. It can take a bit to get papers back because he genuinely enjoys what his students have to say.

definitely not my favorite class. He tries almost too hard to make this class interesting. He bases it around monsters which I don't really take interest in. His grading is terrible, he waits until the last week of the semester to finally grade assignments so you never know what your grade is. I wouldn't take this class again!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I think he did the best he could with your basic freshman English class. Tried to make it more interesting with readings about monsters and letting you choose your topics for papers. Grading took a while but was always fair. As long as you show up and do the work you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: He is not good at grading at all. You will not know your grade in the class until the semester is over, and he is very forgetful about what students tell him. He also says he will have things graded a certain day and they will still not be done two weeks later. The class is easy, but his grading can be very harsh.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The class is based around monsters (vapires and stuff) and is not that great. Their are English 1000 professors who grade on participation. I reccomend finding one of them. This class is too hard for a freshman level course and hes not the best at lecturing. On the plus side hes really understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: He's an average professor that really believes your all there because you want to take the most basic English class. It's paper after paper but the readings he gives aren't required so you don't have nightly homework. You get 6 absences but don't miss any more than that or bad things will happen. He's really quick with responding to messages too.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: He incorporates lots of mathematical theory in his lectures, which can help understanding. He can be hard to follow at times, you certainly need to pay attention. There is quite a bit of homework, and the tests can be difficult. Would recommend studying a lot. Bushman is helpful at answering questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures aren't posted online and there are quizzes in class, so attendance is basically mandatory, but it doesn't hurt your grade. The only thing is he goes over things relatively quick, and it can get confusing. There is weekly homework and as long as you keep up with it, it's an easy B
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This review is for Math 1160 Precalculus. Mr. Bushman is great. His lectures were always detailed and would answer any question. He never assigned homework over the weekends and breaks. For tests, he gave use a very good study guide, and a formula sheet. Tests are very easy. He made sure we understood concepts and genuinely wanted us to do well.
