Continually badmouths other faculty/people in the English department, as well as the university.  Makes everything about her.  However, if you're able to spout back what she wants to hear this class is very easy.

Dr. H-W is absolutly pointless. She brings outside conflicts which should NOT be discuss with students into the classroom. She talks on her cell in class. She made us buy FIVE of her books (which we did read much of) and only 3 other author's books -- it was a LIT CLASS! This woman makes me angrier than any professor I've ever had to deal with.
No Comments
No Comments

I like to tell people that Dr. Hudson-Weems is crazy 100% of the time. 60% is fun, mad scientist crazy, but 40% is legitimately frightening. She's extremely intense, but, if you pay attention, you will absolutely learn something. Is she self-absorbed? Yes, but she most certainly knows her stuff. Overall, I liked her.

By far the worst class and worst teacher that I've ever had in my life.  She is totally self absorbed, and likes to talk on her cell phone during class.  Unprofessional and tacky!!!!  I wouldn't be surprised if she didn't read a single paper her students have written for her class.

Her class is her soapbox, and it's painful.  If you try to express an opinion contrary to hers, you and the rest of the class will all suffer for it.  Don't take this class because you think it's going to be easy. It's not easy to listen to her preach.
No Comments
No Comments

More interested in her own writing than teaching course subject. Don't take any of her classes unless you enjoy regurgitating to your prof, but learning nothing. She picks favorites, yet never learned any names of her students in my class.

I would not recommend taking this class unless you absolutely have to. The only grades in this class are 5 out of 6 exams and bonus points received for attendance. The slides Dr. Clarke uses are extremely old and he has an extremely monotone voice and teaching style. It's hard to hear him and harder to pay attention. Do not take unless you have to.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: FS1030 is an easy science credit, with lots of extra credit opportunities. The lectures can be boring, but attending is key for bonus points. I found unstuck study and the textbook super helpful for test prep - definitely made studying more efficient.

I think Prof. Clarke has a passion for his subject, but he does a bad job communicating. It's an introductory class and he makes it seem like we should know everything that he's been studying for 35+ years. He speaks down to everyone like they are dumb. Very monotone and rambles, hard to listen to. Tests are nothing like the lectures

Not particularly difficult. Show up to class and take notes and you're pretty much guaranteed to have a good grade in the class. Gives out LOTS of bonus points, sometimes online, sometimes in person, so you should always attend lecture just in case. Additionally drops one grade out of 6 tests, on top of giving out bonuses.

Go to class! He does small little quizzes that are for extra credit. Literally the only thing that made me pass, if I had done one less I would have failed and that is not an exaggeration. He is a nice person, but his class is extremely hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Clarke is great. Definitely passionate about what he does. He gives pop quizzes at least once a week with 3-4 questions each that you answer for extra credit points. There are 5-6 pop quizzes a unit and the quiz questions and answers are word for word on the tests. If you study the lecture slides and the pop quizzes you will do great!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Clarke is a respectable man, however, his lectures were a bit fast and not so clear. We took about 5 FS exams over the course of the semester. These really did not have a lot of info that was in the notes. I did enjoy the extra credit he gave out, but it seems that when you fail the exams, that other credit will be just barely getting you by.

Easily worst professor Ive ever had as a student in general. Most monotone speaker Ive ever come across and makes no attempt at making lectures anything but putridly boring and a waste of time as the whole entire class is on quizlet. Extremely condescending and rude to his students, much more so than any professor/teacher Ive ever had in my life

Do not take his class! I have friends in the same class with other profs and they actually enjoy it. He is so annoying and arrogant and unless you want to hear someone talk about how much they love meat get another teacher!! This class is easy it might as well be enjoyable too.

Gives so much extra credit and it really helps. Grades only on exams. Very easy if you attend class and fill in the notes. He cares about this class a lot. His extra credit questions are always on the exams. If you go on quizlet you can find so many study guides that are almost like the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took his meat class. It's a catastrophe. He assumes you have all the food science knowledge even though everything he teaches is 30 years outdated. His exams are a complete mystery. He also makes you feel stupid for doing poorly. Luckily, I was one of the students to get an A, but I sympathized with the others.

FS 1030 is the go-to class for non-STEM majors to get their science gen-ed requirements out of the way. Although boring, monotone, and cluttered; Dr. Clarke has a passion for food science and a lot of his lectures have interesting material and offer easy extra credit opportunities. Tests are heavily memorization based, but nothing too difficult.

I didnt do well on ONE test so I had to take the (not mandatory) final to strike out that bad grade. He didnt grade my test right and I was set up to fail... My grade was a 69.8% and he REFUSES TO ROUND UP. If you are taking this class because of a FIG, drop it! Its not worth it, you either get and A or fail and it really depends on him!

He is so boring & can be rude. His voice is very monotone, I could fall asleep every class. There isn't a final unless you wanted to take it to take over your worst test grade. He does bonus points online. I barely put effort in & got a B in the class. Dont bother buying a book, I never opened mine. To study, I went on quizlet & found study sets.
I could've fallen asleep listening to him teach. Although clearly passionate about what he taught, his voice was too monotone and lectures were boring and seemed unnecessary.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: You don't have to go to class every day. If you go, there's a good chance you'll get bonus points for that day. There's no homework, only tests. He's a pretty boring professor who rambles on a lot but overall the class is fine and fairly easy. I didn't put too much effort into it and still got a good grade.

EXTREMELY straight-forward class. All of the grades are based on tests and extra credit (plus he drops the lowest grade). As long as you show up to get the extra credit and memorize the fill-in-the-blank slides, you'll do just fine. Easy A but YOU have to put in most of the work. As a lecturer, he can ramble but the stuff is somewhat interesting.

Andy Clarke was my favorite professor this semester! I genuinely enjoyed this class. He has a textbook (which he wrote) but you DON'T need it to be able to pass the class. As long as you study and show up for lecture, you're going to do well in the class. It's straight forward.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class is an easy A. Professor Clarke gives out so much extra credit that you could most like average a C on the Exams and get an A. You don't even have to pay attention to the lectures if you don't want to, all the study guides for the exams are on Quizlet. There are 5 exams and one final but he drops the worst grade, so you could skip final.

Food science 1030 was a waste of my time. I thought it would be an interesting and relevant science class but I spent every lecture spacing out. Clarke can be condescending when you ask questions and just reads directly from his powerpoints, making his lectures so dull. His bolo tie gets in the way of his mic and makes it really hard to hear him.

The entire semester's grade consists of tests and extra credit. The extra credit is easy and appears on the tests. The tests are typically hard. Every class is a lecture that's hard to hear and pay attention to. Come to class for extra credit quizzes and attendance points--it could save your grade.

Easy A class if you attend class, use his powerpoint slides, and do all of the online bonuses. He is extremely generous with students, but you MUST still do your part. No too science heavy, definitely manageable for those who hate science. Interesting guy, easy class, graded only by tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Super easy class, really nice guy, tons of extra credit opportunities, tests are super easy as long as you read the powerpoints

Go to class, he randomly gives extra credit. Don't buy the textbook, I didn't open it once and got an A. It's an easy A as long as you put in some effort.  Make flashcards of the slides and study for an hour or two and you'll be fine.

Most if not everyone takes this class to get easy credit for a science and for good reason. All you do in class is fill out a powerpoint which he puts the answers to the tests in.  However, it's not mandatory to go to this class, it's pretty easy to just go onto Quizlet and memorize the terms for the upcoming exam
If you aren'y good about listening to tegrities and taking notes, don't skip class.  There are bonuses, but the tests can be hard, especially if you blow them off.

One of the worst professors at Mizzou, but one of the easiest classes. I wouldn't recommend taking this class unless you need to boost your GPA because it isn't very interesting and putting up with this professor's attitude for the duration of a semester will drive you mad. Six tests (one of which is dropped) and TONS of extra credit.
Guided notes, 6 tests, drops ;west test score

Ever wanted to know everything about Food Science, down to the molecular and sometimes hypothetical level? Here, you will be forced to, regardless of interest. If you get confused, good luck - he won't help. He'll say something very condescending along the lines of "should have been in class" even if you were in class. Good luck with this one.

Really easy A course and the professor knows it. Content is very boring and so is the teacher, just show up to class to fill in the blanks in your power point or ask a friend for it. Gives out tonnes of extra credit (a big reason why you should attend lectures) and exams are easy. I only studied 30 minutes before each exam and ended up with an A+.

Clarke is super boring - maybe it's because of the subject. He gives out 60 bonus points through out the whole semester, and I fully believe it's only because he wants to keep up his grade distribution - not because he actually cares about the students. With that said, it's hard to get anything less than an A.
Tons of EC, but bores you to sleep and tons of guest speakers that don't even have relatable material to the class.

His power points are fill in the blank and he gives bonus points for those who show up to class or do the online quizzes. But his teaching style will most likely put you to sleep, unless you plan on becoming a food science major. Even the TAs get bored. He also has a weird sense of humor that no one understands and can be rude towards students.

Food Science 1030 with Dr. Clarke is an easy A. There are fill in the blank powerpoint notes. He has opportunities to get bonus points throughout the semester. The material on the exams comes directly from the powerpoints. Dr. Clarke isn't the best teacher, but just study the powerpoints and you'll be fine.

Tests are extremely hard. Deviates greatly from what he tells you could be on test. Pulls information out of no where for exams. Even with perfect attendance and studying i managed a C at best on exams.
HE DO NOT HAVE ANY INTERESTING WHAT HIS STUDENTS ARE DOING.

Decent teacher, not terrible.  Lectures are exactly out of the book, so read or attend your choice.  Typically gives online extra credit opportunities on Mondays, and in class (where he gives you the answers) on Fridays, so helpful to attend on Fridays! Beware :Lectures are extremely dull unless you understand his humor, I didn't.

The class is really easy, just show up and write down the red words and you should be fine for reviewing. He is not very helpful if you are struggling, I don't think he really cares. Go to the classes, if only to get the red words and the bonus quiz questions. Sometimes I missed the bonus points and I was fine so honestly it's not that hard.

This class is pretty easy, if you take notes which isn't hard to do because all you have to do is fill in the blanks on the powerpoint slides and those blanks with be on the test. also he posts the lectures online so you can watch if you miss class. The material is boring but if you just fill in the blanks ans review your notes you should be fine

It's like being in middle school again. He has you fill in red words on his Powerpoint during the lecture (which you can find online if you skip class) and that's what's on the test. I didn't learn anything though. I just memorized everything for the test and forgot it two seconds after the test. It's a terrible class if you're a foodie.

I found Professor Clarke's lectures to be boring and hard to follow along. The only grades we received in this class (other than bonuses) were tests which, in my opinion, made the class difficult. I couldn't manage to get a satisfactory grade on the tests, so I asked for help and he told me to see the syllabus. He was of no help whatsoever.

He is confusing and goes on random tangents that don't make sense. Offers little help except for his extra credit some of which is given online and some in class.  If you study the notes its n easy grade but the instructor makes class torture to sit through.

This class is so so easy. He tells you exactly what is going to be on the test and he gives A TON of extra credit. Plus all the former test are on quizlet and he hardly changes them. The class can be kind dull but it's an easy A.
HORRIBLE TEACHER. not helpful. don't know what will be on tests. so much material to cover & it is SO BORING. goes on random tangents in lectures that are useless. STAY AWAY.
This teacher makes, what should be an easy class, a very difficult class. His exams are pretty difficult for the type of material
very low quality rate, but easy. boring teacher,the worst academic advisor

This class was super easy. He gives you exactly whats on the exams. Don't buy the book, you will never use it. He does random bonus attendance points which help more than you think. This class is so boring but is sooooo easy and meets the biological science gen ed.
I was so bored in this class. He puts everything on Tegrity & its only if you show up do you get extra points quizzes...that he tells you the answer to anyway. Easy A, but bored outta my mind.
He is soooo boring. Could make anyone fall asleep. He looks like a nerd and talks like one. He thinks everything in the class is interesting when its awful. Hes a bad teacher
Gives extra credit for going to class. Total of around 65 points given for extra credit. Very easy B, should probably get an A. Lectures are really really boring but its worth going to for bonuses
Go to class- you get bonus points!

Very quirky prof. Very few people go to his office hours, but he is willing to help you and asks questions to make Blackboard more approachable. Bonuses are amazing. He gives all the answers for the in-class ones and these are on the test. Easy class

Do not buy the textbook (everything you are tested over is on the slides), all the slides are on blackboard and you go to class to fill in blanks, he gives an exam worth of points in bonuses. Go to class, fill in the blanks, get answers to bonuses and you have an A. final is optional and he DOES NOT curve
Go to class for extra credit bonuses otherwise not mandatory. Classes on tegrerity otherwise. Bonus questions posted online and are always on exams.
so easy

If you think this class is hard there's for real something wrong with you. He gives away so many bonuses, puts every class on tegrity, and all the Power Points online. I barely ever went to class and participated in like none of the bonuses and got a B+. He makes it so easy to get a good grade. And he curves at the end. Take this class

Easiest class ever. His test questions come directly from his powerpoints, and he gives you bonuses just for coming to class. He usually even gives you the answers to the bonuses. Boring class, but very easy. Haven't used the book at all...so total waste of money. Clarke knows his stuff, and is very...corky. But is a nice guy. Easy B or A!

You should not listen to anyone complaining about this class. It is the EASIEST class you will find at MU. ALL TEST QUESTIONS COME DIRECTLY FROM THE POWERPOINT SLIDES. And all "bonus point questions" that he posts on blackboard will show up on the test worded the exact same too. Dr. Clarke is boring but I love his quarky sense of humor too!

Food Science & Nutrition class can be very easy with him if you don't fall into a lazy trap. Rely on the textbook readings instead of the power points. Things in the textbook appear more clearly on tests than the powerpoint does. He is also a mildly annoying man. I slipped in this class because I thought the powerpoints could save me.

No matter what any of your friends say, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS, atleast not with this professor. He is not understanding of anything and seems like he wants everyone to fail. He is the most un-interesting teacher i've ever had and takes his boring 1000 level food science class way to seriously. THIS TEACHER AND CLASS SUCKED!!!

This class is awful. He is a very rude, stubborn man that will not give you the time of day. He perceives his intelligence to be always correct, even if you have proof that he is wrong. DONT TAKE THIS CLASS. Save yourself the trouble of dealing with his antics.

I took Food Science with Andrew Clarke, and the class was boring. He is the most knowledgeable person about the subject, but the class is boring. The PowerPoints are taken from the book (which you should NOT buy), and he posts them online. You don't need to go to class to get an A, but you will need to study hard for some of the tests.

Anyone who complains his grades does not belong in college. This is THE easiest class at Mizzou, if you try in any way you will get above 100%. We did shots in the back row and I got 112%. Sure this class is boring, but its because he has to deal with so many liberal arts retards. If you ask him a real question and don't just wine he's very helpful

It is a really, really boring class, but you can easily get a good grade if you go, pay attention somewhat and keep up with the bonuses. I would recommend getting another science class if you can. Don't buy the book. Most people don't take it seriously, which can be a hassle.  Go to class and you'll get a grade higher than you deserve in bonuses.

EASY class. Gives out tons of bonuses if you show up. All classes are posted on Tegrity. Only incentive for going to class is the bonuses. Do not by the book, everything is on the powerpoint slides. I did not buy it and got an A. He is boring, but very ethusiastic about the class.

Classes are recorded online, no need to go except to get the BONUSES. The tests are based off the bonuses, and he flat out tells you what to study! Never opened the book, a waste of money. Go to class only for the bonuses, and you will have issue landing a solid A/B.

The class is not hard if you study. All of the bonuses are on the test so about 10-15 questions are just given to you. The class is boring but the bonus is worth going and really helps your grade. DON'T buy the book, I never opened it.
The class as a whole I found nearly agonizing to have to attend, but the tests are based off pure memorization and he is nice enough to give out a ton of extra credit, which helped me land a solid A.

I feel bad for the unfortunate, naive freshman who will choose to take this class. The man is extremely useless, and doesn't hesitate to tell you how much help he WON'T give you. What a complete piece of sh*t this man is. I'm an excellent, hard-working student and I received a B- in the class. Way to lower my GPA, you miserable cretin.

DO NOT buy the book for this class. It is a waste of money, I promise. Mine sat on my desk all semester. He shows power points and gives you the words to fill in the blanks, so having the book is pointless.

BORING!! You can listen to every class online so its pointless to go to class except for bonus which he does in pattern... Tests are extremely hard.. you have to memorize useless facts.. And he hates vegeterans..

I dreaded this class every week. The tests were so hard and it seemed even if you met with Andrew he wouldn't have any sympathy about your grade. I tried really hard and even stayed late during finals week to take the optional final and still made a C. Don't take it if you don't have to.

He is lame! I am an A/B student and I studied forever for the first exam and got a C. I emailed him for advice on how to improve my score on the next text and he replied something like- Sorry, memorization is a lost cause for some people. I got a C in the class whether I studied the 200 slides or not! Not an easy A!

BORING!!!!!!!!!!!!! He is very clear about what is on the test but you really dont learn much, just memorize things.  i Hated it but it could be some peoples dream class if you are good at memorizing.

This was the worst class i have taken in my life. I am normally an A or B student, and i barely squeezed by with a C-. The uninteresting information is presented on slides that he simply reads and then says "we move on." I wouldn't take this class unless someone is holding a shotgun to your head, and even then you might want to think twice...

This class was incredibly easy, all you need to do is memorize the PowerPoints and show up to class for the bonus. DON'T BUY THE TEXTBOOK, you don't need it. Easy A, but the class is really boring and if you have an aversion to country-ish professors, you probably don't want to take this class.

Wow.. can we say BORING! Must go to class to get the bonus points tho...especially on Fridays. Easy class if you can memorize the slides.. most quesions come directly from slides. Lots of rather large words to memorize tho. also, you will find his voice very very annoying.

Go to class...you'll be bored to TEARS, but you'll get bonus points.  This class is a dozer, you'll learn nothing, but you're almost guaranteed to get a B or higher through bonus points.  Only enroll if desperate for a GPA boost.  Otherwise, it's not worth it.

Legendary teacher and a legendary class. Got and A-, missed 2 bonuses all semester, class is a must. Just went to class filled in the blanks, played on my computer and talked to my friends. A lot of fun. And he's just a goofy fun teacher

Horribly boring class. All notes on powerpoint slides. Tests were all memorization about stuff that nobody cares about and lots of words that you can't pronounce. The only thing that saves your grade are the in-class bonuses he gives.

The class was boring, but the class was very easy. I suggest taking it if you are good at memorization, if not, this class is not for you. So far this smeester, I have not gone to most of the classes and I have a B+.  If you do bad on one or more exams, don't worry, the 60 points of extra credit you can earn abring you grade up a lot!.

horrible class. in-class bonuses are only reason to attend. try reading the book. it explains things much much better than he does. don't bother asking him questions personally. i tried. he didn't make eye contact with me and simply said "e-mail me." I did and he didn't return an e-mail. very impersonable.

The worst class I've taken!! The only reason to go to class is for the extra credit. All the notes are online on slides and in lecture all he does is read the slides. It was the biggest waste of an hour. The test are rediculous. My class didn't have a 10% curve, it was more like 3%. I ended up with a B. A LOT of memorization!!
A lot of memorization. Most I spent studying for an exam was an hour.  Hard at first, then he throws in the 10% curve. ITS HUGE..  I went from a c- to a B-.
it f-cking sucks. i hate the class. he needs to be fired. -__-;
yeah his lame jokes i like and his curve i like. but the tests are ridiculous. anybody else commenting saying an easy A in this class is a nerd or dr.clarke or one of his TA's
Ok um there are like 500 people in this class so unless you like being a number, don't take it.
Great Curve

Though I'm not doing so well in this class, if you show up to lecture every time you should have no problem with this class. It's mostly memorization, but he gives about 24 random quizzes, and those are easy (they are on the PPslides he gave that day). If you can do that easily, then you'll be fine.

Terrible class!  In order to do well on the tests, you have to memorize an insane amount of powepoint slides, and he doesn't let you know anything about what will be on the tests.  Don't take this class!!!

This is by far the dumbest class you'll take in your entire college career. He gives quizes every class that everyone cheats on. I didn't study for any test and got a B. But still a difficult class if you try. I just got lucky.

Although the information is basically pointless (Memorization of trivial PP slides), the class as a whole is very simple.  Clarke tried his best to be humorous despite the fact he knew many people hated his class.  Easy A
He was unbelievably hard at the beginning of the year but really helped our grades out at the end.  He dressed as a cowboy everyday for class. totally weird
No Comments
this class sucks! never take it! it is completely dependent on how well you can memorize a billion power point slides for 50 question multiple choice tests.
Yuck! His class is really lame.
He seems to be obsessed with salsa.

Christine Cord is a professor who will talk back to students when they bring up relevant issues with the course. She reads from the slides during lectures and often goes off on tangents about her own life. She continuously changes her syllabus and assignments in the middle of them being due. I would never take one of her classes again.
Honestly best professor I've had at Mizzou I loved her and she truly cares about her students. She knows how to teach and is passionate about her job PLEASE TAKE THIS CLASS.
she would talk about all the topics on the test the day prior so we all knew what to stud

She is a very nice person and really wants to make a connection with all her students. If you are ever having problems you can just go talk to her and she is very sweet and understanding. As long as you go to class you will pass. Just make sure you go every day because there are clickers. I would definitely recommend this class!!!

Professor Cord was really sweet and wanted the class to engage. Attendance is mandatory via IClicker, and some of her assignments were unclear on the instructions, but if you reach out for hel,p she is willing to explain and help everyone to the best of her ability.
Read directly off slides, and went through them way too fast for anyone to take notes. Wouldn't post them online either, you had to hope to get a picture of them. Quizzed over the most random things.

4620 - Family Interaction was one of my favorite classes!

Christine Cord takes the time to get to know every student, cares about students well-being, and is overall the most loving, caring, and respectful professor on campus. She presents fun and engaging lectures, you will never not laugh in class. I wish I could take her class again!

This class was reading & discussion heavy, but was made easier with the amazing professor! She cared to learn about who you are as a person and saw you more than just another student. The class structure was beneficial to our learning by getting to participate and lead class discussions. She was very flexible and understanding. Would recommend her!

She is her own kind of bad. She reads directly off of slides, but also, she posts the textbook's version of the slides, and then she edits those, removes information, and presents that, so we can see when she skips all of the LGBT slides, or slides that she doesn't personally agree with. She also states opinion throughout the entire class as fact.

all she did was read off of slides the entire class and never actually taught us stuff from her own mind. she also set us up for failure for almost every test because she would tell us to just study for example  chapters 1-5 (AKA 100+ pages and definitions) or something like that and then she quizzed us on the most random things. never take again.

Courtney is one of the best professors I have ever had. Her lectures are great because she gives examples that help understanding. There are group projects that are actually fun and help learning. Go to her class and you can get a A.

Professor Cothren is amazing. Her lectures are very detailed, and she gives examples to help students understand better. On assignments, she gives feedback that is applicable for further projects. You can also tell that she truly cares about her students. She is seriously awesome. Pay attention and you can easily get an A.

Courtney is one, if not the best prof at Mizzou. She is a tough grader but really wants to help you succeed. This class is a lot of group projects but its very useful and applicable for post grad. Also, even though there are a lot of projects, you only present in front of the class once. She is super knowledgeable and an amazing caring professor.

Courtney is a great prof. her classes are pretty difficult but you actually learn and she really cares about helping her students. She's always very  responsive and helpful. Marketing 3510 is a reversed class so there is a lot of in class time to work but you have to do a little work outside of class. This class is big on group projects.

She is an unreasonable grader and provides little to no direction in her online discussion assignments. She just tells you to put important things in bold. Very Vague. Avoid this woman's classes at all costs. She is the WORST.

Her class was very easy and straightforward. Show up, take notes, participate in the group projects and yall pass this class with an easy B (at the minimum). While attendance is mandatory and iclicker is taken, she's very understanding with different circumstances that may arise. Would definitely recommend this class to anyone

Courtney Cothren is professor that cares about her students and tries to connect with each person to the best of her ability. Her exams are based off the study guide and powerpoints as well as lectures so it is important to attend class but class is interesting and fun.
Genuinely my favorite instructor from my entire college experience. I graduated a year ago and still look back fondly on her lectures. She's the best!

First class ever that I averaged a 90 on both the midterm and the final exams, as well as above an 88% on all assignments. However, those grades did not get passed Courtney and her overbearingly hard grading. Received an 18/25 on participation and finished with an 89% in the class. (No curve allowed) If you like tough grading, this class is for you
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Courtney is my hero! She really cares about her students and wants to help you succeed. She is very clear about what she wants and is always available if you need her. She even helped me when my power went out the day of the first exam and told me not to worry about it, to tell her when I was ready to take it.

Courtney was one of the best professors i had at Mizzou. She's very caring and considerate, her lectures are very informative, and she's super flexible. The group project was a great experience, fun and you learn a lot. The exams (there's 3) weren't hard if you prepared and they're curved. Take her class, you will not regret it.

Courtney is one of my favorite professors. She is very organized and always prepared. She is also one of the most caring and genuine professors and gives great feedback on assignments. Just be prepared to really study for her exams because they can be a little tricky!

LOVE Courtney! Her class is definitely hard and you need to put in effort and attend most lectures, but she makes class fun. She doesn't waste your time and regularly lets class out early if she finishes lecture. She grades strictly but fairly and is a really effective teacher. Couldn't reccommend her enough!!!

I had Courtney for MRKTNG 4220 and decided to take her new class (3510) because I loved her so much. She is without a doubt the best professor I've had at Mizzou. She cares about her students and wants them to succeed. She works really hard and it shows. Everything covered in 3510 is extremely useful and she makes it make sense.

Courtney is by far the best professor I've ever had in college. She's engaging, she cares about her students and her lectures and guest speakers are actually fun to go to! Her examples are relatable for college kids, and I would definitely take this again.

Once again, useless lectures, long, confusing and pointless labs, irrelevant, lengthy weekly assignments, iClicker quizzes, mandatory weekly meetings outside of class, 1000 word lab reports every week, doesn't respond to emails if you do not call her "Dr.". Assignments are also due at 8pm...

Melissa Collins was an absolutely fantastic teacher! She's always on top of her work, definitely doesn't make her ta's do all of her work, and the class overall was taught in a very academic manner. Everything you learn in this class you will use in real life! especially when learning about pronouns vs nouns! I've lied about everything)
Like engineering 1000, Collins yaps through lecture even though she reads off the slides. Labs and homework are tedious for no reason at all and due dates are weird.

Collins yaps for the entire lecture and mainly reads off the slides. The homework is tedious and very unnecessary and is due on random days and at random times. Labs were ok but again, tedious for no reason at all for a 1000 level class.

Terrible professor, assigns way too much homework. She structures the class so that you have a pre-lecture assignment covered in the lecture to boost her ego. Then you have to show up to lecture for an I-clicker, and then you are assigned a post-lecture assignment. I'm convinced she was lying about having a PHD. She likes to waste everyone's time.

Lectures and long and extremely boring. In the syllabus there is no description of how i-clicker attendance affects your grade or even says that it is included in your grade, but you are still graded on it. Labs are pointless and just extra work, lots of teamwork. She is terrible at announcements. Overall just a waste of a class, pointless.

AWFUL!!!! Her lectures are pointless and the biggest waste of time. The other week she told us class was cancelled 10 minutes into class as we were all in the building and made a zoom, I joined for as soon as I figured out class was cancelled. She proceeded to give me a 0 for joining too late. I'm done

All assignments due at 8PM on random days. Acts like her class is the most important, when this is an early level engineering course where you don't really do anything, when everyone could be studying for their calculus or physics, but she makes a ton of assignments that don't relate to the topic.

This is genuinely the worst class I've taken in my entire academic career. She speaks to us like we're children and has taught us absolutely nothing useful. She teaches us about teamwork and diversity as if we didn't just take a class last semester that did the same. She seems uneducated and I'm convinced she doesn't actually have a PHD.

Listening to her talk feels like I am pouring acid in my own ears. TikTok rizz brainrot is more educational than this sorry excuse for a tuition fee. Each time that I am forced to return to the hellscape that is her class, I am reminded of the ever-impending face of death that breathes down my neck each day. This class feels like impending doom.
Talks down to grown adults

I am so disappointed in how much I pay for tuition and THIS is what I get. She talks down to her students, she usually has guest speakers (who can be good but usually not), and when she does speak her slides are below average. I pay her salary and this is what I get? Ridiculous

She once cancelled class 10 mins before the starting time and told us to join a zoom. She's also the type of professor to have an assignment due during spring break. She also just treats everyone like a child.

I swear my freshman high school science class felt identical to this course. Everything from the assignments to the basic labs with overcomplicated expectations to the way the teacher talked to the students.

So many complainers in here... I'm no exception. I was tired of being treated like a child, was told college would be different and I would be respected if i showed respect. Nope. To the multiple people who said she's on a power trip, yeah. I don't mind calling you prof. but if you dont respect me I have no choice but to like the gorlock comment.

The lack of communication- in a career course completely dependent on communication- is ridiculous. No-notice lecture cancellation, nitpicky remarks towards students who wish to constructively critique/ desire explanation, lack of understanding and maturity regarding interpersonal matters- and an utter disregard towards students time. Unchecked.

The only thing you need in her lecture is an Iphone with Bloons TD 6 installed. This should keep you busy while her guest speakers yap. She never teaches herself, she thinks she is better than everyone by talking down to her students, unnecessary complicated labs I would do in middle school. mowing a lawn with nail clippers is a better use of time.
I would rather bash my head against a wall for an hour every week, then to take Melissa's class ever again. Bad.

When I got to college I thought I would be treated like an adult, but this class reminded me of middle school/high school. She treats students like children with too many superficial and assignments/rules. I got a 0 on a lab for using the restroom once. She ignores if you don't call her "DR". This class is child's level yet consumes so much time.
Massive time waster

reviews.comment: might as well take the tuition cost of this class and put it on black

I actually enjoyed learning about the all the Engineering fields. But, Good Lord, the amount of useless dribble you have to do makes this unbearable. The labs are tedious. The online work is a chore. She's on a power trip every time she speaks. People say this is engineered (hah) to waste your time? DON'T IGNORE THEM.

This class is the biggest waste of time I've ever seen. It's engineered to waste as much of your time as possible. Enormous amounts of weekly homework, mandatory weekly meetings outside of class, a confusing and boring two hour lab in addition to useless but mandatory lectures, 1000+ word group lab reports weekly. She's impossible to contact too.
She doesn't respond to emails and assigns way too much homework for a class that's supposed to be 1 credit hour. Overall the most useless class offered at Mizzou
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Never in my life have I had an encounter with a person so dedicated to wasting my time. As a winner of multiple academic awards, I can expertly say that her lectures are academically useless, however, attendance is mandatory, likely to inflate her ego due to having a full class. Also, the labs are extremely unclear and a complete waste of time.
Gorlock the destroyer.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: terrible professor, homework due dates are just bad, class is structured poorly. A waste of time
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Collins structures Engineering 1050 with way too much homework. A lot of readings, a 2-hour lab, and you learn a bunch of useless things. Lab reports are supposed to be like 400 words about teamwork and other useless things. The whole class is a waste of time. For 1 credit hour, it shouldn't be that much work.

Was an excess amount of homework for a one credit hour class. The labs were very poorly written and did not always work correctly. She spoke in a very condescending manor and was little to no help when problems arose with the systems she had us use.

Attendance at the labs is mandatory. The lab reports suck, and there is way too much homework for this to be a 1 credit hour class. You don't need to show up to the lectures, just get the lecture assignments from friends who did go or rotate week to week with your friends, sharing the answer each week.

Professor Collins will not respond to an email if you refer to her as "Mrs. Collins." She is arrogant and seems like she is always on a power trip. The class is very easy but is the most boring thing in the world. You don't learn anything in this class. Unfortunately, this class is required to be an engineer. One of the most annoying professors.

People dislike Collins but her class isn't actually that bad if you just do your work. The lectures can be interesting depending on the guest speaker. Make sure you pay attention enough to answer the in-lecture assignment. The labs are fine, mostly online simulations, lab report due weekly but it's easy to pump out. She has easy extra credit too.

Class is painfully boring. Labs were fun, peer mentoring was helpful, but all the work felt like "busy work." Attendance is counted by lecture quizzes but you can BS most of it. Don't spend too much time on this class, usually they give out good grades for most anything in labs, plus its only one credit hour. Easy class but kinda a waste of time.

Prof. Collins rarely lectures to the class. She instead invites guest speakers to give a completely irrelevant lecture, even though the lectures have (unofficially) mandatory attendance. The labs for the class are badly written, teach you nothing, and very tedious, also with mandatory attendance when it could be done at home. She just doesn't try.

For one of my most expensive classes, assignments and labs were poorly written, cryptic, out of date, and in general of shockingly low quality.
Talked down on students and, especially if you try to fix an issue with your grade, is extremely snarky and rude. Mistakes in assignments made me feel cheated out of a grade.
Avoid if at all possible.

Awful lectures filled with guest speakers that have nothing to do with the labs, paired with lecture assignments meaning lectures are pretty much mandatory. Labs are hard to follow and very tedious and grades can very much depend on who is in your group. Assignments are due at 8 PM for whatever reason and absolutely zero late work is accepted.

Doesn't even teach during her lectures, yet invites guest speakers to give their entire life story for an entire lecture, which is irrelevant to the poorly explained lab assignments. The class makes me want to switch to any other major. Along with mandatory lab attendance, assigns random "mentoring groups" where you meet once a week and do nothing.

Expensive textbook for simple 5 minute assignments, you're not really learning anything new in the lectures. Everything covered in this class is like stuff you looked up on YouTube in high school before you actually considered going to college to be an engineer. Lab assignments barely give context to how to assignments should be done.

The professor gives lecture assignments irrelevant to what the guest speakers discuss. There are several assignments a week with different due dates, all due at 8 pm. Assignments are not mentioned at the beginning of the semester, and no late work is allowed. Labs malfunction and teach you nothing relevant to the field.

I am so sorry, engineers. All the other negative reviews are true. All her policies are intentional pitfalls poorly disguised as a way to "get you used to college." It is by far my easiest class but by far my lowest grade. It's a required class, but useless. You're not graded on engineering but simply on how well you can navigate this mess.

Extremely poorly structured class with assignments due at 8 pm for no apparent reason. The premise of Engineering 1000 is to introduce students to different engineering disciplines which is noble. However the actual labs were extremely confusing with poorly written incoherent directions, to the point where the TAs did not even know how to do them.

Literally the worse class - and it's required for all engineering majors! Assignments have the most inconvenient deadlines. Don't be surprised if you miss some assignments - why are assignments due at 8:00 PM? Genuinely why?!

Don't even get me started on the lectures. They're completely pointless for the vast majority of students.
Waste of time, makes you come to pointless lectures. Makes work due early in the day for no reason, and refuses to accept late work.
Absolutely the worst, long labs, tons of busy work. Doesn't teach anything in her lectures. Not nice and makes assignments due early in the day with no late work accepted. Pointless class.

Horrible class and a complete waste of time and money. Attendance for labs is required, and the labs have incomprehensible instructions, but are graded harshly. Lectures are skippable if you can get the answers to her lecture assignments. Skip if possible, the lectures are just random industry guest speakers, and Melissa never actually teaches.

All the other reviews are true. Weird deadlines. The class basically taught by TA's, department heads, and guest speakers who work in the industry. There are meetings outside of normal class hours that are required. If missed, you lose points, EVEN IF YOU HAVE A TEST DURING THE SAME HOURS. Make friends in it so you don't invest too much time in it.

You do not learn anything you can actually apply to engineering. It is nothing but busy work. She does not respond to emails in a timely manner at all. Assignments sometimes have confusing deadlines and all assignments are due at 8pm. This class is nothing but a waste of time and money. There are also mandatory weekly meetings outside of class.
This class equates to highway robbery, it takes my money and it gives nothing in return. Worst of all it takes the one thing I can't replace, my time.
waste of time
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Read the reviews. Everything everyone says about her is 100% true. Absurd deadlines, course is useless, and it seems like she almost tries to hide assignments. I read on here "it seems like she wants her students to fail." that is completely accurate. Easiest class in the world, and she complicates it to the max.
She is just the worst. She doesn't give her own lectures. She doesn't have set office hours. She doesn't email people back. She does not care about your grade. She makes me furious.

It is ridiculous that this is a required class. This professor never teaches or goes over the assignments, and instead leaves it to apathetic TAs. Assignments include obvious software issues and contradictory information. There is a lack of communication from both Melissa Collins and the TAs, and homework is unnecessarily tedious.

Uninteresting, poorly designed class that requires labs that are a complete waste of time. The labs are uninteresting, tedious, and time consuming. I've taken 2 similar classes to this in other degree programs and this one is by far the least beneficial. This class makes the engineering program at Mizzou seem like a joke.

Everything has weird deadlines, she never teached anything in lecture that is part of the assignments, assignments themselves have little or no clear instruction and are pretty janky, and the whole class is supposed to be like introduction to different engineering majors but theres only basic level information and you dont really learn anything.
She doesn't ever teach the material that is covered in assignments, and unlike other professors seems to be rooting against her students.
Professor has deadlines at random times during the day and not accept late work. Does not round grade minuscule amounts.

This class was so easy that they had to put so much filler to keep us busy. You don't have to go to lectures (there may be assignments linked to the lecture) but the weekly group assignments were iffy. If you have a good group it's fine. TA's can be hard on grading and follow the assignment rules precisely. There are also peer group meetings.

Melissa spent the first lecture fear-mongering all of the students by introducing really strict and unnecessary rules (all papers must be turned in without any wrinkles, must have good handwriting, strict formatting requirements). In reality, we didn't turn in any physical papers. Assignment due dates & times were horrible and had lots of busy work
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was very annoying so many little assignments with no benefits. Many assignments due at odd times of the day which were hard to keep track of. Just the most useless class I've ever taken. It was really easy though.

Professor Collins needs to refine her teaching style and lectures. The way she conducts lectures makes it seem like she thinks that this class is below her. On top of this, she can be hard to get a hold of in a timely manner. Her decisions regarding class policy matters are inconsonant and can be frustrating. The class itself better than 1000.

ENG 1000 & 1050 is such a waste of time and money and shouldn't be a requirement if you know what field you want to go into. Also, you have to put so much time and effort into assignments just for them to not be worth much. Also, they give you barely any instructions on how to complete labs, yet they expect you to know what to do.
L professor

Most of this class is a waste of time, unless you have never ever taken any kind of science or math class in your life. If you selected engineering as a major, this class will be a waste of time for you, and I truly hope they remove it from the list of required classes for engineers. Busy work is the only thing I can say.
There is no reason an assignment should be due at 8PM. And to add on LOCKING it until 3PM the day before? Some of us have a life outside of college. Grow up Melissa.

Mellissa Collins is a difficult professor that likes to ramble and is very stingy about her rules. Her lab sections have too much tedious work. For an introduction level class I did not learn anything about engineering disciplinaries that I could not have found from Wikipedia. The class expected too much for being a 100 level 1 credit hour class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's a fine professor. The class itself is extremely useless and should not be required... but it is. Assignments are easy, but if you don't do them on time you wont get any extensions. She replies to emails super quick. Your grade is mostly just in the hands of your TA, but dont be afraid to ask for regrades on lab reports

Dr. Collins was a required class for me but it was not one that was as harsh as people say. The grading was easy and there was rarely any real homework unless you didn't finish your labs. Fine lectures and somewhat interesting speakers depending on your engineering.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: You need to take the course, but drop this class from the curriculum or something, please.  She talks down to students and is a terrible teacher.  Get her fired dawg.

Engineering 1000 is the most useless class to take. The labs are so entry level that they are below entry level. Lectures and labs are both pointless, you essentially just learn the names of different flavors of engineering.
Pointless lectures and a waste of time
bad

Whoever wrote that Engineering 1000 had easy labs apparently pissed the Collinator off because every lab in her class now has us going over end-level Engineering concepts with no guide or instructions. She just expects us to do it.

Engineering 1050 is a generally pointless class with unhelpful lectures and incredibly elementary labs. It feels like a stem summer camp that you pay college tuition for. The upside is that it's very easy and that the professor and TAs are generally fair/reasonable.
The most useless class ever taught by someone that talks down to you. This review doesn't even matter because it is a required class...
She is like a relative that you only see once a year and that is definitely enough. That being said, the class was very easy as long as you turn in work.

This class is insanely mickey mouse. Do not go to any lectures, there is a quiz every lecture day that can be figured out if you are not an idiot. Every week theres a lab where you do things you would do in grade school, we literally made a popsicle stick bridge 3 weeks in. You also have to meet with a peer mentor every week which is not bad.
For 1050, show up to your labs and be nice to your TA. If you do these, you will get one of the easier A's in your college career. If you put a tiny bit of effort in, this class is very easy.
Engineering 1000 and 1050 are so dull and unnecessary. Dr. Collins is very harsh for such an entry-level class. As long as you show up and do your work it is an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Engineering 1000 and 1050 were the easiest classes I've ever taken. Lectures are long and boring, labs are simple but time consuming. Peer Mentorship was the highlight of these two classes. Overall, this class was mediocre and a waste of time and money.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The intro to engineering classes have been an overall waste of time and money. It's not a difficult course but the lectures aren't useful or interesting. The only positive I've found within the course is that the mentor groups can be helpful, but are not worth the tuition money to be required for every engineering student for two semesters.
If you fumble a few of your assignments your grade is ruined. No compromises with Melissa. Nope, no can do.

Took Engineering 1000 with her. Great teacher and really pushed students to get involved on campus. Dr.Collins was really nice and helped me get connected to some undergrad research even as a freshman with questionable capabilities. I didn't go to very many lectures, but the lab was required. Overall an easy course with a lot of assignments.

My biggest gripe is that she's not very good at explaining complex concepts in a digestible manner. The only math prereq for this class is college algebra, but the way she whips out new, complicated formulas without explaining them was annoying. I know the material isn't easy, but Professor C seems to have forgotten this class is for undergrads.

She is so good at explaining concepts, and the lectures are clear and helpful! Although there are a lot and they are long, it's not too much work. Responded to emails amazingly quickly and very kind and helpful. 
Also had the option to redo all the homework (after feedback), which made it easier to know what to do on tests and get a better grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. C is incredibly funny and brilliant. The content is hard and you cannot slack off. If you put in the work, you will get a good grade be amazed at how interesting this subject is. It is one of the courses that made me love Economics again. Do the homework and practice exams several times and you'll be ready for the exam. Amazing Professor!

Dr. C is probably the best Econometrics professor in the nation. She is incredibly clear, does awesome lectures, and makes everything extremely understandable. Assuming you show up to lecture and pay attention, you are more than prepared for her tests, which comprise over 75% of your grade. She grades fairly and is always available for questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Dr. Crozier started out the year saying it was "statistically impossible" to fail his class, and then he pulled up the data to prove it. 

Three major tests make up most of your grade, but they're on an extreme bell curve (Bs would curve up to 100s). The class is extremely easy if you show up and take notes during lectures, at the very least.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The lectures are engaging, but the exams are completely unreasonable. You're expected to memorize hundreds of pages of "Ovid" with no guidance and identify random speakers from obscure passages not covered in lecture. The workload is excessive for a 1000 levle humanities credit and not worth the GPA risk.

Professor Crozier is easily the worst professor I've ever had, and this is easily the worst class I've ever taken. Your grade depends on 3 tests, each oh which are on 8 units(96 STORIES ON ONE TEST), which you need to memorize because each test is closed book He is a joke.

Dr Crozier is a hilarious guy and clearly very knowledgeable about mythology. He does go on long tangents sometimes when lecturing, but he does go over everything you need to know. You will have to read a lot and take a lot of notes ON PAPER!!!  He gives you six free days that you can miss and records lectures and publishes his slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: he's hilarious, so easy to pay attention in lecture. it is so easy to pass this class, you don't really even have to do the readings, just come to class and you'll get at least a B.

Grade totally relies on three tests which are ridiculously hard for an 1000 level class. If you're looking for an easy pass this is not it. If you're not good at memorizing, stay far away. His lectures are interesting but that's more about the material than anything he's doing. He is lenient on attendance and posts lectures online so that's a plus.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Curved all his tests, which you could take whenever online, and I got over 100% on all of them. He's a very chill person and cancelled class a decent amount because he wanted to go to football games out of town.

Lectures are never boring, you can so clearly tell that mythology is his passion. Even stopping by office hours to chat is fun. Very easy "writing intensive" because he integrates ai into the curriculum... do with that info what you will. Got a B bc I didn't study tests but did well on essays and attendance is a freebie 100% if you just show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--So many papers

reviews.comment: There is genuinely something wrong with Crozier. He is very rude to students, cancels class CONSTANTLY, then assigns you to study the lectures alone that are absolutely no help on the 3 exams. Lockdown browser is over-doing it for a 1000 gen-ed and half of one of my exams was in LATIN. NOT ENGLISH. please stay away!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I do not recommend this class at all. His tests have questions about things we are not taught in his lectures or readings. It's a guessing game, and the average most of his tests is around D-. The exams are Ai proctored, closed notes, etc. If you are looking to take an easy class I do not recommend this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The professor was very nice and was willing to help explain concepts you didn't understand. Although there isn't any homework, be prepared to put 5-9+ hours of reading/"Homework" a week. A lot of information crammed into 3 exams. Tests are hard, but get curved. If you ACTUALLY enjoy mythology, take this course, if not, choose something else.

You need to either show up to class or watch the recorded lectures to pass this class. TAKE NOTES. the exams are in lockdown mode and are proctored so you can't cheat. The exams are hard but he curves. The lectures are enjoyable and interesting. You don't need to read the books, the questions that show up on exams about passages are easy to answer.

I am a straight-A junior and work really hard to maintain A's. I took this class as an elective and felt like I was in the wrong class every day learning material that was for a Mythology major. I did all of the readings, attended class every day, and took extensive notes but was never able to make higher than a D on the 3 exams-the only grades
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy pass, I genuinely can't see how anyone could get less than a C+. The readings did really matter, but they aren't hard. Dr. Croziers lectures are also really informative and he clearly cares about what he's teaching.

All of the Material you need to know for the tests can be found on quizlets. His tests are ridiculously hard for the material he teaches. The median grade for an exam was around a C- in a course about mythology.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: There are only three tests that are over 8+ units of work at a time. They are insanely difficult(for that amount of content) and those are the only scores that go into the grade book. This is the first B I've ever gotten seriously don't take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Waste of time. AMS1060 with other professors is definitely the way to go. His lectures are filled with irrelevant information that wont be on the test and often times not appropriate side rambling about his personal life. You're graded on only 3 exams on lockdown browser. I think I would've learned more watching Disneys hercules

Crozier was one of my favorite professors this semester. I took AMS1050, Greek and Latin in English, and it was kinda clear that the class was a work in progress because this is only the second time it's been offered, but he was easy to work with and created a really great classroom environment. The class is pretty exam heavy, be ready to study.

Crozier is nice but doesn't teach this class very well. I enjoyed it but tests were difficult: closed note with lockdown browser, camera on, ect. They were weighted very heavily and the content is really difficult to study for. He cancels class a lot. Doesn't give a lot of material to study for but I found him knowledgeable and personable.
He makes the exams crazy hard and ends up curving it a lot.

I regret taking this class. It was listed as an easy humanity when choosing classes. However, this course was far from easy. For this to be my lowest grade out of all my other classes, I am very unhappy. The exams are very difficult, considering he has to curve every test. He does not give you a study guide or any idea of what is on the exams.

Ridiculously hard for a 1000 level gen. ed. The honors classes I have taken are not this hard. I have not missed a class, read all the materials, and studied for hours upon hours and still get poor test grades. There is not clear guidance on what to study and no study guides. Not sure how there are good reviews from previous years. Stay away!

He doesn't teach! Grades are comprised of 20% attendance and the other 80% comes from only 3 exams! He cancels class all the time and leaves it up to the students to learn the material. When students asked about study guides or reviews for the exams they were dismissed. He is very inconsiderate and makes fun of students for doing poorly in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The goat. The game is super fun, the tests were easier, and the only real homework was prep for the exams and the game. Overall super glad I took this class and its especially an easy honors credit if you need one.

Doesn't really teach the class in any way, everything you need to know for exams is just random facts you don't learn. When asked if there is a study guide he just leaves you with nothing and says it's everything you've learned even though he doesn't teach. DO NOT take this class with this teacher, the class isn't the problem, it's the teacher

Exams are extremely hard, when asked if there's a study guide for the upcoming review he told us "nope! it's everything we have learned in class up until now" which is fine because I attend every class; the only problem is its 50 full pages worth of notes and HE DOES NOT ALLOW OPEN NOTE. Would not take again he is rude and inconsiderate.

One of my best experiences with professors at Mizzou, and one of my best humanities experiences. The materials used in class were available for low cost or free, and you definitely need all of them. Everything you use in this class is enjoyable, not to mention the open note tests!

Crozier did not respond to emails and was very inconsiderate when I had to miss class for a death in the family. After multiple emails that got no response, I had to show up to class on the day of the funeral to request moving a test, only for him to tell me that he saw my email and chose not to respond.
He's a very fun professor who lectured like he was telling a story. Very engaging and I looked forward to going to class.
Interesting class overall, make sure to do all the reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Funny and interesting lectures, exams were online, straightforward, and super easy (especially if you were a percy jackson kid -- not kidding). Will definitely be taking his classes in the future!

Dr. Crozier is one of the nicest faculty members I have encountered on campus. My singular gripe with this class is that the online lecture part is not stressed very much, even though the two exams that cover the flipped lectures comprise of 60% of your grade. The game is a ton of fun and only gets more enjoyable the more you put into it.

I took mythology online so it was easy. The only annoying thing about this class is the online lectures were very very long and took forever to watch them and take notes. It is an 8 week course so it goes fast and there's a lot of course. It is a very easy A and a good GPA booster. there are 3 exams, all online and very easy.

Dr. Crozier is hilarious and entertaining. His classes are super fun. I'm just here to warn those of you enrolling in The Ancient Greeks: Honors. If you take this class, you will have two exams based on lectures done outside of class. Don't read the books, it isn't necessary. Get ready for actual LARPing. I hated this class, but loved Crozier.

Crozier is awesome, by far the best prof I've taken at Mizzou so far. He's super enthusiastic and funny but is also very knowledgeable about what he is teaching. The class is a discussion type class so you will be given a group in the beginning of the year and they will be your squad for the entire semester. Tests are online.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Crozier is an awesome guy and 2100H is a super fun class. You will have to read and write quite a bit, and taking good notes is vital for the online exams, but as long as you let yourself, you will enjoy this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Easy content but can be time consuming. If you want to rely on your notes for quizzes and exams, you really do have to write down pretty much everything he says. In the 8-week course, we covered 2-4 units per week w ~60-90 min of lectures for each unit. Quizzes and exams were super easy with detailed notes and doing the readings wasn't necessary.
rambled on, didn't teach anything, bullet point slides and expected students to copy everything down from that then proceeded on, relies heavily on textbook reading.

Very easy 8-week class. He gives online lectures through 3-part videos for each unit, with each video being around 15-30 minutes long. You are expected to watch around 4 units a week. If you want to take detailed notes and watch all of the lectures all the way through, you will spend a LOT of time on this class.

Doesn't know how to write good prompts, they're all very one-dimensional and give little room to explore or be individualistic. Does not care how well you write only that you follow his high school-esque formatting (my argument is ___ and I will show it by ___, ____, and ___). Very elementary and gives worthless feedback. The class was easy though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: The only professor where I wanted to watch his lectures, he never stutters or say um or like. Only an 8 week course and there's a bi-weekly quiz and 3 exams that are both open notes. If you need humanities TAKE THIS ONE!

If u have a hard time writing papers do not take this class. I am sitting here reading the essay question over and over just trying to figure out what its asking. the last paper took me every bit of 3 weeks. this is the worst class I have ever taken.

Professor Crozier is an amazing professor and I highly recommend him to anyone needing humanity credits. His lectures are interesting and you don't really have to do any work in the class to do well. All tests are open note and online so it isn't hard to do well as long as you are somewhat familiar with the content.

he is really cool, often he moves class to an online version because it is nice out. The tests are kinda hard, they are open note and online, but there are so many versions of myth you need to know his version you can't look up every question.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I literally love Doctor Crozier! He keeps the lecture exciting& helps you stay engaged. All notes are handwritten and a lot of grade is participation in iClicker and only like three exams. Literally would take this class again in a heartbeat. It's just a lot of reading and things to keep track of but his teaching and lecturing makes it worth it!!!

Dr. Crozier is hilarious and a fantastic professor! There is no homework and three open-note exams over the semester. You do have to read the "Metamorphoses" but it is split over several weeks and is pretty easy to read. All "textbooks" are provided for free. Attendance is part of your grade and all notes are available online after class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Crozier makes every lecture interesting, even if you're not interested in Greek Mythology. He is very interactive during the lecture and makes sure that we are all where we need to be content wise.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Crozier is one of the most incredible professors I have had the pleasure of working with throughout my college experience. I absolutely loved the first class of his I took, and chose another to take simply because I loved his teaching style so much. I have great respect for this man, I would highly recommend any of his classes.

He is okay. Overall, he cares about his job, tries to make lectures relevant, and is pretty funny. However, I am someone who enjoys mythology and I do not enjoy this class. His lectures are longer than what they need to be and he gives way more background info than what is necessary, which makes things boring.  Tests are not too hard. Weekly quiz

His class was online last semester because of COVID, but I still enjoyed it. The lectures are interesting. He is very funny, and you can tell he is passionate about teaching. Tests and quizzes were easy as long as you took notes and read over them beforehand.
none
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took his Mythology and a custom class he made connecting classic Greek literature to the Vietnam War. He is one of the best there is in the uni. He's enthusiastic, cracks jokes all the time, and often makes the tales of these stories relevant. Tests are pretty easy because they're online. You will read a decent bit.

Crozier was a great professor. I took the course online over the summer. Tests were straightforward and easy. As long as you watch the lectures and take notes you wont need to study very much. He made the lectures interesting and his teaching style was easy to listen to. Definitely recommend Crozier and the class.

Your entire grade in this class is based on only quizzes and exams. A lot of the questions are mostly from the study questions provided along with the lectures that he gives out. But Beware, you have one minute per question on each quiz & exam unless you have extended time accommodations and you can't go back & forth on the questions. So READ!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The lectures pull you in and make the info fun, reading was heavy and mandatory to pass this class. The quizzes/tests are on a time limit (short) and no backtracking. He is very easy to understand and PP is easy to follow. AGAIN READING IS A MUST. Overall, I would take his class again now that I know what is needed to make the grade. again READ.

Crozier is awesome! His lectures are fun to listen to, and I looked forward to his class every MWF. Show up, pay attention do the clickers, and work smarter not harder with the readings. Tests are online, but you do have to actually study bc they are timed and you won't finish them if you're looking every question up in your notes.
Iclicker & 3 exams is all you get. Have to show up to class. Online exams are a perk. Nice at times but also kinda of rude. Unless you enjoy mythology dont take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He gave great lectures and truly wanted everyone to pass. Highly recommend him to anyone

Probably my favorite professor of all time. He reanimates mythology in entertaining lectures that feel like story time. Just show up and do clicker questions and you'll be fine. All tests are online. The lectures are well worth showing up for, and the man is very accommodating. Any ambiguity on his end and he is quick to make it right and fair.

Only has 3 online tests and iclicker questions. MUST do readings to pass class and actually go to class and take good notes from lectures. He records lectures online, but definitely suggest just going to the class for easy points and better notes. Tests can get tricky, but just use your notes and keep up and its pretty easy to ace. AMAZING TEACHER!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Crozier is a great storyteller and hilarious which makes the class interesting. Your grade will rely heavily on how you do on the tests so you'll need to do your reading. I would recommend reading a chapter and then listening to his lecture on the chapter to prepare. Make sure you go to class so you can get participation points for the clickers.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Honestly just someone who loves his job and does it very well. Makes lectures very interesting even though the subject matter may not be. he makes this class my favorite on my schedule. Nothing but good things to say about him. The class is a larger setting however so you have to be prepared to do a little learning on your own. CrozierThe Man.
He's the best teacher I've had at Mizzou!! Can not recommend him more! Take this class!!
Funny funny funny! Also online tests make the class very easy to pass!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Funny and sometimes inappropriate. Test are online and you can google all the questions. Easy A if you need a GPA boost. You have to go to class for the clicker questions because he does it for 30 seconds and doesn't show the question. Easy clicker questions and you get 0.8/1.0 if you get it wrong which is nice.

I took this class online and he made me work for it! 3 books to read, each about 500 pages. Had to write 20 essays (2 pages each) plus 3 exams that have to be HAND WRITTEN on paper (about 6 pages each). Does that seem reasonable to you? Too much writing, too much reading. Seriously. Grading is fair. Does not care about content only proper format.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Really goofy guy, but the tests are online and you can take them in a group. Easy A.

Good teacher, he's very goofy and sometimes a little inappropriate. Prepare to be uncomfortable but laugh a lot. He made boring subject matter entertaining. Easy A if you go to class and do the clicker questions.

Great professor that truly challenges your writing by shredding half-done papers which ends up improving your writing. Tests are great if you review the study questions he provides. If you try you will get a good grade and improve your writing from this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: This dude thinks the 50 minutes 400 other people and I have him 3 times a week is his standup hour, and I love it. He makes the material interesting, plays dope music before each class, and is a very real guy. Quick notes on the class; Online tests, skim the reading for the tests, let's you out early/cancels class quite often.

The content of Mythology is not difficult, it is just a lot of memorization. I highly recommend being proactive for this class by taking notes on the readings before lecture-otherwise you will be completely lost bc he teaches assuming you already know the basis of things. His grading scale makes a 93 an A- and grades on very few things.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor Crozier is the best professor I've ever had. He does care for his students, and he makes hilarious comments throughout his lectures (a ton of dave chappelle references). If you're an average student you'll definitly get a B in his courses. If you're a hard working student it will be an easy A trust me!
