reviews.comment: Dana is a young and spirited individual. You're required to watch films weekly and then answer a few questions about them. There is a textbook that you should read. Rather than having exams you have essays. I suck at writing, but still did good in the class. Dana is not a tough grader, just make sure to interpret films and explain your reasonings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I have ever had.  Lectures are very thorough and highly interactive. Expectations are clear, and will never throw a curve ball. As long as you attend lecture and lab, you will do just fine.

She is so nice, she makes lecture super interactive which is great, prepare to show up because there are opportunities for points randomly throughout lecture. Such a sweet woman, wish I had her next semester.
Going to labs and lectures is the only way you will pass!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: You really don't learn much from the lectures so once you get your clicker points you don't have to go. Just make sure you know how to do the homework and look at the sample exams and you'll be fine for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Lectures are awful but lab is actually useful. I learned everything in lab and basically taught myself the rest. Easy to learn though.  She tries to teach during lecture but I did not learn a single thing in it.

Billie's class was great. Her exams are almost directly from the material learned in class. Go to lecture, go to lab and you'll be fine. Mostly just basic math. She does take attendance so go to lecture to get easy points.
Pretty easy just go to lab and lecture and you will do fine

Billie loves her class and her topic, but the class itself sucks.  The TA's save your grade during lab as that's where I learned most of the content.  Tests are 90% of your grade and there are only three so they are not exceptionally hard, but screw up once and there goes your A.
This class was the biggest snooze fest. Lectures were so boring I wanted to sleep the whole time.
Really good teacher. Got to class, she really clears things up for you if you go to class. Read the textbook, a lot of multiple choice questions come from the text book.

Billie is a great professor and is there to help students understand the material. To get a good grade  you need to attend lecture to get the clicker points and attend your labs with the assigned homework, and there are three tests but no final. The class is not difficult if you put effort in to stay on top of it, and do not get behind

Only reason I did so well in this class was because of the lab (the TA's are awesome). Billie teaches well and tries her best to keep everyone awake but the lectures are long and boring. She takes clicker points but leaves you room to skip like 8 times. Overall I don't think anyone else could do it better, hardest part is staying awake in lecture.

Very good teacher, very nice and enthusiastic about the topic. She's very disorganized at times and screws up when teaching a technique or two which doesn't help wit the test. The TA's were awesome though. They were the whole reason I did well.

I really liked the professor. She really cared about her students and was pretty funny, too. The class was not too bad. Go to all the labs and attend class for clicker points. The practice tests she posts are fairly similar to the actual exams. Get a good start on your first exam because it can make or break your final grade!
Very boring lecture but must go cause of clicker points. Memorize workout problems for the test and you should be fine. The multiple choice can be a little tricky.
The class is very boring and the homework is a joke. What's really important is going to the labs and saving the lab sheets. That's where you actually learn anything.

I thought I was going to love Billie, and I went to every class the first half of the semester. But it's seriously SO boring that I would have to hold my eye lids open. You have to go to lecture for clicker points but lab is what will actually help you out.

She knows the subject well, but she is very boring to listen to. She also plays bad music in the middle of class sometimes to get people awake. She's very nice and actually interested in what you have to say. She may not be the best, but you can certainly do worse.

Billie is great! I had her for an 8 am, and she kept be awake and engaged which is usually hard for me that early. She's enthusiastic and knows what she's talking about. Sit in the front!! Homework is barely collected, but it's worth doing to know it. The book is pretty helpful. Definitely go to the labs- they explain and reitterate everything.

She is a very enthusiastic teacher. The class is pretty easy you just have to study for the tests that are each worth about 30% of your overall grade. She posts everything on blackboard including old exams. Good teacher I reccommend the class.

She's a pretty engaging teacher and she wrote the book, so she knows what she is talking about. But most people don't show up for this class, and participation is a pretty small part of the grade (20 points out of 360, and there are like 40 available participation points). It's test heavy. Just go to the labs and look at previous tests. = A

Billie is so enthusiastic about teaching and does a great job relating to her students. She honestly cares about them! If you go to class and lab you will be fine on the tests. They're very straightforward and she will always tell you exactly what will be on it (no curveballs!).
She is a good teacher. Go to class and labs because test is just like material that you go over in lab.
i had to work really hard for my A. the labs were helpful, and i had a good TA. tests were super hard- especially the multiple choice.
Great teacher. Although you do need to read the text to suceed, she is pretty clear on the material you need to konw for the test!

Go to the lab and do the homework! Easy class if you read the book and do the homework, I got an A- and didnt go to even half of the lectures. I didnt even like accounting but if you keep up its not hard...

Good teacher, very friendly, tries to make class interesting, makes sure everyone understands. Tests are very hard though so study A LOT (my TA wasn't very good though). GO TO EVERY CLASS else you will fall behind. Read your textbook because she doesn't cover most of it in class. If you like acct. or are good at it, you will do well.

I must admit that Cunningham did a pretty decent job teaching the class, although there were a couple times she just made thigns harder than they shoudl have been.  Her exams are pretty consistent with those from previous years.  Read the book: it has great example companies that make it a more interesting read.  Lab sessions for this class rocked!

SHE WROTE THE FREAKING TEXTBOOK! HINT*! READ IT! Take the practice exams too, and basically anything that has questions on the chapters because she wrote all of those too . . and chances are you'll see similar if now the exact problems. Very energetic, sort of dificult. See your TA's regularly.

Billie is a great teacher, especially to have at eight in the morning. It is very important to go to the lectures and the labs: she presents concepts in lecture, and the problems on the test are from the labs. Makes this class great for everyone.
She was an excellent teacher! Make sure you READ YOUR ASSIGNMENTS before class as well as focus on understanding how to do the problems in labs
Cunningham was a very upbeat professor who always tried to make class interesting. She always made sure you understood what we were covering.
She is fun, but not always on task.  I like her style, but you can learn everything from lecture by just going to lab and doing the lab work.
funny n not too serious.. .subject matter is just kinda boring!
No Comments
Billie's a nice lady.  She goes off on a few tangents, but if you read the book and understand the lecture you'll do fine.

Long lectures but important points to pick up if you want to do good on the tests come straight from them.  Labs helpful to gain experience.  If you can do the homework you will do fine on the tests.  Usually no curve but class avg. is around 80.  Many struggle, many think it's easy.
well prepared and thorough.  tests are very fair.  I am thinking about entering the business school because of her.
billie is a nice lady.

I suggest investing in a palm pilot and using AvantGO (www.avantgo.com) to read news during lecture.... that or buy a $5 pocket tetris game. Lecture is boring but she offers an occasional bit of knowledge not found elsewhere, so don't skip. Read the book and go to lab and you'll be fine.
Some of the worst lectures I have ever had. Lab was useful. She is awful, TAs make the class
she never helped me and her lectures suck

Although she doesn't always pick the best T.A.s, she is an awesome teacher, and is very helpful to those who need assistance. I hate accountancy, but she helps make it easier to understand. Very good professor.
she litterally bores me in lectures...but lab is fun

This class is fairly easy.  Lectures come straight from the book, so as long as you read that, you should be fine.  Labs are excellent b/c you actually get to practice.  Tests are kind of tricky, and the multiple choice questions totally suck!
Classes not hard, suggest not skipping though.  Tests can be a little tough, but over all very good class, and a good prof.
This teacher wasn't very good, however one of her TA's was awesome.  Not to mention any names, though, because I think he's hot.

The class is easy. The lecture is taught at a remedial level, but she wrote the book so you don't have to go to lecture, because the book stuff is EXACTLY the same. The TAs are where your help is supposed to be. If you get a bad TA for lab, you're screwed
Her tests are hella long and hella hard.  The first tests start out okay, but the second test was so friggin hard.  But it's not a plus/minus class..which i guess is a good thing.
No Comments

I'm taking an online class, so maybe that's why my experience has been different, but it's been awful. He doesn't accept any late work at all, yet drops assignments randomly. There's no calendar, so it's completely random. The slides he posts are barely thrown together and have a lot of mistakes. He doesn't seem to care about this course at all.

This was my second class with Dr. Smith. The lecture material was very similar to his first class, even though the topics were different. His exams are more difficult than you would expect, so make sure to study. Totally possible to get an A, though!
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. Smith is a well respected professor in the NEP department. I really enjoyed this class. However, the exams are much harder than I was expecting, so be prepared to study. If you come to class and work hard, then you can get a good grade.
If you have had one of his classes, you have had them all. But very easy A and very good professor! Super cool guy and really helpful. Definitely recommend his classes.
Very straight forward guy, weekly quizzes are kind of tough but the tests are exactly what was on the quizzes so its easy to boost your grade there.

Switzer is a great professor for pub adm students. His Intro class is not extremely difficult, with the main gist of it being 1) read his short canvas write up before class 2) show up to class 3) participate, and 4) make sure you study for the quizzes because that is the majority of your grade (3 quizzes: 20%, 15%, 10%) Also he loves water policy.

Learned a lot in this class, thought Dr. Switzer was great. Clearly passionate about what he does, well organized, grades in a timely manner. Would recommend taking thorough notes during lectures, as there is not much on canvas and zero textbooks.

Dr. Switzer is the best! He cares about his students and the information he teaches. He's very passionate with his lectures, which makes them even more interesting/keeps your focus. Great guy I hope he teaches more classes soon!

Dr. Switzer designed and wrote most of the content for this class and is very passionate about every topic. He genuinely cares about his students and learns everyone's name in a 50 person class. You take notes on readings and lectures in class and then do simple assignments. Study guides accurately reflect exam content. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very social professor and knew everyone's name in a 50-person class. You do have to take pretty good notes because not a lot is posted to Canvas.
He's a super nice guy and very funny, I enjoyed his class. It is very test and lecture heavy but nothing unbearable. I'd say it's not easy but if you put in the work you'll be fine.

I would not take this class with this professor. I looked it up later and he has the lowest grade distribution out of all of the professors that teach this class. He does IClickers but they are random and you will never know when they are. Your entire grade is based off of iclickers at random and tests. Take this class with anyone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He gives way too much info. There are no study guides and says that any content can be on the tests. It is too much information to cover, too many reading assignments to keep track of, and test averages are not great. Usually C averages for the class on tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are entertaining and you learn a lot. Exams are very very hard and if you dont memorize pretty much everything you are probably out of luck. Wish there was opportunities to raise your grade through other things like a project or something else
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Attendance isn't 'mandatory', but if you miss a lecture you will not be able to pass an exam as well as losing very grade heavy iclicker points. Extremely unorganized class, only canvas posts are in syllabus. He makes lectures entertaining at least, but exams are difficult to study for because of an abundance of information and no study guide.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: Tests are majority of your grade. Go to class! Write everything down. Statistics will be on tests. Read the books and articles assigned. He seems like a pretty chill guy but he's an alright professor. Class could be organized better. I feel like he could use things other than exams to gauge learning. Mentioned that and gave reccs in my course eval.

Dr. Ruggeri does a really good job with lectures and keeps them interesting. Make sure you write down EVERYTHING from the slides as that is the majority of the material for the exams. There's a lot to read and no study guides. I recommend using quizlet to study for tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Go to class!!! It's literally like 80% of your grade and he makes attendance weigh more than exam scores!!! He's a nice teacher but I wish the class had more structure. He'll say something won't be on the exam and then it ends up on the exam. There's also no study guide, no clear direction on what or how to study. Won't respond fast but yea he's ok
Not bad just go to lecture and study the statistics from the slides for the exams. It would be better if there was a smaller class size

Ruggeri really cares about teaching, but I thought his class organization was terrible. Only graded by a few things; test grades were your grade. Need to be in class for iClicker and notes. You have to buy 2 books, and read lots of articles and pdfs. There are no study guides or learning objectives for exams, purely the notes and what you read.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Only grades on canvas are from exams, a couple of quizzes and Iclicker. It is almost like he wants us to fail.

This is the second time I have had to take this class, as the first time was too difficult. Don't expect this professor to respond to your emails unless you've got time to wait 3-5 business days. There are typically lots of unclear assignments and a lack of answers to questions. I'm doing better this time around because my TA is so much better.

Very lecture and exam-heavy with no homework to help besides assigning articles to read. I got poor exam grades after studying for hours for them. (1st 2 exams class ave: 68%). Received a lower-than-expected score on my paper, with no comments/advice as to why I got that score.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Grades were unfair leaving no comments for future improvement or any comments on what was missed on papers. Lecture heavy with no homework to help study for exams. The lectures were long and not interactive.
Nice man and passionate about his work, but the class had a ton of information in lectures and not enough homework or other sources to help prepare for the test

During class, we would talk about random business topics most of the time. It was somewhat unstructured. Guidelines for assignments were not always clear and he would give vague descriptions for things that he wanted very specific. Grading comments were vague/frustrating as well. We had a case study due each week, group projects, and 2 tests.

Yes, attendance is mandatory. If you miss a class, you can reach out to a friend and get the notes for that day. If you study the slides and just pay attention in class (which is easy to do because Dr. Ruggeri is fun to learn from) you will do great on the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Ruggeri makes class interesting and there is minimal work to do in this class, attendance is important since he will have random pop quizzes, but other than that - 3 group papers and 3 exams, all of which are super easy
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Take the class with a different professor, it will save you the time. If you don't come to class, its impossible to pass. He doesn't post his slides online, so if you aren't in class for the day, then he doesn't have sympathy. I went to almost every class and studied my butt off and barely got a B-. Not very lenient on unexpected life emergencies.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Ruggeri is not reasonable at all and if you want to try and contact him about your grade or anything else he is very hard to reach. He doesn't care and will say read the articles and the book to get a better grade on the exams but doing that literally didn't help. I swear when I get to the test, half of it I have never seen before.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Amazing professor that offers good clarifications if anything is ever misunderstood in class. Relatable and keeps class interesting even though its just lectures. Must attend class because he doesnt post his slides online. 3 exams, 2 group papers, and 1 individual paper that determine majority of your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: great professor! highly educated & caring for his students! willing to work with you for clarifications and feedback. requires coordination of group projects, and there were only two tests which made up a large part of the grade. however he keeps his lectures very interesting so if you pay attention &take notes youll be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: All the negative comments on here are 100% NOT true! Ruggeri is one of the most passionate professors I have met and truly cares about his students getting good grades. It can get confusing, which means you should ask questions and not sit back and blame it on him.

Not the most exciting professor, but the content and his expectations are straightforward. Decent amount of readings but not a ton of work. A few online quizzes and group papers. Can't do well if you don't show up for lecture. Definitely easy to do well as long as you show up and stay on top of readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: So your grade in this class is basically 2 exams, a couple papers, and pop quizzes. The group papers aren't difficult as long as your group gets together early to work on them, but the exams were so hard. I really don't know where the information came from because it wasn't from his slides. Have to go to class to get the notes and take pop quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He's very rude and not understanding whatsoever of typical "life situations"... He's very arrogant, strict, and a tough grader. By all means, take this class with someone else if you have the option.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Worst teacher I've ever had in my life. Pompous, vague, distant, rude. Wish he would never return to teach.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: The teacher brings in professionals from different health care fields for each class, and you're randomly chosen for if you take a quiz after that. I had to say the second book you have to read for the class is quite awful. Dr. Ruggeri is very approachable, but he's not actually teaching the lectures. The test questions are often small details.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: His lectures can get long and boring but he tries his hardest to crack jokes and keep it light hearted. He's kind of an ass but in a good way in that he makes it interesting. Class is easy as long as you're there to receive all points possible. If you do your work and do decent on the tests, it's not hard to get an A

Dr. Ruggeri genuinely wants his students to learn the material and is not as focused on the grading portion of his class. Attendance is not mandatory but you may miss in class assignments or quizzes --There are not many grades in the class so make sure to submit all assignments and put in the work for the final paper and you'll have no problem!
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Great professor overall. Everyone I know respects him. He teaches some harder subjects, but he takes time to ensure each person understands the subject.

Good professor and understanding, takes a while to put grades in leaving the final period to be a little stressful as all grades were not put in until the Saturday before the Monday final. Easy to talk to at the end of classes, there are quizzes every Wednesday.
Professor Davis is one of those professors where you can tell he really just wants you to succeed. Respect that, do your work, and don't leave class early on Wednesday and you're gonna love it.

His lectures are very unorganized, and He knows what he's talking about, but his class structure is awful. He makes his class assignments and lectures feel like a chore, and I find the subject he teaches fascinating it's very annoying.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I think Dr. Davis is really funny and I like his tangents, sue me. There's no tests except the final and the quizzes are pretty easy and he posts a study guide for all of them. You get a chance to go on a pretty cool tour of one of the envirosci related facilities in Columbia and you have class off while the other tours are going on.

This wasn't the worst class I could have taken but it could be tedious to go to. The lecture can be fun one day and extremely boring the next. I would advise to not get up and leave his class mid-lecture, he will doc points. He will go off on long tangents about random things but it wasn't bad. Get ready for weekly quizzes you will forget about!

Dr. Davis was an amazing professor. His lectures were very interesting and quizzes and homework was easy. There will be tours and guest lectures in this class and there will not be class on Fridays in many weeks. He is also very understanding professor.

Dr. Davis is an awesome professor! He understands that many of us take this class to earn credit and not because we are environmental science majors. Because of this understanding, the class is easy to pass. I enjoyed him and this class a lot. He is a bit unorganized, but he admits to that. You only have to attend 50% of lectures for an A.

While I believe Dr. Davis is a good person, he is far from a good professor. He is extremely disorganized and condescending, never seems prepared, goes on tangents, drops assignments at random, changes due dates with little to no notice, and strays away from expectations in syllabus. While the class is fairly easy, these factors add challenges.

He is a good person, but he is disorganized, and condescending. He changes due dates at the last minute, he calls students out in front of the class, he drops assignments randomly, and ridicules emails.The class is very easy to pass, but you have to be organized(unlike him)and show up to most classes. He does give study guides for each quiz though!

The class was easy and I would recommend taking it as an elective. There were no exams, only weekly quizzes that were easy if you studied and they were curved for extra credit. We were required to attend 1 event outside of class but he also didn't have class on Fridays frequently. The final was easy and took 15 minutes if you studied the quizzes.
Super clear grading criteria, if you put in the work, you will get an A. Lectures could be a little disorganized at times.

Mr. Davis is overall a good professor and his course load is very easy to keep up with, as long as you attend the lectures. He had a really clear grading policy and provided students with lots of extra credit options granted that you did the work for it. The only thing that I disliked about his class was that his lectures are disorganized
He's a respectable professor, and his class is fairly easy, as long as you pay attention and do the assignments.
Dr. Davis really cares about his students and wants you to succeed. His lectures can be a little jumbled at times

Dr. Davis is an amazing professor. Such a kind and caring person which can be hard to find in college. Take his class if you get the chance! Very straightforward and you will have to do work, but his class is what you should expect for college.
Dr. Davis is not the best at lecturing, however if you go to his office hours he is very helpful 1 on 1 and wants you to succeed.

Dr. Davis is a great person, he is very caring and generally understanding of his students. However I took his intro enviro sci class and this one as well, and one thing I've noticed is that he is not the best lecturer. I think his slide shows are overly visual. I think with more experience he could be better, he's just a young professor.
The class was very easy; Dr. Davis just doesn't have the best lectures. At times he seemed unorganized and got off-track easily.

Generally a pretty easy class. Quizzes once a week, short textbook activities every week, a few assignments, and a final. Dr. Davis is a greatt guy, but lectures can seem a little all over the place some days. I'd recommend to anyone that needs an easier credit.
Very nice and generally fun class to go to! I would recommend!

I feel bad cause I gave him a really bad rating on the course evaluation and then he dropped our lowest quiz scores so I have over a 100% in the class, he's not terrible (sorry Dr. Davis) he just doesn't seem passionate during his lectures so they can be pretty boring

Dr. Davis is a solid professor. Sometimes lectures seem a bit jumbled but that's mostly an organization issue. No tests, only quizzes, and a final. occasional assignments, no group work. No need to buy the textbook. Lectures posted online during the pandemic and was flexible. Easy class overall, but easy to get behind if you didn't go in person.

This teacher is so nice. Office hours are super helpful and he's willing to answer every question in a way that is easy to understand. He makes sure to ask if there are any questions while going through the practice problems in class after every topic or difficult problem to make sure everyone knows how the answer was found. Would recommend.

this guy is awesome, hes the chillest guy ever and so fun to talk to. tests get graded as such: 1 mistake= earn half credit and 2< mistakes= earn no credit. tests are short, hw quizzes every week, hw is kinda long. but if y'all have any choice of teacher, TAKE THIS GUY YOU WONT REGRET TRUST.

Great teacher for Calc, he didn't have much freedom because it is a 900 person class in sections and coordinator is very strict. You can tell he cares and understands the material well. I would suggest going to class because there is not a recorded lecture. Quizzes every Wednesday, he gave occasional days off if we got ahead of schedule.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Loved him as a person. I just personally had a rough time with Math 1400. I know people who I clicked for and people like me who had to scratch and claw to move on. Overall, he would give extra credit and give you points whenever he could. Very fast lecture style. I would NOT take Math 1400 if it's not required.
Very chill and approachable dude. He taught well enough that I could skip most classes and still get high grades. Very easy, highly recommend. He's super nice, I want to be his best friend.

Always helped and tried to give as many points on the tests. During quiz gave extra credit for writing our favorite song. Easy to understand and good at answering/explaining questions. Maybe don't take the 8 am... wanted to fall asleep in class. (Not because it was boring just because I was tired and didn't want to lock in that early lol)

Overall, he's a great and helpful teacher. Gave effective and easy-to-understand lectures about the subject matter and willing to give help outside of class. I had a few medical issues the semester I had his class but he was always willing to be accommodating. Also, he's just a very kind and fun guy, definitely recommend taking his class.

Great professor, and a super nice guy. Has good office hours to get help. Seems like he does not have much control over the course as their is someone above him controlling everything. 3 exams and a final exam. weekly homework that can suck as sometimes you will have 100 homework questions. also have weekly 2 questions quizzes. Overall good!

Justin is great at explaining difficult calc concepts.  He tries his best to give partial credit on tests and always offers office hours for help. Weekly homework assignment isn't too bad, study for the exams by using the MyMathLab practice exams the questions are usually the same with different numbers.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Talks fast but will slow if you ask, tries to give as many points possible on exams/quizzes. Miss a class and you might fall behind but he's available for extra help (go to him and not tiger tutors if you can). He's super nice and chill. Quiz every Friday, tests are 70% of grade, hw 25%, and quizzes 5%. 
(1)Lowest homework and quiz will be dropped.
Sweet, friendly.

I've always struggled with math but I could somewhat understand what was going on through this course thanks to the professor. She tends to explain things very well, but be prepared that there are more difficult things she didn't cover in the homework and exams. If you go through the homework and study, you'll do fine.

I liked how she dropped 6 attendance grades I thought that was very nice because that was not the case for most classes. What my complaint is, I felt like my math skills didn't improve, homework was extremely long and took a ridiculous amount of time to complete, and test questions felt much harder than what we had worked on or reviewed.

She's super sweet! My only complaints are that the average homework assignment is 70 questions and just repeats the same kinds of problems so that's annoying. Basically a review of high school algebra. The TAs are psycho though.

If you take her class make sure to have a graphing calculator! She says there won't be graphing on the exams then pulls out 4 questions about graphs in the final without any final reviews or anything. She also goes through stupid easy concepts for forever and difficult problems she just skips through. Be prepared to teach yourself!

She was very rude and unhelpful. I would not recommend this teacher to anyone ever. She doesnt seem to care much about her students well beings at all considering how much I know my peers and I tried to reach out to her but all she ever gave back was attitude.

Ms. DeSouza is one of the nicest teachers I've ever had. I have always been notoriously bad at math and she truly helped me learn the basics of Algebra. She is incredibly helpful and never makes you feel stupid for being in intermediate math. Highly recommend taking this class with her if you struggle with math.

I loved Mrs D. She is a very sweet, funny woman and cares about her students. I had her for int. algebra, and despite hating math, she was very patient, answered as many questions as you had, and was very helpful. Math sucks, but she made it a little better. Take her if you can!

Take a quiz every wednesday and then retake it as a group the following friday in lab. Backtracks mid sentence and tangents a lot during lecture which can make it hard to follow. The lab format is kind of confusing but you can tell he's passionate about the subject he teaches.

Loved his class structure. We took a quiz every Wednesday but then retook it as a group in lab on Friday and the grade was the average of both quizzes. Final was just all the quiz questions word for word. Really wants students to do good while learning.

Nice & funny-Class was easy & style is same as rum nutrition. Quizzes/labs/final were the only grades. You get to take the quizzes twice, once by yourself & the second time as a group & he takes the average of the scores. Hard to get ahold of. Likes to go on tangents. Very opinionated, even when he knows nothing about the thing he is talking about.

Nice & funny-Class was easy & style is same as beef prod. Quizzes/labs/final were the only grades. You get to take the quizzes twice, once by yourself & the second time as a group & he takes the average of the scores. Hard to get ahold of. Likes to go on tangents. Very opinionated, even when he knows nothing about the thing he is talking about.

Very tough grader and takes off points for things that aren't on the rubric. He gives good feedback when you ask about an assignment, but then will still take off a million points when you turn it in. Also takes WEEKS TO A MONTH to grade assignments. Putting in a lot of effort will still only get you a B+ with Gordon. Take 1300 with someone else.

Firstly he comes across as a nice person but throws that out of the window when it's time to grade and that seems like what a coward and mean person will do. Tries to sound like he's doing the right thing but will tell mean things in a nice way.
Nothing. He just needs to be nicer

Gordan is a decent teacher, didn't really know what he was talking about most of the time and said "I'll have to ask Kat" every time you asked a question. Would also give good feedback on assignments but then when they were turned in would tear them apart. Myself and classmates experiences this a lot. Could also use more public speaking.
Santos is hilarious, caring, and a great instructor. He seems to be effortlessly funny and is a phenomenal Spanish educator (easily the best of the four I've had!).
He is one of the nicest guy's ever! He genuinely cares and wants you to do well. He made Spanish easy and we got to play a lot of fun games. There is a ton of homework but just look it up on quizlet

Santos is the best Spanish teacher I've ever had!! He answers all questions and makes sure you understand everything thoroughly. The tests aren't bad and he always uses games and fun exercises to learn new concepts! He is so funny and understanding to every student and makes you feel comfortable speaking a new language.

One of my favorite teachers of all time. He definitely cares a lot about students, and a very nice guy. Very funny as far as teachers go, and not too strict. Tests were easy, but there was a buttload of homework, but that's not his fault. I really enjoyed his class and I think he has the best smile I've ever seen :)
Best spanish teacher ever!! Makes you so comfortable speaking a new language! Very understanding and nice guy.
Best teacher I've had at Mizzou. He makes the coursework very interesting. He truly wants all his students to succeed. I would definitely recommend him to anyone!
Professor Santos is the best. This guy is amazing, funnny and very smart! Best class that youll ever take!

I absolutely loved being part of professor Santos class! He is a great professor!! His classes are the best. He is funny, understanding and he will make sure that you understand Spanish from day 1. I hope I had Sr. Santos for all the Spanish class Ive ever taken! He is just amazing! I highly recommend this class!

Diamond Wheeler is one of the best professors at the university. He is kind, understanding and very straightforward with classwork and exams. There is no reason that anyone should do poorly in his class. Attendance is mandatory, but he makes it worth your while with his great lectures. He is informative and very applicable, PLEASE TAKE HIS CLASS!

Professor Wheeler is one of the best instructors at Mizzou. His lectures are clear and engaging, filled with real-world examples that make the material easy to understand. He genuinely cares about his students, offering extra help and constructive feedback. His passion for teaching and dedication to student success make his classes unforgettable.

Diamond is the greatest professor that I have had at my time at Mizzou. He cares so much about his students and what he is teaching. He is very entertaining and you will never be bored in his classes. I wish I could take every class with him, he is the best!

If you're interested in sales or marketing Prof. Wheeler is a great resource. His lectures are laid-back and entertaining. If you show up and listen it's pretty easy to be successful in his courses. He's also extremely upfront about what you will be tested over and what you'll need to know for the exam. You won't regret taking a class with him.

This professor is hands down my favorite professor I have ever had. He truly cares about his students and wants us to succeed in life and school. He makes class SO fun that you will want to be there! Only 2 exams and he goes over each question before the exam.
This guys is the best. He knows what hes talking about and knows how to make it fun. He provides a comfortable atmosphere that helps students engage. Would take his class again for sure.

Literally the best teacher I have had in my 4 years at school. Not even because his classes are not the most difficult, but because he has such a positive attitude and loves to share real life experiences that correlate to the material. This man is incredible and if I could take every class with him, I would. Take his class!

nicest professor I've ever had. has real world experience in the insurance industry and uses relevant examples and stories in class. just keep up with assignments and discussion posts and you will get an A. if you're struggling to keep up don't be afraid to reach out to him. he's very understanding and will help you get a good grade.
Two easy assignments a week, easy tests - only 3 including the final, good lecturer
She is really sweet and I enjoyed her as a person a lot but her class was ver difficult and hard to follow. It also tended to be boring.
This professor was very big on participation, even for an online class. Makes you work super hard, not a lot of time for other classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Tough grader--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Very tough grader. Stingey, even on participation, but definitely willing to help on larger projects such as research papers.

One of the best professors I have had at Mizzou, she has high expectations for work- meaning you have to put forth effort. Class was overall easy 7 reading responses and 4 tests. She really knows her stuff, and is helpful if you are confused, she can also be funny. Work load was perfect, just short stories- take her!!
He is very helpful if you have questions and approachable.

Do NOT take this class. It has been an awful class overall from an insane amount of homework every week to a one-question quiz every class period. Moreover, he offers office hours but it's only essentially a repeat of what he said in class with little to no actual assistance on the course work. Avoid this class if you can.

The material for the class was not that difficult, but half of each exam was material that I had no idea what to do. My class was curved twice and that's the only reason why I got a B+. The lecture videos were by Dustin Belt, which were great, but a TA ran the class. I wish the practice exams had an answer key too.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Ding wants us to learn how to analyze and solve for problems, not plug numbers into equations. She is very enthusiastic and was thorough in explaining the topics. All notes were made online and were extremely helpful. There were quite many assignments (HW and tests). But all hard working were paid off when I saw my final grades.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: All notes are uploaded online and review lectures are held before exams which are extremely helpful. A lot of assignments but they are not hard if you attend every lecture. Example problems are very clear to understand. Hard working is rewarded. The course is intense, thus it is hard to catch up if falling behind.

You'll need to attend the class and do the assignments to do well in the class. She emphasizes on solving problems and a lot of examples are given in class. Extra credits are provided for students. She is always available and willing to help. However, you won't pass the course without knowing the fundamental knowledge.

Gives a lot of homework with no explanation of how to do it. Extremely unfair with partial credit. Worst professor I have ever had at the University of Missouri. Marks off points on your homework but does not hand it back until after the test so you cannot see what you did wrong to correct it. Do anything possible to not take her.

She constantly breezes past examples and doesn't explain herself. She'll assign HW at the last minute and make it due only a day afterwards. You'll have to go to lecture as without it, the notes are entirely useless.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: My grievances: she proves formulas then expects us to apply them with no examples, which is not teaching. She made mistakes nearly every lesson and excused it by claiming it was intentional. This cost me exam points. She also wastes 10–15 minutes setting up and runs over every class. Not a good professor.

didnt lecture until the end of the semester, used borrowed notes, we did super long homework for hours, and exam averages were really low. she was nice, gave some extra credit, but if she'd lecture from the start, it would've helped a lot. nice person, VERY tough class. might be good in calc 1-3, but def wouldnt recommend for differential equations

- weekly if not more hw assignments that take 4+ hrs each
- difficult exams with low averages
- in class notes do not prepare you
- lecture style consists of group work and then students presenting the work on the board (dont take if you like actual lectures). After answer was provided we would just move on
- final project on top of final exam

Dr. Ghoreishi is an amazing professor. She truly cares about her students. We were offered over 30 points of extra credit throughout the semester. She cares more about the students actually learning the material than the grades received on exams. Go to her office hours if you're feeling lost!! She is incredibly kind and caring.

I took calc 3 last semester with Dorsa. She was an amazing teacher, caring, tough and inspirational. I always looked at math as course I have to memorize the formulas and pass but after I took calculus with Dorsa, I got a totally different concept from a math class. I loved her classes! if you every get a chance, take a course with her.

I took calculus 3 with Ms. Dorsa. She is by far the best math teacher I have had in college. The class is hard but she makes it so easy to understand. She loves math and it projects on her lectures. I was lucky to have her for Calc 3!!

Somehow makes a 3 credit hour class take more time to complete all of the work and study effectively for than the 5 credit hour and comparatively harder calculus 2 class before it. Does not explain everything you will need during class, so be ready to teach some material to yourself. Also gives the most useless "group work study guide" ever.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dorsa is a great teacher. She has a good understanding of the material and explains to us both the mathematical, formulaic components of what we were learning along with the three-dimensional, applicable part of the course. Slides are always good to have for studying outside of class. If you get a chance, take Calc 3 with her.

Dorsa always was very nice and tried to connect with the students. She explains things well. This was a challenging class for me. I liked that we had access to slides but most of the times I didn't have enough time to go over all the slides. Dorsa has an excellent teaching style. I would definitely recommend her Calc III class.

Calc III was just as hard as Calc II for me and Calc III is only 3 credit hours compared 5. I thought it was really annoying the work load was the same but I received less credit hours. Dorsa is a really cool and nice person. It was her first semester teaching Calc III my semester so she didn't explain things the best all the time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dorsa is super sweet and cares about her students. Her tests are not easy, but they are also not impossible. Shes new to teaching so her explanations could use improvement. Dorsa also uses a lot of slides. The class was much better towards the end when she wrote out examples on the board. Shes a nice teacher and she helped me learn the subject.

Dorsa is the best math teacher I have ever had. She presents organized lectures and she is always prepared. She is always in a good mood when she comes to class. I took calc 3 before and Dorsa helped me actually understand the material this tie and I could do much better in her class. I just love her!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dorsa is a great teacher. Calc III is a hard class and she made it very clear for us. She used slides to teach each section and we had access to the slides after class. Dorsa is extremely knowledgable and eager to help us when possible. I would definitely recommend taking Calc III with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I would not recommend taking Calc 3 with Dorsa. She is a nice person but really only knows the math she prepares in lecture and quickly forgets. If you go to office hours and ask for help a lot of times she doesn't know the material. All my friends had much easier calc 3 teachers. My semester has been a lot harder than my friends because I had her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Don't trust her appearance. She seems super sweet and kind, but her exams are awful. I got As in both calc I and II, and Dorsa made this class way harder than needed. The exams were extremely challenging and not straight forward. She just clicks through slides quickly. She isn't knowledgable of material and has to prepare for lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I had taken Calc 1 and 2 and got an A+. I took Calc 3 with Dorsa and got a C. Other Calc 3 professors at Mizzou give formula sheets and practice exams just like the actual exam. Dorsa doesn't provide any of these materials. I've always loved math but after this class I dropped my math minor. Whenever I ask hard questions she tries ignore it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dorsa made a difficult class as enjoyable as possible. She was extremely kind and made it apparent that she wanted everyone to do well. I initially planned on having difficulty passing the course, but she made the content easy to understand, and I was never stressed about my grade. If possible, take Calc II with her!

Ms. Ghoreishi made Calculus II feel quite easy. The majority of this class consisted of going through powerpoint slides that were explained clearly and concisely. Dorsa is also a kind person who would often speak to her students as a friend and offer additional explanations when asked. Overall, very enjoyable class. Strong 8 to Light 9 / 10
Very friendly. Always took the time to walk us through tougher concepts and tried to tie new material back into what we had already learned.

Dorsa is a great professor. She knows what she's talking about, explains it well, and really seems to care about the class. Calculus 2 is a difficult class, but if you take the time to do the homework and the review guides Dorsa hands out, you'll do well on the tests.

Dorsa was a great TA. She was always on time and able to answer any questions thrown at her. Very easy to get along with and good at explaining things. She was also a pretty lenient grader and would give points back when deserved. I still say hi to her when I see her on campus because she was that friendly! Very attractive and cute accent
She is si nice and she cares for her students. Always available if you need help. She knows the material so well and she explains everything in the best possible way.
She is a real G
Wasnt bad but she stickler for details. Makes sure you always have something to do every week
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Lectures are all over the place, not much info. Unclear in her directions for assignments. Only provides several links to youtube videos to watch which do not supplement the material that she expects us to know for assignments. 2 quizzes & 2 papers per week. Lots of group work. Horrible communication. Takes 5-7 days respond to your email or text.
Dr. Dreier was extremely organized and quick with grades/feedback. I had her for an 8 week course, so it was very lecture dense, but not overly demanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Probably favorite professor, ever- great teacher. Took the back-to-back 8-week classes, and Prof V-D makes it entirely doable. Entire courses are group-based so it helps to have a good group. You'll have to actually learn to do well, but it's enjoyable. Several assignments each week but it's easy to find your rhythm. Highly, highly recommend.

Had this professor for Philosophy for section 4210. He doesn't make sense at all. Constantly goes on rambles and monologues. He has specific criteria for assignments and says that he didn't ask for it when you specifically follow instructions.

He talks at the class the entire time. When someone asks a question, he interrupts them and doesn't let them finish asking the question. He does not respect students' time and lets us out even 10 minutes late most days. I don't see how he is allowed to teach undergraduates. There is no possible way to retain anything he says during class. Horrible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
Took Dr. Melnyk's "Philosophy of Science" in fall '99. So long ago now that Mizzou's course numbering system has changed, and the original course number, which I think was 300-something, is obsolete, but this RMP page is among the top hits upon Googling his name, so I thought I would chime in: 

Just take a course with him and thank me later...
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Many of the complaints I've heard about Prof. Melnyk are usually due to people not taking his class seriously, rather than any problem on Melnyk's part.  His lectures are dry, but he never goes on tangents unrelated to what he's talking about.  He's very specific and very detailed.  He can be a tough grader but is not the worst I've had.

He's clearly knowledgeable, which leads to him having a tendency to ramble on about tangents that are barely even related to the actual topic of the lecture. He also spends a lot of time going on about the same things over and over again.

The actual class is not difficult as long as you physically show up and complete your homework assignments.

Melnyk's course on logic was interesting. Many are turned off by the less metaphysical and more mathematic nature of the class material, but I found it to be worthwhile. He is slow and unclear during lectures, but he truly does care for his students. He was a favorable grader. Understand that his class focuses on argument validity not ethics.

I took 1200H with Professor Melnyk. If you are a decent writer, and put a little effort forth in the class, you will get an A. Additionally, his curve makes it difficult to get below a B. Overall, he's a good guy even though his lectures are boring, and has a British accent which is fun.

This guy is extremely confusing. If you ask him to clarify, be prepared to be more confused than you were before you asked a question. His readings are incredibly hard to follow. He even tells you that you'll need to read several times, PLUS use a Thesaurus to really understand them. His exams are only Essay questions. He gives no real feedback.
Absolutely excellent. Lectures are extremely clear, and insightful. Discussions were good. Also he's more than helpful with papers if you put in a bit of effort and don't procrastinate.

In one word: BORING. He posts notes on blackboard so when you decide it's just not worth it to show up because you'll fall asleep it's OK to miss. He's an easy grader though and the amount of work is reasonable. If you like philosophy you might do better than I did.

Definitely a difficult teacher, but if you work hard, you learn so much. He's really brilliant. The only negative thing is that sometimes he couldn't understand why we didn't always grasp the material. He's a really nice guy (and British), and he'll always help you, but you have to ask for it. Be prepared to study hard and work for your grade.

This was an honors class. He is VERY knowledgable about what he is talking about, and is willing to help you anytime that you email him or come to his office hours. He does make you work harder, but you come out with a much greater understanding than you had before. I would recommend him if you like challenges and are interested in Philosophy.

I took this class last year, and do not listen to the previous comments.  His class was difficult, and required a fair amount of outside work...but nothing unreasonable.  He was also very helpful in his office hours, and a good guy in general.
DO NOT GET THIS TEACHER. HE IS HORRIBLE, THE TESTS ARE RIDICULOUS, HE IS VERY UNCLEAR IN HIS TEACHING METHODS. ONCE AGAIN: HE IS A TERRIBLE TEACHER IN ALL REGARDS.
No Comments
Very knowledgable, stimulating and entertaining. I would take another class with this professor. Very interesting subjects.

He was awful. weight of attendance is inconsistent. All exams and quizzes are written and grading is vague when you get the exams back. He seems confused about what he is talking about during lectures. No set dates for exams or quizzes other than the final (the syllabus literally says "around November"). I do not recommend this class.

This has been one of the worst classes I have taken during my time. He doesn't have a schedule laid out for the class, does not grade in an efficient manner, very monotone during his lectures and virtually made me fall asleep the entire time during class. 0/10 would not take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Literally the worst professor I have ever had. He doesn't actually care about the students and doesn't care about what he is teaching. He never sent out a schedule for exams/quizzes, so no one was ever prepared. He was so monotoned and this was the most unorganized course I tried taking.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Attendance is needed and gives bland lectures that are hard to get through. The class is exam-heavy, with the final exam being worth 35% of your grade! He expects you to do hours of reading every week and give specific details to his satisfaction on exams. Expects you to know loads of material and he asks random questions that are written in only.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Slow grader, slow lectures, hard to find the movies anywhere for Brazilian Cinema class. If you miss a screening you will not find the movie anywhere else. He means well, he's super knowledgeable, but he's rather dry. Especially awkward when he asks us to participate and everyone's spaced out. Interesting/important class, but a hard one to take.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prof. Draper is awesome fr. He is so insanely patient with students and is more than happy to help explain concepts and answer ANY of your questions. Attending class is extremely helpful as he walks you step-by-step through everything but the textbook and online homework/videos can get you through on their own. Low-stress environment for sure.

Honestly worst class I have taken all semester. Spanish Civilization is a decently interesting topic, especially if you have a passion for the area; HOWEVER, he is so dry and boring that I practically feel asleep. His ENTIRE grade was from five quizzes and three tests that were heavily essay based. NEVER received a cumulative grade or a schedule
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dont take a class with this guy ever. Content is so boring and he somehow makes it worse. Almost impossible to sit through the lectures and gives you no time or information before the exams to prepare.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He really knows a lot about his subject, but he is incredibly boring. He tries to encourage class discussion but the class is none-to-interested.  There are lengthy exams - and he is very strict on the deadline - the papers are due at 11:59 and I submitted mine at 12:02 and he counted it as late!

Nice guy but way too serious. He never cracks a joke and barely smiles. His lectures are so monotonous and deadpan. Drags on about the same topic for weeks before moving on. Constantly encouraging class discussion, and will call on you if you don't participate. On the plus, he's willing to help, and has really organized PowerPoint notes.

Lectures are very boring. Content can be interesting, but it repeated itself so much it got old. Majority of grade was papers, that were graded very easily. Final was not fun (short answer, essays, IDs, etc.). I began to dread going to class about a month in. The readings were EXTREMELY long & half weren't needed. Bad at facilitating discussion.

The professor really emphasizes to read the book for the exams and to come to class. The lectures don't help because he rants about a bunch of stuff that will definitely go over your head. He asks the class a question and waits 30 seconds to a minute for a response when the question isn't even something he has fully taught the class yet.Theres more
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Not a fan of this class. Lectures were a lil boring, we were assigned LOTS of homework, everything was graded very harshly, report revision comments felt rather unprofessional and sometimes overly rude, and made it a point to give no frame of reference for what was to be on tests. "If you went to class you'll be fine" was not necessarily true lol
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I got an A in the class, but don't take that as a sign that the course was easy, as I scored very near the top score on every major assignment, usually around 20% above the exam/ essay average. The professor is arrogant and snarky when you ask him questions and hides any information about upcoming exams. Generally rude and harsh. TAKE ANYONE ELSE!

Started off enjoying this class. Halfway through the semester, I dread this class. First exam was basically a toss up, had no idea what to prepare for, got lucky and passed with a C. An insane amount of assignments. Extremely tough grader. His email responses are rude and unprofessional. Unsure if I'll pass the class now. I'm extremely frustrated.

Dr. Winholtz is a wonderful 2200W materials professor who is very passionate and detailed in his lectures of material. While the class may be a bit more difficult than some, you will know the material in depth by the end of the course. Recommend for anyone interested in materials path of MAE.
He grades tough, there is a ton of homework during class and outside of class
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Great teacher highly recommend!

Great guy, you'll need to delve into the class to do well, but if you continuously ask how to better your reports and presentations he will give you good tips. Funny, and makes fun of stupid questions just an overall good teacher who knows what he is doing. One downside is the textbook is absolute garbage.

Possibly the worst professor in the MAE department. Does not teach anything relevant in the lectures, the book he uses is completely useless, and grades the group projects harder than anyone else I've ever had before. If there is another professor teaching this course, take them instead. Winholtz will ruin your GPA.
He is a good teacher overall. Doing his best during class and in his office hours. Some of his questions are kind of difficult. To do well in his course, read the book and notes.

Send him outta here. It was like dealing with a depressive personality trying to teach a course that interfered with learning objectives that weren't well planed to begin with. Spent too much time on obvious derivations when more discussion could be used about mechanics, problem solving, and applications to industry.

Winholtz was not an effective teacher.  It seemed as if he expected us to already know about Engineering Materials before we even started class so he didn't explain what he was teaching.  When asked a question, he would usually give a half-hearted answer that kind of answered the question but not entirely.  Overall,he was a very poor teacher.
Terrible teacher and communicator.
Terrible teacher and communicator. Seems to have a lack of knowledge of material. He never answers question, only beats around the bush.
TERRIBLE

This professor appeared to have a lackluster command of kinematics plus utilized his atrocious writing skills on the examinations given to eager to learn engineering students.  Just imagine he actually is the professor for the writing intensive course MAE 3200!  He made a mockery of MAE with his poor attitude and below par subject knowledge.

horrible horrible horrible. made me not want to learn, even though I was extremely interested in the subject prior to stepping into his class. I hope I never see him again.  ruined two 4.0 cumulative GPAs that I know of. lacks intelligence and common sense. brings mizzou's rep down that they keep someone this bad in the engineering program.
attend and participate in lecture - and be sure to READ THE BOOK.  the whole class is based off the book.  Great teacher and communicator.

Winholtz is a good lecturer, but to really do well on the exams in this class you need to attend everyday and take the notes.  The few times I went to his office he viewed it seemed as if I was interrupting him and there wasn't much help.  Averages on the tests were pretty low, but the labs and homeworks really boosted people's grades.

very good teacher overall. great note giver as well as his explinations of the subject matter are wonderfully specific.  He is sarcastic. Has been known not to answer your question(he will beat areound the bush).  He rarely looks at the class when teaches(looks at the ground).  He doesn't have office hours. Doesn't like unexpected visits.(make app)

The lectures are really boring. Reads off notes when giving them, without much class participation. Course should be called "Founding and History of the American Colonization Society" because that's what 50% of the lectures are on. Graded almost entirely by 2 assignments, with no real feedback in between, on topics that are barely covered in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: History 1100 was an easy class. Lectures were heavy, but had nothing to do with your grade. The grades in this class consisted of 2 essays and weekly readings and responses. You could get an A in this class without going to a single lecture. Discussions are graded by attendance as well as the weekly readings and responses.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I have him currently. He is a very nice person, but, he goes on LONG rants. A lot of what he teaches is not relevant to any of the assignments he gives. His assignments are odd POVs from made-up historical characters and you will have no idea how he is going to grade your paper. He gives massive readings and some of it is difficult to understand.
The best man alive. Definitely take his class, especially if you love law or the Constitution. As long as you listen to the lectures, you'll do well.

I took this class in fall of 2020 and it was fully online due to COVID-19. I was initially nervous but Dr. Dyer's podcast lectures (I listened on Apple podcasts) were really well done. There were no exams for this online class, but weekly quizzes and 3 papers. You need to be good at writing about the Constitution. Overall a great professor.

Very intelligent professor and does a great job of portraying topics in a non-partisan way. Course content is interesting and relevant. Tests are challenging but doable and fair. Overall, great option for a poli sci professor.
Dyer is a good guy. Show up to lecture, take notes, and use the study guide.

Final is 50% of grade. Doesn't activate canvas grading page. Syllabus doesn't have dates and doesn't use slides or powerpoint to stay on topic. Gets off topic easily & spends most of class talking with over-eager students about concepts loosely related to topic. Learned more from the website Oyez & txtbook, but have to go to class for pop quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Not a loud lecturer, so sit up front. Gives study guides for Exams. The exams are pretty easy, but they lazily do not hand back your exam in class, you have to go to the edge of campus during office hours to get it. When you read the textbook just note the concepts that are brought up. Don't ever worry about reading the "Comparative Perspectives"

Decent lecturer, definitely knows his stuff and keeps you engaged mostly. 2 exams are very easy. The essay was kind of tough, but doable and has a rewrite. Doesn't take attendance but does 10 pop quizzes. Easy if you show up and drops the lowest one.
Amazing teacher and one of my favorite classes so far. He presents the material in a very organized and interesting way and really cares about his students' learning.

He is a great teacher that keeps students interested with his lectures. The fact that he is super hot helps most people pay attention. He listens to everyone's opinions and always plays devil's advocate so you have no idea which way he leans. The grading is a little harsh but there are only two tests and a ten page paper.

I've had Dyer twice, and he's been my favorite professor so far. His lectures are very interesting and keep you engaged. He's very nice and willing to help. He does like pop quizzes - so don't miss class (not that you should anyway, great lectures). No surprises on the test- gives you exact study guide.

I really enjoyed going to this class. I thought the lectures were interesting and made the reading much easier to understand. The homework was light and study guides were provided for the tests--no surprises.
Great teacher. So long as you read the book and attend lectures (which I found to be interesting), you should be fine. He also kept his political affiliation private, which I thought was good.

I took the honors course, it was kind of hard. He's a good teacher, pretty good humored. Definitely hard to stay awake at 8am though. I didn't read the book at all and did okay. Tests were not easy, make sure you're there for any pop quizzes!!
He's a great professor and a great guy, has a good sense of humor and an interest in student success. Honors section is a little hard, reading the textbook is important!!
He is an easy teacher. You have to go to class because he has pop quizzes, but if you listen in class they are super easy. Tests come straight from the lecture and a little from the book. Easy A.

He was really tough I thought. He uses a lot of videos and media in his class which I enjoyed but you cannot miss a single class. There was 7 pop quizzes which were pretty easy if you went to class. Tests were pretty tough.
He's awesome!

He is awesome., tests are easy just study a week before. he doesn't post lectures online so go to class, sometimes its interesting. The study guides are really helpful and go with the test almost perfectly. GOOD LUCK

He's really knowledgable about what he is teaching. He's easy to follow if you're interested in French. This class was review for me, so there were times when it got really boring. But otherwise, he usually gives you time to work on homework. Lectures take up all 50 minutes 99% of the time. Very helpful if questions are asked. Book needed for HW.

I found him to be a harder teacher to follow when it came to constructive learning. As smart as he is, he's likes to teach through the book and doesn't show the class examples. He does have office hours but during them, you feel discouraged and a little insulted. It's hard to talk to him when he expects you to already know the answer.
His class isn't too hard, however, you'll be doing a lot of studying by yourself. He gets very off topic. He sometimes curves grades, which is nice. Overall, not bad.
Professor was very helpful.  French is tough but he makes it easy on you by submitting homework as many times as you want until you get a 100% and he gives you last years exams to look at.
After loving French 1, this class was awful.  Matt can't stay on topic, minimal direction...in one word: painful.

Love this guy. Very helpful outside of class and genuinely wants to see his students succeed. You don't even need to go to every class just make sure to review his content on Canvas before the exam. I would do it all the night before and I was just fine. One of the best professors at Mizzou hands down.

Dr. Rudy is great! Lectures were exactly what you needed to know for exams. Class was in-person, but you had the option to complete the entire course online with the exception of tests. Tests were extremely easy and almost always curved so you got extra points. Extremely nice and understanding professor.
I took HDFS 2300, and the lectures were easy to understand, and tests were a little hard, so be ready to stud,y but otherwise he is a super sweet professor who genuinely cares about his students.
Super easy class. Would recommend taking this class if possible.

He was good so long as his attendance remains to be not required because he is really bad at lecturing. He talks slow, quiet, dull, and stutters between most of his words. There are at least 4 assignments worth 3 points or less due/week. Everything except "Term Tests" (exams) are online which is nice, and the class content was interesting at least.

He is so kind and cares to teach the information. He uploads all of his lectures for the week so you can either attend class or do it online. I preferred doing both in case he added anything in person. All together, very sweet professor and absolutely would take again.

Dr. Rudy was great. I took the class in person but only went to class for the tests. I did watch every lecture posted, which is why I secured the grade I did. Not a huge time commitment, and it's pretty interesting information. Study your notes for the tests and you will have no problem!

You can tell how much Professor Rudy truly cares about the information he is teaching; class can be done fully online. He is a lovely man who works with students to ensure they understand class lectures and expectations. I would recommend this class to anyone due to the versatile subjectmatter and content!!!

He had all his class content online so you only had to come in for tests. I ended his class with a 105% because he curved all the tests and dropped a bunch of assignments at the end of the semester. If you do the work, you're ready for the test. One of the easiest classes I have taken, the content of class is great too!

Rudy is an absolute angel to the whole world. While he is a bad lecture giver, he grades everything fair and justly. The discussion boards are something you can finish very fast and easy, along with his quizzes. A lot of the material on tests are common sense questions except the vocabulary part BUT if you do the quizzes you can easily understand.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Rudy is honestly the best professor I've ever had. He genuinely wants every single one of his students to succeed. This class can be taken in person or online and honestly I really enjoyed it online. As long as you actually watch the lectures, you will have absolutely no problem passing.

Professor Rudy is one of the best! Very kind and always so thoughtful of his students; Lectures are posted online and very easy to access. I constantly felt very well prepared for the exams and always had my grade back within a week or less. Great class.

Professor Rudy is one of the most nice and caring professors that I have. He is always willing to help other students and better their grades. His tests are easy as long as you study and pay attention in class. I can tell he is very passionate about what he teaches his students! This class was very interesting I recommend!

Rudy is the most boring professor I have ever had. He sets up the class so you only have to come in for tests, which was disappointing for an in-person class. He talks very slowly, I only got by through speeding his lectures to 2.3x. The content is interesting, but he is a bad teacher. I got an A while doing many assignments completely hammered.
As long as you take notes your ace it.

Professor Rudy is one of my favorite professors at the university. His exam questions are similar (not word for word) to those in the quiz, which he provides every possible question to. There is a bit of extra credit, not too much, but there are opportunities to get some.

Very few tests so make sure you study for them because they will make a big impact on your grade. Professor Rudy tends to give boring monotone lectures, but attendance isn't required and he's good about helping students so I feel like it's worth it. You have two quizzes, a discussion, and a quick questionnaire each week and he drops lowest grades.

Save your self and do not take this class. During lectures he talks about nothing of importance and shows power point slides that have like two sentences on them.  No matter how long you study for the exams nothing from the study guide will be on the test.The exams will contain material we haven't even touched on yet.

This class was really interesting and honestly super easy. Prof. Rudy was very helpful when needing to make up assignments. Attendance was not mandatory and the assignments were easy. You can tell that he enjoys the topics so that made it more interesting.

This was probably one of the easiest classes I have taken. He has about 4 lectures, 2 quizzes, and 1 discussion post due every single week. Quizzes are easy and exactly from the lectures, and he gives you all the possible questions for each quiz. They're 5 questions, worth .5 points per question. Tests are short, easy, and multiple choice
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor with an interesting class! The class can be completed in person or online but I highly recommend going in person. The class work is not much for each week and it is a great class! Highly recommend

This professor is so boring and he is not a good teacher. He always messes up the grades and it's awful. He doesn't specify anything he's actually talking about. Please do not take any of his classes.

I absolutely loved this class. I learned so much and the material was very interesting. This was an online course during COVID-19 and Rudy made it very interesting. I was so glad I decided to take this course. He was always cracking jokes and was honest up front that we wouldn't need the book. He also offered a lot of extra credit. 10/10 recommend.

He was a great professor. You're required to buy a textbook, but I never used mine. Two quizzes a week but you're given the possible questions in advanced. Barely have to do any work, make sure to take notes on lecture videos or study the class learning objectives everyone fills out to do exceedingly well. Interesting class.
