Kind of a monotone voice so lectures can get long, but interesting material and very nice. Class activities and quizzes super easy, and tests should be if you take good notes.

Lots of opportunities for points but tends to be a heavy workload if taken with other busy courses. The exams dont have to be difficult but for some reason can be. Just really focus on the concepts more so than straight facts is my only advice. The professor is funny though, I always enjoy the lectures, and I feel like I learn a lot.
Is very disorganized with grades and will constantly change them at the end of the semester. Posts lectures online, but there are a couple classes that are mandatory at the beginning.

Super easy class! Only showed up for the tests and was fine! He also gives out extra credit if you're struggling. The quizzes are super easy and a lot of the test questions come from the quizzes, which he gives you the answers to in class before taking the quiz. Highly recommend this class with Rudy

Got an A- not going to class except for the first week and watching the lectures the day before. His voice can be boring but speed it up 1.50 on tegrity and its not bad. Forgot to take 7 quizzes but 6 get dropped and they're on quizlet usually
His class is pretty easy. Posts all his lectures online. Never went to class and passed the class fine

Dr. Rudy is a good professor. His class is extremely boring and his PowerPoint slides have little information on them. He does give you extra credit if you do poorly on an exam which is good. I found that going to class was a must for me because his videos were so boring
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Class participation is not mandatory. You can watch the lectures on Tegrity(or the MP4's he posts). The quizzes are online and you get three attempts to get the best score you can. You don't need the textbook, and he gives loads of extra credit opportunities. Just take the notes and you'll get an A no problem.
Class isn't mandatory. Easy A if you watch the lectures on Tegrity and study before the day of the test. Didn't use the textbook.

Easiest class ever!! You never have to go to class unless you have a question on something. He puts all of his lectures on tegrity and has online quizes. Has great study guides for tests which are only 20 questions and there is no final! Overall this class was pretty interesting and can be done at your own pace.

This class was alright, the teacher is so nice though. He is very caring and compassionate and will help you if you need anything. It was relatively easy. Lectures sometimes got boring, as with most classes, but overall it was okay.

Didn't have interactions with Nick directly, but enjoyed the class! Easy assignments, follow the tutorials and you'll get an A. Only complaint was hosting all of the tuts on OneDrive. They took forever to play bc of the slow download speeds which got frustrating after a few weeks. But this was a year ago, so maybe he's changed that..

Probably the nicest professors I've had at MU so far! He actually seems to care about students' learning and is very enthusiastic, funny, and relatable. He's strict about some parts of the class, but projects are easy and he doesn't expect anything too ridiculous. The online course was actually engaging, not just reading powerpoints. Pretty easy A

It won't let me select the actual class I took, 2615, color design. It shouldn't have been a 2000 level course. You have to read nearly a hundred pages and watch hours worth of videos in every single module. There was also way too much groupwork for it being an online class, and it took a while to get grades back from the professor
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Hands down the most fun class for the IT degree. If you're looking for real world and hands on experience, take this class. It's half group projects using a lot of cameras/mics/lights, half listening to Nick talk. The group stuff can be annoying, but most IT classes require it. Nick is pretty funny, he likes to comically complain about the industry
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Amazing teacher, super friendly and approachable to just chat with about anything. He knows his stuff and leads often through example. Sometimes he'll just read slides but often he's trying to actively give first hand experience. Easy and fun class if you just put some effort into it.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Only been in this class for 3 weeks and my opinion might change, but so far it's fantastic. Nick is hilarious and makes class relatable, but he's still serious and really knowledgeable

Nick was an incredible Professor for his first time teaching the class. You definitely have to put work into the homework assignments. But he is always willing to meet one on one and help and meet you where you are at. Hilarious and easy to pay attention too.

Great lecturer and material, but be warned. The group projects are MASSIVE in terms of amount of time needed. I spent weeks of night editing to get them done. But the tradeoff, I gained huge knowledge. A hard class but very valuable for all film/media/tech aficionados.

Nick was the ta for audio video 1. It's an easy class but there is a lot of content. He posts boatloads of tutorials online. Usually happy to bump deadlines by a few hours if you need extra time. Lectures can drag out sometimes but that's just how it goes sometimes. Added bonus: very down to earth
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Duan seems ok. He taught a couple classes and had the TAs teach the rest. This class was so easy to pass, but it felt like a waste of time. The grade is based on a few things: 5 WebGL assignments and a final project. This course doesn't have a ton of content, and the content that it does have is glossed over and poorly taught. Please avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Deep learning is a very important class for any CS student. This class course slides are based on Stanford's CS231n . Grading is based on mid-term and final project. Lectures are good . Exam is easy. Prof Duan will help you form groups for the final project. So,it's killing two birds with one stone. Easy 'A' and you will learn something on the way.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof Duane's class is one of the toughest I took He himself said it The prerequisites were laid out clearly You need top be very very good at Data structures,a bit of Linear Algebra Mat lab and Open CV and Geometry It has only 3 assignments but prepare to sweat a lot He is a generous grader through
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lectures can seem cumbersome at time but Professor Duncan is really nice and you can tell how dedicated she is towards the subject and her students.

Reading quizzes 3 times a week online . In the study guide, she said they would help us on tests. Later, she told us that the quizzes wouldn't be beneficial for helping us study for tests. Hard tests, boring readings and unhelpful reading quizzes. Synagogue visit was fun but i don't see how it helped anyone understand ancient Judaism.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: While there are a lot of papers and quizzes, the course is really effective in teaching the material. Plus she makes the lectures engaging and really engaged with students who ask questions and engage with the topics.
Carrie Duncan is my favorite professor. She is very clear and very helpful. If you want a teacher for a Religious Studies class, then Carrie Duncan is for you!

Professor Duncan was clear at the beginning of class that it would require work and effort to get a good grade. As a professor, she's extremely helpful, wonderfully engaging and always enthusiastic. Couldn't recommend her any more.

Professor Duncan is straight forward and very clear on what she expects from her students. She makes sure to let her students know that her courses require work and are not easy. I took New Testament religion and Old Testament with her and absolutely loved the classes. IF you do the work, IF you read the book, you will do well.
Midterm and Final were ridiculous, two quizzes and a page length paper due each week.  Attendance taken at a very boring lecture.  Interesting material, hard class

Her midterm, and final were ridiculously hard for absolutely no reason.  Took attendance at the most boring lectures ever.  Quizzes twice a week, with a page length paper due at section once a week.  Did debate instead of research paper, which wasn't bad at all, but overall the class sucked!
This is not an easy class: two quizzes and one short paper per week. Mandatory lecture. You do learn a lot about the New Testament from a secular historical perspective though.

This class is a higher level one that is meant to be challenging/tough, but this is the worst class I have ever taken (I've taken grad level courses w/ some very intense teachers). His grading is extremely ambiguous and subjective; seems to change assignment to assignment. I have cried - hysterically - about this class. DON'T TAKE, I'M BEGGING U!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Biomedical ethics is not the easiest of courses. This said, Professor Nelson does a fairly good job of making the course passable by anyone. Thoroughly read the documents he assigns, and put something halfway decent on the two page papers he has you write every week and you'll be fine for the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Don't do it. Don't take this class. Whatever you do, look elsewhere. Comments were unhelpful, grading ambiguous and subjective. The main reason I joined Ratemyprofessors was to warn future students of this professor.
Has to be one of the hardest classes I have ever taken. His grading is completely subjective and feedback is sub-par. Run away.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dustin Nelson is by far the worst professor I have ever had, I passed the class keep in mind its not coming from a place of hate and failure. He gives zero feedback grades with a vendetta and responds to emails a week or more after the assignment is due. he is terrible at best and has an incredible complex and desire to be relevant in the world.

Quizzes are open book, final is not and proctored. Professor knows his stuff. He is a tough grader. Harsh and doesn't work with you to make you understand when responding to something answered incorrectly, he's almost like self righteous in some way. It's a completely different language in itself. Worst experience.

I would like to say that this was the TOUGH class I have ever taken!! Professor was difficult to talk to (via email) he has a higher level of expectations from each essay that you will submit. I have one more class to pass and get my B.B.A AND NOW I'M THINKING OF DROPPING MY MINOR OF HEALTH CARE MGMT. I DIDN'T PASS THIS COURSE! Discouraging!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: This was my first intro to Phil. I thought it was a difficult subject, but Pro. Nelson was great. I didnt take his feedback as rude. I thought he was funny & to the point. He responded promptly to emails & posted grades timely. He gave constructive criticism. Expect reading,  quizzes,  Argument Paper, and Final.

He grades tough and he comes of as rude. Also, you have to email him numerous of times before you get a response. Lastly, he posts grades when he feels like it. I'm so glad to have passed this course, but he had me on the edge all semester!

Makes you write critiques over papers that are nearly impossible to get full credit for. He says he will grade them and give you feed back, however I only received feedback on one critique out of the twelve I did all semester. Doesn't know how to work blackboard, so you never know where you stand in the class. Lectures are boring. Unfair and rude.

All you have to do is read papers, write critiques, and take a couple tests on the papers you've read. If you understand the paper you don't have to go to class, but he does do pop quizzes over the readings every once and a while. He's a great professor and really makes you think.
He is disrespectful to students and the classes are so boring that I can't help falling asleep.
Kind of hard, lots of reading to digest.

The material is hard to understand.  It's very rich and there is a ton of reading.  If you get the material, the tests aren't hard.  He isn't out to trick, as the tests are straightforward, but the hard part is actually understanding the plethora of material.

Well, that was depressing. Part of class is participation, but he constantly answers his own questions. He has you write summarized papers (he said because this is some people's first philosophy course) but goes out of his way to fail you on his mundane tests. His expectations are unreasonable.
Someone seriously ran out of my final threatening to kill herself because it was so hard.  Other than that it was a good course.
horrible
Didn't really have to do all the readings.  As long as you went to class and read the parts he specifically tells you to you should be alright.  Grade is Lab, 2 short answer tests and a few papers.

boring, boring, boring!  you definitley need to go to class and take notes, and pretty much just memorize them!   he isnt the best at explaining clearly and his exams are all essay!   just pray you get an awesome TA!   but yah, the class isnt as bad as you think...the papers in lab are super easy and its not too hard to pull off a solid A or B.
Have trouble sleeping? His lectures are better then Ambien.

His teaching style is quite generic and boring, but he definitely knows his stuff. In order to do well in his class, you HAVE to go to lecture and take thorough notes. His exams correspond with the lectures. Also, the lab helps a lot if you come with questions and need clarification regarding the lecture. Overall, you learn a lot!
He knows what he's talking about, and he's willing to help out his students. Is this clear?

He IS monotone. I realized that right away. And he doesn't help much. He just quotes what we're reading. Like I understand anything that says.... "Aristotle says...." If I have to hear that again I don't know what I'm going to do.
This class was extremely boring. I thought Professor Duarte was nice and willing to help students with questions, but it was hard making myself go and stay awake through the lectures.

I thought ethics would be boring and I was right.  He doesn't look like your sterotypical ethics professor, but teaches like it.  It took all of my energy to stay awake in lecture and listen to his monotone voice, which is why I never went.  Only reason I came out ok was because of my amazing TA.
His tests are very unclear.  He was worthless in the review...it didn't help at all.  You cover an impossible amount of material before the first exam.  Lectures are brutal.  Bring coffee!
Pretty good professor.  Can definitely be monotone at times (always) but uses numerous examples to make certain topics are clear.

The class itself probably wouldnt have been hard if I didnt leave every lecture feeling like everything just sailed over my head.  I wouldn't advise taking this course if you just want an easy credit.
No Comments
Omg, he is the best professor ever!!! Stats was my nightmare, now I'm considering taking more stat classes.

He can teach basic stats to grad-level students in the easiest way. He recaps previous lessons every time before the next class, explains complex concepts in a unique and easy way, and gives detailed feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: LOVE THE GUY!!!! He is an exceptional teacher and would recommend! He made math fun.

Best professor I've ever had. Acted not only as my instructor, but a mentor and friend as well. Is very knowledgeable about Public Health and will inspire you to be a better person. Her class also made me learn a lot more about myself and my values, and I have had personal and professional growth in myself. Do the few easy assignments and it's an A

Best teacher and class I have taken so far at Mizzou :) The classes are all very interesting and it was one class I looked forward to going to! There are no tests and homework is minimal. Just make sure you keep up with discussion posts and don't slack on your project! If you loved the class then I would advise also joining SHAPE :)

Really loved the class. She grades hard but is always willing to help and usually lets you redo the assignment if you are not happy with the grade. There are only three assignments so keep that in mind.

BEST CLASS I'VE EVER TAKEN!!!  I learned so much about advocacy, sexual health, and most importantly, myself.  As a freshman taking the class, she was very helpful with making sure I kept up with my peers.  I was also going through a lot emotionally at the time, and she was incredibly compassionate and helpful.  This class will change your life.
she has high expectations but does everything in her power to help you reach them. the only advice i have is if you want to pass you can't blow off the project!!!

AMAZING teacher! Very knowledgeable on her subjects; she really knows her stuff. Fun class to go to. Don't blow it off, go and PARTICIPATE and you will learn stuff you didn't even realize you wanted to know. The service learning project is a rewarding experience as well. TAKE IT!

This sexual health class was the best class I have ever taken.  I learned more in one class period than my whole year of college.  The teacher is great and there are a bunch of people that come in and talk.  It's not a blow-off, its a service learning project based class.  Well worth it!

Dr Brent's use of SAGrader should be illegal. This MAN asks you to define multiple concepts in every paper (paraphrased obviously), use a direct quote for an example and other bullshit. BUT WITH SAGRADER YOU LITERALLY HAVE TO HAVE THE EXACT SPECIFIC WORDS TO EARN POINTS.This MAN doesn't even GRADE THE PAPERS HIMSELF, you get the grade from SAGrader

horrible class. was not given information about anything. I had to contsantly email with questions. There is not even a canvas page for this class. No idea what was gonna be on exams. Very difficult for a bull shit class.

I first had Professor Brent as a professor my freshman year of college while taking his introduction to sociology course. I enjoyed this class a lot and even decided to minor in sociology. I am now a senior and just got done taking his social psychology course. I HATE writing, but you can rewrite the essays as many times as you need so I liked that

Rather boring lecturer, but very easy to pass. Pro tip: Create a GroupMe to discuss the assignments with people before turning them in, but DON'T COPY! As long as you make sure to have all the required elements for each assignment, you'll be good. But if you cheat and copy exactly, the system WILL catch you and punish you.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: You have to go to class for attendance purposes but the assignments were so easy on SA grader it tells you what you miss and lets you do it til there's nothing left to fix. I got a 98.9 in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Brent's SOC 1000 was an easy A. Online writing assignments can be done as many times as necessary to get the grade you want. Only 3 tests (no comprehensive final) and they're multiple choice. He gives extra credit assignments at the end of the semester. Lectures not mandatory, but he uses iClicker for attendance and questions in class.

Prof. Brent was a great match for me as a freshman taking sociology for the first time. His lectures, while large, were engaging, and he had a good variety when it came to topics, and induced critical thinking in and outside the classroom. I will say, SA Grader can be difficult, but as long as you finish them on time, you will pass for sure.

Decent guy. He makes sociology pretty darn bland, but the information is all good. Not a fan of the reliance on SAgrader -- the tech is just too unreliable. I almost always had to challenge my "wrong" answers. Also: clickers are a scam. Very straightforward lecture class other than that.

Dr. Brent's class was one of my favorites. Even though I'm not a sociology major, I would take another sociology class because of how much I liked this class. He has a deep knowledge and his lectures are amazing! I would 100% recommend this class.
Not the best professor but if you do your SAGrades you will do fine. Go to class to get points, tests can be tricky.

You have to do well on the online assignments. If you do, then it's an easy A. Plus, you can keep submitting them until you get 100% so make sure you do that because the tests are pretty hard. Brent is kinda dull but he's really nice and cares a lot about his students. Also, he gives out a lot of curves and extra credit, which is really nice.

SAGrader should be your main concern throughout this class. He posts his powerpoints online so you do not really have to go to lectures. He takes attendance for participation points, but he tells you on the first day that he provides extra credit to make up for a student choosing not to come to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: he is a G

Extremely boring class, but as long as you do all of the SAGrader assignments you can still pull off an A even with doing very average on the exams. If you go to class you can also get participation points which helps a little.

I did not like first few lectures but once I started doing all my assignments on time, I got very comfortable with the subject matter. I would strongly recommend this class to students who are looking for easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: If you are regular to your class, and do all the assignments, its easy A.

Online 1000 was the only course option that worked with my schedule to earn my Sociology minor -- I wish there had been any other option. The textbook is insanely expensive and poorly written by Brent -- I spend more time distracted by errors than absorbing information. SAGrader doesn't measure your understanding of material, just of technology.

His lectures were very dry and inaccurate most of the time. Was very rude to students that asked questions and uses SA Grader very heavily. Easy A if you get good grades on the SA grader stuff, they just take a long time.

He means well but the class is very boring and it is very easy to zone out. I took SOC 1000 and although he is boring, it was an easy A. The class relies heavily on online assignments which allow unlimited submissions until you get 100%. The exams are challenging but he offers like 10% worth of extra credit at the end of the semester. Easy A/B

He has pretty good and helpful lectures, but it is super easy to zone out, and do other things on your computer. The homework and iClicker reef are easy points. Just try to listen and take notes in class, so you dont have to waste time to learn it later. Go to class for clicker question. Hardest part of the class, it's super easy to get distracted

I took this class online. SAGrader is nice because you get unlimited attempts, but Brent provides no feedback when you challenge the scoring. He just tells you that it's wrong. I definitely recommend attempting to get a 100 on all of the homework, then you won't have to worry much about the exams. Also grading criteria isn't very clear.

The lectures are so boring, but you have to go and answer the clicker questions. Plus, the test questions are taken mostly from lecture. If you do well on the SAgrader hmwk and extra credit, your grade will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very unhelpful teacher and not care about his students concerns. The SAgrader system is ridiculous and cannot accurately grade an essay that you spent hours writing in 5 seconds. It asks for info that is not in the prompt provided and grades definitions wrong even when they are the exact same out of the textbook. Dr Edwards does not seem to care.
Boring class. Easy A.

Boring lectures but easy A if you go to class regularly. Do all the SAGrader assignments which help to make up for the points you will loose in the exams. Make sure you reach out for help. Very helpful professor.
Very helpful professor if you reach out for help. Easy class and easy A. SAGrader helps you boost your grade.
Don't miss his classes as he takes point off . Easy and helpful professor.

lectures are really boring, but if you go to the lecture, you don't have to read the textbook. with a test average of like 70%, i still got an A- in the class bc he offers easy extra credit. homework is online and you get unlimited tries up until the due date. he uses clickers for attendance, but it doesn't matter if you choose the right answers

Lots of pointless homework. Three tests which are not bad if you study the material. Clicker questions are like the tests. A lot of the tests have specific knit picky questions which is annoying. SA grader is used and are annoying, but actually made me read the book and learn the material. Not a fan of Ed, he is boring and rude. A lot of EC though.
Thought it would be an easy course for a humanities Gen Ed. but I really had to work for it. Uses online essay grader which usually has problems with grading. Wouldn't recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Very boring lectures but have clicker points, easy assignments that are on SAGrader, easy A if you go to class and study for your exams

Listening to Brent lecture was my least favorite part of the week. Most days I just watched Netflix on my laptop and only went to class for the clicker points. Lots of essays but it's easy to get an A on them. He also offers extra credit. Average C's on the tests an A's on the essays and get the clicker points and you will get an A.

His lectures are painfully boring and he uses clickers so you have to show up. His tests are surprisingly challenging for a 1000 level class. Overall, Brent seems like a jerk, is insensitive to a student who has disabilities so I would strongly recommend a different professor for soc1000. SA graders are also really unclear and daunting.

This class was online, so there was a lot of using SA Grader. He was very unclear about his expectations for our assignments, and was very rude about answering my questions. The midterm exam was impossible, had to write 11 essays in 2 hours without having the essay questions ahead of time. Once I got SA Grader figured out, it wasn't too bad.

Professor Brent is the absolute worst teacher I've ever had. He and his TAs completely ignore all emails, he has NO office hours, and does not prepare students at all for tests. If I were you I would pick a different teacher for Sociology 1000.

Easy to get an A because homework has unlimited attempts and offers up to 5% extra credit. His lectures are really long and boring and he is very monotone and boring as well. I would recommend taking it with a different professor, his tests are actually more challenging than expected for a 1000 level course.

find a group help each other with the SA graders get 100's on them & do the extra credit you will be fine. some friends even did clicker questions online in bed and never even went to class. if you skim the book & read the notes you will get a decent test  (shoot for a c) also the website  study . com is basically your textbook i ended with a 98.9

The lectures are long and boring, but all of the homework is online and you get unlimited attempts. Show up to class for clicker points, but he gives you more than enough extra credit. I did average on all the test & still got a 96% in the class. EASY A as long as you do the online work. I recommend taking this w/ Brent if you need a GPA booster!

Material is easy and interesting, but the way Brent teaches it makes it hard to pay attention for very long. His lecture notes (which he posts online), are practically the same as what is in his textbook (that he wrote himself).

The lectures could be extremely boring on one day, and very interesting on another day, it honestly varied. He's pretty entertaining sometimes, he's a very nice guy and will help you if you reach out to him. I went to class about 60% of the time and still got an A. I barely used the textbook, he puts everything online.
Super easy--failed two tests and still received an A in the class. Just get 100% on the   SA graders and do the extra credit

The material in his class was really interesting and the commentaries on each chapter were straight to the point and relatable. The essays were pretty easy for a writing intensive class since you can revise them as many times as you want. Be warned, the midterm is excessively hard!!! Make sure you know exactly what you are talking about.
Boring teacher. must know material for test. get the text book. you don't need to go to class, all power points are online. all you need is an A on the SA graders and  at least  Cs on the test.

Attendance is mandatory for the clicker questions which he gives you about 15 seconds for. Basically on your own with the SAgraders. There are questions on the SAgraders about content he hasn't discussed and sometimes isn't even in the book THAT HE WROTE. Be prepared to do a lot of digging through the book and lectures for your homework.

Long boring lectures that will put you to sleep, but you must show up. He has clicker questions that reward attendance points for answering so you have to go to class. Online essays are super easy as long as you put the work into them. Tests are fairly difficult. Requires a lot of studying.
Just awful, class is a joke! Reef polling doesn't work and SA grader is unorganized. Your grade isn't a reflection of your understanding of sociology but of your understanding of technology.

come to class for clicker points. Online assignment on SA Grader can be confusing especially the case studies. But if you do your best on those and get at least a C on the tests you'll pass with an A.

Dr. Brent did not work with me when my iclicker was not working properly. He was very condescending and wouldn't hear me out; even when one of his lectures focused on proper argumentation, which includes acknowledging the other point of view.

This class may be boring, but it is also easy to take!  Just show up everyday, get full points on the SAGrader assignments (which make up the majority of overall grade), and don't bomb the exams below a C average!  By the way, he gives extra credit assignments!  Also approachable for help if you need it!  Best of all, no final exams!

Good luck navigating his pedantic SAgrader assignments--you'll need it, seeing as they make up about 60% of your grade. The rest is made up by 3 exams and attending his lectures, where you'll listen to him monotonously read his powerpoints word-for-word. Oh, and I hope you like being force-fed political propaganda; he seems to think this is polisci
Nice but very boring, only go to lectures to get clicker points because he puts all the slides on blackboard. Do well on SAGrader and you'll be fine

Everyone complains how boring he is, but if you are taking SOC 1000, Brent is the guy you want! The SAGraders (homework assignments) are so easy and you can retake them until you get a perfect score, and if you just do perfect on all of those you only have to average a C on the tests and you will have an A. Easiest class ever, only take him!
One of the best class I have ever taken. Nicest professor who was willing to go outside the classroom to help students.. Thank god! MU has such an amazing professor

The class is fairly easy. I got a perfect on every SA grader assignment. I read the entire book which he wrote himself. I didn't really take notes or pay attention in the lecture because its the same as his book. Book is needed to complete the SA grader assignments. 3 tests; no final. iClicker points. Class is very boring. Offers extra credit.

I took this my first semester here and it will more than likely be the worst class I ever take. He forces you to buy his book that he wrote & it's expensive because it includes a code to an essay website that he created himself. You have to go to class for clicker points. Basically he wants to jip your money, so save it and don't take this class.

Brent goes very fast on his power points , however he posts them online. Clicker points are your participation gradeattendance. Also, the exams can be difficult but don't worry because they are only 30% of your grade. The majority of your grade comes from SAGraders , which are easy and helpful for future assignments.

STAY AWAY FROM HIM!!!! This is the worst class I have ever had. He sucks as a teacher. If it wasn't for clicker points I would have never gone. His lectures are very old and are copy and paste from the book which he wrote. This class is awful, stay away from it.
Supppppppppper boring. The only reason I go to class is because we get participation points via i-clicker. I would'nt take this tacher I had could go back in time.

Very helpful, intelligent and friendly professor I have ever taken class with. Even though his lectures are boring once in a while, he is willing to help students and give enough time on the course materials. Take class with him if you actually want to learn

Boring lectures but have to be there because he uses clickers, SAGrader makes the course an easy A, and the tests are pretty straightforward and he provides study guides. Take it with him if you are willing to do about 2 hours a week of homework. Not bad.

Horrible class. Professor is incredibly boring and the class doesn't help you at all but you still have to go because of his clicker questions. SAGrader assignments aren't bad but they're annoying. His tests are hard because his study guides are poorly written. Interesting course with a horrible teacher. Do not take!

This is honestly the worst class I have every taken. The professor is horrible. His lectures put people to sleep, the work is annoying, and the tests are hard. This class is a waste of time. Find a different professor. Also the extra credit is him trying to get you to buy his other book for the answers.

Horrible horrible class. This class is so boring I never wanted to go but there are clicker points. But when I do go I zone out before he gets to the second slide. Apparently you can get all the information out of the book but the book is Mizzou published and horrible. Homework is a majority of the grade and is super easy though.

If you can't manage an A in this class, you never will. That being said, this class is terribly boring and all of his notes come directly from the book that he wrote which you must use for the class. The online assignments are easy and you can resubmit them until you have a 100. Class is a waste of time but he uses clickers for attendance.

Online assignments are easy.  They are straight out of the book and you can do them as many times as you'd like.  The tests are very hard.  I studied for all three and didn't do well. Still entirely possible to get an A in the class.  Overall very boring.  No final exam, though.

Would go to class to get clicker points, but I would put in my headphones and either read the book or sit on Facebook. I learned a lot more from the book than his lectures. His test are HARD, but since he offers SAGrader, you can still get an A. Just do all the SAGrader's till you get a 100%, and it is a guaranteed A.

lecureare boing, he reads straight off the powerpoint, which corenspondes with exactly what the book said since he wrote it. SAGraders are easy and give you multiple attempts until you get 100% or desired grade. 4 exams and clickers points.

His lectures are boring but if you actually read the textbook [which he wrote himself so you can't sell back :( ], you will do fine on the tests. The homework is graded online via SAGrader, but you get as many attempts at it as you want until you are satisfied with your grade (I got 100% on all of them because you can just keep doing them).

I fall asleep if I'm not on Facebook in that class.  The tests are critical thinking application questions & he only goes over basic stuff in class.  I learned more basic sociology in my 1650 social deviance class. The essay grader just gives you points, no learning involved.  Do not take this class with this teacher.

The SA Grader assignments were somewhat easy (and you get unlimited attempts to boost your grade), but they pretty much required you to copy straight out of the book for the program to recognize it as a valid answer.  Pretty nice guy, pretty easy class if you do the work and pay attention to the lectures.

Professor Brent is a decent teacher, but his hour and a half lectures are super boring. You have to attend for the most part though because he uses clickers to take attendance, even though he doesn't know how to use technology most of the time.
The class itself is super easy, but lectures are boring and he doesn't know how to even use the technology he demands we use.
He is one of the best professor i have ever taken class with. Enthusiastic, helpful and understanding. Be regular to his class, you get lot out of his class.

Introduction to Sociology 1000 was by far the stupidest and most useless class I'd ever taken. Mostly because of the professor, Ed Brent. The class houses at least 400 people, yet he still makes attendance mandatory by electronic sign-in (which he doesn't even know how to use.) He is also Incredibly boring to listen to. I fell asleep every lecture.

Professor was absolutely useless.  I love Sociology, but his Intro to Sociology class is horrible.  SAGrader is horrendous, the clickers are horrible.  I was having trouble with my clicker, and the professor knows nothing about how they work.  Don't take this class.

For Intro into sociology - your book is key. Dont even take notes..bring your book and highlight. All the powerpoints are taken straight from the book. DONT ignore SAgrader..its annoying but helps your grade alot, show up for the clicker and just guess on the questions!! Oh! and on essay grader just make it simple a "quote" the book.

Definitely do not take him for Intro to Sociology. Though the topic is interesting, the teacher was awful. Book was awful, easy grader program was awful, clickers were interesting but obnoxious. If you end up with him, try as hard as you can to switch out! Easy grade, though.

BORING BORING CLASS.  I've never been so bored in my life.  Used a program called essay grader which is horrible.  Used clickers which were almost as horrible as the computer program that grades your essays.  DON'T take this professor for Intro to Sociology.

Very boring class. Professor only reads the powerpoint, which is on blackboard, to you and attendance is graded. The online homework can be frustrating, but easy because you get an unlimited number of submissions. Tests are relatively hard. Homework is majority of grade, though. Don't recommend the class, especially with this teacher.

Extremely boring class. I went to every class. Tests are decently hard because they are so big, but he gives a 5% curve.  Professor doesn't really teach, he pretty much just reads the slides.  Online homework is easy and you get to submit them until you get the grade you want.  I would not recommend this  teacher.   I did not learn anything.

The class is dry, but definitely worth taking to get an easy A and still learn something. He seems like a nice guy, but the lectures weren't too interesting. Just come to class with your clicker and keep doing the assignments until you get 100%. There are unlimited submissions on most of them.

If you do not get an A in this class you will not get an A in any class at Mizzou... it is easy, I did all of the SAGrader assignmetns and got 100 because they are unlimited submitions and worth 60% of your grade as well as the Extra Credit which is 5% added to your final grade... if you do this an A will be guananteed, just don't BOMB the tests!
Easiest Sociology class at Mizzou!.. Yea it's boring but just show up to class with your clicker and you can Facebook all day. Homework is 60% of the grade and its all online.. super easy!!!

The class was really boring, and even though he takes attendance via the clicker, I still skipped almost half the classes and still received an A. But I have to admit he seems like a nice guy. He tries to make the class interesting, but hey, it's basic sociology. How much fun can you make it? Just ace the assignments and you'll be fine.

This is such an easy class, but it is boring beyond belief. He puts all of his lecture notes online, so the textbook is not necessary except for the SAgrader code inside of it. Don't take this class unless you want to be bored out of your mind!
Terribly boring class. If you did not get an A in this class I feel sorry for you. Homework is worth sixty percent of the grade

All of the lecture notes are online and he NEVER deviates from the slides. A  ridiculously easy A, you have unlimited submissions on SA Grader assignments which are 60% of your grade. Despite how easy this course is I would not recommend taking it... Brent is a great guy and clearly knows his stuff, but skip this class and take an upper level...

EXTREMELY boring. Takes attendance with clicker, & all notes are online.  Played Tetris & Facebooked the whole time after clicking in for attendance & lecture questions. Dont take this class if you have Ed, I try to make it through his oring lectures and find myself either falling asleep or wishing that I was dead. He is useless the only reason anyone goes is because we have these stupid clicker questions. If you ever had an interest in any kind of sociology field forget about it due to this horrible class.(teacher

Lecture was really boring. He pretty much just reads you the power point, but you have to go to class since he takes attendance with clickers. His Exams are scantron and weekly assignments are graded by SA grader, a computer program. (SA grader sucks!) He doesn't do****. Everything is graded by a computer. Basically I didn't like him much.

EXTREMELY BORING!! All I do in class is read books and magazines.  It's all slideshows and video clips....no book work at all.  BUT SOOOOO BORING!!!  Avoid this class just because of the risk of dying of boredom.

Take attendance with clickers. I read magazines during class since i had to be there. Posts exact notes online. Homework but not to hard once you figure out SAGrader system. Don't plagerize use "According to the text..." Text is online you have to buy this (no book from book store) Test were difficult but are slightly curved. Do the extra credit!

Lectures are reallyh boring! He posts the notes on webct and thats exactly the lecture. Takes attendance points with 'clickers'. He's fine.  I didn't do well but that wasn't his fault.  The class he teaches is just so boreing.  The book sucked!  I never went to class.
Boring lectures, yes, but he is so nice.
Although some people thought the class was boring, I love the examples, stories and illustrations he used to bring the topics to live and relate them to real life situations
Boring lecture.  Easy class.

reviews.comment: He is the best professor ever, so sweet, and very chill. BEST PROFESSOR AT MIZZOU!!!!!

There are no exams other than the final which can be daunting but there are weekly mcgraw hill assignments that make up the bulk of the overall grade. Miller posts a lot of extra resources in canvas and is easily accessible during office hours and over email.

He is a great lecturer and truly cares about his students' success. He is super easy to have a conversation with and is always willing to talk to you. The readings and homework can be a bit long and repetitive at times, but they are relatively easy.

He is a great professor, and it is very clear that he genuinely cares and is interested in the material he teaches. There are no tests until the 75-question final, which is more difficult than you would expect, but still easy to do well on if you take notes and know them front to back.
he had nothing but mcgraw hill assignments all semester than gave a cumulative final at the end and expected you to do well it was not kind of him to do
Dr. Miller is the best! His class is very interesting and he is a very passionate and caring professor. His class has a lot of busy work, but nothing difficult at all.

Super great class, very caring professor. His lectures were very engaging and I had it at 9:00am! No exams the whole year, but there was a 75 question final which I found pretty hard, so be prepared. If you just do your work its an easy A

He is so amazing and such a good guy, he genuinely cares about his students and cares about your grades. go to his office hours if you miss something hes very understanding and wont ask questions if you miss something! you wont regret taking this class
Fun, genuine prof who makes lectures pretty exciting and shows he cares about all his students.

Amazing teacher, amazing lectures. Lots of extra credit. Very understanding. Cares about his students. Great introductory course for Psych or just as a Gen Ed.

Not much to say other than Dr. Miller was one of the best professors I've ever had.  Very kind hearted, and respectful man.  Doesn't get much better than him.

Honestly the greatest lecturer I've ever had on this campus. He's kind, funny, and extremely knowledgeable in his subject and honesty a joy to have had.

#DennisNation
this class is super easy, just show up! He is amazing

He is such a sweet guy who cares a lot about his students and what he is teaching, and is very considerate/gives extensions when it comes to outside struggles. The only hard thing about the class is that participation is 25% of the grade, so iClicker is very important, and it is lecture heavy so I recommend taking this class later in the morning.

Professor Miller is a great guy and knows a lot about the subject. He makes it easy to stay engaged in lecture as well. The only thing I really struggled with was the attendance policy, attendance is 25% of your grade. I would only recommend this class if you have it later in the morning.

Dr. Miller is a wonderful professor! He cares about every student and wants the best for them. Nothing too difficult about this class. As long as you show up to class and do the homework on time, you should get an A. He makes lectures engaging and relatable, so it is easy to learn.

This class was very easy and Mr. Miller is amazing. He is incredibly kind and cares about his students. There were smart books(about 1 per week) that took about 45 minutes to complete, but everything else was extremely easy. LOVED this class.

Professor Miller is truly one of the Best! If you are reading professor reviews and considering taking this class definitely do so. The class is very interesting and a very light work load/ Show up to lectures, do the work and you will get an A.

Everyone loves Mr. Miller, and there is a reason for that- he is the best! Sweetest guy ever and such a great professor. He is so passionate about psychology, and you can tell he genuinely loves his job and will take any excuse to form bonds with students. Lovely professor!
His lectures are very clear, he makes each lecture easy to listen to, and he genuinly cares about the students taking his class.
Very easy and fun class.

I loved this class! Miller is a really wonderful lecturer and I never felt too lost or confused. Lots of relevant examples and easy to follow lessons. The class structure was laid out really well too, and there are only two exams, midterm and final. As long as you come to class and do the homework, you will get a good grade!

Dennis is a fantastic professor. The class is easy enough to where you don't have to actually learn anything to get an A if you're taking it to fulfill a required credit but he made it so interesting that I wanted to learn and pay attention. The iClickers are annoying but they're free points if you pay attention. I would totally take this again.

One of my favorite professors this year. Class is easy to get an A without actually having to learn anything if you're just fulfilling a credit but he makes it so interesting that you want to learn about the content. Great class; easy, interesting, and would take again for sure!

Dennis is the nicest professor I've ever had! Loved this class, he makes lectures interesting, and he's really willing to work with students to help them succeed. I wish I had more classes to take with him. Genuinely can't say enough good stuff about this guy, and the class is easy if you just show up and do iClicker. 1000/10.

Very good professor, you have to do research studies for points, but very simple and you have whole semester to complete them. He is very understanding and allows for late work. Does take attendance, but if you go to class and finish assignments you should do just fine. Has online midterm and finals as well and no exams other than those.
Very nice professor. Easy class and he's a good teacher with a clear passion for what he's teaching.

Dennis Miller is the nicest professor ever. He cares so much about his job and you can tell. He lets our exams be open note to not stress ourselves out. Attendance is not fully mandatory, I have missed a couple classes and still end with an A+. You do i-clickers in class that count towards attendance. I would take any class again if he taught it.
AMAZING! If you have the choice to take a class with him, DO IT. You will not regret it!

For a few Fridays and Mondays I had to leave campus early and come back late on weekends due to family issues back home. Dr. Miller was completely understanding and allowed me to have opportunities to make up the work I missed for no late points. He is one of the most genuine and amazing professors I've had the privilege of having.
He is hands down the most wholesome and caring professor/teacher I've ever had. He really makes sure his students understand what is going on and succeed.
He is amazing!!! Everyone needs a Dennis miller in their life!!
Professor Miller makes psych super engaging. Attendance is a must, but the easy quizzes and unstuck ai make this a fun, manageable class. Definitely take if you can!

Professor Miller is one of the best professors I've had. He cares about his students, is passionate about the course material, and encourages his students to participate in research on campus. I'm not sure what else you can want from a professor.
One word: amazing.

The Man. The Myth. The LEGEND. We all love Dennis Miller for a good reason. He is one of the best professors that you'll ever have. very passionate about psych, just very boring and not engaging. Has IClicker so you must go to class, if you miss one day your grade will take a big hit. No exams though which is very nice. Prof. Miller was great fun! He made a huge lecture still feel

He is so funny and makes psychology so interesting! As long as you show up and do the homework this will be a fun easy class. If it's for your major I'm sure it would be the perfect intro! He is also very easy to contact and SUPER friendly!

Dennis Miller is a professor who wants his students to pass and learn. 35% of your grade is based on attendance and random "clicker" questions however the questions are very easy if you were paying half attention to the lecture. He made psychology fun.
Awesome professor, probably the best on campus! Just show up to class to get the points from iclicker. Homework on inquizitive and quizzes every chapter.
Interesting lectures. Just go to class and you will be fine.
Dennis Miller is the best professor ever, take his class if you want an easy gen ed requirement!! Just show up to class and you will get an A!

Dennis Miller is the most fun, caring, supportive professor ever. He genuinely cares about his students and continuously puts them first even admist his own personal/family emergencies. He makes his lectures interactive with questions and videos and always sneaks in fun analogies.

Dennis was such a nice and sweet guy and I loved taking his class. He was clear about deadlines and what was expected and was very charismatic and easy to follow. Everyone loved dennis. I;m gonna miss him

Dennis Miller is truly one of the best professors you will ever have. You can see how much he genuinely cares for his students, and how much he wants you to succeed. He uses iClicker, so you do have to show up to class, but if you're paying attention they're super easy questions. The quizzes are all online, and he gives a full week to do them!

It's super obvious that Dennis Miller cares about the success of students! Sends out emails encouraging good work, does take graded iClicker questions for attendance but they're easy if you pay attention. He always has lots of great examples to help you understand, and the required research participation is a great way to help out other students!

Dennis Miller is the man. His lectures were so awesome that he inspired me to minor in psychological sciences! Dr. Miller is one of the best professors on campus, he truly cares about the success and health of his students and has a very simple yet informative class. i love Dennis miller he is my favorite professor from my freshman year, i can tell that he really loves the material that he teaches and he is always excited to teach.

love dennis. take a class with him. now.
