Great professor, managed a huge lecture hall very easily. Rewarded those who stayed all of class and participated. Didn't love the homework platform but that didn't affect my grade too much.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Moore is an amazing organic chemistry professor. I have taken CHEM 2100 and CHEM 2110 with Dr. Moore and she is able to simplify one of the hardest college courses in the country so that students are easily able to pass her exams. Exams are all multiple choice, lowest exam dropped, lots of extra credit available, iClicker attendance is taken.

This review is for Organic Chemistry 1 (A) and Organic Chemistry (B+). Are the classes hard? Yes, but that's to be expected. Professor Moore has been one of my favorite professors so far, and she made a notably difficult course more bearable. Stay on top of the homework, review the online textbook, and go over the practice tests before the exams!!

I'm an academic weapon and secured the bag - A. The class is good but you have to actually do stuff. Go to class. Do the homework. Study. It's not rocket science - it's freshman chem. Off to orgo we go!
It's a hard class but she does what she can to make it reasonable. I'll take again for organic.

This was a difficult class for me. I would spend 10+ hours a week in tutoring and it barely paid off. The homework program she uses did not help me learn and it was difficult to use. Her lectures were boring and hard to follow along with. She goes on rants about things that don't pertain to the class and would sometimes come off as condescending.

I honestly did not enjoy this class at all this semester. She is generous in her grading, but the lectures were hard to listen and follow along to. She was known for doing sneaky things like stopping the recording and giving hints to students for the exam. She also said snarky things sometimes, so overall I wouldn't take her again personally.

I'm enjoying Dr. Moore for chem. I had monotone robots for everything last semester, so it's nice to have an actual human for a change. Dr. Moore truly wants us to succeed and she doesn't think less of us as students if we don't do well. She recognizes that it's not easy and that we all learn differently. 10/10 (would recommend.)

Dr. Moore is the best ever especially after having Keller last semester. She makes chemistry accessible and offers tons of resources for practicing. Her lectures aren't boring and the labs go along with the lectures. Multiple choice tests every 3 weeks, which are totally manageable as long as you know the material. Uses iClicker for attendance

Dr. Moore knows that she teaches a difficult class and doesn't make it harder than it has to be. If you just go to the lecture and don't read the textbook you will likely be confused. Dr. Moore hits the high points and does so quickly as there is a lot of material to cover. Most often she will tell you EXACTLY what you need to study for the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: While organic chemistry is a tough topic, Dr. Moore is an amazing professor and makes it much easier. She doesn't put tricks on her exams, is a very fair grader, and cares about her students doing well. I did have to read the textbook for this class to understand the material, but part of orgo is just practicing so it wasn't unexpected.

Dr. Moore is the absolute best professor I have ever had the pleasure of learning from during my time at Mizzou. Not only are her lectures straightforward and easy to follow along with, but she also really cares about teaching and making sure her students are successful in one of the most difficult classes ever. She is absolutely incredible!

Professor Moore was a great teacher for organic chemistry. You hear a lot about people failing organic chemistry. She makes sure we have homework and extra credit assignments to help with grades. If you study with a group, go to office hours, and do the homework you will pass the class.

On the first day Dr. Moore said that she will never think less of you as a person if you are failing her class. She is very fair with grades and has definitely made Organic Chemistry easier to learn. I definitely recommend her class!

She is so helpful at office hours and understands that not everyone gets organic chem the way that she does. She is so validating. There is a drop test, so if you do bad on your first test like I did, don't freak out too much. DO THE HOMEWORK and DO THE PRACTICE EXAMS they help sooo sooo much.

Organic chemistry is not easy but you can tell that she is passionate about the topic and wants students to succeed. She is very approachable outside of class, unlike many other chemistry professors. 10/10 would recommend it!

Dr. Moore is easily one of the best professors I have ever had throughout college. Organic chemistry is not easy, but she makes it fun and enjoyable. She would go over things that the majority of the class struggled with which many professors in college do not do. Her tests were challenging, but not extremely tough. I would 10/10 recommend Dr Moore

It is a blessing to have Professor Moore for organic. She's approachable, laid-back, and well spoken. She doesn't try to trick anyone on the tests; she genuinely wants to see us succeed. For a course that carries such a bad reputation, she makes it enjoyable. One of my favorite classes this semester.
Best professor I have had at Mizzou so far in regards to class expectation and structure. Make sure you understand your homework sections and her practice exam for each test and you will do well.

Dr. Moore is so intentional with everything she does. Her homework and classwork are meaningful and prepare you for all tests. Her work is posted online which makes the class and material so much more accessible. Her respect for all students and her intentional efforts to create an equitable learning environment do not go unnoticed.

Dr. Moore is the first professor that I've had that actually cares. Cares about the material, the students, our understanding, classroom equity, etc. She doesn't look down on people for not understanding and recognizes that it's a hard class. She should be the only one to ever teach orgo here.

I really like Ellen Moore for my organic chem professor and she makes the topic easy and understandable. She is one of the newest teachers here and her first test average was 80. She gives homework but it correlates with the exam along with the exam reviews as well. You don't have to show up for her class because she post it online too. She's great

This is the professor you want for organic chemistry. If you go to class and do the homework you should be able to do well in this class. Tests are over expected material and you are able to drop the lowest test grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Katie was one of the best professors I had at Mizzou, she is a great person, really cares about her students. I only heard good things and they were all true. many small assignments throughout the week, all clearly defined. Class content very relevant. The exams were manageable. You complete Google Analytics cert. Really enjoyed this class!

Katie is the golden example of what a professor should be. She is always in a great mood and makes the material incredibly interesting and easy to digest. I would take her for every marketing class if I could.

MRKTNG 4201:

The nicest teacher. She is great to talk to, seriously so nice and helpful if you need it. This class specifically is great and you should take it. It isn't super hard and it is very fun and interactive. Sometimes she'll have odd guest speakers or make u play team bonding games. But if you're positive & open-minded you'll love her.
Fantastic professor. You can tell she really cares about students learning and is willing to help wherever needed. The content is useful and she is great at teaching students!

please for the sake of your mental health take Katie Essing for marketing 3000 over Joel Poor. took her class over the summer whilst at an internship across the country and was still able to manage everything and understand concepts well. fantastic professor.
So nice and actually cares about her students. Also very understanding of any problems or issues.

Prof. Essing did amazing at formatting the summer section for mrk3000. The workload was maybe heavy to some, however I think it prepared me for the exams well. There were only 3 discussions on interesting topics. She cares about her students and gives them the best experience in class that she can! I will be taking her other marketing classes!

My favorite professor thus far at Mizzou. Katie is filled with compassion and is always ready to help out. She replies to her emails at rapid speed. Her class is average difficulty, the discussions were annoying but that goes for any course. Genuinely an angel on earth.
Great instructor and always prepared. Provides feedback very quickly Available for extra help upon request. There is a lot of work but it is beneficial to the course. I would take it again.

There are way too many assignments in this class - quizzes, labs, group projects, reading and exams. The exams are pretty easy, if you prepare, but the study guides can be up to 80+ pages. Instead of focusing on important concepts, its really a know everything class since the exams ask the most ridiculous questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Essing is a very caring professor and enthusiastic during every class. However, the exams were difficult for no reason at all. They were a combination of short answers, fill in blanks and multiple choice, and they were so specific that it felt like a memorization test. Read the book and take the pre quizzes!

Katie is the BEST! I had her for digital marketing and her lectures were engaging and I actually enjoyed the semester project. Study for the tests and youll be okay. She has so much knowledge and genuinely cares and wants you to do well. If you need emphasis support for marketing I would take anything she teaches.

Great professor and a fun class. I had her for digital marketing and she is really outgoing and bubbly. The lectures are interesting and discussion- based. You don't really have to speak during class but it is nice to hear feedback from peers. Would highly recommend if you are a Marketing major or need emphasis support.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Best Professor I have had at Mizzou. Takes time to get to know you, and really cares about your performance. Would highly recommend taking her course.

I have loved my time so far in Katie's class. She is a very caring professor that takes the time to get to know her students and talk to them about their life. Her lectures are always interesting and there really isn't too much homework. I would highly recommend her class.
Go to class, he has random and weekly quizzes. If you actually try on the HW, the quizzes aren't bad at all. He grades pretty harshly, but the tests aren't that hard overall; know the material.
Stay away hes not a good professor. Gpa distribution is a 2.3-2.4 every year.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Rivera is an impossible teacher. He speaks so fast during lecture that you cannot keep up with him. He also grades so harshly on the exams that if you aren't 100% confident in the question, don't waste your time. Its not a for sure thing but its possible that this class will stop me from graduation (I have all A's in my core department classes).
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Easily the worst professor I have ever had. Homework is not helpful and is incredibly long. For ENGR 2100 my grade was severely dropped due to missing few days with announced quizzes that had 50% averages anyways. Appears as though he finds joy in punishing class when attendance is low. Materials are not helpful. Take online section if available.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: He is the professor that if you show that you want to learn the material, he will give you the benefit of the doubt. expect once a week HW's on mastering (sucked). overall if you show that you care, he will give you the grade that you want/need
Great Professor, hes really passionate about what he is teaching and the course material is pretty easy as long as you attend all the lectures and are actually paying attention. Would reccomend!

Dr. Sandvol was a fantastic professor. I am not big on science, but would actually find myself really intrigued during lecture. He explained concepts well as was willing to answer questions and explain things again when people were confused. My TA was generally unhelpful though and the labs were difficult.

Eric is a very good professor, as in he is very passionate about geology and teaching in general. Geology in my opinion is not the most interesting subject, but Eric makes it probably about as entertaining as it can be. Labs can be difficult if you do not have a good TA, especially the lab quizzes. I highly recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Eric is one of the nicest and most enthusiastic teachers I've ever had. His lectures are well done and he tells you everything you need to know multiple times. The tests are all pretty easy, even if you don't pay attention in class. He uses good examples to help you understand the topics and is always ready to help. Some labs can be difficult.

Dr. Sandvol is very nice but the class can be tough. Avoid missing too many classes because all test information is from lectures and textbook. Some information is only available or clear in lecture itself.  Studying can be tough but going to review sessions is very helpful and he appreciates people who ask questions. Lab depends on who the TA is.

You don't have to go to class since the full slideshows are on canvas, but he makes comments during lecture that are hard to get if you don't show up to class. He's a funny guy and just asks for respect and quiet while he is lecturing. You have little quizzes as a check-up that are always on the test.
Good class.

Professor Sandvol's class isn't extremely easy. You have to show up to class, pay attention, take really good notes to pass. Without showing up to class, you will have no idea what is going on. He is very passionate about geology which I think makes it easier to pay attention. I did pretty bad in the lab, but I did well on the quizzes and tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This is the type of class where what you put in is what you get out. If you never show up to lectures (which a lot of people do) you are going to think the tests are impossible. Just go to class and pay attention and the 5pt quizzes he gives every other week are easy. He curves tests a lot so that is nice. He is very enthusiastic about geology.

Great professor who sometimes goes over the top in detail to make a point. Sometimes goes on tangents during lecture, but he knows his stuff. Enjoyed lecture and felt like I got something out of a class I wasn't super excited about. Gave study guides for exams and was available for help on homework. Quizzes were sometimes a little confusing.

Professor Sandvol is one of the worst teachers I have ever had. He has a very disorganized syllabus and students won't understand what to do. He couldn't explain things at all because he thought the material was too easy. He arbitrarily will deem which question is the "best". The homework, quizzes and tests aren't configured correctly so good luck

Class was so disorganized.  He was very enthusiastic, but his lectures were hard to follow and take notes on because he jumped around so much.  Tests and quizzes were also really hard, and the tests covered the material in too much detail.  Hard to study for.

Sandvol presented the information very well. The class was straight forward if you understand basic (very) physics. He loves to use fancy scientific words so you may want to bring a dictionary if you have a limited vocabulary when it come to science. Study the online homework and test will be a breeze.

HORRIBLE.  Very unclear, didn't teach the material he tested students on, learned next to nothing, made geology boring and irrelevant when it isn't.  Although, he is very enthusiastic and knowledgeable about course material...but he does not teach it in a relatable, engaging, thorough manner.  Made easy material difficult to learn and understand.
Lectures were disorganized and hard to take notes on. Lots of diagrams and scientific terms. Tests are hard, but he'll explain things more clearly if you ask for help individually.
class was completely unorganized.  he skipped around alot.  confusing teaching methods.
this class was so much fun. Dr. Sandvol is a lot of fun.

Sandvol loves geology and it comes out in his teaching. The class is easy if you go and do the online quizzes because alot of those questions are on the test. The tests take some studying for, but the information sinks in during class becasue he makes everything very understandable.
Class is real easy.  You dont even have to read the book and I recommend not buying it.  Just study the notes from class and take the online quizzes and you will get an B or higher in the class.

If you have to take Geology, you might as well take int with prof. Sandvol. The class is borring. I studied way too much for his tests and know I remeber absolutly nothing. But he does enjoy geology and is very clear about what to do if you want to get a good grade.

Dr. Sandvol is the typical geologist.  He loves geology, and wants his students to be excited about it too.  The class isn't too hard if you read the book and take the online quizzes.  Most of the exam material comes from the online quizzes. Study those and you'll be golden...its the lab thats more difficult.
class is pretty difficult.  there are so many small details that this guy throws on his exams.  each week there is a quiz in his lecture and the labs are 2 hours long.  wouldnt reccommend.

Dr. Sandvol loves powerpoint.  Every lecture he has a power point, which makes taking notes very easy.  The class in general is pretty interesting and easy to begin with but gets harder as the semester goes on.

Dr. S is addicted to powerpoint and if his computer or the system is malfunctioning, he will waste half the class trying to figure out what is wrong instead of attempting to give the lecture without his precious powerpoint presentation. He speeds way too quickly through material too

All right, so Geology is boring, but Dr. Sandvol has positive (somewhere short of annoying) energy, and is very clear.  You do have to study, but he makes sure you have every resource at your disposal.  I don't really think anyone could do a better job.

He is soooo boring!  His powerpoint lectures are stupid and I never learn anything useful for the quizzes.  And the lab for  this class sucks it big time.  He seems like a nice guy, just a big dork.  Don't take this unless you have SOME interest because it is really really really boring.
he was a pretty chill/easy going teacher...class is basically just a book discussion, fairly simple, swears in class, watches random funny youtube videos

He is a good professor and an extremely smart person. He is kind of unclear about what he expects from his students in their essays but he is very easy going. overall, the class is enjoyable and very entertaining. It's really interesting as well. However, I wouldn't recommend it to weak writers though. John is not bad to look at either.

He is a very intelligent person, although he doesn't give out A's easily (barely at all to be real), there is a lot to learn from him, so I would recommend his class. You talk about a lot of famous writings which are in a book you're assigned to read. Overrall, not a difficult class, he is very lax when it comes to rules of how to write papers.
Amazing professor with engaging lectures. Makes it very easy to learn Korean even as a complete beginner.
Take korean!!!!!!
Eunyoung is the best professor I've had. She's kind, funny and amazing at teaching. I feel like I've learned so much thanks to her.
She's literally so amazing and a great professor!

Professor Choi is an awesome professor. Do not miss the opportunity to take this class! She helps everyone succeed, is kind, caring, and very funny. I love her class. She makes sure goals are achievable, and you are having a good time while feeling like you're learning. She knows what she's doing, great professor.
I wouldnt want anyone else teaching me Korean!
She is so kind and very caring. I had her spring 2020 and Fall 2020 and she was so flexible. Really great teacher
Fantastic prof who injects energy and life into dead subjects. I suspect my experiences having him as an instructor will be a motivating force in my life to come.

Attending class with Ethan is a bit like sitting in on a lecture one would see in a movie when the prof is extremely excited about what they are presenting.  Other profs should copy this style of instruction.
He is really quite funny and full of frenetic energy. Very approachable. Ethan's class was always lively and enjoyable.

Very awesome guy.  He is energetic and works his hardest to keep the kids interacted/interested.  He does a wonderful job teaching the material and very kind.  Not a problem contacting him for help or to just have a friendly talk.
Ethan tried so hard to get us as excited about the class as he was. He helped us in any way that he could, and made the class a lot easier to take.
I enjoyed his class so much! He is funny and makes class fun. He really enjoys teaching and it shows through his enthusiam.
he loves art and you can tell because every class he tries to get us interested and to participate in discussions.  he is very helpful and understanding and will help you out if you need it.
I absolutely LOVED him!  He was so funny and made me want to come to class.  He's so intelligent and it shows in his teaching.  I would recommend him to anyone and everyone!

Professor Ewing is really understanding and will work with you... if you can reach him. He did not respond to emails at all. The class was discussion based but participation was not graded harshly. He also provides clear rubrics that explain how he grades papers and grades fairly.
Professor Ewing is so organized and well spoken. A real gem of a professor.
His voice in the video lectures, so soothing. He's a great professor, and although the other 3 professors for this class were good too, I wish prof Ewing taught the entire class.

I took his class via the internet this semester, and his lectures were very clear and explanatory and the slides he had along with them were very nice and easy to jot down. This class is very very lecture based, but all of the tests are open note, open lecture. Pay attention and take notes and you'll do great.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Gives clear, concise lectures and is knowledgeable about government. His homework isn't difficult, and neither are the exams. Also, has a nice bookshelf background for his videos, and sometimes his dog is there. Ewing is a solid king 10/10.
American Lit was a great experience, the readings all felt very intentional and important to themes discussed in that unit, and writing assignments had a great variety

I liked Evelev! I will say, the amount of reading assigned was definitely overwhelming but he was super understanding and did not require us to speak a lot in class. Would recommend him if you are a shy student!

Professor Evelev is a great professor. I saw a lot of comments that say he is dull or confusing. I don't think he is dull if you actually do the readings and engage with them. He cares about the well being of his students. He is a bit of a tough grader on papers, but he gives a lot of constructive feedback. You can also make it up by participating.

Terrible professor. Expects you to read 10+ readings for one exam, all of which can range from 8 pages up to 30+ pages. Then, he gives you an exam where you have to identify quotes from those readings. They're all basically the same quotes, and it's impossible to memorize all of that. Oh, and a paper every other week. Terribly hard grader. Unfair.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: n/a
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great professor! His class is a lot of work, but he is willing to help you get through it. He is a very caring professor who offers some valuable information, and I would definitely recommend it if you are up for a challenge!
This professor is open to feedback and willing to give more time on assignments if needed.

Professor Evelev was one of the most caring profs that I've had. He tried so hard to make sure that everyone was engaged and understanding class. Sometimes his expectations were unclear, but all I had to do was reach out for a little bit of help. Would def recommend him- such a nice guy! You def have to read (obviously-its English!) & attend class!

Lots of reading but, if you are taking this course that is to be expected as it is a requirement for an English major. John is a really good professor, during COVID in the spring he went out of his way to accommodate for students that were having problems adjusting to online courses. All-in-all he is a really amazing teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I found Professor Evelev to be very accommodating in respect of my disability and I found his course to be really inspirational. I am grateful for being introduced to the text of Leslie Marmon Silko's Almanac of the Dead as it has become one of my favourite novels. Also Powwow Highway is a great film.

I think that Evelev can be confusing and even more so when you have not read the material, however, what he expects from students is clear.  He grades toughly, but he is willing to help each student and discuss papers if asked. This is not a class to take if you are uncomfortable talking to teachers independently when you don't understand.

I think most of these negative comments are unfair to Dr. Evelev. He's an incredibly intelligent guy who encourages different points of view. If you don't want to speak up in class, then you shouldn't be taking an English course. He is a hard grader, but only because he wants to help you.

This guy was awful Spent most of his time berating us for not talking enough when any time anyone who didn't exactly agree with him got berated and belittled. Tests were easy but the papers he assigned were awful he doesn't tell you what to write about and he'll take points off for his opinion then belittle you for having them DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS
Nope. While he may seem like a friendly person, there is an elitist know-it-all lurking inside that automatically judges all of his students as lesser beings. He's not worth taking.
HARD GRADER, VERY BORING AND MEANINGLESS CLASS.

I think the comments below are a little unfair. I've had two classes with Dr. Evelev, both were about American Literature which he is very knowledgeable about. He is a difficult grader if you're used to getting A's, but he is also a fair one. You NEED to participate, that is the key to making up for the low paper grades. Just act like you care.
This was the MOST BORING experience of my life. Nice guy, but very boring and make dull jokes. Impossibly hard grader. Stay away if possible.

He is a friendly guy but very difficult to understand. He mumbles and trails off, and rarely has anything viable to say. He asks confusing questions and continues to confuse everyone by talking about how they are confusing. He's also a very tough grader.
Avoid her at all costs.

Harsh grader, very dense course load but was self-paced. A LOT of required readings and media to watch, very dense but few assignments, all papers and a proctored final that the study guide did not adequately prepare us for. Took the class with a friend and we both agreed this is not a 2000 level course, we have had easier 4000 level courses.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: This was a paper-heavy class, with not very many assignments, but they weren't too difficult, and there were no outside readings, only short lectures. Content was interesting
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her feedback is inconsistent, unclear and often downright rude and unprofessional. She should consider professional development and interpersonal skills before continuing online classes. I would skip this professor, because you will get an A one day and a D the next, and she will provide no valuable feedback as to why she gives the grades she gives

She didn't start grading the homework until week 4. It was then she said my work was "trying too hard" and I was "acting smart". She told me to answer like I'm telling a child. When I did, my grades came back still failing with her saying it was "too basic". Does not answer questions in emails. Super biased and condescending. She should not teach.

Probably one of the worst professors I've ever had. The class is based off of reading articles and writing weekly assignments that would've been a lot easier if she would've offered better help instead of telling you you're wrong without stating why. Also very rude on multiple occasions and never felt comfortable enough to ask for help.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: So basically the worst professor I have ever had. Very rude. Very inconsiderate. Gave terrible feedback whenever I tried to do better. Nothing you say will be correct to her!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Unorganized class. Can be disrespectful to students. Not much instruction was given at the beginning of the course except for the syllabus. Will take off points on major assignments without giving feedback. The course itself was very bias. When asking a question, isn't helpful but then will later grade harshly even though she didn't help to begin

I would have loved this class- with a better professor. Her lectures are disjointed and hard to follow, but you'll still have to show up because she gives randomized quizzes. Her assignments are unclear and she can be rude sometimes. People told me to switch out of her section before I took the class, and I didn't listen, which I now regret.

She expects you to read a lot, but most WGST classes do. She gives pop quizzes that are either attendance based, group work, or individual. She does not do powerpoints, so you have to consistently pay attention to get notes. Her homework is based off the notes you take in class.

Super intelligent and insightful, but unfortunately tends to be unorganized sometimes, making note-taking a challenge. Her energetic, welcoming personality and passion for the topics made the class worth taking nonetheless. She puts a ton of emphasis on class participation, and sometimes does pop quizzes, so attendance is crucial.

She doesn't care about her students, always shuts down her students who she FEELS answer wrong.  Horrible grader, her assignments are not clear and she's very biased.  Not enjoying her class and happy to almost be done with her course.

It was always great going to class and getting to discuss the readings because she really valued letting students having their say in the class. However, her tests (and written assignments) were always a little tough and unpredictable - the rubrics are nearly unreadable and extremely confusing.

Did not care about the students time whatsoever. Tests would be only over the notes that you had to get from going to class, and i would have been okay with that if i could have actually heard her speak. Rude and disrespecful.

She is VERY passionate about the subject and comes across as biased. She imposes her opinions on the class, and discourages class participation by shooting down students who answer wrongly. However, she is also very entertaining & her passion is infectious. Tests are easy & easily graded. Easy class, but you have to be tolerant of a 'personality'.

Eve does not respect her students time. She comes to class unprepared, she complains about student requests and questions, she is unclear during lecture making note-taking impossible, and I feel like I wasted $1000 taking her class. The material is interesting. She is a classic case of a professor ruining an otherwise excellent class. Truly a shame
Used his online videos for Multivariable Calculus. Literally (I hardly use the word "literally") saved my semester. EXTREMELY CONCISE, EFFICIENT, AND CLEAR.
teaches very clear and well

The hardest I have ever worked for an A in my entire life. The material itself is tricky, but Chris really is an amazing teacher. Be prepared to work. Also, his lectures are posted on YouTube which helps if you miss something in class.
Incredibly difficult class, but also very well-taught and fairly-graded. He really knows what he's talking about, and he's always willing to help students. Extremely intelligent guy.

Man, I got a solid D in this class but that wasn't the fault of Chris at all. The fact that I got a bad grade but still think the professor is wonderful should tell you something. I couldn't blame this guy for my score - he's too awesome. Super nice, fun-loving guy. Very generous with grading but he does what eh can to make you think. Hard but good

He is a brilliant person but he has a hard time dumbing down the course material so that it?s understandable.He is very fair and has a VERY generous curve (52%=C-).You have to work very hard to get a good grade and his homework is very frustrating.The exams are very indepth. All in all if you take his class and pass you will have learned something.
He cranks the awesome to the max!

Horrible teacher, can't follow what he teaches you and he goes off on tangents just so show much smarter than you he is. Makes his own tests and will make them as complicated as possible to once again rub in how smart he is. Won't curve if you do bad its because your not "smart enough," not his fault

Chris is one of the hardest teachers I've had at Mizzou, but he's also one of the best. You will come out of his class having actually learned something and may look at all surfaces in a new way. I would highly recommend him.

This guy knows that he's teaching entry-level sociology to a bunch of non-majors and he's really cool about it. Start the homework assignments in advance, because if you take the time to fix them up it's impossible to not get an A.

Evans really cares about teaching, and he'll definitely talk to you if you just ask questions.  However, his use of SAGrader, an online essay grader that is 70% of your grade, did not encourage me to really delve into the material.  I ended up skipping almost every class and still got an A.

Great teacher! Truly was not interested in sociology but after a few lectures came to love it. About 90% of what is needed for the class is from lectures. homework is only online and they are essay prompts. most are easy. think everyone should take his class.
SOOOO HOTTTTT........I GOT TO CLASS FOR THAT....
He is sooo funny and his homework is really easy! I barely went to class and still did well on everything. His tests can be kind of tricky though.
So much fun, very easy to get an A.  He is super funny, inlcudes video clips and is incredibly hot!

First off the class itself is great and the things he taught were interesting. Getting an A is easy because the assignments are easy and he offers a lot of extra credit. But all of the assignments are done using sagrader where we submit essays online and they are graded by a computer. Its a  frustrating and annoying, but is'nt hard to get an A.
Really interesting class. He really made me see the world in a different way when I think about things like politics and crime and devience. Plus he is SO HOT!!

Pretty awesome teacher, he tries so hard to help you do well! He is a little nitpicky with essays though  so make sure to ask him exactly what he wants. GO TO CLASS! I got a ton of extra credit that way.
Good teacher and extra help is available when needed
he is a very good teacher he knows what he is talking about! sometimes he does not seem very confident but usually seems really interested in what he is teaching!
She has no idea how to teach a class. She is way too lenient I don't even know what the point of that class was.

She's a nice professor, but her lectures are awkward and disorganized. Don't rely on the syllabus. She admits she falls behind on content. We had only one discussion post despite them being listed as weekly, and the exam was all essays, not multiple choice/short answer like it was stated. Few chances to earn points and grading is very slow.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Rais was an easy grader, who rarely assigned projects; but liked to assign a decent amount of reading.Throughout the entirety of the semester, I never felt like I could challenge any of the statements made, which turned me off. No professor should teach as if all things in the textbook are inherently fact, and she did. Wouldn't take again.

Reading the textbook and being engaged in class is super important to get the most out of class. Professor Rais is incredibly caring and always open to feedback--she always asks students for their feedback so speak up! There are few grades so make sure you put time into her assignments. Class isn't required but she'll respect you if you show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She was extremely kind and welcoming but her class lectures were a tad hard to sit through as she was a bit unorganized. In the syllabus she stated there would be assignments every week but we only had 3/4 grades put in by the time she posted the final exam. The slides were not always the m sot helpful. Get the book for the final.

I feel bad because she is really nice and made my class a breeze but HOLY... she rarely assigned stuff and her classes felt so unbelivably optional. If you want an easy class go for it but I wanted to learn way more.

Professor Rais is exceptionally pleasant. Her lectures prove engaging, and she provides ample chances for participation. She is accommodating in various aspects, such as attendance and deadlines. So, I strongly endorse taking her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She was a bit hard to listen to throughout lectures, not the most organized and lots of time was spent on figuring out how to work things. Very nice but not paced well.

Professor Rais is very kind and understanding. Her lectures are interesting and she gives lots of opportunities to engage. She's flexible on just about everything, including attendance and deadlines. Highly recommend her class.

She has trouble at times with getting things graded on time or clear feedback, but overall an amazing professor. She is extremely caring and understanding. She cares more about you understanding the material than she does you being able to test well over the details. Her class is very enlightening and teaches you a lot about yourself and society!

The class format is awesome. I took the Culture and Crisis in Athens course which included a one-and-a-half month roleplay session (not that kind) where we participate in the Athenian assembly as historical figures after the Peloponnesian War. It was very fun as well as enlightening on how ancient Athens truly worked.

Dr. Farmer is a very nice guy who knows his Greek Culture. This class is all reading though. You have to read the books to know what is going on. There are a couple of books throughout the class that you can spark note and get away with going good on the tests, but you have to read. The first test is the hardest by far and attendance is mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He was an amazing teacher! Always so easy to understand and is actually pretty funny with his lectures. There's no doubt in my mind that I would take his class again if I could.

Dr. Farmer  is the best! He engages the class during lecture, he's funny, and he only tells you what you need to know. Tests are easy as long as you go over your notes before the test. Would definitely take him again.

I took Greek Culture (CLHUM 2100).   Dr. Farmer is really amazing at lecturing and able to hold student interest quite easily.  His class isn't that difficult, but it still helps you learn.  I would definitely recommend it.

I took his course 8 years ago. It took me until now to realize how good he was. His class is hard but reasonable. Hell go out of his way to meet with students. What makes him standout is he really cares. We had a few snow days that canceled class. That night he emailed the class that if anyone needs help to please email him.
His lectures are different than most other classes. He expects you to keep up with the material and frequently asks questions that make you think.

Everyone else's description before this is pretty spot on. Be prepared to read in advance and practice before showing. Expect each test to be more difficult than the assigned HW due to time constants. It is about the same length.

Fadi is a nice guy, but that's about it. Very poor at explaining circuit analysis in a way that the average Circuit Theory 1 student can understand. Expects way too much prior knowledge for an entry level ECE class. Tests are very tricky and difficult to finish in the allotted time. The only positive is that grades are somewhat negotiable.

Expected to read lesson before class (pop quizzes sometimes). Wants students to learn from each other rather than him. Tests are very challenging and very long. Every test he will tell you he finished in 20 minutes. Doesn't really keep up to date grades.

Fadi does a lot of examples and likes to have the class form into groups. He's known to have people come up to the board pretty frequently to do in class examples. Amount of homework is fair, but his test are pretty brutal and most of the time they take too long to complete.

The most unorganized professor I have ever seen in my entire college career. I could of done a better job. I would schedule meetings with her and she would forget. I registered, enrolled, and paid for an in person class. Class was supposed to be in person but we never met in person not once. The TA did all of the grading, she never graded anything

Etti is a nice professor who cares about her students' wellbeing, but this class is a mess. Easy A if you show up & turn in work, but the most unorganized class I have ever taken. Due dates are posted wrong or not posted at all. Instructions are unclear, especially for final project. Much time wasted talking in circles and irrelevant guest speakers

This is the MOST disorganized class I have ever been in. It's not even close, it's actually shocking how disorganized it is. Canvas was not up till halfway through the semester, and all the due dates were wrong and were never changed. If you want to email her for anything, 9/10 times she will not answer.

I did not think that Etti was that great of a teacher. The canvas site was put up late and was never updated with due dates. I had no idea what I was supposed to be doing during my group presentation because there were never any guidelines sent out about the project. She also picked movies that were old and somewhat outdated. I would not recommend.

Etti is an incredible human being who genuinely cares about increasing cross-cultural awareness for her students. Attendance is mandatory--even when you think she does not count attendance, she does! My main complaint is she's extremely disorganized so you never know when due dates are or where you stand in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Etti is a wonderful woman that is caring and respectful to everyone. As long as you show up and do your work (which is minimal) this class is an easy A and is pretty fun when not discussing sensitive subjects. That being said, she is very disorganized and due dates/instructions are not always clear.

Etti is sweet, but there are issues. She graded all assignments of the semester the weekend after finals, and gave me the same score on everything - clearly she didn't actually read any of my homework. There are no rubrics or clear schedules for the class. It's an easy class but if you need organization - not the class for you.

Etti is hands down the best professor I have ever had. I cried when her class ended. She cares about her students more than any professor at any university and works with you so you can get the best possible grade in her class. Her class isn't on canvas, so being in class is important. She gives you dates and lots of time for assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Etti is very kind and caring but the class itself is set up very poorly and there is no structure. We are over halfway through the semester and I havent received a single grade on an assignment. She only communicates by email and doesnt even use the Canvas page. She also talks in circles for 20 minutes at the beginning of every class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class has great content. The class was fun and interesting but it is not worth the disorganization of the class. Never received grades on assignments. Put canvas up half way through the semester. Never knew when assignments were due because there was no schedule. No rubric for the presentation or paper. Had no idea what was happening all semester.

She's an incredibly caring person and is passionate about many social issues, however class is extremely disorganized. Towards the end I had no clue what specific things I was supposed to do for assignments and nothing was graded.

While Etti is a great lady, the class is completely disorganized. Never received grades on assignments which is annoying and unprofessional. Friends who took class said to show up for every class, participate and it's an easy A. Weekly write-ups, semester group project. Basically a class you can get an A in by showing up w/o learning anything.

The good: Etti is literally the nicest professor you'll ever have. She goes out of her way to look after her students. The bad: the class itself is very disorganized. She doesn't use Canvas, so you don't know the schedule or your grade all semester. Would highly recommend to anyone who doesn't care if you're in the dark all semester.

Etti is very caring and passionate about many social issues. No tests, no lectures, mostly opinion-based journals. Compelling guest speakers. Big complaint: VERY disorganized. Canvas page went up crazy late, didn't put in any grades until the end. However, her classes are very easy A's. Show up to class and participate a little and you're golden.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Great professor! She is very interested in getting to know the students and super easy to talk to. Her classes are a little unorganized without any notes being taken, just make sure you listen in class. The assignments aren't really too hard and for the class environment that you will be a part of, it's definitely worth taking the class!

This class is so disorganized. Etti is nice but gives absolutely zero feedback whatsoever and doesn't put anything on Canvas. Literally have no idea my grade and haven't done anything remotely related to psychology yet. Super nice but wouldn't recommend if you want to know what's going on

Disorganized, rambles, annoying, impossible to get ahold of outside class, class ended a month ago and most assignments are still not graded. Loses assignments because she insists you email them to her school email instead of through blackboard or canvas. Class content is okay and not hard, but teacher could use some work
Most participatory class I've taken yet. She is seriously the easiest person to talk to on Earth! Special guest speakers are pretty cool too. Oh, did I mention no homework?

I've had Etti for 2 different classes & honestly look forward to them each time. She is very passionate, the nicest lady ever, and doesn't believe in "traditional" classroom methods - so you'll never take an exam. She is, however, very heavy on papers (mostly just reflection papers) and group projects. If you're there, you'll get an A or B.
Incredible and meaningful material taught by an inspirational woman. Etti is absolutely amazing, both as a teacher and as a human being. I would take this course again!

I've had Etti for two classes (Psych at the Movies and Cross-Cultural Psych) and she is brilliant. She's accepting and truly cares about her students. While she may go on and on and repeat herself (her favorite word is "basically"), the material she teaches is important and you will learn a lot.
Etti is a wonderful professor. I highly recommend taking a course with her. There's an assignment every week, but there are no tests. Her class is an easy A.
Etti is a fantastic professor. She is extremely passionate about what she teaches and imparts that on her students. Modern Israeli Film is my favorite class I have taken at Mizzou to date.
Etti is the best professor you'll ever have at Mizzou. Class is super easy- guaranteed A. You have to go but lectures are awesome and guest speakers almost everyday.

Etti is by far the BEST professor I have ever had. She makes an effort to get to know about each student and truly cares if you succeed. Attendance is mandatory and if you miss 3 class periods you cannot pass, but you will want to go to class. She keeps things interesting and really makes you think about your personal perspectives.

Etti is the nicest teacher I've had! Psychology at the Movies is an awesome class if you love movies and talking about cross cultural issues such as race, gender, class, religion and sexual orientation. Basically, you watch a movie and write a response to it. There are no tests, only a final take-home reflection, paper and presentation.
She's really nice and laid back. No tests. She likes to get to know all her students.

Great class, Great teacher!  Class is really interesting, no notes/tests.  Alot of participation and very subjective assignments.  Definitely take this course!  She works really well with students, whatever you need.  One of the best courses I've taken.
She will open your eyes and challenge your misconceptions. Enlightening experience!
An amazing class. Take it if you can!
Best course in college. Best prof ever!
What a great course, what a great prof!
i never say this ..but really!!she is the best professor ever!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Absolutely amazing! She cares deeply about the success and the learning of her students. It's a tough class emotionally and will challenge your way of thinking. But it will by far be the best experience you will have in college. Even if it's not in  your major... TAKE THIS CLASS!
Best teacher you could ever ask for...she truely cares about every student.

Etti is the most compassionate teacher I've ever had. She cares so much about every student and how much they learn in her class. Discussion is a breeze, guest lecturers are usually interesting and movies are good. Sadly, she quizzes on chapters in the book each week, which can be a drag. I didn't do so hot on those, but still got an A in the class
Awesome lady.  Class was all discussion based, no tests, and simple papers/presentations.  I really enjoyed the class.
Best class ever.
I love her!! Always willing to help, SOOO sincere and loves her students.  Very interesting woman.  I looked forward to going to class.

This was one of the most interesting and fun classes I've taken, and it's all thanks to her.  She is the most sincere teacher I've ever had, and she takes a lot of interest in every single student both inside and outside the class.  Take any class you can with her.
Should be a reuqired class! So important! Fun, too. Highly recommend.
Interesting, original, fun!
Great class!
Amazing class!
No Comments
My best course at MU.
Best class I have taken in college. Nothing like it!
This lady is amazing.  She is the sweetest teacher I've ever had.  Don't miss a chance to have a class with her.
Great teacher! She is very kind and explains things well.
Prof. Fan is knowledgeable and prepares her classes very well. She also provides many examples and practice with immediate feedback during class. Office hours are also helpful.
Content delivery was not very clear.
Professor Lu is a good teacher. She explains things well and gives lots of practice. I really enjoyed this class and felt like I learned a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Lu is a nice person, but not the best teacher. She just reads off the slides, making lectures drag on. She does give participation points during most lectures. 3 midterms and a final, very difficult tests. Also gave 3 assignments. Assigned a huge group project which was assigned right before Thanksgiving, and due the day after we returned.

Professor Fejzula is both caring and well-versed in her subjects. However, her teaching tends to bounce around in place and time, leading to a sort of confused and unrelated week-to-week. Her main fault is dedicating around 30% of class time to self-help lessons and activities. I know about as much on the topic as I did before this class.

Dr. Fejzula is clearly knowledgeable and passionate in her field, and genuinely cares about her students. However, she seems to overemphasize self-care exercises rather than course content, which I found a bit frustrating as I was interested in the course's subject matter. Overall, her class was consistent and easy, but not especially fulfilling.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Fejzula is an incredibly well spoken, knowledgeable, and compassionate professor. She has strict requirements for participation in the course, but is incredibly easy to communicate with and, so long as you keep up with out of class readings and activities, you'll retain most, if not all, of the information and perform well on quizzes.

I'm just not a fan of the class structure. I took this class because I don't know that much about the history of Africa, and I feel as though I have not learned very much. It's not a good representation of the true history of Africa because I feel it jumps around topics too much. She is very smart and kind and knowledgeable about the subject.
Not a fan.

Professor Fejzula is brilliant, that is not to be doubted. She also wants you to learn, as she should. However, whoever takes this class must be prepared for a very challenging and rigorous experience. Participation is crucial and if you do not speak, you will fail! Moreover, her grading is tough but fair. She is great, expect a challenge!
Boring lectures and hard tests.

Boring lectures and hard tests. Canvas page was very dis organized. I got more out of reading the book then going to class. Tests are much harder then what we do in class. She made the class harder then what it should have been.
great prof. very engaged in class and actually cares about her students. class has a bit of hw but its not terrible. make sure you do class preps so that you can participate in discussions
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Could rant for hours about how terrible she was. The canvas page and syllabus was a mess, with lots of missing assignments/points. Never cared to correct it. Lectures were useless, study the textbook instead. She's the type of person to try to make it seem like she likes her job, but actually hates it. Made what should've been a fun class miserable

A nice professor who cares about her students, but the class itself is so much work. The Canvas page is extremely difficult to navigate with lots of errors in due dates and uncertainty about what assignments were due when. Understanding and answers emails - makes herself available to students when needed. My thoughts about her got better with time

The 1st day she said we could miss 1 day of class. Once I had to go early and she made the class on zoom extra long just 'cuz. On another, I had tech issues, she said she wouldn't grade the assignment if we hadn't been on zoom for 10 mins. I felt singled out both times. Luckily a different prof graded me. Frustrating, not impossible to get through.

Most myopic and close minded teacher I've ever had. Will not listen to student suggestions even when they are overwhelmingly popular, even though she claims she is open to change. The only answer she gives when you ask something is "It's all in the assignment if you read it", even when "it" isn't. She is driving potential nurses away.
Don't skip her class or she won't let you hear the end of it. Also don't bother asking for help on anything cuz you'll be hit with the "it's your responsibility to know what to expect in the class".
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers

reviews.comment: Extremely passive-aggressive. Don't bother emailing her about any questions you have, she'll make you feel stupid for asking. I'm seriously thinking about changing my major just because this professor caused me to have mostly negative thoughts about nursing. I've never had that experience before, very disappointed in her as a professor.
Very basic papers that arent very multicultural but just her own preferences. Make sure your grades are all in because she misses grading some and lowers your grade.
Online lessons were kinda funny. Very easy quizes.

DO. NOT. TAKE. THIS. CLASS! I can not say it enough. Her lectures are so confusing, not concise AT ALL. Plus, the program (MU Online) sucks and had a lot of issues regarding grading. Of course I emailed her 10+ times on this matter and never even got a reply. No matter how hard you study, the tests are IMPOSSIBLE. PLEASE DONT TAKE IT!!!

Pay attention and participate and you'll get an A. She's very knowledgeable and knows her stuff. You'll need to book if you don't come to class. There are very few assignments so they each count a lot. They're pretty easy though. Just put some effort into it

All of the quiz answers are online but don't expect to get a good grade based on that alone. The tests are impossible. I read the book and took notes on the lessons and still did terrible. Very little feed back after grading. Just save yourself the bad grade and chance it with Joel in class.
Tests are impossible!!! DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS

I very rarely go out of my way to write positive reviews, but Prof. Fischer truly deserves it. Genuinely cares about his students education and seeing them succeed. Highly recommend taking one of his courses, he makes it very easy to succeed while balancing actual retention of information. Cannot stress more how great of a professor he is.
Nice and approachable!

One of the better professors I've ever had, especially within the school of ECE/CS. An easy class anyone can sit through, however lectures provide incredibly helpful and valuable tips/tricks. I asked a question after a lab once and was given a spectacular breakdown of my question to the lowest level.. He has great knowledge he wants to share.

Fischer is a really nice professor who is open to feedback. The class is typically small so it's easier to reach out for help. As long as you pay attention in labs and lectures, you'll be fine in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: What he asks for and what he wants aren't always the same. When asked a question, he rarely answers what was asked. His talks are ridiculous: rambles on about semi-related things, is unclear about important concepts, etc.

I did not like his teaching style. He jumps around way too much and is very confusing. He repeats himself a lot saying how he smart and humble he is. These are the only two lines I remember from his class. Did not learn much at all.

he's very nice, smart and humbled. really liked the capstone course. besides, i was considering to apply for mba after a couple of years. i requested a meeting with Dr S and he spent 2 hours helping me with gmat questions. idk any prof other than Dr S who would do that for a student. in short, amazing guy and teacher.

I really loved his course and teaching. I think the person (very clear is the same one from the writing) is talking about someone else. He never talked about him, treats students fairly, cares about students. Exam was hard but his curve was super generous. Nobody I know got below B.
Do not take this professor. He is so unorganized and lost and doesn't tell you what he expects from you. He hasn't taught me much other than about himself. I was so willing to learn.

Too arrogant and isn't very clear or helpful. From his boring lectures, he already expects you to understand all the concepts. Rather than helping, he'll ridicule and chastise you for not knowing. It's hard to tell whether he's using constructive criticism, or just too mean and arrogant.

Professor Felipe is a great teacher who really cares about his students and always finds time to talk when requested. Not a fan of the capstone course because it is more like a finance course? but the prof's attitude and passion to teach is remarkable. Plus, he helped me with case questions for my consulting interview.
Best professor I had at Mizzou. The complaints below are false. How can a prof treat students badly if the classes were pre-recorded?

He has the worst attitude. He wants to overtalk the students. He talks more about how great he is than hearing what the students have to say about essential topics. He treats the students like subordinate kids. He makes the course boring and a complete waste of time.

Dr. Silva is a horrible professor. Not does he expect students to think as he does, he has a terrible attitude. The way he talks down to students is disgusting. I would not recommend taking his course if you actually want to learn.

Dr. Silva is kind of hard to understand and does not explain well, you'll need to teach yourself to get a good mark in this class. I would recommend this class to people who are self motivated and like teaching themselves. If you're not don't take it.
Dr. Silva's class helped me reconsider my career goals and study for the CFA exams after the CPA. He knows more finance than finance profs.
He cannot teach. More interested in wasting student's time than teaching. Does not take student's feedback well.
Professor Silva rocks! Very accommodating with students needs, really smart and fair. His project discussions were the most valuable classes I had at Mizzou.

Dr Silva rocks! Not only super smart but very humble, despite being Ivy educated. Always worked with students to accommodate our restrictions in a challenging covid semester. His feedback on students presentations are very encouraging and he always respects different points of view. The comments below are clearly from some kid upset with his exam

For the first time in college I felt that I was talking a university level course. Prof Silva is the smartest teacher I ever had. He knows about everything from finance to vaccine. He always goes an extra mile to help his students during his office hours. His exam is not easy, but you'll learn a lot from him.
Very hard to understand and doesn't teach very well. He often seemed unprepared and didn't answer questions clearly. Also does some really weird things... In short, stay away
Worst professor ever. I learned nothing from the class, heard him rambles on all class Take the class with Dr. P

I did not enjoy his class at all. He's very very unclear on everything and rambles on about random topics. Nobody knows what he's saying. If your opinion was different from his, you were wrong. He does not tolerate opposing arguments. He's the worst and most arrogant professor I've ever seen.

She can be very tough and is definitely and acquired taste, I know many aren't fond of her. Course work is heavy and missing one class can set you back a lot. Lots of homework, many late nights. She's very abstract in her thinking and that can be jarring. She's very understanding and patient, always willing to do whatever she can to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I got sick multiple times this semester and I didn't want to get my classmates sick so I didn't go to class. Little did I know if you miss more than 4 classes she will fail you. it didn't matter that I was yaking or I literally could not get out of bed. She aslo never looked at her emails despite me emailing her multiple times about our projects

She's a great professor and really nice to me. But I also can't help but notice she's a lot harsher to one student more than anyone else. it's not like their projects were bad, you can see they tried but she couldn't say anything nice so I feel a little bad but overall she's really nice and is clearly passionate
Amazing teacher! She clearly labels what needs to be done. Your grade depends on how much effort you put into the course. Doing more than is expected will enhance your learning experience.
The amount of reading assigned is unrealistic for a full-time student. I also experienced some borderline unprofessional responses, as well. Unfortunately would not recommend this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: As a person who loves sci-fi, this class made me start to hate it. The prof. is very unclear about what exactly she wants from your essays including the fact you have to site a ton of resources. She recommends you read extra texts that don't add value to the essay assignments. If you try to reach out for help, she is very critical of your work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class has very interesting course material, but you are given an unrealistic amount of work to complete in a small period of time. Also I had a medical issue, got a doctors note, let the professor know and she was not accommodating and at points disrespectful. Great course material but the professor is a no go.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: So much reading. Soooo much reading. Multicultural Case Studies is boring but it will totally enlighten you at least a little bit. Get a global perspective on stuff, geopolitics and what not. But there's a paper every week in the form of a blog post, and the blog is Wordpress and it's stupid. She herself is kinda fun and quirky though
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Monika Fischer is not a tough grader, you just have to turn things in. She spends a lot of this class spewing leftist garbage on feminism, women's rights, and other SJW problems, so you might have to pretend to be a liberal on the blogs to get an A. She will provide a ton of reading for you to do, but I got away only doing the bare minimum.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Fischer was a hoot! She keeps the Peace Studies class interesting and always entertaining.  The course as a whole is neat considering it introduces many of the world's issues to students.  Anyways, Fischer is kind, willing to listen, and expects each student to have a grasp of website creation.

This was her globalization class and overall the class is pretty easy to get an A. She's passionate but not very interesting w/ some guest speakers. Lots of reading that you more or less just need to scan through. DO THE BLOG POSTS, they are worth a huge chunk of your grade.  The papers were tedious but not worth as much (but still important).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She is super kind and caring. You can tell she loves teaching and her students. Show up to class, the textbook isn't even that important. She just wants to make sure you are getting something out of class. Highly recommend!
She co-taught with Mr. Pinto and I thought they were phenomenal. She is so involved in everything she does and she really just wants everyone to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: She's pretty cool, and the co-instructors were alright. Just show up, really. Don't buy the books, it's not really worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Firman gets off topic very easily and his lectures don't really have anything to do with the exams. He also grades on pop quizzes & attendance and it's worth 20% of you final grade, so show up to class. He doesn't change the material year to year, so if you can get ahold of old notes/ tests it will be very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Honestly an easy A capstone course for animal science students. Show up and take notes. All exams, quizzes, and final are open note/open laptop and easy to pass. If he says help is needed at the turkey farm GO HELP. I received 60 points extra credit towards my quiz grades. Lecture doesn't have any prepared notes or structure so be prepared to write
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--SO MANY PAPERS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Tells irrelevant stories during valuable class time. In class teachings and even his "study guide" for the test, have very little to do with the actual test.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Firman is a pretty chill dude and tells pretty cool stories, but the topics discussed and the way the class is structured does not go along with the test.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Horrible class. Only talks about poultry. Would not recommend.

Dr. Firman has a tendency to subtly insult his students. His lectures are long and unorganized. His blackboard page is also very unorganized. He poorly prepared students for exams, with little guidance on areas to focus on. He does manage to make relatively dull topics interesting and has some good stories.
Dr. Finneman is amazing. She's a tough grader, but if you do what she asks (no more, no less) and get it in on time, you'll be fine. The group project at the end is brutal.

Professor Teri makes me want to go to my cross cultural class (fall14). She seemed strict at first, but she is very knowledgable and objective on the controversial topics covered in J2000. Don't think about skipping classes- some test questions are based on the tinest details. But as long as you go to class and take notes, you will be fine.

She's very smart and knows the material well. Not the most approachable for extra help and some of the test questions are on the smallest things. There are enough easy grades to where if you put the work in you'll get a good grade. The group project is a huge part of the grade as well. Good teacher overall though.

Prof. Finneman is awesome. The class is discussion based. There's a lot of outside work though. I took her cross-cultural journalism class and it was very interesting. I actually wanted to go to class. If you pay attention and study a little you should get a good grade.

Professor Flink is a wonderful teacher who gives great feedback and really cares for your success. This class is a lot of work, difficult, and Flink is a tough grader, but overall I've had a good experience.

Jamie is an awesome teacher! I loved my team in this class. I wish her style of teaching was clearer and that lectures would have been more consistent but overall I would recommend this class to anyone in strat comm and would take a class with her again.

Jamie is a professor who puts in as much work as she asks for. She's so incredibly smart and supportive. I appreciate her for always meeting groups where they're at and helping them out. Be prepared to work a lot in this class. Your group's success depends on everyone doing their role. If the class isn't right for you, drop early in the semester.

This is a really time-consuming, difficult class, so DO NOT take it unless you're willing to put in a LOT of hours outside of class. There are a few major group projects, but you can get some really invaluable work for your portfolio out of it. She was a really good lecturer and knows her stuff. She's a great advertising professional to learn from.

This course is just how bad do you want it, he isn't a bad professor as you can't expect someone to teach you anatomy in one meeting once a week

Just actually put in work and you're fine
Switched my major after taking this class

Doesn't care if you pass or fail, doesn't teach nothing in lectures. Pretty much you will listen to a bunch of videos and have 2 quizzes per week with 3 tests overall with about 50 questions. Nothing is dropped.

The class isn't impossible, but you are pretty much on your own for this class since it is flipped schedule, the professor doesn't seem to care if you pass or fail, your grade reflects how much work you put in for sure.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Goodluck, just study

Great anatomical examples in class that relate to in-person exposure in a hospital setting. Lots of studying and memorization but that's to be expected with an anatomy class. Some exams would have confusing questions but overall straightforward if you studied.

Amazing classes, I've learned a lot of applicable stuff from him. His knowledge is wide reaching and anything you're interested in within the J school he can teach, or get you connected to the right people. Make sure that you ask for help even if you don't think you need it, and always be seeking feedback from him.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Jim is probably the best Journalism professor at Mizzou and often goes out of his way to help every single student. However, he does teach several classes per semester which usually results in him scrambling to stay on track. NOTE: He also really pushes you and wants you to work for a good grade. He's a nice dude tho. You'll learn a lot from him.

Professor Flink has the most amazing voice ever and paired with his iconic glasses makes him such an amazing guy! Theater 2005 was a fun course with him. It was a lot of group project work and we helped out the local Thompson Center.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Caring

reviews.comment: Jim is my absolute favorite professor in the J-School!!! Highly recommend any of his classes. Intro/Adv. Promotional Video classes are an extension of J2150. Lots of camera use and video editing. Class itself was super easy and you only meet once a week. Put in effort and it'll be an easy A.
Be sure to ask him for guidance along the way. Don't get on his bad side. Keep asking what you can be improving on.

I feel like my Spanish got worse from this class. Most of the class was him talking at us. When we would make grammar mistakes when he occasionally did ask us questions, he would interrupt us to correct us, which made learning so much more stressful. His class was not a good learning setting for me at all.

I liked Dr. Fleak. The class is definitely not the most interesting part of my day but its tolerable and it's a very easy A. The homework is graded on completion and its fairly simple. He is a nice old man! He does ramble a lot but quite frankly, the people in my class who don't like him were the kind people who had no patience for old people.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: He's very audible which is great for a Spanish teacher. The class always had about an hour of homework which you have to do because 1) it's for a lot of points and 2) all you do during class is go over homework answers. There's a good chance this class will be the dullest part of your day. Attendance is worth points :(

Dr. Fleak is just the best professor ever.  It is clear that he loves teaching and working with students. He is such a good person.  He makes the class so interesting and chooses great books to use and the students always learn the material well.  I would love to take all of my Spanish classes with Dr. Fleak.  I love attending everyday.

Like some have said, Professor Fleak is a very awkward man and you really have to get used to his weirdness and rambling. BUT he is very well intentioned and is definitely there for you. Class itself is excessively dull and boring. The text used is honestly horrible and I can't say it aids in improving your Spanish. Easy A, but not enjoyable for me

Dr. Fleak is absolutely the best professor I ever have had at Mizzou.  He is very organized and cheerful.  I have learned so much in his course. It is clear that he loves teaching Spanish and getting to know us.  I hope that I will be able to take my remaining Spanish classes with Dr. Fleak.  I recommend him highly to all other students.

Fleak is literally the most useless teacher I've ever had. My Spanish has digressed so much from being in this class. It is almost painful to sit there for 50 minutes. If you want an easy A, take this class but if you want to actually learn something and improve your Spanish avoid him at all costs.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH PROFESSOR FLEAK. It is the most boring class I have ever taken. He is the most awkward man to walk the face of the earth, and he makes class ridiculously dull. He is also very unreasonable when it comes to attendance and turning anything in late. I dread going to class each and every day.

Sr. Fleak is seriously the nicest teacher I have met at Mizzou thus far. He is SUCH a sweet little old man! His class was interesting and I really learned a lot. He is extremely helpful and easy to understand most of the time. You will definitely improve your Spanish speaking and writing skills in his class.  Take his class!!

Professor Fleak is the best professor I have ever had.  He is so nice and always helpful to all students.  I feel like I greatly improve my speaking and writing skills in his class.  I would love to take future classes with him.  He is the best in every way.

Professor Fleak is the best teacher I have ever had. He is so energetic and enthusiastic.
