He makes himself available to his students for extra help, goes on interesting rants in class, and assigns Blackboard articles so you don't have to shell out a million bucks on a textbook. He's very flexible and understanding, but does expect you to participate in class, which isn't difficult.
He's the best teacher I've ever had

No textbook is used, he chooses selections out of various journals & books. Some of the readings are difficult, but he is absurdly helpful if you don't understand it. He can go on tangents, but they're always interesting and relevant to the topic. Knows his subject well, cares about his students, and doesn't care about "grades" so long as you try.

This course was difficult, but I felt very supported by Kat. She strives to help all of her students, and while feedback is slow, there's over 100 students and only a couple graders! I really appreciated how much effort she put into our work being published, and while she is harsh, she really does care about your success.

Does not work well with students (especially female students for some reason) and is incredibly defensive over criticism. Not a fan of this professor, would not recommend whatever section of 4180 she's teaching.

Kat is a great instructor, especially if you are willing to meet her halfway and put in the work to improve. The organization of the class leaves something to be desired, but she will go the extra mile to help you succeed if you INDICATE AHEAD OF TIME that you are struggling. She's very approachable and wants you to succeed. Go to office hours!!!

Worst professor I've ever had. She asked someone to start over on a two week long project a mere three hours before the deadline, she doesn't turn in feedback for your first draft until the night before it's due, and she will count you off points for changes that SHE made. She's never even been a reporter. Avoid her at all costs.

Truly one of the worst professors I have ever had. My first project I had approved by multiple editors, classmates, and another professor. When I showed it to her, she chopped and screwed it substantially, sucked all the life out of it, and gave me a 52%. She shows zero regard for her students and her well being. Avoid her at all cost.

Kat was really harsh about grading late work, would give edits at the last possible minute, scored half the class really low (favoritism), constantly stressed students out and would not give clear directions. She would give feedback that drastically altered assignments a couple hours before deadline and padded the class with mind numbing speakers.

Kara is a great professor. She really cares about students, but you have to show up and put in the work. She's going to help you out more if you try to establish a relationship with her. She cares and wants to help you be successful. Can be a tough grader at times, but gives good feedback on assignments. Take 4824 with her - it was a great class.
SHE IS AMAZING!

Very helpful course. Weekly newsroom shifts in 4824 let us put everything into practice to build experience and portfolio. Lots of guest speakers to build networking opportunities. Somewhat project heavy with lots of long-term assignments, but she is very helpful throughout the semester.
Extremely tough grader, gives vague instructions and will deduct points if the rubric is not followed exactly how she wants it to be. Does not respond well to emails

She would take points off from assignments and claim that I hadn't followed the rubric. What she would take points off for were not reflective of my work and her claims were not consistent with the contents of the rubric. This is a 1 credit hour online class with minimal work and minimal instruction and yet the grading was difficult.

she gave a lot of extra credit and gave good instructions about the assignments, the class content was little bit disorganized but still there was nothing too dfficult and assignments didn't take much time to do

I think prof. Edgerson is a good professor. I communicated with her few times and she responded within hours. She was respectful and understanding in her responses. The course was easy and she also gave a lot of extra credit opportunities, which was. great. I think she just expects studnets to pay attention to rubric and wants to see quality work.
I did not like her grading system, I did not like the class.
She's just not helpful at all. Nothing against her she just isn't helpful and the class is honestly pointless if you use social media regularly and are a worldly person.
Very unclear person overall. By far my least favorite professor I've had at Mizzou.

Kara was a horrible professor. No clear grading criteria. Will take off tuns of points for saying you missed things when those things were not in the rubric but saying they were. If you email her a question about your grade she is so rude back. Literally avoid her at all costs. She is so miserable.

kara is a terrible communicator. I am a straight-A student, and I am finishing with a C because she does not communicate properly. I would send follow-up after follow-up emails, and she would ignore them or send unclear instructions when I had questions or concerns. Avoid this teacher.

She grades so hard for no reason like this is an online class lets be so for real. Will take off 15 points for missing things that were not even mentioned in the rubric. Makes assignments way harder than they need to be. Discussions weekly and she grades very hard on those as well. If you can take it with another professor you should.

This professor was one of the most challenging professors I have ever had. She was rude when asked why she graded things a certain way, and was not lenient at all. I would not recommend this professor to anyone.

I was so excited for this course and am extremely disappointed. It seems like you will know what to do on assignments and then be blindsided by 0s, not understand why, and suddenly have an awful grade. Why would a uni known for a good journalism program have this prof??? The course is 1 credit and shouldn't even be worth that.
Professor is incredibly unclear about expectations and is rude to students. She is trigger-happy giving 0s to students when they don't read her mind. Don't even bother taking her class.

So. She is a good teacher but the ways she grades SUCKS. if u get a bad group for the semester long group assignment ur put of luck. That's what happened to be i got an a on ever exam and did my work but the 30 points i missed because of my teammates are why I couldn't get an A.

Stacie is a great professor who truly cares about her students. She can be a tough grader, but she's supportive and open to concerns. The class is one big group project with 4 tests and weekly group homework that builds into the final project. Not too hard, but there's a heavy focus on presenting and groupwork.
She rocks and has a lot of real world experience
Super easy class would reccomend
Stacie Kane is easily the best professor I've ever had. She really takes the time to get to know her students and cares deeply about their ability to learn. She is seriously so awesome.
Stacie Kane has such an amazing heart. I hope to stay connected to her beyond this class. She always tries to make class fun and interactive. She truly cares for her students.

Stacie is very nice and energetic, the class is "writing intensive" but I wrote 3 papers the whole semester. Very straightforward class, textbook is provided for you but I didn't use it once. There is a group project, but it's fairly easy. We often had guest speakers during lecture which made class interesting.

This is an online course that requires LOTS of time. Each week you need to complete about 20 assignments and an exam on Sunday nights, but it isn't hard work just very time consuming and you have endless attempts for the assignments only. You can work ahead of time too since she unlocks weeks worth of work in advance.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this class online, and it was very easy. There is one unit per week (approximately 15 in total), and it takes about an hour to complete. All assignments are multiple choice or matching with unlimited checks, including each unit test. Would highly recommend this class!

Unfair grading system and not clear with homework instructions. I wouldn't take another class of hers again. 

I wasn't given access to an assignment and when I told her I was docked points for it. She was rude when I reached out about it and was unreasonable too. Her instructions are also not clear and she typically doesn't follow her own rubric.

I took it online and it was a very easy A. Every week there were about 15 assignments, but they were very easy and only took about an hour to complete. Quizlet and Google will become your life and savior. She was very caring with weekly check-in emails. Great course overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I don't know the professor well but that is good because I could do the course asynchronously with no problems! There are a lot of assignments but they are not very difficult if you utilize the textbooks. Great course for future work!

Overall good content, grades a bit tough and sometimes takes off points for reasons that seem iffy. We had a journal prompt each week which was 250 words, but was graded complete/incomplete and not worth any points even if you completed. You failed if incomplete. Irritating to produce quality work and find out I could have done the bare minimum.

This class is basically done entirely on Cengage, so she does not really teach that much, but all due dates and required materials are clearly outlined and given to you at the beginning of the semester. If you ever have questions or need assistance she is more than willing to help. Overall, a very interesting class that teaches you a lot!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: A lot of discussion boards, but it makes for easy points. In the beginning of the semester I mixed up the due date for initial discussion board posts for the due date of discussion board responses, but that was my fault. She provided feedback for assignments and graded fairly. The class was very well organized and I enjoyed her teaching style.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This is one of my first online classes I had to take at Mizzou, but this online class is an easy A, that is, if you do your readings and discussion board, as well as acing your HW and quizzes, even with the two paper assignments!  Best of all, no final exam!
Turn in your homework on time.  Write your papers so they can be easily read/understood.  Turn in your homework on time.  You'll be fine.
idk why there are so many bad ratings, like, Joel is the best, although i definitely did not learn anything.

just no. you could read his entire book, go to every lecture, and still be super confused on the exams. There is a reason the curves are 10 points. he is a great guy though. very funny. 10/10 entertainment. and his homework/projects are super easy.

I took Marketing 3000 over the summer and had a much easier time than students who took it in person. He covers the material, but you definitely have to be paying close attention to every word or you will for sure miss crucial information.

Knows students don't like him, has no reason to change. Uses shock humor in lectures, crickets. The textbook is self-written and full of typos. Research participation is "optional" if you consider a 1,200-word journal essay an alternative to an in-person, out-of-class study for which you get a week's notice. Overall, not hard, just a waste of time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Joel Poor is hilarious, and his lectures and self-written textbook are actually pretty interesting. Also, all the assignments he gives you are super easy and he doesn't assign much. He doesn't really give you instruction on what to study or give a study guide, multiple choice practice tests, which makes the tests hard. Going to be my first A-.

I mean hes impossible to listen to in class, he always goes off on random tangents and it makes it impossible to stay focused during classes. The class has barely any structure or guidance, and we have about 6 grades total. The tests are just guaranteed fails and praying for the curve. Seems a bit unfair to me.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor is usually relaxed. But, once he skipped a class without notice, leaving us waiting for 15 minutes before we all decided to leave. He didn't apologize at the next lecture and acted as if nothing happened. Don't know why he made us earn a cert that teaches us how to use AI better when there's better certs.

He created his own textbook, which is filled with spelling and typing errors that are behind autoaccess, including the lecture slides. You can't skip any lectures, as even minor details could be on the exams. He easily loses focus. He does give some curves, or else no one would pass his exams. In class ai assignments and ai certificate.
Guys been put on leave by the university, look it up. Lectures are unrelated to the material at all. His test questions are bizarre and make it unnecessarily hard. Try to take any other professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Two tests, and like 4 assignments is your whole grade. Made the only required class material his book he wrote. Never stays on task during lectures.
The class was very book-heavy but also confusing about what content should be taken seriously.
He is very funny and good at what he teaches. The tests are most of the grade and are very difficult but he curves them very generously. If you read the textbook there is not much to worry about.

I wish Mizzou had different Marketing 3000 teacher options. Joel Poor rambles on during his lecture and does not actually teach. The textbook used in class is one he wrote himself- which has many typos and does not actually help you learn anything. You have 5 assignments all semester, and 2 tests which heavily impact your grade. Good luck with him.

The best word to describe Joel Poor is OK. Get an A on all the homework and other assignments and get B-C on exams and you'll pass the class, class itself is weird and he ends it whenever he feels like it but he is OK

He is a horrible teacher, rambles on and on, and does not allow for any makeup or late work no matter the circumstance. There's two exams that impact grade heavily and barely any assignments. The class is centered on a textbook he wrote, that's overly complicated & useless; and I found countless typos in it. Test questions are extremely specific
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I want to start off by saying Joel Poor seems like a great guy. He is hilarious and super kind, which helped me pay attention in class. However, his exams mostly aren't based on concepts, they're just super random questions. For ex. “Which example did I use from class.” I had a 4.0 before this semester but will be receiving an A- from this class.

Joel is tough. While his lectures are fine, he makes great jokes and has lots of industry experience, he shouldn't be a professor. His exams are awful, and there are barely any chances to get your grade up. Getting one bad exam grade tanked my final grade, and he doesn't round up. All I can say is READ THE TEXTBOOK and pray
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Weirdest business class I've taken. 50% of your grade is automatic 100s, but the exams I have nightmares from his exams. They're based on his textbook (which he doesn't lecture on). Most questions are "which statement is correct?" followed by 5 unrelated sentences. Unless you're Joel Poor himself, they're a living hell.

You can get by in the class if you read and take notes from the textbook. Don't expect him to be lenient on assignments, even if you encounter a technical error he will NOT regrade an assignment. His knowledge on marketing is outdated and inaccurate at times, and half of lectures are on AI and not marketing.

I actually enjoy the lectures and the content of marketing 3000, but joel makes it impossible with his exams that dont correlate with class content and there isnt much opportunity outside of exams to raise your grade.

I know a lot of people don't like Joel in MRKT 3000, but he is awesome in MRKT 4440. Class is very discussion based so you get to hear from your peers a lot. Almost every class is entertaining. Joel makes jokes to keep the lecture light. This discussion based class is SO much better than sitting and being lectured at.

Joel really only cares about your class participation in this course. Class is mandatory but if you just talk in class and have a decent group project, you will be fine. He is also absolutely hilarious and loves to make jokes in class that sometimes don't make any sense.
fun guy. Not a challenging class just read the books.

He rambles on about random topics he makes up. I have always been an A student with maybe a B a semester. I got a 40% on the first exam because the book was barley on the test and the content is made up Joel poor nonsense.

Joel is an okay professor...but he definitely shouldn't be teaching classes of 500 students at a time. I never know what I needed to learn in his classes, and everything felt very unorganized. The marketing material itself SEEMED easy, but for some reason those exams still found a way to confuse me.

There were 4 total assignments in this 8-week course. 2 of them instruct you to use ChatGPT. This entire class felt very low effort from the professor's side. There were 2 tests, each 60 questions. The tests are where I struggled since there was practically no teaching from him, it was up to you to figure it out. Wouldn't recommend him online.
Test heavy, make sure to review lectures and textbooks. He does graciously curve but don't depend on it. I thought the material was interesting to learn as well.

It's a very test-based course, STUDY STUDY STUDY. I would review lectures and read the textbook as well. The wording can be challenging to interpret on his exams, but as long as you are prepared, you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His ego was the reason his class was difficult. I enjoy the class material but he presented it in a way that made learning difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Even if he isn't the hardest professor, he sucks. He rambles and goes into the class with the attitude of wanting some people to fail. He called me out in the middle of his lecture with 300 people saying that I was late when I just went to the bathroom. He just thinks embarrassing people is fun.

Worst professor ever. He rambles on about random stuff and makes very odd jokes. Attending lecture is pointless. There are only three assignments and the rest of your grade depends on exams. Exams are worded very POORly and this is just the worst class ever. DO not take a class with him, you will regret it.

Joel Poor does not teach well. He often gets sidetracked, and tends to make distasteful jokes. I would look him up, there was a news piece on him. If this class is required for you, good luck. If it's not and you wanted just a fun marketing elective- DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS.

The professors use their status to mask insecurity, making courses harder to boost their ego. While lectures may be interesting, he hides behind professionalism, especially with tenure. If possible, drop the class or switch professors. Or use study groups and outside resources. Education should be about learning, not catering to a professor's ego.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: There's a difference between good professor and good person. He lacks the former. An example of a test question is “ What is an example of innate need that a student said in class.” Very poorly designed course with no material outside of lectures. The book available is written by the professor and it shows, with spelling/grammar mistakes every page

Joel Poor is not a helpful and insightful professor. Every lecture he rambles on about random things. There is no point in going to the lectures because all he does is ramble. There are also no points other than exams. There are three 50 point exams and only two other assignments, thats it. He also wrote the textbook himself and it is awful.

He makes lectures interactive with the student and uses really good examples to help you learn the material. His personality makes it fun to learn about marketing. He wrote the book that you buy, so there isn't any extra reading which is nice! His tests are hard, but if you go to lecture and study like you should, you will get an A!

90% of lectures are irrelevant, borderline-inappropriate rants, and 10% useful information. Horrible professor. Focuses on small details from class where he usually goes off on a tangent. Go to class. Exams are pretty much impossible so make sure you memorize the entire book in order to know the exact definitions. Don't take this class unless absolutely necessary. Would not recommend. Doesn't really teach the information that's on exams.

Joel was hilarious and kept class light.  He was an entertaining professor and never bore you to death.  But that doesn't mean to not take his class seriously.  You really have to pay attention to the notes and attend class or you will not do well.  His tests are VERY tricky and studying ahead of time is a must.

This class is not going to be easy, and anyone who has taken it will tell you the same thing. Tests are some of the most difficult ones I've taken, and he aims to trick you. Your best bet is to memorize everything -- he tests minute details rather than useful course concepts.
have taken three classes with him.. and he is by far my favorite teacher I've ever had a mizzou. ya he's hard. but if you study you will do well. also he is so funny

Nearly every class period he will go on a tangent that has nothing to do with the material, which he expects you to memorize for the test. Tests are impossible. Half of the questions are direct quotes from the book. Rode the curve to a C+.

Based on what we discussed in class, which of the following companies would be a good example of a ____?). Attendance is not monitored, therefore not mandatory, but you should go as much as possible. Good guy.
Exams are tricky.

Absolutely terrible. The tests are purposely designed to trip you up. Tests on the most random details in the textbook and on random examples in class. Also, the tests have a lot of "all of the above".

Joel Poor is hilarious and a lot of fun but don't let that fool you. His tests are impossible and many questions are examples used in lectures SO DON'T SKIP CLASS. There are only two exams and reading the textbook is a MUST to do decent on them.

Yeah he's funny and all but that gets old real fast when the tests are extremely difficult and tricky for no reason and he spends class time joking around and getting off topic. The material shouldn't be hard but when it's not covered in class and shows up on the tests it makes the class extremely frustrating. Would not recommend.
His lectures are funny, but very vague. You have to read the book and go to class in order to pass the tests because he uses references from both.
He is very helpful to reach out and help students.

Joel is a great professor but you absolutely have to pay attention during lecture. Lectures  hilarious. Tests  Extremely hard.    Joel's the kind of guy you'd want to have a beer at a bar with. However, the tests are hard and cover both the book and random things said in lectures. You'll have a laugh, learn a lot, but might not get a good grade.

He spends most of the class asking for examples instead of actually teaching the material. The tests are ridiculously hard and 90% of your grade is based on test scores. Either take the class online or at another school.

He is a great teacher but you have to read the book and study for tests. There are only two tests and really pay attention to class examples because they will sneak up as test questions! READ THE BOOK. Half of the tests are from the book! Study and you will do fine.
Not an easy class, but the material was relevant and time spent in class was always time spent laughing. Very helpful if you go and speak with him in office hours.
His lectures are the greatest! Exams were difficult though because it is all reading the book.

I enjoyed this class thoroughly because Joel Poor is such an entertaining individual and the subject matter is somewhat interesting and easy to comprehend. His tests are difficult to say the least. Not too bad until the final. Lot of "all the above" "two of the above"

Learned nothing.  Tests questions are designed for failure.  Instructor emphasizes more so on in class examples, rather than knowledge of concepts, for exam questions.  I needed this class for graduation, but it was for sure a waste of money for the amount I actually learned. To bad there wasn't another professor for this course...
The class itself isn't bad at all, but the tests are rather difficult. The class is only out of 100pts so know everything like the back of your hand if you want an A.

Joel is a great guy. He made it clear that he was there to be a resource for you if you needed anything in your college career. He is hilarious  and keeps the class engaged. I practically aced the class, but I had a natural interest in the subject. If business is your thing, his class is designed for your success. HIGHLY recommend.

Joel is a fantastic teacher and his lectures are interesting, if you are taking this class you obviously have some interest in marketing so you will enjoy it. His jokes always have me laughing in class, even though it's an early class. The tests are NOT as hard as everyone says, but you HAVE to go to class and you HAVE to read the book.
He's a funny guy but his tests are impossible. I studied days in advance for hours per day and still only managed a C on his tests. And there's only 3 grades in the whole class- 2 tests and one quiz.

Teacher is extremely funny and cool, however his tests are not. The tests are very tough, and it requires you to definitely read the book. Just study the book meticulously, and enjoy the lectures and you will be fine :)

Extremely hard class. He makes his tests so specific that you have to know a random example given by a classmate. The whole class is his comedy show and he essentially teaches you nothing. Lowest grade I have received in college thus far.

Joel was extremely vague and I did not learn anything new in his class besides the fact that he tests over very specific examples from the book and from class that may or may not be important or valuable to what you are actually trying to learn.

Poor, is extremely funny, can easily get off task during lecture but he was very knowledgeable. You could tell that he knew what he was talking about but the information in lecture was so general you couldn't pass the class with just that information. Reading the book and asking and asking the TA questions was a MUST in order to pass his class.

I thought this class was a lot easier than people here say. Poor is a great professor and a riot to have class with. The lectures are extremely important to go to! DO NOT SKIP. Read the book and you will be fine. I got mid B's on both tests but didn't study much at all. Really this is not that hard and its fun. Just do the reading and go to class.

Class was enjoyable, until test days. There are things on the exam that are not covered in class, so reading the chapters is required. The exam scores were curved. Two projects that were relatively simple to complete.
Joel Poor is one of the coolest professors ever, but his two tests are extremely difficulty. Keep up with the readings and study hard!
He is really funny and tests are not impossible as everybody says, as long as you go to most classes and read your textbook before an exam you should be fine. Really interesting class!
He's nice but after awhile he gets annoying. Test are impossible! I don't know how people pass with an A or even a B in this class.
His exams did not match his lectures and the questions on his exams were quite confusing.
He's an interesting professor, just not exactly the most informative...tests are unbelievably hard
Hes very funny but his tests are impossible! Plus there are no other grades in the class. I only passed because of the curve.
A really cool guy to listen to in lecture but the exams are extremely difficult due to wording and the depth of the content you are expected to know/learn on your own.

Joel is really cool, class is fun, but tests are ridiculous. If you're comparing to someone like Tim Wade, Joel is infinitely more fun, interesting, and a good person. But his tests are much harder as well. You will laugh every class, and cry after every test.

Very funny and enthusiastic but his test are difficult! Our class average was like a low C! He gets off topic a lot but don't let that fool you! Pay attention to everything and study the textbook as much as you can!
Nice guy but he expects you to have every inch of lecture notes and book chapters memorized on the test. Don't let his nice personality fool you, the tests are hard.
Great guy, funny as hell but his tests are impossible. DO NOT let the first one get you. It may seem easy but you have to study like crazy.

He's one of the coolest and funniest teachers you'll have. The class seemed like the easiest thing ever but the test are very difficult for what was covered in the class, you have to read a lot more then whats in his powerpoint.
Tests were REALLY hard. Poor is very funny and a nice guy, but that didn't really make up for how difficult it was.

He is a very interesting guy, and more than willing to offer help when you need it. He may not be the best teacher on the planet, but he's not trying to make you give up, he tries to instruct. If you need help deciding what to go into, ask him. He's got experience in Advertising, Engineering and Business. He'll help you out.

Joel is pretty hilarious and made me want to go to class.  Don't underestimate the course though!  It's not as simple as it seems!  Study thoroughly for the tests.  He hooks you up with big curves though so that is nice.
I loved him. He was a very good teacher and his class was very interesting and taught extremely well.

Too early to pay attention and it?s only on Fridays so you will never want to go. He says some pretty funny stuff if you?re awake. Tests are hard. Go to class, especially when you?re discussing an article. Read the book thoroughly. Content seems easy but it?s harder than it seems!

I loved attending class. He is a funny guy with lots of job experiences with stories to go with it. His test are extremely hard even if you know the stuff front to back. Tries to trick you and make you second guess yourself. Don't know anybody that got an A or high B.

Very fun class. I thought it was really easy and the notes were very helpful. Poor kept the class very entertaining and made me want to come every week. The topics covered really gave an overview of the business world. Definitely recommend this class if you are even thinking about Business.
He's a good teacher. He makes things funny and interesting. You have to go to class to do good on the test although attendance is not mandatory.

Joel poor is my favorite professor this semester. His lectures are interesting, and he keeps class fun. His test can be hard, but just study the vocab and read the chapter/articles before the test and you'll get a decent grade. Attendance is not required, but he gives test questions and answers in class.

Joel Poor is the nicest guy. But BEWARE: his tests are deceptively hard. Lecture is very dumbed down compared to what he tests on. Read the book twice. Also, the lecture hall is filled with about 600 business school bros so coming to class is hard to stomach as a journalism major.

Joel Poor is simply the best.  He is hilarious, knows his subject matter, and truly has an interest in his students (despite how many are in his classes).  The course is challenging yet his teachings style makes the work definitely worth it.  Take Joel Poor for any class you can!

Do not take this course online. I am assuming you need to be present to understand his teaching methods. The only thing I have learned from this course is that asphalt isn't reliable. If I filled in all "c's" I would have probably done better. Trick questions? Really? Why not make your students right essays or short answer questions.

He makes learning marketing fun.  His tests are tricky if you don't go to class.  He tests in a way that makes sure you know the answer for sure and won't talk yourself into other answers.  His class was hilarious too!

This class was completely useless, I didn't learn anything. He didn't take the class seriously, yet the tests were very hard. Test questions reflected discussions from class as well as concepts from the book. I hoped to actually get a good taste of the business school, but the professor did not take the class seriously.

Joel is a stand-up comedian, not an advocate for education. After the laughs from his 400-person audience when real questions arise he's no help, not to mention downright unreasonable, when it comes to individual student's needs. Enjoy the comedic act while you can. Find a way to only have him once.

Joel Poor's jokes are... well poor, but he keeps class interesting and keeps you laughing (with him or at him). He is very willing to help you if you ask and the tests aren't too hard, just do the reading before class just in case he asks questions. He curves the tests quite a bit and if you do what you are expected to you should get a good grade.

Love this guy! Really made class interesting, great examples. However, don't mistake fun for seriousness..the exams are HARD. Even if you go to all the classes, be prepared to really study. He got me there! Sneaky snake.

I have so much love for Joel Poor - his class is by far the most fun I've been in. He's a genuinely nice guy and he really likes what he does. That being said, don't be fooled by his easy-going manner. Tests are HARD and you MUST read the book. I made the mistake of slacking off for the first test and it's turned out to be a real GPA killer.

Lecture makes the class seem easy; but I warn you his tests are very hard and requires a lot of studying. Be prepared and go to class. He will use a lot of examples from class. Besides that he is a great teacher and makes class interesting with his jokes and such.
Pretty funny guy and made class somewhat interesting. The material is very easy to comprehend, but he tries to trick you with his test questions, using a lot of examples from class.

went to class maybe 3 times the whole semester (excluding exam days)....still managed to pull off an B. study notes and make sure you go when there's a guest speaker, but other than that this class is a waste of time.

Worst class ever. I went to every class, studied for hours before the test, and still managed to only pull off a C. As an A student in the honors college, this was definitely my most hated class at Mizzou!

He is the funniest teacher I've ever had and keeps class extremely entertaining.  He uses great examples and makes you laugh all the time (and it's all stuff related to the subject).  However, his tests are very difficult and tricky.  You must study a lot for his exams in order to do well.  If you put in the effort, this is a very fun class.
poor

He is extremely funny and will keep you entertained all hour, which helps if you don't like the material. His examples are easy to understand and he uses most of them on the exams. They are HARD. Read the book. Go to EVERY class. Even if you study your butt off, the tests are harder than you thought. The curve helps...but just be prepared.
His tests are pretty tricky, but class is entertaining and enjoyable.  Yes, his jokes are bad, but his goofiness is entertaining.

Joel Poor's comedy hour is by far the funniest, yet hardest class.  His tests are impossible and I've heard his final is meant to screw you.  He uses good examples and as long as you are in class and do the readings, you will do okay on the tests.  His tests are hard though.
great guy. he is really funny in class and uses great examples that get your attention and really help you learn the material.
No Comments
This class well where to start, Joels jokes are terrible, O and so are his tests!!!!! I hope you enjoy hell expect to see none of the above or all of the above on just about every answer!!!

Don't let him fool you with his jokes. While class can be entertaining, there is a lot of material. He pulls a lot of questions from the book only and uses examples specifically given in class. He tries to trick you by giving answers like "all the above" ,"none of the above" or " a and b only" which sucks! Be prepared to actually study some.

Aweful teacher.  Rambles on in class and flirts with girls.  Doesn't talk at all about marketing only about himself.  The class however is very easy if you read the book.  Don't go to class b/c the notes are totally uselss, just read.

Easy class, just read the packet and take a few notes. I'd recommend reading over all the material again before the test, because there isn't much. Curves were about 5 points on tests (each being worth 50 points), thanks to the hoards of stupid kids in the class, so it helps.

I don't know what these people are talking about...this guy had the easiest tests I have ever taken.  If you read, you're golden.  If you are illiterate, you may have problems.  But in this case, you probably are in the wrong place...something to think about.

I hate this class.  The lectures are dull and just seem to go on and on and on.  The tests are just bizarre.  No matter how much you study, you just can't be prepared for the exams.  They're just nit picky.  I dread what this will do to my average.  Thanks, buddy.
Easy and interesting class. The tests are not as easy as the notes may seem. Make sure to go to class and take very good notes. The tests are based on his examples in class.

he makes you think its going to be an easy class, but its not, you really have to study and know everything he tells you to know, there was no final so that was nice, and the curves helped, but if you go, take good notes, and study its not that bad and you should be able to get a c

He was a good teacher.  The only thing I can suggest is to go to class.  He uses a lot of examples from class on the exam.  If he repeats anything more than once, write it down and highlight it.  Most likely, it will be on the exam
Good classes and keeps people engaged. only thing wrong with class is that tests are very unpredictable and thats basically all you are graded on.
study the notes
No Comments

He's funny and entertaining.  But where are his test questions coming from?  He asks questions of picky details that aren't even the main subject.  Study in detail for this class.  But sometimes, he reuses the questions from sample exams.
The class is well organized, just study the packet. I think he wore some sort of pastel color every single day. Very entertaining.
Doesn't teach that well but everything is well organized in the notes so not that hard of a class. plus he is pretty entertaining not that bad of a class
No Comments
Professor Poor makes the class interesting and fun.
doesn't have a clue as to how he is teaching
No Comments
easy class just study and read

He is a terrible teacher!  He tells you it is going to be really easy and it isn't at all.  He gives stupid pointless lectures and never puts any of the stuff on the test except maybe one question of an example that is really obscure, so you don't remember it anyway.  Joel Poor Sucks!
No Comments
He "tells you what is going to be on the tests" but it appears that 1/50389 of those hints aren't on the test...that's awesome Joel
Tests are impossible.  Class is near worthless, but you still have to go just in case he gives a specific example of something that will be on the test.

He makes you think that the class is a lot easier than it is. Even after you take the first test and know that his questions aren't covered in class, he still tries to tell you that it gets easier and his class isn't hard to pass.
He makes the class seem easy but the tests are really quit difficult. However, there is a curve and extra credit available.

He tells corny jokes but that just makes him funnier. I didn't do so well in the class because the tests sucked, but then again it was first month of first semester, and all you needed to do was pass the class. Either way, know the material, the tests aren't as easy as he says.
No Comments

He makes you think the class is going to be easy with his lectures, then asks you questions about things he never lectured on. Tests are very hard, and the questions are tricky. I wish I had not taken this class.
He's funny but in a somewhat creapy way... Overall not too bad of a class.  Oh yeah, and he does the Barbie and Ken thing every semester-- it's not new.
His tests suck.  Often felt material was irrelevant.
The most boringest class i have ever taken.  He would tell dumb jokes the whole time and he thought he was so funny.  Then the tests were full of wquestions i had never seen before
His jokes are lame he drags class out for the full time by telling dumb jokes that he finds hilairous.  Not that hard though
He's ok, funny but kind of hard
this guy is awesome! makes me laugh every class.
I actually wanted to pay attention! He was so funny!
Really funny guy, tests are very hard and poorly written.  However, I got C's on the first 3 tests, and an A on the final and ended up with a B.  There is a huge curve in the class.
A very funny guy, but gets annoying after a while.  He spends too much time in lectures digressing and trying to be funny.  The questions on the exams are often poorly written and very hard.

Lectures were informative and interesting.  But exams (midterm is 40% of your grade, final is 60%)had ridiculously specific and completely irrelevant questions, making the class much harder than is probably necessary for a lower level 1 credit course.

Great teacher.  Keeps it interesting and has exceptional real-world examples.  Those who think his tests are too difficult are the ones who give business majors their current bad reputation.  Seriously not difficult.
Unlike everyone else, I did not like Joel Poor. His humor annoyed me and it was just a total act to get people to like him. His class was somewhat hard and you have to study hard.
Tries to make the class fun, tests can be diffcult, but not if you keep up on reading, and study prior to them.
Great presenter, very funny, and very straight forward in terms of what you need to study.  Tests are challenging and worth A LOT so study very hard for them.
This guy is hilarious...his tests suck but he makes class fun, so taking his classes is worth it..I've never fallen asleep
He should be a comedian instead of a teacher.  He would tell you how easy his test were and they were not.  Study for his tests and dont let his "act" fool you
Like everyone else said, hard tests, but an awesome teacher!  They're not too hard if you just pay attention to the note packet and read a little bit.
Funny guy.  Fun class.  Hard tests that require a good amt. of studying to do well.
The tests are hard and you can't over think the questions or you will do poorly.  I was in the class were the final was so hard it was droped.
Class is alot of fun. He makes class enjoyable. You HAVE to go to class to do good on tests though.
fun, informative class...hard tests
No Comments
Don't let his fun personality obscure you're thinking of his tests.  He might joke around a lot and have fun in class, but make sure you study really hard for his tests.

Kerwin is particular, but awesome. Classes themselves are discussion based and free flowing. Attendance is mandatory and unexcused absences do require short essays to receive credit. Very unique essay style that prioritizes exploratory commentary over argumentative analysis. If you've got the space to take a Kerwin class, do it.

A truly good teacher who cares about his students. If you take any of his classes, you are guaranteed to improve your writing and reading skills. He's a funny guy, and a very tough grader. His feedback can sometimes be ambiguous, but overall, he will make you a better student.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: SO much reading for this class but I will admit I learned a lot
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: A fun person to talk to if you go to his office hours but his class is difficult. He does not give out a 100 on nearly anything and will always find something that you need to improve upon. His feedback is sometimes helpful but not often & he gives confusing instructions on assignments. He also has a tendency to interrupt people during discussions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very funny, and knowledgeable prof, but a truly tough grader for English majors. I enjoyed his class, and you will become a better writer if you have him as a professor; he's very encouraging, and is amazing about checking his email/responding quickly. He made me smile on tough days, and I recommend taking him.

HARD grader. he is funny and asks big questions. you can tell he has lots of experience. loves demedicalizing medicine so ur papers will do better if you talk about that. big on commentary. so much reading for this class and some are hard texts. also 2 big papers, 5-7 books and 2 presentations and discussion posts.

Attendance is pretty mandatory, he gives weekly quizzes, and there's a paper for every book you read.  If you're open to a lot discussion and fun analysis he's for you. He always provides critques of the works and encourages diverse voices and opinions. Gives great feedback and actually teaches you how to write good papers. Tough but fun.

I decided to do the Irish summer program with Dr. Kerwin this past summer and absolutely loved it! Yes, there were many readings needed for class, but all are necessary to have an interesting discussion! He's very open to other ideas and interpretations of the texts. By far one of my favorite professors at Mizzou!

This was probably the worst class I've ever taken. If you take this class you will have to read up to 200+ pages a night just to keep up with the class. A few quizzes but most of your grade lies in a final project that amounts to 65% of your final grade. His grading criteria is very unclear on individual assignments and attendance is VERY mandatory
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Great prof. Made the material interesting and always encouraged participation (including different POVs about the text/films). Pop quizzes but graded consistently so you knew how to prepare.  10/10 would take another class from Dr. Kerwin.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Out of nearly 50 authors listed in the syllabus, only 4 were female. Three hundred something years, dozens of famous female poets during the Renaissance, and that's all the space he wanted to give them? Hmm.

He is the best professor here. I take 8 am class so it would be a tough act for me, especially about Shakespeare. But i was wrong. He is great and humorous and he help students with their works. He really cares about his students. Just remember to study the readings as he has pop quizzes. The exams are great as long as you study the materials.

I have to say Kerwin is a nice & awesome guy outside of Campus. I had the privilege of getting to know him as a person & not just a professor. I've even had a beer with the guy! But, sticking w class, he's such a strict grader. He often gives 8.5 out of 10 as the norm for a weekly paper. Perhaps he likes to have an equal distribution of grades.
He's very intelligent and knows his stuff. He's also pretty patient when it comes to helping students understand.

Prof. Kerwin was probably the best prof. I've had at MU. He is very intelligent, knows his material and most importantly he treats his students like human beings and not burdens. I highly recommend taking him for any course he offers.
Epitome of a traditional & great prof.

I don't know if it is possible to say something positive about Kelli. The panopto lectures were a total of 93 minutes (across the entire semester mind you). One of the supplemental videos for a topic was also in Bulgarian?

Lectures were boring and read straight off the slide. Group project required for an 8-week online course and was unhelpful when I emailed her about my group not doing their part. Used YouTube videos with less than 10 subscribers to back up most of her lectures and some of them weren't even in English. Doesn't post your cumulative grade. Avoid!!!!

STEER CLEAR. Her exam questions consist of either stuff that she brushes over or are near common sense. It is very easy to get 70% or so, but impossible to get higher than 85%. She also does NOT let you know what you need to improve on. It is a wonder that she is still teaching at this university.

Exam questions were either really easy or super obscure facts not even mentioned in the lectures. 
Lectures were short and monotone and her intonation and phrasing sometimes made it hard to understand her point. 
Lots of textbook reading to prepare for everything and it didn't even seem to help.

Would take this class in person with a different professor before I took it again with this one.  Exams are open for four hours during the day, which is extremely inconvenient if you have other classes.  She does group projects, which is frustrating for an online course. Also refuses to let you see the quiz scores and correct answers.
She gives no clear expectations and the lectures are super boring and monotone

Avoid at ALL COSTS. Her presentations are terrible (literally just reads off the slides) and is not helpful at all if you reach out for help. Exam questions are also either shockingly easy given the course content, confusing/misleading, or just incorrect. Prepare to have your exam grade rise 10% a week after it's graded

This class is an absolute waste of your time. She grades NOTHING. Everything was either peer-graded, graded by a TA, or multiple-choice. You will be tested on up to 12 chapters an exam, including random statistics. Tests are also during in-person class times. She puts little effort into the class and her grade distributions are terrible. AVOID HER!

Easily the worst professor I've had in my career. Her presentations were very dry and she just read verbatim off the slides, then changed the grading scale to make it HARDER after all of our assignments were graded. Avoid any of her classes with a fifty foot pole.

McB came off nice and organized at first and then the class became a mess. Her canvas is unorganized and hard to find assignments, she expects you to just know things that haven't been taught and read her mind. Also, dont bother emailing her because she wont respond of if she does its short and snappy.

This whole class is very unorganized. Dr. McBee changed multiple assignments and project requirements days before they were due. She did not give clear instructions on assignments or projects, and half the lectures were just guest speakers. I would not recommend her classes at all.

I feel like due to tenure she is not putting in as much effort in teaching the class. There is a semester long project and although it is do-able it was some times way more difficult than it had to be due to unclear directions and things she just expected us to already know.
Kerri is amazing! I love her personality and her lectures are always interesting. She provides feedback on assignments and is very knowledgeable!

Dr McB was truly one of my favorite professors. Very funny, and makes the lectures as whole very entertaining.The classwork itself is probably the hardest part of the class as it is very group work centered, but other than that I really enjoyed this class!

I took this class Summer 2021 and it was a VERY TEDIOUS class but was fairly easy to understand the main concepts. The explanations for work can be confusing at times so go slow and start early on all the big projects. I recommend this class but be prepared for a lot of busy work in between.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This teacher loves textiles. If you are going into the fashion industry, the class may be better for you. But to someone who just needs an elective I would NEVER recommend. She makes every assignment SO much more difficult than it needs to be. The textiles book combined with the labs she made us record and edit weekly, just bad. You've been warned.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Like many others, I took this class to duck Chem. I thought I had found the easy way out, but man I was wrong. Dr. McBee-Black makes this class as difficult and time-consuming as it could possibly be. The quizzes are full of insanely specific questions and several of the labs took me almost an entire day. Definitely just take Chem or Geology.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: She does assign a lot of work, but she makes her expectations pretty clear. Shes a tough grader, but if you read and reread all of the instructions and follow them perfectly, youll get a good grade. She offers an extra credit assignment every week, which I really appreciated.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: All I have to say is that she is so rude & doesnt care about her students. So much busy work & so hard for no reason. Every week theres a study guide where there are at least 50 vocab words to define & questions. Quizzes are lowkey hard too. Dont take this class. She makes everything so confusing

By far the worst professor and class Ive ever had. There is an absurd amount of work for a class that honestly doesnt matter. Im talking "study guides" due each week with a min. of 50 vocab words to define from textbook only worth 5 POINTS. plus a lab each week, and a discussion post. She is rude and gives a ridiculous amount of work. DO NOT TAKE!!

This is the hardest class I have ever taken, for no reason. She makes everything so confusing and it takes so long to turn everything in correctly. Like I can't simply upload a video you must go through panopto. She makes everything more complicated than it needs to be. Never take a class from her. If you have her as a professor drop or switch.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class was a lot of busy work but it was predictable which is nice especially during these weird times. She responds quickly to emails and grades everything quickly. I would take another class from her for sure.

She is very specific about what she wants you to say in responses. She isn't helpful whatsoever and when I would reach out for having tech difficulties, she didn't care and would give me a bad grade. There's also way too much work and she puts questions on the test that aren't in the lecture. Overall, I don't recommend taking any of her courses.

I would absolutely NOT recommend any class she has to offer. Dr. McBee-Black was one of the most difficult and unsatisfactory professors I have ever had at mizzou. This professor should be ashamed of how she handled her class during this past semester. I have never had a lower level, non-major class have this much homework and unnecessary work.

Very nitpicky with assignments, doesn't grade in a fashionable manner, and is horrible at explaining things. Not to mention how she puts questions on the tests that aren't in lectures while assigning no readings. Don't take this class unless you have to. Take geology.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is the worst teacher I've ever had. If I didn't take her class in person but if I did, I'd probably argue with her a lot because of how bad she is. I've turned in MULTIPE assignments days before they're due and she'll still put them in as missing. I'm currently failing because she cannot grade to save her life.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: AWFUL AWFUL AWFUL... ABSOLUTELY RIDICULOUS. This teacher doesnt give two craps about what her students needs are or how she can be helpful. She goes about everything in the most complicated and annoying way. Shes disrespectful and rude. Has no regard for helping students succeed. Acts as if everyone is always capable of understanding everything.

LISTEN TO THE REVIEWS DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. Terrible instructor. I feel like I wouldve gotten so much more and even maybe enjoyed the class had it been with a different professor. Very rude and inconsiderate. The tests are very hard and almost impossible to pass.

Most kids take this class to avoid bio or chem and she knows that. she's clearly insecure about her subject so she makes it as hard as possible, while everyone knows its a pointless class. The harshest and rudest professor I've ever had at Mizzou. I would avoid this class at all costs. She makes you buy 2 books and one of them you have to assemble.

Extremely rude from the very beginning, makes every assignment harder than it needs to be, wouldnt help me with the textile kit and gave me a 0 because the video wasnt exactly to her liking. Probably the worst teacher Ive ever had.

Taking online over the summer. McB grades incredibly hard, does not seem approachable, and is incredibly nitpicky over things as stupid as your file name. She seems to care more about how you submit than what you submit. Tests are extremely hard, lecture videos last forever, and the lab instructions are frustratingly vague. 0/10 would not recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Kerri is a great professor. She is highly experienced and educated on the topics she speaks about. She WILL make you work for that A. It is a lot of work, but if you are serious about working in the fashion industry, SHE IS DOING YOU A FAVOR! If you have questions or concerns, she is more than willing to help you and give you advice!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Kerri is a very sweet person, but not a fantastic teacher. I took TAM 2200 as a general lab course, and I would not recommend doing so. This class is really difficult and has a lot of work, the textbook chapters are long and tedious and the tests are extremely difficult. The labs are take-home and pretty easy, though.

Kerri is an amazing professor who knows exactly what she is doing. This class is a lot of work though. 17 worksheets, 7 labs, 8 exams, in addition to class twice a week, recorded lectures, and chapters to read. You have to do the work to pass the class. Kerri is very specific on what she wants so follow directions to a T.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This was without a doubt the worse class I have ever taken at the University of Missouri. Never take this professor. There are EIGHT full on tests and long labs. All lectures are on your own time. You basically don't do anything in class but it's mandatory. Spent at least 15 hours a week on this one class. Listen to the reviews. DONT TAKE IT.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Tough grader, very lecture heavy and she makes you do everything outside of class. If you don't come to class prepared, you will fail
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: There's not much to say about Mcbee-Black other than she's an awful educator with an ego as large as the moon. Don't take a class taught by her, or you will end up contemplating never taking a college class again.

This class made me switch my major from TAM. It was horrible. Get ready for a project all semester long, if you get assigned a bad group you're out of luck. She picks favorites and grades so hard. You have presentations and have to dress business casual, and she grades harshly on how you dress. The material was interesting but she makes it hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. The first project took me 6 hours to complete and it was literally just copying down information on fabric to a binder that I never used once throughout the entire course. Highly recommend!

Dr. King is an amazing psychology teacher but it is obvious that she's also an amazing person. It's easy to see her passion for psychology and her lectures are some of the most engaging I've ever heard. It's important to show up to class but you will want to because she's so funny and down-to-earth. I highly recommend!

Honestly, she isn't just a professor, she's a comedian, researcher, and parent of all of her students. The best professor I've ever had, and I highly recommend her as a teacher. Very easy grader. Loads of opportunity to get an A, and she accepts late assignments. If you want an easy class for your GPA, take one with Dr. King. You won't regret it
It's what you would expect from a typical psych class with an amazing professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Easy class with relatively easy tests. Class graded on tests only. BUT class is exhausting if you don't like story time She has a story example for everything and it's time consuming and boring if you're not into that mode of teaching. Otherwise it is a good course and relatively interesting Not too book heavy; she has you read a few pages per exam
Dr. King is wonderful. She loves what she teaches and does a great job of keeping you engaged during her lectures. She is hilarious, but also very down-to-earth.

LITERALLY SO AWESOME! She is so funny/nice/laid back/and cool! She is very passionate about her work and is very good at teaching it. Kept interesting with adding stories about her own life. I was completely in love with the subject after taking this class. If you get the opportunity, take one of her classes, do. You won't regret it.
My favorite professor, made the class extremely interesting and fun! Even at 8am

Dr. King is the ideal psychology professor! She kept me awake and interested at 8am when I didn't think that was possible. She knows her stuff and has a big passion for it which was great to see. Her personal stories are amazingly funny, I'd highly suggest taking Psych 1000 with her. She's also very willing to help.

Intro to Personality was amazing. Laura King kept an 8 a.m. class interesting, and I was always a little disappointed when I over slept. If you go to class every day, you really don't need the book and she has a really forgiving grading system.

Dr. King is a very sweet person and very funny! Also, she shows her true emotions a lot, so don't be shocked if she cries in class (she cried about 4 times in ours). Make sure you attend class and take notes of everything she talks about that aren't on the Powerpoints. Otherwise, class is a breeze. She offers TONS of extra credit.

Awesome teacher, favorite professor ever. Made the subject matter interesting. Very intelligent, too. You can drop a test, so if you do good on the first four, you don't have to take the fifth. I had her for Intro, too, and loved her. She really cares about what she teaches. Great story teller, too. You won't be bored in lecture.
VERY GOOD TEACHER. EXPLAINS IDEAS WELL. CLASS IS VERY INTERESTING. IF YOU GO TO HER CLASS, YOU DON'T NEED THE BOOK. EXAMS ARE PULLED FROM LECTURE. SO GO TO CLASS!
Funny, warm, intelligent, engaging -- everything a professor should be.
Greatest Teacher EVER!!!

This was the best professor I have ever had. I was interested in the class from the very first day. She seems like more of a student herself that just knows what she is doing rather than a boring professor. Take this class. You wont regret it!

Dr. King is great! Her examples are really funny and relate well to the material. I didn't even mind going to class at 8 a.m. because the class was so engaging. One of the best professors at MU; take her class if at all possible! She gives lots of extra credit, too.
Great teacher. Makes even the dullest of subjects interesting. I had this class at 8 am and I didn't fall asleep once. Gives out extra credit for each test and it brings your grade up a lot.
really fun. I enjoyed going to lectures. Really up front about what is expected from you. The extra credit really helps your grade.
No Comments
No Comments
No Comments

This class focuses on current and past issues in politics today. It's heavily graded on class participation. You are required to attend 2 seminars and write a reflection on them, but they are fast and easy.
Everybody should take this class!!
Best teacher I have ever had. Great guy.

Loved this class! The professor was very easy to understand, lectures were mostly discussions. No tests or quizzes just participation and a few papers. Class set up was very clear. Topic for the day had assigned readings to prepare for discussion. Great professor! Great class! Overall the class was very enjoyable and definitely recommend.

Kim is very knowledgeable and a great instructor! She gives lots of creative freedom and very good feedback. She provides lots of examples for class projects and is very available when you need help. I found the class difficult, mostly because of the time it required. But that is expected when it comes to animation. I definitely learned a lot!

Very knowledgable on the subjects being taught, and had amazing advice or feedback when stuck. Parts of her class, like being required to present every project completed, was horrible, and no one really enjoyed that aspect. I think without that included, everything was great.

I loved that she gave a lot of feedback, but she tended to tear students work down rather than build it up, which was kind of frustrating. Also, her grading system was difficult to get a high A in. But if you're dedicated and really want to go into film - go for it! She's super nice and has a great personality.

I love Prof. Kim! I actually bettered my work because of her and her awesome feedback. You can tell she actually cares about her students success and wants to help. Very nice person and also very understanding. Highly recommend her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor facilitates lots of discussion in class, so be prepared to give lots of feedback on classmates' projects. She gives feedback, but she grades very tough and inconsistent though and I felt that, at times, I was rolling the dice with how well she would grade me. At times I even felt that she wasn't that knowledgeable about the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Kim was by far one of the best professors I've experienced. He made me enjoy learning and genuinely cares about students. He was very accessible outside of class and gave detailed feedback on every assignment. Great professor, and I would definitely take his course again.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Fair. Applicable. Can't complain. Just go to class and pay attention.

His lectures are awful, he talks in circles for an hour. He grades harshly and requires you to answer questions in the exact way he wants them answered or else you won't get full points. Doesn't matter if you got the answer right, if you didn't quote his horrible lecture then you get a C. He also changes the syllabus and doesn't announce it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Attend class!!!! While it isn't mandatory he does give grades for class sometimes. You can only miss 4 classes

I think everyone is being too hard on him. He is a passionate teacher and also funny. While there are in class "pop quizzes" he lets you discuss with people around you and they are only used for attendance. The exams are all online and the homework assignments are all multiple choice. It is easy to get an A in his class i would take again
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: NEVER take this professor if you can help it, not only can he barely speak English. He would give us attendance quizzes every class on stuff we never went over in class. Worst part about this class is I had to go out of town for a funeral, and I told him in advance,and he still gave me a 0 on attendance and my project contribution for those weeks.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He asked for our feedback mid semester then spent a whole class period telling us how we were wrong. He would have random pop quizzes every single day and would give you 2 minutes to complete it, even when they would contain long math problems. He told a student that he could not make up his test even though he was gone for a university event.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Kihyung Kim likes to give daily lecture quizzes to the class. He will give you weekly homework assignments, but will only teach you half of the stuff on the hw so you are forced to learn the other half on your own time. The homework is also extremely long and repetitive. I would advise not taking this class with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
goes on power trips and takes away extra credit for other students behavior 
doesnt grade things correctly 
wont show you previous quiz grades because he doesnt want to show you how he will grade your paper unfairly 
class avg tests from 70%-66% wont curve grades 
failed class by less than a percent as a senior and have to retake the course
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Kathy Kiely is the worst professor in the world. Avoid her section at all cost you will genuinely regret being in the class. She's a tough grader and takes weeks to even grade portfolio assignments. I don't know how her old self is allowed to keep teaching.

While it is true that 4180 is a "weed out" class in the J-School, Kathy makes it fun. Her feedback is very good, and if you put in effort, she will take note. She's honest with you, which is really useful and and she cares about her students. Do well with Kathy and you'll be on track to success in the newsroom. She's a sweetheart!

Professor Kiely has a deep well of knowledge about the history of journalism and challenges students to think critically about the free speech barriers they face in our current technological landscape. She gives detailed feedback and loves to talk to students who are passionate about the work. Her class was one of my favorites in college by far.

The sweetest, smartest woman. If you are nice, ask good questions, show a real interest, do Portfolio Revisions for J4180, and show that you care about getting a good experience out of the class, she'll give you a good grade that reflects that. Don't be afraid of her honesty, she's just showing students what its like to work in a real newsroom.

The best professor I have had by far. She has such an in depth knowledge of journalism that you will learn something just from being in the same room as her. 4180 is not an easy class regardless of the professor you have, but she is always accessible if you need help and genuinely wants you to succeed in the class. Could not recommend her more.

Something about her always rubbed me the wrong way. Some of my group members were genuinely terrified of her because she could be so mean. Even if you have to take the class at 8 am, AVOID her section of 4180, she was truly a nightmare. I've heard she's a nice enough person, but being a successful journalist does NOT mean you should be teaching it.
Tough grader but I love her so much!
She is professional in journalism as well as humorous in taking classes.

Grading is mostly based off her own outdated journalistic style. Says offensive things in class. Expects full time commitment (4 credit hour class), but gets very defensive when students ask for grades or assignments to be posted in a timely manner. Unrealistic standards and insanely unclear instruction. AVOID.

Class was unorganized and requirements were poorly communicated. Professor Kiely was often hard to reach and gave feedback that contradicted her grading. She seemed to have a dated understanding of the field of journalism. Overall, she was not understanding of students and gave the impression that she was too busy to teach this class.

Kiely has been my favorite professor of my Mizzou career, although there were students in my group who would have completely disagreed. 4180 is a lot of work, especially outside of class. Kiely really will hold you to an unshakeable standard, but I liked that. Easy to get ahold of, fair grader & will work with you with deadlines if you communicate.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Class is a slog to get through, if you aren't a comms major, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. While Klien is a nice guy, you will constantly be berated by redundant video lectures, busy work, and tedious projects all with iClicker and assigned seating. Class is unorganized, prof is months behind on grading constantly, and you'll hear the same lecture twice.

Klien makes an what could be an. easy class ridiculously involved and time consuming. The TAs take months to grade assignments and when they finally do it is all over the place. This class is extremely homework heavy (although it has no real relevance to the class) and attendance and class participation are mandatory.

Worst professor I have had at Miz. I have not yet finished his class, but finals are in less than a month, and grades from January have not been put in. In my opinion, if you are requiring your students to put in as much time as you are asking, the least you could do is grade promptly. He cancels office hours every week and never answers emails.

Klien uses a flipped classroom where you watch a video going through the slides for the week. So essentially, you are sitting through the same lecture two times twice a week. This class is nothing more than a waste of time in my opinion. It's an easy A, but homework is not relevant to the content at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Klien is very passionate about the material he teaches, but the class structure isn't supportive of student learning. Canvas is overloaded with lots of "busy work" type assignments that don't really contribute to learning and just take up time outside of class, group/partner work happens almost every class, and lectures are long-winded.

This class is an easy class generally in content and in the big projects. What bothers me about Klien is his over-bearing and almost ridiculous insistence on using AI. Textbook is unneeded except to do unnecessary and repetitive homework through. He also assigned a 3-4 page essay the week of finals, which I didn't really appreciate.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Klien is a nice guy. He cares about the info he teaches. However, the amount of assignments he gives for a communication class is absurd. The 'career capstone' project is a waste of time. I'm a freshman who's not a communication major yet I have to spend hours researching a random career I don't care about. He's not respectful of students time.

Overall I would say that Dr, Klien is a very average professor - nothing outstanding but not the worst professor ever. Lectures are boring, and mandatory with assigned seating. He is also very slow on grading. I would say that this is a class and a teacher that you've just got to sit through for 3 months. Overall not bad but not the greatest.

While Professor Klien is a very passionate professor, he is also very intense. If you are not a Comm major, do not take this class. You will be expected to be just as passionate as he is. Additionally, homework was extreme, and the homework that had to be done prior to class was what the lecture ended up being. So the same material twice.

The grades were not updated in a timely manner so not sure if I will end with an A+ or a super low grade. Lectures are boring and assignments don't really support learning. If its a requirement for you its not horrible but I wouldn't take it for fun because there is a lot of pointless tedious assignments

I LOVE DR KLIEN!! He has so much genuine care for not only his students, but also the comm department as a whole. Students are allowed three skip per semester, but he offers a ton of extra credit that makes up for missed classes. I wish he taught more classes :(

Before the first day of class, Dr. Klein sent out a very, in my opinion, intrusive survey--asked questions about sexual orientation, racial identity, etc.-- that was a requirement. He also burdened us with his own medical information and political affiliation. He shared very unnecessary information too fast that led to me fear him being biased.

While I enjoy this classes content, hes trying too hard to do too many things. A lot of the assignments and projects are based on career prep, which is frustrating as an underclassman who is more so focused on getting to senior year. While he has good intentions, the work load for a class like this is criminal.

he gives out so much homework and so much extra credit. i did every single assignment and got b s on the exams and somehow got an a- which i think i deserve an a+ after all the extra time i had to spend watching the video lessons. this class is good to take its pretty easy and the lectures are blow off but there is an iclicker.

Assigns so much busy work you will be driven insane. He has cancelled almost every office hour due to a different random excuse and not once have we ended class before our end time he runs it over single time without fail. If I could change anything in my time at Mizzou the #1 thing would be to avoid Stephen Klien and any course taught by him.
