IF THAT MANY PEOPLE ARE CHEATING MAYBE YOU ARE THE PROBLEM!  Nobody ever understood what was going on and it is very difficult to do well in. If you aren't good at science and need a lab credit TAKE ANYTHING ELSE!

Don't listen to all the negative reviews of this class. Just read the textbook, and do the lab and it will go by quick. Also, just engage with him if you have questions, he is very quick to respond via canvas.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took it with a "lab" which was just a semester long observation project. He grads the projects super hard. Very few things are graded. You're main grade is on bi-weekly quizzes. These quizzes are 10 questions each worth 5 points multiple choice. The questions are so hard to understand and you spend half the quiz time understanding what it's asking.

He is very specific in his grading but there is a big curve on assignments. Do not take if you don't want to put in the work. There's 8 tests, 3 labs, and a midterm and a final. Our class did so well on the midterm that he made the final optional. Little work but requires a lot of effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Simply do not take this class. I took this class t get a lab credit without a lot of math and this was not worth it. The book is impossible to understand, his "lectures" are 10-15 minute videos where he poorly explains topics with poor drawings and the quizzes are written in such a convoluted way you spend more time solving riddles than learning.

Impossible to speak with. He was incredibly rude to me. I would not recommend anyone taking this course. It doesn't help that the book for the course is written by the professor because there's lots of errors and his work is difficult to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is a intro class to astronomy and it felt like i was trying to re make the movie of interstellar. By far the hardest intro class i have ever taken. You are required to teach your self the entire class because he doesn't post lectures or help you understand the content. It amazes me how this professor is allowed to teach. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This is the worst class I have ever taken in my entire life. I reached out for help multiple times because I didnt understand one of the very first subjects that we talked about (because in his assignment description he didnt tell us how to do it or where to find more information about it) and he was just rude, talked down to me and did not help.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This man provided little to no context in class in order to properly prepare students for exams. There was also a lack of helpful communication when requested. As this was an intro-level course, he had standards set for those of grad-level students. Would not recommend this class.

This class was the hardest class I have ever taken. I took this class during covid-19 and he did not do more to help us students other then to read the book that he wrote which is very hard to comprehend and has lots of errors in it. For his quizzes you are told to read the book and the answers will be in it but they arent. Do not take this class.

Worst professor Ive had at Mizzou. Even if you have a complete understanding of astronomy you will not do well. His class is base solely off of the book he wrote that is practically impossible to read. Lowest grade I've ever received in my career even after spending 15 plus hours a week on it. He was also without wifi all of online finals week??
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: His lectures were so and he never really talked about anything of substance just rambling on, never telling us when something he said was important, which it probably never was. He said reading the textbook would help with quizzes, it doesn't. Plus its 4 credit hours so unless you do well it sucks GPA wise

Due to COVID 19 my class was moved to online and Wouter did not change or adapt the course at all. The material on the quizzes is not easy to find no matter how much you read in his terrible textbook (which the bookstore only gets about half the amount that they need). Also has not posted a single lecture since class became online.

This class is "INTRO to astronomy". Online there are no lectures, so you must understand material based solely on textbook (which he wrote, filled with errors). The content is fascinating but it was super complex & time consuming because you are forced to teach yourself. Homework takes 2 hrs per week w/o the reading & endless googling to understand
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: This is the hardest class i've ever taken content wise.  I received an A - I suck at physics.  Here is how you do it.  Tips to an A: Get in the top 15% of the class Attend all office hours Make sure to get 100% on HW, go to chegg if you must.   Study @ least 20 hours a week before you complain. Know how to do every HW problem by heart

This is a very interesting class.  The electricity, circuits, and lenses and mirrors section gets a little boring, but it is not to tough.  Exams are all multiple choice and if you study the recitation problems, practice exam, and mastering physics problems you will do well.

Only 12 questions on exams, which cover four chapters per exam. So hopefully you study the right things! I love the class, but I don't feel like my knowledge is properly tested on exams and the teacher can be rude when asking for help.

Went to his office hours seeking help.  Just talked down to me because I had trouble grasping the abstract concept of voltage (which everything is later built off of).  Asked for help on homework, and he didn't really tell me how to approach the problem.  Assigns readings, but doesn't clarify or add to understanding during lecture

Wouter is the right guy to teach this class. He's funny, engaging and easy to listen to so there's no reason not go to lecture. Everyone struggled with the short essays, but most people in this class didn't put in much effort. I mostly got A's except for the last one which I thought I deserved better on. Final exam was open laptop, open everything.
I'm a sociology major who hates science and math, but I thoroughly enjoyed taking his class. He makes things interesting and funny, and is very reasonable with the assignments and grading
Totally interesting and intelligent professor, who genuinely makes learning fun. Wish I was a physics major so I could have more classes with him.

Fairly easy-going class taught in a multifaceted and engaging manner that should offer something relevant for all learning styles. Essay grading is simple – if you got the concept and explained it, you got all the points; if you rushed through it and weren't creative in your response, you might get a low D. Wish we'd get more time for the exam.

Well, Wouter on his own is a good teacher. However Lanika does the majority of the work and grading for this class. Just a note it is IMPOSSIBLE to get a good grade in this class unless you have had some prior classes in physics/astron. Avg this sem. was 55%. However the curve is so high it doesn't matter. Going to class helps a lot.

He is teaching my astronomy class and he is one of the best professors I've had.  I'm sure he is equally as good in physics.  He is very funny and entertaining.  I would recommend this teacher to anyone.
Has a good sense of humor that helps make this boring topic more tolerable.  Really wants you to get it and tries hard.  Tests are still kind of killer, but has a good curve/grading policy.
Wouter is a great prof.  Class is fun, and he always has great alternative explanations if needed.

I like him so far.  He's a laid back guy who knows what he's talking about.  He likes to make sure you understand the concepts during lecture.  Doesn't focus a ton on math, since that's in the book anyway.  I like his sense of humor too.

Second semester physics is extremely abstract by its nature, but Prof. Montfrooij truly has a gift in making this material approachable. He relates new concepts such as electrostatics and magnetism to earlier material like gravity in such a way to make it

Unhelpful, difficult to reach, unclear grading and incredibly pretentious. Quizzes are worth a 3rd of your grade and made with the intention of failing students. Papers have instructions that aren't clear and then will be graded like you're in a masters program. I don't understand why he's a teacher, he does everything possible to make you fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: be ready to literally translate the language he uses in his exams, he try so hard to fail people that he uses extremely odd words, you can read the paragraph that should tells you the answer and still won't be able to understand the question. AVOID HIM AT ANY COST!

This is an easy class... to fail. Prof. Wright expects a knowledge of philosophy that you will not have from prerequisites. Tests are multiple choice, but the wording is intentionally difficult to understand. Most of the points are awarded at the end of the class. expectations are unclear and little guidance given.
Not helpful at all , avoid if you can
Grades horribly. Took online class and was based off of 2 essay exams. Doesn't even give partial credit. Do not recommend.
Didn't post grades till the very end of the the smester, I would not reccomend him to anyone.

Tim is a nice guy and the class is easy enough, but I at least found it to be boring.  Go to class, because you lose points if you don't, and he makes everything worth however many percentage points of your final grade.  He is at times a little difficult to understand, but you get the gist, and that is more than enough.
difficult to understand, does not clarify, late to class

I took the writing intensive version with her. There was an essay due almost every week, but you could knock it out in a day. She requires APA format on all papers and in text citations. She did not grade the essays extremely difficult and the tests were pretty straight forward from the textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Wybrant was really nice. Tests were very easy and assignments were definitely lots of writing but I received full credit on like all of them. Definitely would recommend!

She presents herself as a very empathetic, caring, and pro-learning person, but she doesn't employ much empathy when talking to students and grading their work. If students don't learn the exact way she teaches and thinks they should, then they won't be successful in her courses, in my experience.

Took this purely for credit but because I love writing, I actually enjoyed the class. Definitely lots of writing, as it is a writing intensive course, but pretty easy regarding the the content. Make sure and read the syllabus and directions for assignments VERY carefully.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She was the most theatrical grader ever. The drama. I couldn't believe the emails she sent. Also, no lectures?

She gives extra credit for papers being turned in by a reasonable deadline. It is writing-heavy, but the essays are three pages (but this can make it hard to answer all the prompts). She is helpful & polite in her emails, but it can take a couple of days for a reply. Sometimes her feedback differed from paper to paper despite the same format.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: 10-20% off for 1 small missed thing about a paper that didn't affect the material in the paper

Took this as a writing intensive online and the work was pretty fun but if you would ask her a question she would not answer you clearly or just tell you to look somewhere else which was very frustrating when I needed help on a specific thing
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Was an okay class. if you really needed to, you could put assignments off until its due but definitely not advised. Sometimes when i would email him a question he would come off snarky but overall not bad class/teacher. Pretty easy once you realize how he grades and the schedule hes on and what expects from you.

Does not communicate grading criteria well. Does not give any reasonable feedback before or after the assignment is submitted. Overall difficult to get along with. Student success is not a priority at all for this man.

Took his class online and it was super easy, maybe spent 1 hour a week on readings and taking the quiz. Only like 5 or 6 discussion boards all semester and don't have to read the book for quizzes bc its all on quizlet. Big part of your grade is a group project and my group had a ton of problems, and he was really understanding.

He was very bad at communicating due dates and expected criteria. Your main grades are group projects throughout the semester. When I reached out for help, he did not give me any helpful feedback and I was quite disappointed.
Yechan is a cool guy and really wants his students to succeed. He's definitely more helpful and easier to talk to than some of the other 1400 TA's.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Yechan was a solid College Algebra TA. Provided clear, exhaustive, example-driven instruction of some occasionally fairly complicated material. The course itself is pretty color-by-numbers, so if you attend most classes, do the homework, and review for tests and quizzes, you'll pass.
Really like Hong, just not as a prof
She encourages class discussion and will take the discussions out of the classroom and even give time in class to talk about local events that may be affecting her students. She is amazing!

Chun can be a very tough grader, I won't deny that. But if you do your reading, go to class, and make an effort to participate, you'll be okay. She can come off as being abrasive and judgmental about writing, but she means well and is actually gives very helpful feedback. Be prepared to blow through your printing quota,  it's a lot of paper!

I would highly recommend to not take this class. It is supposed to be an intro class for creative writing, but she grades as if our story should be good enough to publish tomorrow. She keeps you until the end of class for "discussion" even when it gets to the point of everyone just sitting there not talking. DO NOT TAKE.

Chun is a TOUGH grader. Your story is not good enough if it doesn't include teenage girl feelings, breakups, or sicktwisted people. She didn't like a guys paper so she chewed him out and said he was horrible and his paper was horrible. It was actually good. She is mean, not fair, and doesn't listen to what the students need. She also doesn't teach

Chun is a little hard to understand and the discussions can drag on and be a little boring. There are 10 quizzes all worth one point, a midterm, 3 papers, and a final.  All are very easy, however, she grades very hard on the papers.  Overall an easy class and an easy A if you do the work and participate in class.

He's incredibly boring and probably the most boring professor I ever had.  I only went to class cause I felt bad that no one else ever went.  His powerpoints are not engaging and look like screenshots of a word document.  I never listened to him and usually did other homework for another class and I did fine.  Lab is the time to actually learn.

He is very knowledgable in this area, his monotonous voice makes it hard to pay attention and actually learn anything. His textbook is printouts of his (single-spaced) slides, and you fill in the blanks. it doesn't help. Problem labs are the chance to ask questions, but you work with a program that doesn't have any connection to the homework.
The most boring lectures I've ever attended. Class isn't too hard to pass, but it's not enjoyable while doing so.
Attend lectures and go to problem labs. His lectures are really boring, but if you pay attention and do your work you, you will be fine.  Overall a fairly easy class as long as you put in the effort.
He is pretty dull but he really is interested in making sure his students understand. The first test is pretty easy but they get harder. I enjoyed his class. He's a nice guy.

He's old and clearly has no interest in teaching the class, maybe he did at some point. It is impossible to pay attention during class due to his monotonous, slow voice. Stay as far away from this class as possible.

He has you buy a workbook that are the notes for the entire semester. He has you fill in blanks in the notebook during lecture. After the first test you will feel like it is the easiest class at Mizzou but don't let it fool you. The class will get harder.

Made the class harder than an intro class should be and his lectures were no help. Make sure you go to the section lab and do the practice tests and you should be fine. He's super nice and willing to answer any questions, just not a great teacher

For most people taking this, Stats13000 is a gen ed requirement that you are dreading. So this just makes Prof. Wright even MORE boring. However, if you have no way around taking his class never fear! Go to ALL of your discussion classes and the TA will notice and bump up your grade. Plenty of HW to boost grade and GO TO THE REVIEW SESSIONS!

Very nice guy. Wants to help his students and is eager to answer any questions you may have. Go to the reveiws and sections that is where you will actually learn. His power points are useless. If he ran class like he did his section you would learn so much more.

Don't take this class without prior Statistics knowlege. If you need to take a basic stats class, take 1200. The handbook is totally useless, the only way you'll pass is by going to exam reviews, doing your online homework, and understanding asian TA's who cannot speak english. I got a Tutor and came out with a B, yet I got an A in calc. by myself.

the notebook full of his slides is completely useless, they make no sense and you go to lecture simply to fill in the blanks.  I stopped going to lecture and didnt do any worse on the tests.  GO TO REVIEWS, the practice tests are very similar to the real thing.  altogether confusing and boring class for material that isn't that difficult

Prof Wright is such a nice man. He really wants you to do well but the class is what you put into it. The TA's are terrible and barely speak english. I suggest getting a tutor! Homework and Online MyStatLab is important! Not too hard of a class but boring. Work hard and you can  def get an A!

For a basic statistics course I would recommend NOT taking stat 1300 with prof. wright. The class itself is not extremely challenging but the tests are rediculous and try to trick you. If you spend all of your time studying and are lucky with guessing- you'll probably be able to pull out an A or B, but good luck staying awake during the lectures!!!

This class was ridiculously hard.  I visited the professor during office hours and he showed no interest in assisting me.  I don't think he is deliberately mean, but I hated this semester because of his stats class.
Nice man, wants you to do well. I wouldn't recommend him though, the class was way harder than it should have been because of his teaching skills. Good luck, you'll need it...

Professor Wright is a really great teacher. His lectures are very easy to follow and the problem labs are EXTREMELY helpful. He does everything he can to help the students pass. Plus, he's just an adorable old man.

I hate this class.Makes it way harder then it should be. Speaks like a robot..almost seems he doesn't even take a second to breathe. This man should of retired 20 years ago. Plan on tutoring at least once a week. Frusterating when homework takes couple hours and is only worth 5 points. Oh yeah and good luck trying to understnad the TAs, all Asians

If you are enrolled in this class with faroll wright this is your warning to get out now!!!!!!  I am not kidding, this class will ruin your semester if your not a stat nerd like all the other students who posted previous comments. He is a horrible teacher and talks like a robot at 100mph. his notes are horrible, he is mono toned and needs to retire
Great professor! He is old, he was eager for students to learn and always kept the class laughing. Do the homework and look at old exams, easy A.
He's very helpful when you have questions, and he really wants students to do well. He seems like a really nice guy, my favorite professor!
Great teacher, funny!  class notes are a bit archaic but the exams are just like the practice exams and there should be no problem getting an A.

Awesome guy and very helpful. You ask any question he will help you with it. Very knowledgeable about the class. Class never lasts full time. Only a few assignments a semester ad they are not hard. Very fair grader and fun as can be. Would recommend to any major and any student.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: Professor Yildirim, while still new to teaching/lecturing, he is without a doubt a very fresh, and charismatic professor. He wants you to do well in his class and has no problem of further explaining materials that students are still unclear of. He does tend to go rather fast in lectures so pay attention and write fast. Great professor overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: Yildirim is really passionate about European politics. Excellent teacher! He explains things really well and is always available for extra help. Attendance isnt mandatory but he gives a lot of extra credit and you dont need to read if you attend. Class almost never goes the full 50 minutes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Amazing and fun professor! Very personal!

smart man, horrible professor. if you even have wifi issues and can't connect to class(covid), he won't give you access to the recordings. Does not care about his students at all. ignores emails. will do problems wrong in class. you will hear him say umm more times than relevant information. if you can take it with someone else or avoid the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I am currently taking Quant with him and he is the worst teacher I have ever had. Will record the lectures and then not allow us access to them. Asked him to slow down a bit since he did not give us access to the recordings. He said keep up. Will spend more time telling you theres no time than it would take for him to go over whats asked. AVOID HIM
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was actually pretty fun. The first half of it was stuff I think most people learned in high school biology (punnet squares and meiosis and stuff like that), but the second half was a little more challenging. Yimmy will keep your attention, though.

Yimmy is the coolest TA ever. Make sure to take the lab with him; you're doing yourself a favor. I learned an unbelievable amount of information in the lab, and he's really helpful. He has a sense of humor so lab is never boring. Great guy!

Yimmy was awesome. I was worried about having yet another TA, but he was really pro at teaching and super helpful when you were confused during a lab. He uses funny voices sometimes, but you get used to it.

What a fun and enlightening class! Se Yong was great at picking topics that genuinely changed my perspective on issues and fostering discussion during class. This was the first philosophy course I took at Mizzou, so the essays really helped me refine my writing for future classes. Take this course, whether you're majoring in philosophy or not!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He is very fun, absolutely excellent at fostering conversation and debate while still remaining neutral. While the readings can be difficult at times, they are great at making you think critically about the issues covered.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Se Yong is the salt of the earth, one of the kindest people I've ever met for sure. He's a very good thinker and leads great, thought provoking conversations. The grading rubric on the exams is a bit ambiguous, but as long as you keep up with the readings and the in-class discussions you should do just fine. Definitely take his class if you can

I took Professor Bae's class on Contemporary Moral Issues and I truly enjoyed his teaching style. The class is led mainly by student led discussion with Bae jumping in occasionally to offer counter arguments or pose the student to think deeper about their beliefs. I would recommend this class to anyone who enjoys class led discussions.

This lady is the sweetest lady ever! She is genuinely passionate about her work and does a great job showing it! This is such a well-structured class, and sets you up for success! Class is open note quizzes, learning reflections and discussion posts! Highly recommend, and this teacher deserves all the hype!

lots of assignments but all were easy points maybe except quizzes. quiz questions were straight forward but you had to watch the recordings to get them right. she responded all my emails immediately and was helpful. subjects were interesting.

I had her online and maybe it's bc of that, that I hated this class but this was the worst 8 weeks of my life. Her grading is harsh because she'll ask one thing and mean another. She does care about the class topic, but when asking her questions about the quiz she can be passive aggressive and doesn't really answer the question.

She is so fun and while there is a lot of lectures to listen to, she has let us go from class early, she always goes over material that we don't understand, and she reviews what will be on the test! This was a huge lecture hall class, but it was very easy to approach her or even just email her. She really cares and she is really funny!

This class was one of the easiest classes I have ever taken at Mizzou. She gave so much extra credit and exams were all multiple choice. She reviews in class the material that is on the test. She's also hilarious and a really fun professor.

i love yonca cam. she is so funny and has dry humor if you like that. she is approachable and will offer to help students when they need it. her class is very easy and tests follow study guides and review sessions. she gives a lot of extra credit oppurtuinites so as long as you are putting in the effort it is easy to get an A. go to class tho.

My favorite class all semester. Lots of notes/memorization, but overall an easy class if you have the work ethic. She was an awesome professor as well and made coming to class very fun. I would definitely recommend her and I would take her again if I could!

She gives out a crazy amount of extra credit and makes the exams very easy. It is hard to get a B in this class. Most people I know had well over 100%. She is also very funny in a millennial way, always showing funny videos like a dog dancing or something.
Dr. Yoon is a very kind and understanding professor. The lectures aren't always the most interesting, but his humor helps make it bearable. He also prepares the students very well for exams. 10/10

I really enjoy Dr. Yoon. He is a very considerate professor with a true passion for teaching. The lectures are a bit lengthy when online because it's a 2 1/2 hour long course. However, he does a great job preparing you for the exams. Exams are open note and he provides a lot of assistance. Very understanding and enjoyable. I suggest Dr. Yoon.

You will succeed by adopting a self pace method. All info needed for tests are on his powerpoints (recorded & uploaded lectures to canvas). Very helpful & easy to reach out via email. He is very nice and gives study guides for tests. Tests are open note and you have a couple of days to complete the tests. Grades come from Group Projects & Tests.

Dr. Yoon was one of my favorite professors at Mizzou! He's nice and funny. He doesn't give a ton of work. He also wants you to learn the material. The tests are easy because he gives a study guide with the answers on them. He's a fair grader. He takes attendance, but it wasn't factored into our final grade. He lectures a lot, but they're on Canvas.
Yoon is an incredibly smart person. Always willing to help. He is very passionate! However, use your cohort as a reference, because it helps to process with other people.

I really like Yoon's class but at times it can be a bit boring. It is a really easy class as far as assignments go with only a few tests and projects. Attendance is not mandantory and the textbook is not needed. If you don't understand something, ask him! He is such a nice guy and is extremely smart. He is always willing to help!
Reads directly off the powerpoint without giving any explanation for what he's reading. Lots of group assignments.

TAKE THIS PROFESSOR! I am not an art history major (I am an entomology student) but took this class out of necessity for credits. Absolutely amazing lectures - every class is like a Ted Talk. Super engaging. As long as you show up / watch all of the lectures you will pass easily. Only graded on four papers and midterm and final. Seriously the best!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Michael Yonan is an incredible professor. His lectures are so interesting. Take good notes, study for tests, and go to his office hours and get to know him. If you go ask him for feedback on your papers, he will take the time and thoroughly go over what you did wrong, what you should emphasize, etc. He is awesome!!

I really enjoyed Dr. Yonan's class! I'm not an art history major/minor so I had some catching up to do but the class itself was enjoyable. It is writing intensive but as long as you follow the rubric and hit up the writing center you should definitely pass. No tests, just two papers and two in-class writing assignments.

Definitely plays favorites for art history students, and while participation in discussion is part of your grade he typically only calls on art history majors. If you're a fine arts major or art education major, don't take his class.

Don't be fooled by his syllabus. He only states attendance yet at the end of the year he knocked down my grade for not talking in class (in a 50+ person lecture!) This guy definitely plays favorites and he only called on a handful of students all the time. I got high grades on all the papers and tests, but his lectures are extremely boring.

He is a really great teacher.  He is always helpful and really presents a new way to study art history.  His classes aren't about memorization, like most art history courses, but rather about discussion.  This has been the first and only class I've ever had where discussion has actually helped me learn.
Loved This Class. Super Informative And Super Interesting. Dr. Yonan Has Well Organized Lectures And Maintains Interest In Class.

just started teached here from slu - really good teacher. simple class assignments, tests are exactly what he says they will be. very open to you coming by his office-- make an appointment first though!!

Very nice guy and a very easy grader. Attending class will come with random extra credit days. Nearly impossible to fail his class if you give just 10% effort. Would highly recommend, as he is always willing to give feedback in office hours. Exams were tough, but graded very leniently.

I actually took Dynamics 2600 with him, but that wasn't an option in the settings. This is my first time typing a review, it's that urgent. Listen to me. AVOID THIS PROFESSOR AT ALL COSTS. He is the worst lecturer I've ever had, to the point that most students gave up listening to him at all during class, and the homework is often impossibly hard.

Yuyi does not teach to his exams or homework.Any problems you are given in the class (including exams) are pulled directly from the textbook.The problems from the book require outside information to solve them as there are some sections that don't provide any equations or relevant material properties to the questions you will be asked to solve.
Easy grader and gives lots of feedback, funny guy too.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests? Not many

reviews.comment: don't learn anything from Lin. his notes are disorganized on Canvas.
You may get an A and you don't understand anything from the class. I don't know why the department thinks this course is not important !!

Do whatever you can to aviod taking Mech 1 with Lin.  He is very difficult to understand, his teaching is sub-par, and his homeworks are impossible.  The only upside is he passes almost everybody.  You will not learn anything from this class. It is a complete waste of time.  Winholtz teaches this in the spring, take him.

Lin's lectures are very boring, monotone, and not engaging.  This is one of those classes that you finish without feeling like you've really learned anything.  It can be frustrating.  On a plus side, he practically guarantees a B if you finish the homework and tests with at least a little effort.

this ws the first semester he taught this course and he sucked.  he is a smart man however he cannot teach. he makes up for it with light grading however the homewrok while short becomes lengthy due to unfamiliarity with subject matter.  If your taking this class you dont have a choice. he is the only one who teaches it. Sorry. he has thick accent.
Great teacher

Zach is a kind and caring professor who makes lecture material very easy to grasp, and makes the hands on activities feel easy and comfortable. Theatre 1320 was a lot of fun, and I would recommend to anyone looking to gain some stage building or just general architectural experience

Zach is a really cool guy, and this class is pretty easy. In this class you learn about tools and help to build the plays for that semester. The class time is usually spent working, but there are lectures about tools or materials usually something like once a week. the class does have mandatory outside work, but if you show up you should get an A

The few lectures he gives are extraordinarily vague and badly designed. Any instructions given are so unclear that even the TA gets frustrated. He is easily distracted and then angered by this distraction, and he shows frustration towards students. Even experienced students struggle to understand what he asks of us. Out of class hours are required.
Beast, genuinely cared abut his students and his course. Encouraged participation and treated us like friends.

Best teacher I've had in recent memory, leads discussions in a way that inspires conversation and discourse like no teacher I've had. For me, this method of teaching content really helped me retain information compared to other lecture/discussion style classes I've been in. Very funny and easy to get along with. Phenomenal teacher and person.
Really easy going and willing to help. Makes class fun and listens to students.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Zach is a great teacher. He is passionate and knowledgeable about Star Wars, and politics. The classes are always exciting and I never wanted to skip class. Weekly homework reflected what we went over each class that week. Our only other grades were a midterm and final essay. I highly suggest this specific class and any other class taught by Zach.
He did a great job teaching such a unique class. Very knowledgeable and able to explain the concepts in a way the whole class can understand.
Great teacher great class.
